listings.remarks: Welcome to your downtown retreat! The Chesterfield is a highly desirable, gated community offering two pools, 24-hour security, and beautifully manicured grounds, all within walking distance of everything downtown Stamford has to offer. This spacious and newly renovated 1-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhouse is filled with natural light and boasts an ideal layout. Step into the front foyer with new hardwood flooring throughout and enter a bright, modern kitchen featuring quartz countertops, vaulted ceilings, and contemporary finishes. The kitchen is fully equipped with new appliances, including a dishwasher, microwave, stove, and refrigerator. A formal dining room, which could also serve as an office, leads into a large living room with a wood-burning fireplace and sliders to a private deck-perfect for outdoor relaxation and entertaining. Upstairs, a skylit loft offers a cozy sitting area, while the primary bedroom includes three closets, one of which is a walk-in with a new closet system. The spacious en-suite bath features double sinks. Conveniently located on the second floor is a laundry area with new front-loading washer and dryer. The unit includes parking for two cars, offering the perfect combination of city convenience and suburban comfort!

As one of the area's premier entertainment venues, the theatre consistently draws large audiences for concerts, comedy shows, and live performances, with patrons gathering in the courtyard before and after events-creating a steady, built-in stream of foot traffic right outside your door.  Perfectly situated along the crosswalk connecting Atlantic Street to Summer Street, this space benefits from constant pedestrian visibility and seamless access between two of downtown's most active corridors. Surrounded by popular restaurants, local businesses, and the nearby shopping mall, the location offers an energetic atmosphere ideal for a wide range of retail or service concepts.  The approximately 550 square feet of renovated retail space is currently operating as a bubble tea shop, featuring a clean, modern layout that can be adapted to suit your vision. In addition, the property includes approximately 400 square feet of basement storage, providing valuable support space for inventory and operations.

Beautifully renovated, spacious, and sun-filled condo located in the heart of downtown. Rich dark engineered wood floors run throughout, complementing a stylish kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances, white cabinetry, black granite countertops, and a convenient breakfast bar.  The expansive living area offers endless possibilities for entertaining, along with a perfect nook for a home office setup. Sliding doors lead to a private balcony-an ideal spot to unwind and enjoy city views.  The generously sized primary bedroom includes two large closets, while the updated full bathroom offers dual access from both the bedroom and the foyer. A foyer closet conveniently houses the in-unit washer and dryer.  Notable upgrades include engineered wood flooring (2016), a new heating and air conditioning system (2017), a kitchen renovation along with new bathroom cabinetry (2020), new washer and dryer (2024).  Residents enjoy exceptional amenities, including a penthouse-level fitness center, lounge, and a glass-enclosed heated pool for year-round enjoyment. A third-floor outdoor patio provides space for grilling, relaxing, or spending time with your pet.  With a full-time concierge, assigned parking, and all your favorite shops, dining, and entertainment just steps away, this condo offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and city living.

listings.remarks: Chic 2-Bed / 2-Bath Condo in Gated Palmer Hill - 77 Havemeyer Ln Unit 313.  Welcome to this stylish, turn-key 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo in the coveted gated Palmer Hill community - a perfectly located home in Stamford that blends comfort, convenience, and a touch of resort-style living. With about 1,100 sq ft of thoughtfully designed space, this unit delivers both everyday ease and elevated finishes.  Step inside to a bright, open-plan layout where the gourmet kitchen - complete with stainless steel appliances and marble or quartz countertops - flows seamlessly into the dining and living areas. The living room easily doubles as an entertaining hub or cozy retreat, and sliding out onto your private balcony takes "relax at home" to the next level.  The primary suite is coupled with a roomy walk-in closet and a full bathroom featuring double-vanity, whirlpool/shower setup, and direct access to the balcony. Access to all Palmer Hill amenities including pool, club house, exercise room, hot and under garage parking.

listings.remarks: Welcome to this brand-new townhouse in Stamford's exclusive 14 Taylor Street, a thoughtfully designed 13-unit luxury development. This 2 bedroom, 1.5 bath home showcases an open-concept living and dining area filled with natural light, complemented by gleaming hardwood floors, recessed lighting, and a modern kitchen with white shaker cabinetry, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and gas cooking. The upper level offers a spacious primary bedroom, a bright second bedroom, and a beautifully appointed full bath, while the main level includes a convenient half bath. Additional features include central air, efficient gas heating, an attached 1-car garage with the option for an EV charger, and a contemporary design throughout. Ideally situated within walking distance to Metro North for a quick commute to NYC and just seconds from I-95, this townhouse also provides easy access to Downtown Stamford, Stamford Hospital, shops, restaurants, and major highways-delivering modern comfort paired with exceptional convenience.

Free Heat, Hot Water & Cooking Gas! Large Renovated 1 Bedroom 1 Bath Condo at The Crosswinds! Kitchen with Granite Counter tops & Stainless Steel Appliances. Hardwood Floors Thru-out. Large Private Deck. One reserved covered parking space. Shared Laundry on Floor. Great Elevator building just a short walk to Downtown.

facts.laundry: Coin Op Laundry,Common Laundry Area,Main Level

listings.remarks: Location, location, location! Enjoy affordable living just steps from Cove Island Park in this spacious first-floor (stairs) two-bedroom, one-bath apartment. The home features a large eat-in kitchen, a sizable light-filled living room, and plenty of storage with multiple closets throughout. Two well apportioned bedrooms! Additional highlights include in-building laundry and off-street parking for two cars. A fantastic opportunity to live close to the beach, park, and appreciate all the facilities that the area has to offer: Life is sweet!!

Standalone 3 Room Office with walk up attic (partially finished) on high trafficked Long Ridge Rd. Position your business in a polished, turnkey office with exceptionally low overhead and predictable monthly costs. This 1,072 SF office space is designed for operators who want to focus on their business-not building management-just minutes from downtown and easy access to the Merritt Parkway. Featuring three hard-walled private offices, a full kitchen, and a private 1/2 bathroom. Ground-level access and 10 dedicated off-street parking spaces further enhance usability for both clients and staff. Cost efficiency is a core advantage. The modified-gross lease includes water, property taxes, insurance, common area maintenance, landscaping & snow removal. Tenants are responsible only for separately metered electric. High traffic location with strong regional access, and hands-off ownership make this a low-stress, high-efficiency workspace rarely available at this price point.

Cove Beach Stamford sunny and spacious 2-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom townhome in Stamford's desirable Cove neighborhood. This newly renovated townhome boasts a generous floor plan with stylish updates throughout on three levels. The updated eat-in kitchen w/ stainless steel appliances flows seamlessly into the warm, light and inviting living and dining areas, featuring gleaming hardwood floors. The sliders from the kitchen open to a private deck and fenced-in beautifully landscaped yard that's perfect for outdoor dining or relaxation and all on the main level. Upstairs you'll find nice-sized bedrooms with wall-to-wall carpeting, providing comfort and coziness and a spectacular view of Cove beach which is a short distance away. The large entry level w/ceramic tile has additional space that's ideal for an office, den, recreation room, or playroom. It also has the washer dryer and storage on this entry level. Central air conditioning and off-street parking for two cars. Beautiful yard with deck & mature plantings make this picture perfect. Situated just steps away from Cove Island Park, residents have beach rights and enjoy easy access to the beach, park facilities, tennis courts, and convenient location to trains and highway - a commuter's delight! Don't miss the opportunity to move right-in to this beautiful townhome!

Step into a fresh take on downtown Stamford living. This newly remodeled 2-bedroom, 1-bath upstairs apartment delivers charm, comfort, and everyday convenience in one sleek package. With a bright, spacious living area and off-street parking, you'll enjoy the rare luxury of stress-free city living-just steps from Stamford's best dining, shopping, and nightlife.

Welcome to Schooner Cove, a beautifully landscaped waterfront community with a private marina in the Shippan area of Stamford. This classy ground-floor unit with gorgeous LVT floors throughout has been tastefully and stylishly updated. The kitchen showcases stainless steel appliances, under cabinet lighting and quartz countertops, and flows effortlessly into the dining area and spacious living room. The living area, with a cozy wood-burning fireplace and ceiling to floor windows is an inviting place for relaxing and entertaining. A dry bar and automated window shades are a wonderful addition to this space. A slider door from here to a private patio is also a wonderful spot for morning coffee The main level boasts a generously sized bedroom with a private and renovated ensuite bath, along with a convenient half bath and laundry facilities. Upstairs, there is an additional bedroom with another ensuite bathroom. Schooner Cove also has a gated swimming pool with toilets and picnic tables. Heat and water are included in the monthly rent. Come and enjoy a hassle-free waterfront living experience.

Don't miss this Springdale Special.... Bright & airy townhouse with open floorplan in desirable upper-Springdale neighborhood. Convenient to Parkway and Darien. Beautiful hardwood floors, washer/dryer, storage and 2 reserved parking spaces.

Luxury Manhattan-style living in the heart of downtown Stamford. Spacious, updated 12th-floor unit with open floor plan, abundant closets, and private terrace. Granite kitchen with stainless steel appliances and in-unit washer/dryer. Enjoy The Classic's 24/7 concierge, fitness center, rooftop pool, and dog park with grills and picnic area. Secure underground parking (#216) included. Walk to restaurants, shopping, and entertainment, with easy access to Metro-North and major highways. Water and gas cooking included. Excellent credit is a must. First month's rent and two months' security.

Highly sought-after residence in a full-service lifestyle community featuring an in-ground swimming pool, on-site fitness center, and professional property management. This beautifully updated unit offers a modern kitchen with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances, complemented by luxury vinyl tile flooring in the main living areas, ceramic tile in the kitchen, and carpeting in the bedroom. A spacious wardrobe closet and extended hallway provide exceptional storage rarely found in similar units. Included with the home are one reserved parking space and one guest parking permit. Heat, hot water, and cooking gas are included in the rent-delivering outstanding value. Ideally located near downtown, Metro-North, and premier shopping, dining, and entertainment. Properties in this building lease quickly. Qualified applicants are encouraged to apply promptly. Refundable $500 building deposit required. Minimum credit score of 700 required. Available February 2nd.

listings.remarks: Renovated inside and out. 4-5 bedroom 3 full bath. Great location, walk to everything. Full basement. Finished Attic. 2-3 Off street assigned parking spaces. Brand new 2 zone HVAC system. Siding, roof, bathrooms, kitchen also brand new.

Set on 31.76 acres and thoughtfully subdivided into three distinct lots, this exceptional offering sits along the border of Greenwich, delivering a rare blend of scale, serenity, and convenience. Each parcel offers its own unique character: Lot 1 captures sweeping vistas and breathtaking sunrise views 6.22, while Lots 2 and 3 feature over 18.82 acres and 6.71 acres of beautifully level land. The property is further enhanced by bordering the protected 900+ acre Mianus River Gorge Preserve, ensuring enduring privacy and a stunning natural backdrop. Whether you envision a private compound, equestrian estate, or a refined country retreat, this is a canvas of remarkable potential. A walk of the land reveals the true scale and beauty an opportunity that must be experienced to be fully appreciate Perfectly positioned just 12 minutes to downtown Greenwich and 20 minutes to Stamford, you'll enjoy effortless access to premier dining, shopping, and Metro-North train service--while returning home to complete tranquility. A rare chance to create something extraordinary in one of Fairfield County's most coveted settings.

For Sale in Professional Office Building! Hard to find office condo for Medical practice, or other professionals, surrounded by complementary health practitioners. Office is ideally positioned off entry foyer, closest for easiest patient and client access from parking lot. Outstanding location across the street from Stamford Hospital's Tully Health Center, close to downtown. Looking to expand or start new, with benefits of ownership instead of leasing, this could be the opportunity. Also excellent investment property!

Fantastic opportunity to customize this space to suit your vision. Currently used as hair salon and ideally suited for similar venture or other retail types of uses. It offers approximately 600 sq.ft. of open space, high ceilings and a private restroom. Post Road location with high traffic and strong visibility. It is surrounded by a variety of businesses and amenities. This location is attractive and convenient from highway, public transportation, nearby residents and walk-ins. Zoned C-L (limited commercial district) Tenant must perform their diligence and is responsible for improvements and renovations. Flexible lease- Excellent credit score and job history is a must.

Welcome to this exceptionally spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence offering 1,732 square feet at The Buckingham, a classic luxury condominium known for its timeless elegance and full-service living. With proportions rarely found in downtown condos, this home lives more like a single-family residence, featuring an expansive living area, a true separate dining room, and a thoughtfully designed layout ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The bright, well-appointed kitchen offers white inset shaker cabinetry, granite countertops, and ample storage, flowing seamlessly into the main living areas. Both bedrooms are generously sized, including a large primary suite with excellent closet space, while two full bathrooms add comfort and flexibility. A private balcony extends the living space and brings in natural light. Two dedicated garage parking spaces are included, a rare and valuable convenience in downtown Stamford. Residents enjoy a premier amenity package including a 24-hour doorman, elegant library, fitness center, community room, and a heated in-ground pool-all within a meticulously maintained building. Perfectly located just steps from Stamford's vibrant downtown, you'll enjoy an easy walk to restaurants, nightlife, shopping, Target, and the Tully Center, along with convenient access to transportation. A rare opportunity to own a truly oversized, luxury condo in the heart of the city.

Welcome to your next chapter in this delightful three-bedroom residence that perfectly blends comfort with functionality. This inviting two-story home offers approximately 2,000 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, ready for you to make your own. Enter and discover gorgeous hardwood floors that flow throughout, creating warmth and elegance in every room. The main level features a spacious living room anchored by a cozy fireplace, ideal for those chilly Connecticut evenings when you want nothing more than to curl up with a good book. The adjacent dining room provides the perfect setting for memorable meals with guests. One of this home's clever surprises is a main-level bedroom that could easily transform into a home office, giving you flexibility for today's lifestyle. Upstairs, you'll find the generous primary bedroom alongside a third bedroom, both offering comfortable retreats at day's end. The full bathroom features both a tub and shower, accommodating everyone's preferences. Outside, a covered porch invites relaxing weekends, while the garden area awaits your green thumb ambitions. Situated on a level corner lot, you'll enjoy easy maintenance and excellent curb appeal. Location enthusiasts will appreciate being just moments from Trader Joe's for your grocery runs, with abundant dining and shopping options nearby. Nature lovers can explore the nearby Stamford Museum and Nature Center, and commuters will value the convenient access to the Merritt Parkway.

Short walk to the Springdale Train Station from this 3 bedroom 2 bath rental, and also close to the Merritt Parkway. Enjoy the Panoramic view from the Living Room picture window that looks out over Deck and rear of the property. You can even see LI Sound. Primary Bedroom with en suite bath. The two other bedrooms share the hallway full bath. Eat-in Kitchen, 1 Car Garage, partial basement and attic storage. This is in the Heart Of Springdale with fine restaurants, shopping, skating rink, library and so much more. Freshly painted, brand new Dishwasher and Range/Stove. Very good credit score required. Disclosure: During some months of the year after heavy rain, water can seep into the basement through sections of the wall, specifically behind the washer and dryer and below the storage shelves to the right of the staircase. This can result in standing water. I provide a shop vacuum for tenant use, but any items susceptible to water damage should not be placed directly on the basement floor.
Fabulous Ranch close to everything! 3 bedrm, 2 full bath, 2 fireplaces, Living rm, New Kitchen, Great rm, Patio, level backyard, garage with private driveway.

Welcome to Linden House. This gleaming, large and very nicely updated one bedroom ground floor garden apartment has it all. Filled with natural light, with rich hardwood floors throughout and recent renovations for a modern touch this a great rental opportunity. Add the use of a storage room, an assigned parking spot, a Coin Op Laundry and Heat, Cooking Gas and Hot water included in the rent, what more could you want? Well-manicured grounds featuring mature flowering trees and shrubs that enchant in every season. Conveniently located in close proximity to Glenbrook rail station. Explore Stamford Downtown's vibrant offerings or travel to New York City effortlessly via Metro North or car. Good credit history and references are a MUST. Strictly no pets.

This light, bright and spacious stone-front colonial features gracious, well proportioned rooms, hardwood floors, large windows, French doors and central air-conditioning. Beautiful sun-filled entry foyer, formal dining room and living room with fireplace, lovely sunroom flanked with windows, eat-in-kitchen and office or playroom complete the first flr. The second floor includes a large primary bedroom w/bath, dressing area, double closet. Two additional bedrooms and hall bath complete the main second floor, Another en-suite bedroom/bath provide additional comfort. A full basement is great for storage. handicap accessible.

Harbor View Auto Sales LLC presents a strong, well-established opportunity for a buyer seeking both retail and service income streams. The business has been successfully operating for many years as a used car dealership, complemented by a highly profitable and reputable service department. In addition to steady vehicle sales, the service side of the business provides consistent, recurring revenue and a loyal customer base. The sale also includes a large inventory of Matco tools, offering significant added value for an incoming owner. Harbor View Auto Sales benefits from a reliable flow of used vehicle sales and a solid presence in the local market, making it an ideal turnkey operation with proven performance and growth potential.

Beautiful modern studio apartment in the heart of Stamford within minutes of the Springdale train station, and shopping. Gated parking with a reserved space. Stacked washer and dryer in the apartment. Only one month's security deposit.

" Love Where You Live" The Lafayette, Stamford's Newest Modern Building - Offering Bright Large Studios, Sleek & Spacious One and Two Bedroom Apartments. Showcasing European style cabinets, oversized windows, stone countertops and breakfast bar, + the convenience of an in-unit washer & dryer. Elevate your experience with an urban oasis on the expansive rooftop terrace with a variety of social spaces, from the lounge, to the dining and recreation areas - it's truly an awesome place to relax! The Lafayette features everything from a communal lounge to a dog wash, smart-building access, gym, and separate play area, plus secure parking. The Lafayette is located in a vibrant neighborhood of downtown Stamford & a quick stroll to restaurants and night life.  "Love Where You Live!"

" Love Where You Live" The Lafayette, Stamford's Newest Modern Building - Offering Bright Large Studios, Sleek & Spacious One and Two Bedroom Apartments. Showcasing European style cabinets, oversized windows, stone countertops and breakfast bar, + the convenience of an in-unit washer & dryer. Elevate your experience with an urban oasis on the expansive rooftop terrace with a variety of social spaces, from the lounge, to the dining and recreation areas - it's truly an awesome place to relax! The Lafayette features everything from a communal lounge to a dog wash, smart-building access, gym, and separate play area, plus secure parking. The Lafayette is located in a vibrant neighborhood of downtown Stamford & a quick stroll to restaurants and night life.  "Love Where You Live!"

Stunning & Modern extra large 1 Bedroom apartment in the heart of Springdale within walking distance of the Springdale train station, and shopping. Gated parking with a reserved space,. Spacious one bedroom apartment with modern s/s appliances. Stacked washer and dryer in the unit. Only one month's security deposit. Central air, walk-in closets, large bathroom & sunny & spacious through-out! Please no pets & good credit a must!

Live the way you want at NV @ Harbor Point, where location, community, and quality of living all come together! Take advantage of luxury living with a 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom apartment for rent. This spacious floor plan, providing natural light throughout, is perfect for those seeking more space to live and work at home. The residence offers ample closet space. NV @ Harbor Point offers beautifully appointed finishes and stainless-steel appliances, including a dishwasher, gas range/stove, in-unit full size washer and dryer. Experience resort-style living with 24- hour concierge, gym with cutting-edge cardio and weight-training equipment, swimming pool, outdoor fire pits, around the clock workspace, covered parking, shuttle to train, complimentary water taxi and more. Direct access to public parks, marinas, boardwalk, restaurants offering al fresco dining and 200+ events planned year-round, including everything from yoga on the boardwalk and 5K races to farmers markets, seasonal pop-ups and more.... 16 month lease.

listings.remarks: Live at Your Own Tempo at Anthem.  Anthem is a consciously crafted residential building designed to inspire a shift in mindset, allowing you to live life at your own rhythm. Each apartment is thoughtfully designed with neutral tones, rich textures, and high-quality materials, creating a serene and sophisticated living space. Full-size stainless-steel appliances, open floor plans, private balconies, quartz and stone countertops, wood floors, and walk-in closets provide the perfect canvas to make the space your own.  With layouts and shared spaces designed for connection, Anthem offers curated amenities that elevate everyday living. Entertain effortlessly with a resort-style pool featuring cabanas, outdoor lounges, fire pits, and grilling and dining areas. Unwind in the lobby lounge and game area, stay productive in the communal workspaces, or refine your swing in the virtual golf simulator. Find balance in the fitness center with a yoga studio and meditation room, relax in the spa with a dry sauna, and enjoy conveniences like a pet spa, bicycle storage and repair room, and climate-controlled storage.  At Anthem, every space is designed to complement your lifestyle, offering a home where you can truly live, gather, and thrive.

listings.remarks: Experience Luxury Waterfront Living at The Beacon at Harbor Point  Discover Stamford's premier luxury waterfront high-rise, The Beacon at Harbor Point. Offering beautifully appointed finishes, each residence features stainless steel appliances, a gas cooktop, quartz countertops, a full-size in-unit washer and dryer, and spacious open layouts designed for modern living.  Enjoy resort-style amenities, including a 24-hour concierge, a state-of-the-art fitness center with cutting-edge cardio and weight-training equipment, a game room with billiards, a swimming pool, and outdoor fire pits for relaxation. Take in breathtaking views from the observatory deck 22 stories up, work from the around-the-clock workspace, and take advantage of the shuttle service to the train and a complimentary water taxi for seamless connectivity.  Located in the heart of Harbor Point, The Beacon provides direct access to public parks, marinas, and a scenic boardwalk. Experience a vibrant community with over 200 events year-round, including yoga on the boardwalk, 5K races, outdoor movies, farmers markets, seasonal pop-ups, and more.  Live where luxury meets lifestyle at The Beacon at Harbor Point

listings.remarks: This completely renovated 1-bedroom apartment sits in the heart of Downtown Stamford, where modern style meets unbeatable convenience. This bright and inviting unit features an open, airy layout with tons of natural light throughout. The fully updated interior has contemporary finishes, hardwood flooring and brand-new kitchen & bathroom. The unit includes oversized closets and a designated parking spot. Walking distance to restaurants, coffee shops, stores and entertainment-Not to be missed!

Spacious units in the heart of Stamford with plenty of closet space! Rent includes heat, hot water, cooking gas, and water, plus amenities like a dog park and playground. Free application via specific application link. Security deposit is placed within 24 hours of approval. Requirements: 620+ credit score, income of 2.5x the rent with stubs, and no evictions-no exceptions. Laundry is in the building, and assigned parking is available for $100/month per car.

Bright and professional office space available in the heart of downtown Stamford. This 1100 sq ft first-floor suite is located in a charming colonial-style building, offering a warm and inviting atmosphere for your business. The layout includes 4 rooms, ideal for offices or meeting spaces, along with one and a half bathrooms and a convenient kitchenette area. The space is equipped with central air for year-round comfort and includes on-site parking for added convenience. Perfect for small businesses, professional services, or creative workspaces looking for a well-located and character-filled setting with easy access to downtown amenities, restaurants, and transportation.

listings.remarks: Rare 3.75-Acre Builder Opportunity on W Hill Road Exceptional opportunity to own 3.75 private acres in one of the area's most prestigious and sought-after locations-W Hill Road. This unique property features an existing 4,400 sq ft main residence plus a separate 900 sq ft cottage, offering endless possibilities for builders, investors, or end-users seeking a private estate setting. The current home presents a prime rehab opportunity with substantial square footage, solid footprint, and the potential to transform into a luxury showpiece. The detached cottage is ideal for guest quarters, rental income, or on-site living during construction. For developers, the expansive parcel offers subdivision potential to create up to three additional home sites. Surrounded by high-end properties and set in an enclave, this is a rare chance to build new luxury homes in a premier location with strong resale value. land, privacy, and prime positioning make this a standout investment. Endless possibilities - renovate, build new, or develop. Opportunities like this on W Hill Road are few and far between. Tenant-occupied. Please do not walk the property or disturb tenants. All showings require confirmed appointment .Tenant-occupied. Please do not walk the property or disturb tenants. All showings require confirmed appointment

Welcome to your new urban oasis in the heart of Stamford! This 2 bedroom, 1.5 bath condo offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience, nestled in a quiet neighborhood just a stone's throw from the vibrant Bedford Street area. Step into the kitchen with stainless steel appliances, a charming breakfast bar, gleaming hardwood floors and crown molding throughout. Forget cramped closets - the primary bedroom boasts a large walk-in closet, while the secondary bedroom features not one, but two closets! Speaking of closets, there are two additional large closets to store more of your personal items located in the lower level that will absolutely WOW you. Yearning for some fresh air? Say hello to two private balconies, your ideal spot to savor your morning coffee or unwind after a long day. Central air and an attached garage complete the full package. Amenities include: Fitness Center, clean coin-op laundry room, indoor access to garage Lobby and Courtyard Garden. Pictures taken prior to occupancy. Occupied by Tenant in place until June, 2026

listings.remarks: If You've Been Looking for a Beautifully Updated Rental Close to the Beach - Your Search Is Over! Just moments from the Cove, this sun-filled 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom rental offers 1,400 square feet of thoughtfully updated living space in a prime coastal location. Step inside to a bright, airy interior designed with comfort and style in mind. The sleek kitchen features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and abundant cabinetry, with space for a dining table-perfect for everyday meals or casual entertaining. The living area provides a warm and inviting atmosphere, ideal for relaxing, hosting guests, or enjoying quiet evenings at home. Natural light fills every room, highlighting the clean modern finishes and thoughtful layout throughout. Enjoy easy access to the beach, walking and running trails, picnic areas, tennis courts, a skating rink, and the marina overlooking Long Island Sound. With I-95, the train station, Chelsea Piers, and downtown Stamford all just minutes away, convenience is at your doorstep. Don't miss your chance to live near the coast in a beautifully updated home that offers both comfort and a vibrant lifestyle.

Timeless and charming, this home-originally built as a dairy farm in 1925-has been thoughtfully expanded and updated for modern living, offering over 5,000 sq ft of beautifully finished space on nearly one acre of private, park-like property.A welcoming wraparound porch invites you in, where hardwood floors throughout and fresh interior paint create a move-in ready feel. Generous room sizes and a seamless flow blend classic character with refined comfort. The warm country kitchen features rich wood cabinetry, granite countertops, center island, built-in window seat, and a spacious breakfast area, opening to a step-down family room with gas fireplace, wet bar, and French doors to a skylit sunroom. A separate staircase leads to a private guest suite with bedroom, sitting area, and full bath, while the main staircase leads to four spacious bedrooms, including a primary suite with a wood-burning fireplace and spa-like bath with jetted tub and glass-enclosed shower. From the kitchen and sunroom, step outside to a large deck and screened-in gazebo overlooking lush, private grounds with stone walls on nearly one acre. Completing the property is a four-car garage with radiant heated floors, all set in a desirable Westover location close to parks, shopping, dining, recreation, and with convenient access to the Merritt Parkway.

ALL OFFERS BY MONDAY, MAY 4TH - 5pm. Set in Stamford's coveted north backcountry, this spectacular ranch offers a rare blend of privacy, scale, and serene waterfront living. Overlooking a secluded pond framed by mature specimen trees, the setting is nothing short of breathtaking-an everyday escape defined by tranquility and natural beauty. An airy, open-concept layout with 9-foot ceilings enhances the sense of space and light throughout. With views of the water in every room.The main level is designed for both comfort and effortless entertaining, featuring soaring beamed ceilings in the living and dining rooms, two fireplaces, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. A gourmet kitchen opens to the family room, with french doors leading to a screened porch and expansive deck-perfect for taking in the magnificent pond views. Step outside to your own private waterfront experience, complete with a dock ideal for kayaking, fishing, or simply enjoying peaceful moments by the water. The home offers 5 bedrooms and 4 full baths, including a primary suite with a beautifully updated bath, dressing room, and private balcony overlooking the pond. A fully finished lower level with separate driveway and entrance adds exceptional flexibility, featuring a third fireplace, full kitchen, bath, wet bar, and potential for additional bedrooms-ideal for in-law or au pair living. Grab a fishing rod catch some bass! Electric car charger in garage

Start with Real Estate Rule #1: Location, Location, Location. Add #2: Great curb appeal, and you've found the perfect introduction to this classic, timeless Center Hall Colonial. Designed for both everyday living and effortless entertaining, the home offers spacious interiors paired with a lovely, level property. And so much more: The gracious front-to-back living room with fireplace provides a warm and inviting gathering space, while the formal dining room comfortably accommodates 12-14 guests for memorable celebrations. A true cook's kitchen is the heart of the home, featuring two sinks, two dishwashers, three ovens including a 6-burner range, plus a full-size refrigerator and full-size freezer-ideal for hosting and daily living alike. The flexible floor plan includes a first-floor bedroom with a private, newly renovated full bath-perfect for guests or multi-generational living-along with a dedicated home office and a bright family room with French doors and skylights that bring the outdoors in. Upstairs, three spacious bedrooms offer generous closet space, while the finished lower level is warm and welcoming with a brand-new full bath, creating the perfect space for recreation, fitness, or additional living. Bathed in beautiful southern exposure, natural light fills the home throughout the day. A rare blend of charm, functionality, and exceptional location.

Charming and beautifully updated Cape in Stamford's sought-after Glenbrook/Belltown neighborhood. This 3-bedroom, 3-bath home blends timeless character with modern comfort, featuring a welcoming front porch, formal living room with wood-burning fireplace, elegant dining room with French doors, and an open-concept kitchen with Corian counters, quartz-topped island, and new stainless-steel appliances. A cozy sunroom (or family room) with stained glass windows opens to the rear patio and level lawn, creating an ideal setting for everyday living and entertaining. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite offers vaulted ceilings, built-ins, a large sitting area, and gas fireplace. The primary suite opens to a small balcony for your morning coffee enjoyment. The 2 additional bedrooms are served by the hall bathroom and the loft completes the upper level which has new carpeting on the stairs, upper level hallway, loft and 2nd bedroom. Complete with main-level laundry, spacious basement with plenty of storage, and detached 2-car garage (new roof over the garage) which has the modern addition of a 220-amp charger this home is conveniently located near the train, shopping, parks, and schools.

GREAT INVESTMENT OPPORTUNITY! 4- family building with steady rental income. Each unit has 2 bedrooms, 1 full and 1 half bath, washer/dryer in unit, full basement, and 2 parking spaces. This property is a short distance to Cove Island beach and park, downtown Stamford shops and restaurants, I 95, Metro North train station, and Chelsea Piers. The property offers great future value to re-build as other buildings in the nearby area have been converted to luxury apartments. Income and expense sheet available upon request. Sold "As Is".

Welcome to 290 Red Fox Road, a well-maintained ranch on over an acre in sought-after North Stamford, offering the perfect blend of privacy, space, and convenience. With just over 2,300 square feet of living space, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath home is filled with natural light, highlighted by expansive windows and an easy, open flow designed for today's lifestyle. The family room, complete with a fireplace and wood-burning stove, creates a warm and versatile gathering space.  The main-level primary suite features an ensuite bath, while two additional bedrooms provide flexibility for guests, work-from-home needs, or everyday living. Freshly painted and recently refreshed, the home is clean, well cared for, and move-in ready.  Step outside to a spacious patio overlooking a private, wooded setting-ideal for entertaining or simply enjoying the quiet surroundings.  A full walkout basement offers endless potential for expansion, recreation, or customization, plus an existing workshop for added functionality.  Minutes to the Merritt Parkway and I-95, this location offers easy commuting without sacrificing a peaceful residential feel.  A standout opportunity in one of Stamford's most desirable areas.

Tri-level townhouse within close proximity to downtown Stamford, train and Stamford Hospital. This condo offers 3 bedrooms and 2.5 baths. Two car attached garage and on-street parking. Kitchen with granite counters and stainless steel appliances. Some of the newer updates include: fresh paint throughout most of the unit, high-end large Electrolux washer/dryer on the second floor, refrigerator and microwave plus more! Garage was currently being used as a home gym but can also be used as a garage featuring high-end black PVC tile flooring, upgraded lighting and a large mirrored wall. This unit features hardwood flooring, an oversized master suite on the third floor, two zone gas heat and large attic for storage.

Modern Sophistication Meets New York Grandeur! Turn-key residence at the premier luxury condo community in downtown Stamford. The Buckingham is known for its grand "NYC-Style" floorplans, ample amenities, and attentive on-site staff. This home stands out for its 2024 renovation, combining its unique and elegant floorplan with the building's iconic grand architecture, amenities and 24-hour door service. Step into a brand-new contemporary kitchen with pristine cabinetry, stone countertops, and stainless steel appliances. The attached breakfast nook just off the balcony is perfect for both casual meals and morning coffee. Stunning modern floors flow seamlessly throughout and a custom, neutral paint palette enhances the natural lighting. Enjoy a spacious open concept floorplan with a sun-filled, oversized living room and dining room designed for large gatherings. Sliders open to a private, covered balcony-ideal for enjoying sunsets, fresh air and views of a vibrant downtown. The primary bedroom suite is a spacious sanctuary featuring impressive storage, (2) walk-in closets with built-ins and an en-suite bath. Experience the convenience of a "private home" feel with the benefits of community and social acitivities. First-floor access one level above the lobby, in-unit laundry, reserved garage parking, fitness ctr., community room, garden terrace, 24-hr door service & dedicated storage units. Close to I-95, Metronorth train, Tully Health, parks, fine & casual dining, shops & more

listings.remarks: Charming vintage Cape Cod in sought-after Hubbard Heights, where timeless character meets everyday comfort. Set on a beautifully landscaped and fully fenced 1/3-acre, this lovingly maintained home offers exceptional indoor-outdoor living with space to relax, gather, and entertain. Inside, a welcoming living room with stone fireplace sets a warm and inviting tone, flowing to the formal dining room--ideal for holiday meals or casual evenings at home. Original details including crown moldings and hardwood floors add character throughout. The updated kitchen features a center island, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and generous storage. The screened porch creates a perfect extension of the living space for morning coffee and summer dinners. Two bedrooms and a full bath complete the main level. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a true retreat with an updated ensuite bath featuring dual sinks, heated floors, and a striking copper tub. An additional bedroom, renovated hall bath, and laundry complete the upper level. An expansive backyard offers the perfect balance of sun and shade, with three apple trees and ample lawn space for play, gardening, or entertaining. Additional highlights include a detached garage, gas utilities, 200-amp service, and numerous updated mechanicals and appliances. Ideally located close to shopping, dining, parks, and commuting options this special home offers convenience in one of Stamford's most desirable neighborhoods.

listings.remarks: Tucked away on two serene, park-like acres in North Stamford, 28 Pony Trail offers a refined blend of modern design and effortless living just minutes from the Greenwich border and Merritt Parkway. Natural light fills the home, enhanced by soaring vaulted ceilings and skylights that create an elevated yet inviting atmosphere with seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The property is set against a tranquil natural backdrop, complete with a gentle brook. A custom chef's kitchen by Deane anchors the home, featuring a large walnut center island, marble countertops, and a custom walk-in pantry, while living spaces extend to a large composite deck with multiple access points-ideal for entertaining or enjoying the peaceful surroundings. The Home offers two luxurious primary suites with spa-like baths, including a main-level suite with dressing area and walk-in closet. Upstairs, a second primary suite features dual walk-in closets, along with two additional bedrooms, an updated hall bath, large closets and custom built-ins. A spacious main-level office/den adds flexibility. Additional highlights include two laundry location options, a large unfinished lower level complete with gym, extensive storage, wine capacity for 500+ bottles and potential for a playroom. Enjoy close proximity to Greenwich horse trails and Greenwich Avenue, along with Metro-North access to NYC and Stamford amenities. Added features for convenience include a whole-house generator and irrigation system

Located in Stamford's Cove neighborhood, this exceptional waterfront residence combines striking architecture, high-end construction, and sweeping water views from nearly every room. Set on a professionally landscaped half-acre, the home is designed to maximize its unique setting with walls of Andersen windows and sliders that seamlessly connect the interior living spaces to multiple decks and outdoor entertaining areas overlooking the water. The open concept kitchen and family room are centered around a marble-topped island and appointed with premium appliances including a Wolf gas range, Wolf convection oven, Sub-Zero refrigerator, Bosch dishwasher, wine chiller, and custom cabinetry. Exceptional craftsmanship and attention to detail are evident throughout with gleaming hardwood floors, designer baths with radiant heated floors, retractable custom window treatments, and thoughtfully designed living spaces filled with natural light. The luxurious primary suite offers stunning water views, a waterfront balcony, and a spa-like bath featuring a soaking tub, steam shower, marble topped vanity, and radiant heated floors. Exterior features include Hardie Plank siding, stone facade, Trex decking, Azek trim, solar panels, outdoor shower and changing area, full house generator, deer fencing, and a three-car garage with electric vehicle charging outlets. Fully FEMA compliant and ideally positioned to capture the beauty of the waterfront from sunrise to sunset.

***HIGHEST & BEST 5/12 @ 12P***174 East Ln is one of those homes where you immediately understand why people want to live in the hidden gem that is Revonah Woods. Set on 1.12 acres, it offers a private, nature filled setting that feels like North Stamford, but with all the amenities and convenience of being just minutes to everything Stamford has to offer. When you pull up, you will see why the neighborhood talks about the lawn that looks like it belongs on a PGA course. This classic New England Colonial has been fully restored, expanded, and modernized over the past 5 years. A curved stone walkway, mature trees, and seasonal plantings create standout curb appeal. Inside, hardwood floors, crisp millwork, shiplap detail, and sun filled spaces balance classic character with a clean, updated feel. The main level offers six rooms that are open where you want them to be, kitchen, family, and dining, but still defined enough to keep real character, including a formal living room with wood burning fireplace, den, and office. The kitchen anchors the home with a Wolf gas range, pot filler, wine chiller, oversized island with second sink, and great sightlines throughout. Multiple French doors open to a spacious composite deck, creating seamless indoor-outdoor flow. Upstairs offers three bedrooms, including a well-designed primary suite with a soaking tub and curbless walk-in shower. The lower level adds storage, gym space, and a one-car garage. Turnkey in a location people rarely leave

Antique Post & Beam. Incredible transformation of a 1787 Vermont Barn. Converted to a residence in 1920 artfully integrating hand-hewn beams, random-width floors and incredible stone fireplace. Striking interior with vaulted ceilings and walls of windows to capture natural light and views. Entry with walls of exposed brick and barnwood, vaulted ceiling and sliding barn door. Incredible Great Room with vaulted ceiling beams, fireplace, seating and dining areas. Chef's Kitchen with granite counters and stainless appliances. Primary Bedroom with vaulted ceiling, wood burning stove and doors to porch. Two additional Bedrooms, both with vaulted ceilings and exposed beams. Two Full Baths. Beautiful, terraced gardens, fieldstone walls and stone terraces for dining and entertaining. Absolutely gorgeous grounds overlooking the East Branch Mianus River. Fabulous stone terrace with firepit at river's edge. Convenient location and just a moment's drive to the commercial area of High Ridge Road with its shops and restaurants. Close to the Merritt Parkway, the bus line, the Metro North train and I-95. A remarkable offering!

Charming and full of character, this impeccably maintained 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath home offers the perfect blend of classic appeal and modern convenience. Beautiful wood floors run throughout, adding warmth and elegance, with perfect flow between the living room, kitchen, and dining room. The kitchen is very inviting and features granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, a new refrigerator, a breakfast bar, and a free-standing hutch, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Situated in Stamford's desirable Glenbrook neighborhood, this home enjoys a location known for its tree-lined streets, strong sense of community, and easy access to downtown Stamford, Metro-North, parks, shopping, and dining-making it a favorite for commuters and those seeking a neighborhood feel with city convenience. Set on the corner lot, the property offers exceptional privacy along with generous outdoor space. The yard is professionally landscaped, providing a lush and welcoming setting for relaxation or gatherings. A two-car garage plus a driveway that accommodates two additional vehicles ensures ample parking. Adding to the home's value and efficiency, fully paid-off solar panels keep electric costs exceptionally low which is an outstanding benefit for anyone who is energy-conscious. Be part of the community and own a truly special home in one of Stamford's most sought-after neighborhoods.

listings.remarks: Come and live in Palmer Hill, the luxury gated community on the Greenwich/Stamford border. This 2nd floor midrise home has beautiful views from every room with walls of windows facing flowering trees in a parklike courtyard. Single level living at its best with 3 bedrooms (or 2 bedrooms plus den) plus 2 balcony terraces and a spacious living/dining area with gas fireplace. Modern kitchen with granite counters is adjacent. New floors, carpet, and paint throughout. The primary bedroom has a spacious walk-in closet and luxury ensuite bathroom with Jacuzzi tub/shower.  Elevator access to visitor lobby and underground parking garage with mail and parcel pickup in the building. 2 parking spaces plus large storage cage and bicycle room. Community amenities include recently renovated clubhouse with community/party room, meeting room, well equipped gym and yoga studio, large heated pool and hot tub. Landscaping throughout the community is beyond beautiful. Be in downtown Stamford, Metro North/Amtrack, or Old Greenwich in 5-10 min....a little more to Greenwich point park and beach or downtown Greenwich.

listings.remarks: Set at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in Stamford's desirable Bulls Head neighborhood, this 4-bedroom Colonial offers space, flexibility, and exceptional convenience. With 2,024 square feet of living space plus an additional 1,100 square feet in the unfinished lower level, this home presents a compelling opportunity to update and add value over time. Freshly painted throughout, it features central air, gas heat, and city water and sewer for straightforward, low-maintenance living. The flexible layout includes the possibility for a main-level bedroom suite, with a full bath, which is well-suited for guests, a home office, or in-law potential, while upstairs offers four bedrooms, a full bath, and a half bath ensuite to the primary. A brand new deck with access from the kitchen and family room overlooks the backyard, providing an ideal setting for everyday use or casual gatherings. Inside, the family room has a vaulted ceiling with a fireplace and sliders to the deck. A formal dining room and spacious living room complete the space. Conveniently located just minutes from the Merritt Parkway, downtown Stamford, and Metro-North express trains to NYC in under an hour, the location offers an easy commute and access to a wide range of local shops, parks, restaurants and grocery stores. A solid opportunity to personalize a well-located home in an established neighborhood!

Wake up to sparkling marina views and coastal breezes at Palmer Landing, a waterfront enclave on the coveted shoreline of Shippan Point and one of Stamford's most sought-after communities. This beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 3-bath end-unit townhouse has been newly renovated and completely repainted, featuring custom built-in closets on the main level and a remodeled main floor bathroom. Heat and hot water are included in the common charges, adding everyday comfort and convenience. The sun-filled main level offers an open, airy layout perfect for both relaxed living and entertaining, opening to one of two private waterfront decks overlooking the marina - a tranquil, vacation-like retreat where every morning coffee and evening cocktail feels like you're on the coast at a private resort. A wood-burning fireplace, rich hardwood floors, and a sleek kitchen with stainless steel appliances create a warm yet sophisticated atmosphere. Upstairs, the primary suite features a walk-in closet, spa-inspired bath with an oversized walk-in shower, and its own private 2nd waterfront deck-an ideal place to unwind and enjoy the tranquil water views. Located just moments from sandy beaches, dining, shopping, and downtown Stamford, this exceptional residence offers a rare opportunity to enjoy luxury waterfront living in one of Stamford's most desirable coastal communities.

listings.remarks: Completely rebuilt from the studs in 2008, this one-of-a-kind Contemporary blends sleek modern design with classic New England exterior charm. Set on 3+ private acres, the home was designed to capture beautiful views from every room, with walls of windows creating a bright, open, and airy feel throughout. The main living space features soaring cathedral ceilings and dramatic two-story windows with water views. A chef's kitchen with expansive island, Viking double ovens, and a sunlit breakfast room surrounded by windows overlooks your own waterfall. The layout flows seamlessly from a formal dining room to spacious living areas and out to wraparound decks, ideal for everyday living and entertaining. Outside, enjoy a resort-style setting with a heated gunite pool, spa, and tranquil natural surroundings. Three private bedroom suites include two updated baths, while the primary suite features vaulted ceilings, a sitting area, and serene pond views. Custom storage maximizes functionality throughout. Ideally located just 2 miles from the Merritt Parkway and LaRocca's Market, and within walking distance to Chestnut Hill Park, this property delivers superior construction, privacy and a lifestyle that you will love.

listings.remarks: Best and Final Friday 5-8-26 5pm. A very rare opportunity to join a delightful waterfront community on Coopers Pond in the Turn of River neighborhood in Stamford. This property provides a peaceful oasis with picturesque views of the water to enjoy all four seasons. Mature landscaping and beautiful flowers adds to the natural beauty and privacy of the yard. This home features bright open space. There are 4 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms. The Primary suite also features a private balcony overlooking the backyard and the water! The Kitchen was lovingly updated in 2022, which includes an incredible island for entertaining and gorgeous Quartz countertops. A natural gas range and stainless steel appliances complete the space. Being a front to back split level with natural lighting, there is an open concept feel while still  providing enough private space that you won't feel like everyone is in your business! This layout adds a huge luxurious feeling to the main gathering space. There are a number of outdoor patios, accessible from the kitchen area as well as the lower level family room. A portion of the yard is fenced for privacy and safety of loved ones and pets. There is a one car garage in addition to a wide driveway that will easily fit a total of 5 cars. This home comes complete with a generator which has just been serviced. There is plenty of storage space in the lowest level of the home. This property is NOT in a flood zone and currently no special flood insurance needed!

listings.remarks: Diamond in the rough. Harbor Point mixed use in need of minor upgrades to achieve a 125K NOI. 3 residential apartments, an office and 2 bay garage with loft for a total of 5 revenue streams. Walk to Koscuzo Park, Commons Park and all that Harbor Point has to offer. Nice back yard, Financials available upon request for qualified buyers.

Located on a cul-de-sac just north of the Merritt Parkway, this lovely four-bedroom, two bath Cape Cod style home is situated on a level half acre lot and has so much to offer! Enter to find the living room with a picture window and wood-burning fireplace. The formal dining room is open to the living area making entertaining enjoyable and easy. The large kitchen with a center island and stainless-steel appliances even has pass-throughs so the chef can easily speak with and serve their guests. A door from the kitchen leads to the sunroom and from there you can access the deck. Also on the main level is the nice-sized primary bedroom with a wall of closets and sitting area. A full bath is also on this level. Upstairs, you'll find three well-apportioned bedrooms and another full bath. There are hardwood floors throughout. You won't want to miss the walk-out lower-level with full-height ceilings. The possibilities are endless. There is a one car garage, an enormous level backyard and a large deck for outdoor dining. The home is in a prime location less than a mile from High Ridge Center with Trader Joes, Starbucks and more and within walking distance to ACME, Chipotle and Jersey Mikes. Don't miss this opportunity to make 112 Willard Terrace your own!

***Highest & Best: Tues 5/19 10AM*** Move right in and start living! This renovated Newfield-Pepper Ridge ranch combines modern finishes, smart functionality, and a location that makes everyday life easy. Walk to coffee, Beldotti's pastry, groceries, pizza, and more, while still enjoying the mature trees and neighborhood feel that make this area so desirable. Inside, the open-concept layout feels bright and connected with oversized windows and natural light throughout. The kitchen was thoughtfully designed with quartz counters, oversized island seating, stainless appliances, pot filler, and a custom shiplap hood that gives the space personality without trying too hard. Built-ins and mudroom storage make the home as practical as it is stylish. The main level offers 2 bedrooms and a renovated full bath. Downstairs adds valuable bonus space with a large rec/playroom, office, bedroom, renovated full bath/laundry room, and excellent storage. The backyard is what truly separates this home from others in the area: a large multi-functional flagstone patio with space for outdoor dining, lounge seating, firepit nights, and BBQ area, all surrounded by beautiful stone retaining walls, mature privacy trees, and planter boxes that give the space warmth and character. Just a few steps up is a rare private level yard perfect for entertaining, relaxing, pets, lawn games, gardening, or simply enjoying the outdoors, plus a large storage shed tucked quietly in the back.

Welcome to Midtown Estates-where location, light, and lifestyle come together seamlessly. Ideally situated in the best spot within the complex, this exceptional townhome enjoys natural light and is just steps from vibrant downtown living.  Thoughtfully designed with a lot of extra custom finishes throughout, the home features hardwood floors, recessed lighting, and elegant millwork. The welcoming entry foyer, complete with built-ins, opens to a sun-drenched main level boasting an open-concept layout. The living room and dining area flow effortlessly to a private balcony-perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxation.  At the heart of the home, the designer kitchen impresses with Carrara marble countertops, a breakfast bar, and stainless steel appliances, blending style and functionality. A powder room completes this level.  Upstairs, two spacious bedrooms share a beautifully appointed hall bath featuring both a soaking tub and separate shower. The entire third level is dedicated to the primary suite, offering a peaceful retreat with a custom walk-in closet and a full bath.  Crowning this home is a private rooftop deck with sweeping views-an ideal setting for entertaining or unwinding in style.  Additional highlights include an attached two-car garage with epoxy floors and custom storage. Truly move-in ready, this is a rare opportunity not to be missed.

Set on a sunny acre well back from the street, this beautifully maintained and thoughtfully updated 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers over 3,300 square feet of light-filled living space surrounded by mature trees, flowering plantings, and expansive lawns. Soaring ceilings, gleaming hardwood floors, and oversized windows create a seamless connection to the surrounding property while filling the home with natural light. A long private driveway leads to the two-car garage and generous parking area for guests. Inside, double doors open to a welcoming entry hall and dramatic step-down living room centered around one of two striking stone fireplaces. The updated eat-in chef's kitchen features a large center island, custom cabinetry, premium appliances, and an effortless flow into the dining area where the second fireplace creates a warm setting for entertaining and everyday living. The second floor includes a spacious primary suite with full bath along with three additional bedrooms and a shared hall bathroom. Above, the third-floor loft offers flexibility as a playroom, home office, or media room complete with built-in bookcases and sweeping views over the gardens and wooded landscape beyond. Outdoor living is equally inviting with multiple decks, a firepit area, and expansive lawns ideal for recreation or quiet relaxation. Coveted Westover offers privacy with convenient access to downtown Stamford, Metro North, shopping, and restaurants. A peaceful retreat just minutes from it all.

Welcome to refined living in Stamford's desirable Ridgeway-Bulls Head neighborhood. Built in 2015, this modern condominium offers 1,683 sq ft of well-designed living space with 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms. The open, airy layout features high ceilings, hardwood floors, contemporary lighting, and oversized windows that provide abundant natural light. A standout feature is the rooftop deck, offering beautiful city views. This pet-friendly home includes central heating and air conditioning for year-round comfort. Conveniently located near major shopping centers and within walking distance to Scalzi Park, Mill River Park, downtown Stamford, restaurants, movie theaters, and more. Low common charges include trash removal and yard maintenance, making for easy, low-maintenance living. A fantastic opportunity to own a spacious, move-in-ready condo in one of Stamford's most convenient locations.

This thoughtfully upgraded home in the Davenport Point Association sits on a level .44-acre lot and offers comfort, efficiency, and convenience near Stamford's waterfront. A major highlight is the owned Tesla Solar Roof with three Powerwalls-a sleek, all-in-one system that delivers clean power, cuts electric bills, and provides seamless whole-home backup. Inside, the main level features a warm living room with a large fireplace & wood-stove insert, hickory hardwood floors, and a dining room overlooking the expansive backyard. The custom kitchen includes granite countertops, an island, and a natural gas stove and oven. The primary bedroom has an en-suite bath, with two additional bedrooms and a full hallway bath. An office next to the laundry area offers direct access to the backyard and bluestone patio. The oversized recreation room with bamboo flooring has its own walkout & is perfect for gatherings or extra living space. The waterproofed basement offers potential for a playroom, gym, or studio while providing ample storage space. Outside, a double-wide paver driveway fits six cars, and the landscaped grounds feature a Japanese Maple, roses, lilacs, and multiple fruit trees, including apple, cherry, quince, and pawpaw. Adjacent to John J. Boccuzzi Park with beach access, playground, courts, fields, and SoundWaters, and close to top amenities-0.5 miles to Prime Restaurant and the Harbor Point water taxi, 1.5 miles to Stamford Station.

**SELLER REQUESTS ALL OFFERS WITH COMPLETE TERMS IN BY MONDAY 4PM **Set on a quiet cul-de-sac, this classic Colonial offers a wonderful blend of comfort, convenience, and everyday livability. The bright, open kitchen features generous space for cooking, gathering, and entertaining, with a large window overlooking the backyard and sliders opening to an expansive deck. Ideally located just minutes from the Merritt Parkway, specialty shopping, cafes, Stamford Museum & Nature Center, and Bartlett Arboretum & Gardens, the home also offers beach rights and easy access to NYC in under an hour. Recent improvements include a new roof and gutters, freshly painted exterior, new washer and dryer, updated downstairs bath, all-new windows, and interior painting.

listings.remarks: Experience 1515 Summer St, Apt 506 at The Metropolitan, a recently renovated residence in the heart of downtown Stamford. This light-filled unit features 9+ foot ceilings, an open layout, and updated finishes throughout. The brand-new kitchen includes a waterfall-style countertop, modern cabinetry, updated lighting, Wolf cooktop, and a Sub-Zero refrigerator. Recent improvements continue throughout the home with new hardwood flooring, modern chandeliers and light fixtures. The fully renovated bathroom with porcelain tile flooring features marble and mother of pearl detailing, Kohler fixtures, and Visual Comfort lighting. The spacious walk-in closet offers generous storage adjacent to the primary bedroom. Additional upgrades include a newer HVAC system and an in-unit washer and dryer. Residents of The Metropolitan enjoy access to a fitness center, an assigned wine cellar, and a resident lounge located on the first floor, all within close proximity to downtown dining, retail, entertainment, and transportation options.

listings.remarks: Welcome to this beautifully renovated 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo in the heart of downtown Stamford. This turnkey, ranch-level home offers a seamless open-concept layout, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The updated kitchen features quartz countertops, tiled backsplash, and newer stainless steel appliances (2023), flowing effortlessly into the sun-filled living and dining areas. Enjoy abundant natural light and picturesque views of downtown Stamford and Scalzi Park, with direct access to a private balcony, perfect for relaxing or taking in stunning sunset views. The spacious primary suite includes a full en-suite bath, while the second bedroom offers generous space and ample closet storage. A second full bathroom adds convenience for guests or everyday use. Hardwood flooring runs throughout, enhancing the home's clean and modern feel. Additional highlights include central air, a full-size in-unit washer and dryer, and a reserved covered garage parking space. Residents enjoy access to a fitness center and sauna. Just minutes to Stamford Train Station, Mill River Park, I-95, and downtown dining, shopping, and entertainment. A true move-in ready opportunity in one of Stamford's most desirable locations.

Urban Elegance Meets Historic Charm in Downtown Stamford. Step into a rare blend of style, character, and convenience, perfectly positioned in the heart of Stamford's vibrant downtown, just moments from the city's best restaurants, shops, and the Metro-North train to NYC. Tucked inside a beautifully restored historic building with only 7 exclusive loft-style residences, this boutique property offers a quiet, upscale alternative to Stamford's high-rise lifestyle. This fully renovated 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom unit impresses with exposed brick walls, oak floors, high ceilings, and recessed lighting throughout. Every detail has been thoughtfully curated from the Samsung stainless steel appliances and Caesarstone countertops to the Moen fixtures, Pella windows, and in-unit GE washer/dryer. The secured building features an elevator, interior mailboxes, and a welcoming lobby. Parking is available at nearby garages for an additional monthly fee. If you're looking for NYC loft vibes without leaving Connecticut, this one delivers.

Location, Location, Location! Sunny downtown Stamford apartment with city views from the 7th-floor balcony! Originally a studio, thoughtfully redesigned with a partition wall to create the feel of a separate bedroom space with its own window. Features hardwood floors in the living room and bedroom area, updated bath, dressing area, and two large closets offering excellent storage. Eat in kitchen! Enjoy the convenience of walking to restaurants, shopping, theater, library, and the train station. Building amenities include laundry and gym in the basement, plus beautifully maintained park-like grounds. This is the one you've been waiting for! Schedule your tour today!

listings.remarks: Welcome to Chesterfield, one of Stamford's most prestigious condominium complexes. This lovely townhome exhibits pride of ownership throughout: freshly painted and new carpeting as well as a refreshed kitchen with stainless appliances (microwave and dishwasher are brand new) and new quartz countertops. The main level boasts hardwood floors with an open concept living and dining room, wood burning fireplace and sliders to the deck. This level has a half bath. The Main and second bedrooms are on the upper level. The main bedroom, with it's vaulted ceiling and skylight, has an en-suite bathroom with double sinks, stall shower and hydro tub. There is a second full bath on this level. The Loft, with its two skylights and 2 generous closets, can serve as a third bedroom or office. The lower level has a carpeted family/guest room with corner fireplace, a full bath with tub/shower, as well as a bonus room with laminate floor. The bonus room is currently being used as an exercise room. The laundry is in this area. This lovely complex has it all: a gated community with two in-ground swimming pools and within walking distance to public transportation, restaurants and shopping. Close to highways and train station. A walk or quick ride to the fine dining and entertainment synonymous with vibrant Stamford and all it has to offer!

listings.remarks: Excellent opportunity for owner-occupants and investors alike at 29 Roosevelt Ave in Stamford. This well-maintained two-family home offers flexibility, income potential, and recent updates throughout, making it an ideal option for anyone looking to live in one unit while renting the other, or for an investor seeking a vacant multi-family property ready for its next chapter. The home features 1,982 sq ft of living space with 3 total bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms across two units, plus a finished basement with an additional bathroom. The first-floor unit offers 1 bedroom and 1 bathroom, while the second-floor unit features 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom. Both units have been freshly improved with newly finished hardwood floors, fresh interior paint, and new kitchen flooring, giving the property a clean and refreshed feel. The semi-finished basement adds valuable flexibility, featuring a separate entrance, heat, laundry hookups, and a bathroom. This space can be kept for owner use, storage, additional recreational space, or potentially rented together with Unit 1, depending on the buyer's needs. Set on a 0.11-acre lot, the property also includes a newly sealed driveway and garage parking, offering convenient off-street parking in a highly accessible Stamford location. Separated natural gas utilities add to the home's functionality, and with both units currently vacant, the next owner has the ability to set rents, choose occupants, or move in immediately.

New flooring and fresh paint throughout. Updated kitchen cabinets and countertops, new bathroom vanities and light fixtures. Adorable three bedroom, two full bath ranch style home with walk up attic for unlimited storage on a beautifully landscaped corner property in a convenient location minutes to everything. Cozy living room with oversized window and built in shelving. Large dining room plus a den with sliders to patio and a terrific rear yard. City water/sewer and all landscaping included. Strong credit is an absolute must. A cozy gem completely refreshed and ready for immediate occupancy.

Exceptional Modern Living on a Pristine 1-Acre Property Experience the pinnacle of modern living at 39 Wedgemere Road-an extraordinary contemporary residence in one of Stamford's most sought-after neighborhoods. Extensively renovated and thoughtfully reimagined over the past four years, this 4-bedroom, 3.1-bath home blends high-end finishes with a refined sense of luxury. Set on a meticulously manicured 1-acre lot with professional landscaping, the grounds are designed for effortless entertaining and everyday enjoyment. Highlights include a gunite pool, expansive outdoor patio with outdoor kitchen, a firepit, greenhouse and lush, private surroundings that create a true sanctuary. Inside, the home features clean architectural lines and a light-filled layout tailored to today's lifestyle. The primary suite is a standout, offering a show stopping walk-in closet and a private deck- perfect for morning coffee or quiet retreat. The flexible layout includes incredible guest or au pair quarters just off the kitchen, complete with a bedroom, full bath, and sitting room-ideal for privacy and comfort. And for those who love to entertain, the renovated lower level provides an impressive space for recreation, media, or gatherings. This is a rare opportunity to own a turnkey, move-in ready home in a premier Stamford location-where every detail has been carefully curated for luxury and livability.

Experience the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience in this beautifully updated multi-level townhouse-style condo located in Stamford's desirable Glenbrook neighborhood.  Fully renovated, this expansive residence offers house-like living with sophisticated design, abundant natural light, and versatile spaces. Experience a dramatic sun-filled living space that showcases cathedral ceilings, hardwood floors, white oak staircase, recessed LED lighting, and a cozy wood-burning fireplace. The open-concept layout flows seamlessly into a generous dining area, and an updated eat-in kitchen featuring granite counter tops.   The expansive primary suite occupies its own level and features a vaulted ceiling, double-door entry, a new full en-suite bath and spacious double closet, while an adjacent loft offers the perfect home office, reading nook, or creative retreat. A second bedroom is thoughtfully positioned with convenient access to a new full bath. Additional living space includes a soundproofed lower-level media room, gym, or optional guest suite, along with ample storage and finished garage.   Additional highlights include central air, updated bathrooms, new carpeting, one assigned parking space, plus abundant guest parking. Set within the well-maintained Tamarac complex with a beautifully landscaped courtyard, this turnkey home offers low-maintenance living just moments from Metro-North, shopping, dining, bus routes. New water heater and 2 new compressors.
