listings.remarks: Welcome to 1049 Stillwater Road, a refined and thoughtfully built residence nestled in Stamford's coveted Westover neighborhood. Constructed in 2019, this home blends modern design with timeless comfort, offering exceptional quality and peace of mind.   Spanning five bedroom and four a and a half bathrooms, the home is designed to accommodate both everyday living and elegant entertaining. A private in law or guest suite provides versatility with and extra sleeping area, and full bathroom, while a dedicated office space, home gym, and generous storage enhance functionality without compromising style.  Surrounded by mature and established landscaping, the outdoor setting offers privacy and a serene backdrop for relaxation or gatherings.  Ideally located just moments from the Merritt Parkway, this home combines convenience wit the charm of one of Stamford's most desirable residential enclaves.   This is a rare opportunity to own a move-in ready home where design, location, and livability come together seamlessly.

Everybody wants a flat half acre plus in Pepper Ridge with a view of protected woods but nobody can find it. Until now! This one of a kind farmhouse cape w/3 car garage features the yard you've been fantasizing about and it's just a few short minutes away from shopping, restaurants, schools and houses of worship. Plenty of room to cook and dine in the large eat-in kitchen. The first floor also boasts a spacious living room with fireplace, airy family room w/vaulted ceiling, wood-burning stove and loft, two good sized bedrooms and full bath. Upstairs you'll find two ample bedrooms either of which could be the primary. One has a kitchenette and a full bath en-suite and the other is right next to an enormous hall bathroom with oversized luxury tub. Take your pick! Have a swing on the front porch and bring your creative ideas to this definitely non-cookie-cutter cape.

Perched on a scenic ridge overlooking the bucolic waters of Oriental Lodge Pond, this exceptional contemporary home is a sanctuary for those who crave a connection to the outdoors. Situated on 1.48 acres of verdant private land, the property offers a rare blend of architectural drama and serenity.  A spectacular open floor plan on the main level is the signature feature of the home. Stepping inside the home you are greeted by a dramatic sky-lit, 2-story entrance with soaring vaulted ceilings. Large windows throughout the home keep the home bathed in natural light. The living room, dining room, and family room all have cozy wood-burning fireplaces. A stylish kitchen, with a smart -tech double oven, and a sunnybreakfast nook are the hub of the home. The home has 5 bedrooms including one on the main floor with an adjacent bathroom, ideal for a guest or home office. There are 4 bedrooms upstairs, highlighted by the fire-lit primary bedroom, en suite. The lower level offers a special opportunity to finish addition space with over 1,000 square feet of space, including a fireplace, eager for your finishing touches. If you enjoy kayaking or ice skating, the property has direct access to the water and even owns a little slice of the island within the pond. Whether you're hosting a boisterous gathering or enjoying a quiet morning watching the mist rise off the pond, this home offers an unparalleled North Stamford lifestyle. Welcome home.

Great North Stamford rental set beside a peaceful bird sanctuary. Start your mornings in the sunroom with calming natural views. A grand two-story foyer opens to a 4,500 sq ft home designed for comfort and entertaining. Bright, open spaces include a family room, living room, sitting area, and dining room. The chef's kitchen offers granite countertops, center island, Sub-Zero refrigeration, Thermador range, dual Miele dishwashers, and propane cooking. The main level includes a flexible playroom with workstations and ping pong table, two home offices, and a guest en-suite bedroom. The second floor features 3 spacious bedrooms and 2 baths, including a primary suite with spa bath, soaking tub, and separate shower. Outdoor living includes a large patio with outdoor kitchen, fire pit, and heated porch for year-round use. The lower level offers a full fitness area with weights, machines, kettlebells, treadmill, TV, and Peloton bike. The kitchen table and 4 TVs are also included. Conveniently located near downtown Stamford dining, shopping, entertainment, and nearby beaches.

Welcome to this beautifully updated 2-bedroom condo in a sought-after downtown Stamford building offering modern comfort and unbeatable convenience. This bright, move-in ready home features new flooring throughout, updated bathrooms, and a brand-new AC system. The open-concept layout is highlighted by soaring 16+ foot ceilings, creating a spacious and airy atmosphere filled with natural light.  A versatile loft provides the perfect space for a home office, guest area, or additional living space, while the other room offers endless possibilities for storage, a den, or flex use. Enjoy a private patio ideal for relaxing or entertaining.  Residents enjoy premium building amenities including an elevator, fitness center, on-site concierge, private courtyard with grills, and covered garage parking with direct elevator access. Pet-friendly community.  Located just steps from Stamford's best restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and public transportation, this home offers the perfect blend of style, functionality, and downtown living.

Upstairs, you'll find two more generously sized bedrooms and another full bath, offering just the right balance of space and privacy. Love outdoor living? You're in for a treat! The fabulous backyard is ideal for relaxing or hosting with a brick paver terrace and built-in fire pit-perfect for summer nights, s'mores, and memory-making. Need storage? The oversized one-car garage features ample space above, ideal for all your extras. Located close to shops, parks, and commuter routes, this home offers comfort, convenience, and an easygoing lifestyle in a location that just feels right. Come see why this Turn of River gem is the perfect place to start your next chapter!

Beautifully maintained and thoughtfully updated 1-bedroom, 1-bath Mid-Town condo offering comfort, style, and unbeatable convenience in the heart of Stamford. Ideally located just moments from downtown, you'll enjoy easy access to local shops, parks, restaurants, and major commuter routes including I-95, Route 1, and the Metro North station. Inside, the home features a bright and spacious layout with 9 ft ceilings throughout, enhanced by recessed lighting, crown molding, and a seamless flow designed for everyday living. The kitchen offers abundant cabinetry and generous counter space, providing both functionality and room to create. The living area is open and inviting with a dedicated workspace, perfect for today's flexible lifestyle. The oversized bedroom includes a walk in closet with a custom organization system. Additional highlights include in unit laundry, assigned parking, and extra storage in the basement. A move in ready opportunity in a prime location, ideal for both owner occupants and those seeking a low maintenance lifestyle close to everything Stamford has to offer.

At the end of a Westover cul-de-sac, this architect-designed all-brick Art Deco home blends timeless character with modern comfort. Fully renovated and restored, it preserves original details while offering today's conveniences. A circular entry foyer with custom inlaid flooring introduces the home's unique style. The open great room features soaring ceilings, hardwood floors, walls of glass, a fireplace, built-ins, and access to a stone patio. The gourmet eat-in kitchen includes custom cabinetry, a large island, granite countertops, and premium stainless steel appliances, with adjacent flexible space for dining or a casual family room. A cozy den off the foyer, with fireplace and French doors to the patio, can serve as a home office or fourth bedroom with access to a full bath. Two spacious bedrooms with walk-in closets and built-ins share a full bath. The primary suite offers a fireplace, dressing room, marble bath, and private access to a second-floor sun deck. Set on 1.7+ landscaped acres, the property features a renovated cantilever gunite pool, updated decking, and a charming pool house with storage and bath. Additional highlights include an automatic generator, new mechanicals, windows, and roof-all within an easy commute to Manhattan.

Welcome to 19 Burwood Avenue, a beautifully updated 4-bedroom home offering 1,608 square feet of comfortable living space in desirable Waterside neighborhood. This move-in ready property combines classic New England colonial charm with thoughtful upgrades, perfect for today's modern lifestyle.  Inside, you'll find beautifully refinished hardwood floors that flow throughout, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The spacious layout includes bright living areas ideal for both everyday living and entertaining, along with a well-appointed kitchen designed for functionality and ease.  Upstairs, four generously sized bedrooms provide plenty of space for family, guests, or a home office. High-efficiency central heating and air conditioning ensure year-round comfort.  The finished basement adds coveted entertaining space, featuring a dedicated projector screen - perfect for movies, game nights, and enjoying a true at-home cinema experience. Step outside to your own private retreat - a fully fenced backyard with sparkling pool, patio, and fire pit area. Ideal for summer gatherings, relaxing weekends, and outdoor fun.  Located just minutes from Stamford's vibrant waterfront, shopping, dining, parks, and commuter routes, this home offers the perfect blend of suburban tranquility and city convenience.  Don't miss your chance to make this exceptional property your own!

Easy Living Starts Here. This Charming fully updated 3-bedroom ranch located on a quiet street in Glenbrook section of Stamford. Freshly painted with Hardwood Floors throughout, A spacious large deck perfect for entertaining & barbecues, and a level fenced in backyard ideal for outdoor enjoyment. New Roof & Renovated kitchen with modern appliances & granite counters. Move In ready with modern updates inside and out. Perfect condo alternative. Don't miss this opportunity!

Set on 1.68 extraordinary acres at the end of Davenport Drive, this waterfront peninsula property offers a rare chance to reimagine and transform an existing residence into a custom coastal estate. Offered for the first time in 76 years, the home is surrounded by water on three sides, providing sweeping 180-degree eastern, southern, and western exposures that fill the interiors with natural light and frame panoramic views from sunrise through sunset. The current residence offers a blank canvas for the next owner to bring their vision to life. Whether through a comprehensive restoration or a complete reconfiguration, the opportunity exists to create a home that fully realizes the potential of this remarkable setting. With a completed survey and feasibility study already in place, much of the initial groundwork has been done. The property also offers the best of both worlds - privacy and seclusion at the end of a quiet road in the Southfield Association and extreme proximity to downtown Stamford and Old Greenwich - granting easy access to restaurants, shopping, beaches, and train service. It's a rare opportunity to reimagine a home that is placed on one of the most special pieces of property in Fairfield County.

Charming ranch-style home in North Stamford featuring 3 bedrooms and 1.5 baths, ideally situated on a quiet cul-de-sac. This sun-filled home offers a spacious living room with a cozy fireplace, a dining area conveniently located just off the kitchen, and a versatile playroom or office with direct access to a private backyard. Enjoy an abundance of closet space throughout, along with a full basement providing exceptional storage. Complete with a two-car garage, this home combines comfort, functionality, and a peaceful setting. Roof is only 5 years old. 2025 Draining pipes were replaced with PVC, new water heater tank AND pressure tank. In addition, generator connection is already in place. City of Stamford is in the process of installing public sewer in the street to be completed in the following months. Conveniently located just 45 MINUTES from NYC, with easy access to the Merritt Parkway in under 5 minutes.

Welcome to this beautifully renovated 3-bedroom, 3-bath Cape, ideally situated in the desirable Cove area just moments from the beach. Blending timeless charm with today's most desirable finishes, this home is truly move-in ready and designed to impress. Features an open-concept layout with a spacious living room and dining area that flows seamlessly into a brand-new kitchen, complete with modern cabinetry, stylish tile, and stainless steel appliances.  Step outside from the kitchen to enjoy a fully fenced backyard, perfect for summer entertaining, barbecues, or relaxing in privacy. The main level also offers two generously sized bedrooms and a fully updated bathroom.  Upstairs, the primary suite provides a comfortable retreat with recessed lighting, a renovated full bathroom, and a walk-in closet. The partially FINISHED BASEMENT expands your living possibilities with flexible space for a home office, guest suite, or recreation area, along with access to an additional full bathroom, laundry access and direct access to the garage.  Recent 2025 updates include a tankless heating and hot water system, new central air conditioning with gas integration, brand-new windows, and a roof that is just five years old.

Bring your vision to 79 Loughran Ave, a once in a lifetime, out of the flood zone waterfront property located in the Mid-Ridges of Stamford. This home recently suffered an interior fire, and was subsequently taken down to the studs. Per the city tax card this home is a 4 bedroom, 3 bath ranch, with a 1,576 sq. ft. footprint + 525 sq ft attached garage. Additionally, there is a full walk-out lower level with 10' +/- ceilings. The opportunities are endless - rebuild the existing ranch and capture 2500+ sq ft of finished area (between first and lower level) or vertically expand and build up. Currently on septic/ well, however city sewer and public water are available in the street for connection. Located just south of the Merritt Parkway, and just minutes from Whole Foods, restaurants, shopping and Downtown Stamford. This is a very rare opportunity to own waterfront home, elevated from the river & out of the AE flood zone, that is south of the parkway. Whether you are a builder looking for your next project or an end-user dreaming of a custom waterfront lifestyle, this "blank canvas" is not one to miss out on. This home is sold as-is, where is.

Best of "Old World" Charm with Modern Lifestyle. Located in Stamford's desirable Newfield neighborhood, 1376 Hope Street blends timeless New England charm with modern living. Originally rooted in early 1900s craftsmanship and completely remodeled in 2011, this beautifully reimagined colonial offers over 5,000 sq ft of flexible living space on more than half an acre of private grounds. Features include 9 ft ceilings, rich hardwood floors, welcoming foyer, gracious living room with oversized open hearth fireplace and original antique bar, spacious eat in kitchen with island opening to private deck and serene landscaped views, formal dining room with French doors, and four generous bedrooms including a vaulted primary suite with double sink bath. Walk up attic with high ceilings offers approximately 1,000 additional sq ft, already insulated with electricity in place, ideal for office, studio, playroom or future finished space. Lower level offers another approximately 1,000 sq ft with separate walk out, perfect for apartment, au pair or recreation room. Rare early 1900s stone foundation, full perimeter dog fence, immaculate two car garage, tremendous storage and peaceful natural surroundings complete the property. Convenient midtown location close to Merritt Parkway, Metro North, downtown Stamford, beaches, golf, tennis, shopping, dining and both Springdale and Darien train stations. A rare opportunity! More pictures and video coming soon.

listings.remarks: Live where the city moves in this updated 2 bedroom, 1.5 bath townhouse with attached one car garage, perfectly set in the heart of Downtown Stamford and designed for an active, modern lifestyle. Inside, you'll find a bright, open layout with laminate flooring and an easy flow that works just as well for hosting friends as it does for everyday living. Step out onto your private balcony and enjoy city views that bring energy and atmosphere to your mornings and evenings. This home delivers the features that make city life effortless, including in-unit laundry, a built-in EV charger, and a private attached garage for added convenience. Fully renovated from top to bottom, it offers a move-in-ready experience with a clean, modern feel throughout. Outside your door, you are within walking distance to everything Downtown Stamford has to offer, including restaurants, nightlife, shopping at the mall, and the train station, making it easy to stay connected, spontaneous, and on the go. Whether you're grabbing coffee before work, meeting friends for dinner, or grabbing and express train to NYC, this location supports a dynamic lifestyle without sacrificing comfort at home. If you're looking for a low-maintenance, modern townhouse with a vibrant atmosphere, city views, and unbeatable walkability, this home puts you right in the center of it all.

A striking pebble-finished gunite pool and spa, outdoor shower, professional landscaping and three distinct bluestone terraces create a resort-like feel. A home like this doesn't come along often!

An expanded kitchen and family room anchored by Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances opens to an expansive rear patio designed for effortless entertaining, complete with a hot tub for year-round enjoyment. The primary suite offers a spa-inspired bath with steam shower, heated floors, soaking tub, and private balcony. Mechanical systems and HVAC have been comprehensively updated. The property's positioning allows for a future pool or tennis court. Many who live nearby say there is simply something special about Ridgecrest Road.

The open-concept first floor features a gourmet kitchen with a gas Wolf Range, Sub-Zero refrigerator, breakfast bar, & a large island with double-sided seating, all overlooking expansive water vistas. Enjoy unparalleled front-row seats to Stamford's Fourth of July Fireworks, & year-round sunrises from your living room & patio. The primary suite provides a luxurious bath and an expansive deck overlooking Long Island Sound. Additionally, a first-floor suite with separate access is complemented by a full wet bar & en suite bathroom. Upstairs, enjoy a water-facing bedroom with bay window views, a full hallway bathroom, & a third-floor retreat with another water-facing bedroom, full bath, sitting room, and cedar closet. The finished basement offers an exercise area, lounge, laundry, and ample storage. Located within a short distance to West Beach, Brennan's Pub, Stamford Yacht Club, Woodway Beach Club & just minutes from Cummings Park, Cafe Silvium, shops, restaurants, concerts, and movies in downtown Stamford, with easy access to the train to NYC-just five minutes away-this serene waterfront oasis combines luxury, convenience, and community for an unparalleled living experience.

Stunning Center Hall sun-filled Colonial tucked away in the coveted Revonah Woods neighborhood and perched atop 1.27 acres of pure tranquility. The grand 2-story entryway with a sweeping staircase draws you in to the voluminous layout encompassing nearly 9,000 square feet of living space. Entertaining is effortless with large formal spaces including an elegant dining room and living room, both featuring soaring ceilings and dramatic fireplace focal points. The expansive Chef's Kitchen is clad with high end appliances as well as quartz countertops. The French doors and oversized windows off of the kitchen showcase the level backyard while opening up the home to even more light. Playroom/office, in-law suite and a large mudroom complete the main level. The divine primary suite boasts a large walk-in closet, full bathroom with an additional closet, and a bonus room perfect for a nursery, private office, reading room, or additional closet space. Large office, oversized laundry room equipped with a folding bench and sink, and 4 additional bedrooms each adjoined by Jack & Jill bathrooms complete the second floor. Fully finished walk-up attic is multi-purpose. Lower level features a Rec Room with Fireplace plus a Home Gym area! The patio and level backyard is a serene and private setting. Enjoy the Sonos Speakers and Smart lighting and 6 zone Nest thermostats. All TV's included. Amazing secluded location so close to town. Visit your dream home today.

Welcome to this charming Colonial nestled in Stamford's highly desirable Westover neighborhood. Set on over an acre of landscaped property, this spacious and well-maintained home offers the perfect blend of comfort, functionality, and classic appeal. The main level features a living room with fireplace, formal dining room, powder room, and a large eat-in kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and sliders leading to a deck-ideal for entertaining or relaxing outdoors. A warm and inviting family room just off the kitchen adds additional living space and everyday comfort.  The second floor offers a spacious primary suite with walk-in closets and a beautifully appointed bath featuring double sinks, whirlpool tub, and separate shower. Three additional generously sized bedrooms and an updated full bath complete the upper level. Finished third floor provides flexible extra space perfect for a home office, gym, or playroom. Additional highlights include central air, central vacuum, security system, generator, laundry room, attached two-car garage, and a full basement offering abundant storage. Conveniently located just minutes from Downtown Stamford, Old Greenwich, shopping, dining, parks, and major commuting routes. A wonderful opportunity to enjoy space, privacy, and convenience in one of Stamford's most sought-after locations.

listings.remarks: Shippan waterfront living at its finest. Situated directly on the Long Island Sound, this 4+ bedroom, 4-bath residence offers 75 feet of sweeping, unobstructed frontage-placing the shoreline quite literally at your doorstep. At low tide, a private sandy stretch emerges, creating a beachfront setting ideal for launching kayaks, paddle boards, or mooring a boat.  Inside, light-filled interiors flow effortlessly from an open, updated kitchen to spacious entertaining areas, all designed to maximize the water views. Each of the four full baths has been thoughtfully renovated with a timeless design, blending sophistication and comfort. Outdoor living is equally inviting with a bluestone patio, and a seawall. A detached two-car garage provides convenience and storage.  Life in Shippan offers the perfect balance of seaside serenity and city accessibility. Stamford's vibrant downtown-with its restaurants, shopping, and cultural events-is just minutes away, while Shippan itself remains a quiet, intimate neighborhood where the sound of waves sets the rhythm of daily life. And with the Metro-North train whisking you to Manhattan in under 50 minutes, the home is perfectly suited for both full-time living and a weekend escape.  64 Ocean Drive East is more than a residence-it's a rare opportunity to enjoy the tranquility of a waterfront retreat with all the energy of city living within easy reach.  Listing agent is related to seller.

listings.remarks: This corner-lot building at 1845 Summer Street offers four total units in a prime, high-visibility Stamford location. Three units are residential/income-producing, and one unit is currently configured and used as office space, providing valuable mixed-use potential. The property sits on a manageable lot that maximizes street exposure while keeping maintenance efficient for an investor. The roof was replaced this year, giving a major capital improvement already completed and reducing near-term operating risk. Located along Summer Street, the building enjoys strong traffic, easy access to downtown Stamford, and proximity to shopping, and public transit. The corner position enhances signage, visibility, and accessibility for both residential tenants and office users. This asset is well-suited for investors looking for stable cash flow with upside through leasing, repositioning, or optimizing the office component. The combination of a newly updated roof, mixed-use layout, and prime corner location makes it an attractive long-term hold in a growing market.

From the moment you step inside, oversized windows fill the space with sunlight, creating a bright, airy feel throughout the home. The eat-in kitchen is both refined and functional, featuring sleek quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and clean modern cabinetry. Upstairs, both bedrooms offer double closets and comfortable proportions, while a full attic provides generous additional storage. The lower level adds flexibility with an office space along with a dedicated laundry room for everyday ease. Location truly sets this home apart. Enjoy a short stroll to Metro North (approximately 15 minutes) for a seamless commute, or walk just 5-10 minutes to the harbor, waterfront dining, and local restaurants. Practicality meets peace of mind with a one-car garage, two additional parking spaces, and plentiful street parking for guests.

After 40 years, this gracious split-level ranch on over two private acres is ready for its next chapter. With a versatile floor plan that lives like a five-bedroom home plus office, it offers exceptional flexibility for empty nesters seeking a main-level primary suite or families in need of generous space. The expansive living room, anchored by a brick wood-burning fireplace, flows into the dining room with sliders to an oversized deck-ideal for indoor-outdoor entertaining. A half-flight up is a private wing with two bedrooms and a full bath with new LVP flooring, well suited for guests or extended family. The lower level features a large recreation room with direct access to the private backyard, adding even more space to relax, work, or play. Recent improvements include freshly painted interior and exterior, refinished hardwood floors, a new roof, and new hot water heater-reflecting the pride of ownership throughout. A rare opportunity to make your mark in Westover, one of Stamford's most sought-after neighborhoods.

Fabulous 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath ranch perfectly situated on one of Stamford's most desirable streets. The light-filled living and dining rooms create an inviting atmosphere, while the sunroom provides the perfect spot to enjoy morning coffee, evening tea, or simply relax with views of the backyard. The partially finished lower level offers flexible space ideal for a family room, playroom, home office, or gym. Nature lovers will appreciate being within walking distance of the Stamford Museum & Nature Center, featuring live animals, educational programs, and year-round seasonal activities. Also nearby is the Bartlett Arboretum & Gardens, offering miles of scenic walking trails and beautiful gardens. Conveniently located within walking distance of Northeast Elementary School and just minutes from shopping, dining, and major commuting routes. A wonderful opportunity to enjoy a sought-after Stamford location and all the comforts of home. Just what you've been looking for!

And just beyond, the area flows seamlessly into a newly updated sunroom or private office. Thoughtfully updated throughout, the home features modernized bathrooms and freshly painted interiors, delivering a clean contemporary aesthetic with a refined touch. The lower level presents a flexible bonus space ideal for a home gym, office or custom expansion. It features 3 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms, with hardwood floors running throughout the home. The living room with fireplace flows into the dining room, where sliders open to a spacious deck with an awning. The updated kitchen features a skylight, granite countertops, and stainless steel appliances. The primary suite is a true retreat, complete with an oversized walk in closet outfitted with California Closets cabinetry and shelving, plus a private spa like bath with double sinks, radiant heated floors, a shower stall, jacuzzi tub, and sauna. The lower level family room offers flexible space and could serve as a 4th bedroom, with a full bath and an alcove ideal for a home office. The home underwent a major renovation and addition in 2005, including updated electrical, plumbing, windows, and roof, along with an 80 gallon water heater replaced in 2021, a furnace updated in 2013, and the roof was replaced in 2020.

Waterfront living at her best! Beautifully updated 3 bed, 3 and a half bath end unit townhouse in desirable Marina Bay complex. Private waterside community just minutes from Stamford, CT RR (with fast trains into Manhattan), downtown Stamford for pickle ball & restaurants, and i95 for those needing to commute (north or south - exit 7). Incredible sunset views from living room (park-like vista) and primary suite balconies. Stunning eat-in kitchen with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances and plenty of storage. Large open plan dining (room for table as well as bar stools) and light-filled living room with elegant gas fireplace. Modern half bath completes the main level!  Upstairs there's a spacious primary suite with sliders to a balcony. Two further bedrooms well apportioned bedrooms plus full bath complete the upper level.  The lower level makes for a perfect den/family room, gym, au pair suite and offers a full bath (with oversized shower), side by side laundry in dedicated room, and sliders out to a stone patio! Attached one car garage with bonus storage, and further under stair storage room on lower level. One further parking in driveway. Take advantage of the gunite waterfront pool during summer months, and enjoy moments with neighbors/friends in private clubhouse with fitted kitchen. Views of Westcott Cove, Marina and Long Island Sound for those looking to live by the sea: Life doesn't get much sweeter than this! Sold "AS-IS".

The main level offers a sun-filled living room with marble gas fireplace and built-ins, a formal dining room with french doors to the deck, a bright sunroom/office with full bath, and a fully equipped kitchen with gas stove, granite counters, newer appliances, and mudroom access.  Upstairs includes three bedrooms, two with walk-in closets, including a lofted bedroom with skylights offering flexible living space.  A finished basement provides bonus room for recreation and storage. Outdoors, enjoy a private oasis, landscaped yard with deck and patio to relax and enjoy stunning sunsets. Outside, enjoy a level, fenced-in backyard with a great rectangular layout, a walk-out patio, and a one-car garage. A move-in ready Colonial in one of Stamford's most convenient neighborhoods.

From the striking new front door to the showpiece custom eat-in kitchen - featuring stainless appliances, custom cabinetry, and direct access to a brand-new private deck - every detail has been considered. Perfectly positioned.  *This is the one you've been waiting for.*

Hardwood and slate floors, recessed lighting, rich woodwork, beams, built-ins, and expansive glass sliders reflect the home's distinctive design and appeal. The living room is the centerpiece, featuring a dramatic cathedral ceiling, floor-to-ceiling fireplace, and expansive glass sliders that open to the enclosed porch, where walls of windows frame the serene backyard and set the tone for morning coffee, quiet moments, or easy entertaining. A spacious formal dining room flows naturally into the eat-in kitchen, creating an inviting layout for both everyday living and larger gatherings. Offering 5 beds, with one perfectly suited for use as a home office, 3 full baths, plus a mudroom/laundry off the kitchen, the layout provides flexibility, while the lower level adds tremendous potential for additional living. Outside, the sprawling private backyard is framed by mature trees and offers the space, privacy, and setting for a true outdoor oasis. All of this is ideally located with easy access to downtown Stamford, Metro-North, major commuting routes, and the shopping, dining, and conveniences of Greenwich, offering a lifestyle that blends privacy, space, & convenience in an exceptional location.

The updated kitchen features new countertops, backsplash, sink, hardware, and faucet, along with upgraded appliances and bar amenities.  Recent improvements include freshly painted interiors, refinished hardwood floors, new lighting and electrical finishes, and a gas fireplace insert. Major system upgrades include new furnaces, a tankless hot water system, enhanced HVAC, WiFi thermostats, updated drain lines, chimney repointing with a custom copper cap, blown-in insulation, and new gutters.  Outdoors, a private, resort-like setting features a two-bedroom, two-bath pool house with sauna, a newly replastered pool with LED lighting, and refreshed landscaping. A new main roof (2025) underscores the home's exceptional upkeep. Moments from beaches, marinas, and downtown Stamford, this is coastal living at its finest. Across the street from your private deeded beach.

This home features dramatic 2-story entrance, double-sided staircase, 5 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, 2 car garage. Large gourmet kitchen with tons of storage and pizza oven. Formal dining room, family room with fireplace, spacious living room with vaulted ceiling and sliders to the balcony. Private office with fireplace. Huge private yard with custom Koi pond and amazing multi level rear deck. Owner will consider pets on a case by case. This is a must see!!! Won't last long.

A backyard worthy of a luxury resort, thoughtfully renovated interiors, and one of Westover's most desirable addresses...this is the home buyers have been waiting for. This exceptional five-bedroom home blends timeless architecture with sophisticated modern updates and an extraordinary backyard designed for everyday living and unforgettable entertaining. Minutes from downtown, Metro North and highways, you'll enjoy the rare combination of neighborhood charm, walkable streets, and generous property. Thoughtfully renovated from top to bottom, the floor plan offers effortless flow and abundant natural light. Easy entertaining in elegant living and dining rooms, home office, and a stunning chef's kitchen that serves as the heart of the home. Designed for both everyday living and entertaining, the kitchen features an oversized island, stainless steel appliances, quartz counters, and abundant cabinetry. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with two walk-in closets and a luxurious spa-inspired bath. Four additional bedrooms and two full baths provide flexibility for family, guests, or work-from-home needs. The backyard is truly exceptional, with a heated saltwater pool and spa, complemented by an expansive deck, professionally designed landscaping, putting green, vegetable garden, and expansive lawn for recreation-- all fully fenced--offering beauty and privacy. This is a rare opportunity to enjoy luxury, comfort, and a luxury lifestyle.

Fully Renovated and Move-In Ready! Every inch of this exceptional home has just been beautifully renovated, including fresh interior paint throughout, stunning new bathrooms, a luxurious primary bath, and a brand-new finished lower level. Best of all, every bedroom features its own private full bathroom, offering comfort and privacy for family and guests alike. From the moment you step into the picture-perfect entry hall, you'll feel at home. The sun-filled living and dining rooms are anchored by a cozy fireplace, while the charming sunroom with its own fireplace overlooks the stone patio and expansive private backyard with mature plantings, stone walls and exposed rock, the kitchen is warm, inviting, and ideal for everyday living or entertaining. A flexible main-level room, perfect as a home office, den, guest suite, or in-law space, leads to a spacious family room featuring custom oak shelving, abundant storage, a private entrance, and an adjacent bath. A convenient laundry room with an additional refrigerator adds everyday functionality. Upstairs, every bedroom enjoys its own en-suite bathroom and individual heating and cooling system for personalized comfort. The serene primary suite features a balcony with, French Doors, peaceful views, a beautifully renovated spa-like bathroom, and an adjoining room ideal for a sitting area, nursery, office, or oversized walk-in closet. Situated on 2.25 private acres just minutes from shopping, New Canaan, and the Merritt Parkway

Welcome to 59 Rock Spring Road, Unit 25 - an exceptional end-unit townhouse offering the perfect combination of comfort, style, and convenience in one of Stamford's most desirable locations.  This beautifully updated home features 3 generously sized bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and a powder room, providing a spacious and functional layout for everyday living. The renovated kitchen is thoughtfully designed with modern finishes and opens seamlessly to the main dining and living areas, creating an ideal space for both entertaining and daily life. Updated bathrooms throughout the home add a fresh, contemporary touch. The finished lower level, complete with a full bathroom, offers incredible versatility and can easily serve as a family room, home office, fitness space, playroom, or private guest suite. As an end unit, the home enjoys natural light, added privacy, and the convenience of an attached garage.  Ideally situated just minutes from shopping, dining, parks, schools, Metro-North, and major commuter routes, this move-in-ready home offers the perfect balance of peaceful living and everyday convenience. A rare opportunity to enjoy low-maintenance living in a prime Stamford location.

Lovely big Master bedroom with full bath with hardwood floors throughout main level. Huge family room perfect for relaxing! Come and see this beautiful updated home! Welcome Home to this spotless Colonial nestled in the highly sought-after Springdale neighborhood! Ideally located just a short stroll to local restaurants, shopping, & the Metro-North train, this home offers the perfect combination of convenience and comfort. Step inside to discover beautifully refinished hardwood floors & a bright, freshly painted open-concept living & dining room with sliding glass doors leading to an expansive deck-perfect for entertaining or relaxing outdoors. All rooms have been freshly painted top to bottom, creating a crisp, move-in-ready feel throughout the entire home. The sunny kitchen features freshly painted cabinetry, plenty of counter & cabinet space & a charming solarium window that fills the room with natural light. A versatile main-level office, den, or fourth bedroom, along with a convenient half bath, completes the first floor. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite boasts two oversized double closets & a stunning, brand-new ensuite bath featuring a double-sink vanity, new tub/shower, new flooring, toilet, & fresh paint. Two additional generously sized bedrooms-also freshly painted-and a full hall bath complete the upper level. The walk-out lower level offers a large family room, laundry area & plenty of storage, providing additional flexible living space. Situated on nearly a quarter-acre, the expansive backyard is ideal for gatherings & outdoor fun, featuring a fire pit, storage shed & plenty of room to play or entertain. Move right in!

Every detail has been thoughtfully curated for both elevated entertaining and everyday luxury. Throughout the home, you will find multiple newly renovated bathrooms, including a spa-quality primary bath with steam shower, refinished hardwood floors, custom millwork, updated lighting, and beautifully, newly renovated main living spaces. Exterior improvements are equally impressive, with pressed cedar shingle roofing, six-foot stone walls enclosing the property, extensive irrigation, landscape lighting, paver driveway, rear deck, hot tub enclosure, and re-leveled backyard creating a resort-like setting ideal for both quiet enjoyment and entertaining. This is a turn-key luxury estate offering privacy, scale, and architectural integrity; a truly exceptional opportunity for the discerning buyer seeking a legacy property in a premier location.

Sophisticated and timeless, this beautifully crafted colonial offers refined living in a private Greenwich setting. Designed with both elegance and functionality in mind, the home features 5 bedrooms, 4.1 baths, sun-filled interiors, and graciously scaled rooms ideal for entertaining and everyday living. The heart of the home is the chef's kitchen, seamlessly flowing into the main living spaces. Rich hardwood floors, two fireplaces, and thoughtful architectural details create a warm yet elevated atmosphere throughout. A fully finished lower level provides flexible space for a media room, gym, or playroom. Outdoor living is equally inviting with a screened porch, stone patio and a fenced backyard, offering privacy and tranquility. A rare opportunity to enjoy polished, move-in-ready living just minutes from downtown Greenwich.

The home offers endless potential for investors, builders, or DIY enthusiasts. With a newer roof, newer plumbing, newer siding, and an on-demand boiler, the major updates have already been done, but the home still needs TLC to make it shine. Sited on a generous .133-acre lot in an R-6 Zone. Just a short walk to the Metro North train station and with easy access to I-95, this location is perfect for commuters. Enjoy the vibrant downtown Byram area with its shopping, fabulous restaurants, and attractions like the beautiful Byram Park, offering a playground, marina, beach, and town pool. Whether you're looking to restore the existing structure or tear down and build something new, this is a fantastic opportunity to invest in a prime location in a growing community.

Beautifully maintained 4BR/3BA home on a flat, parklike 1acre property in a private association. Lush lawns, a handbuilt stonewall, and plenty of room for a pool or sports court. Features include hardwood floors, living room with fireplace, formal dining room, large eatin kitchen, firstfloor bedroom, full bath, and laundry. Second level offers a spacious primary with cedar walkin closet, additional bedroom, full bath, and an approved inlaw suite with kitchen, full bath, and separate entrance. Oversized 1car garage, treelined street, and opportunity to expand or move right in.

Fully reimagined luxury 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse elegantly positioned at the end of a private cul-de-sac in highly sought-after Glenville, offering a sophisticated blend of refined design, exceptional craftsmanship, and turnkey living. The main level showcases an expansive open-concept living and dining area centered around a stylish wood buring fireplace with custom built-ins and sliding glass doors leading to a private deck with serene woodland views. The designer kitchen features top-of-the-line appliances, sleek cabinetry, quartz countertops that extend seamlessly to the backsplash, and elegant under-cabinet lighting. The tastefully updated powder room is conveniently located just off the kitchen. Upstairs, the stunning primary suite offers vaulted ceilings, a custom walk-in closet, and a beautifully appointed en-suite bath. A spacious second bedroom and a fully renovated hall bath featuring designer textured wallpaper and a beautifully tiled tub/shower combination complete the upper level. The finished lower level provides exceptional versatility with a spacious family room ideal for a media room, home office, or additional living space, along with a dedicated laundry area and abundant storage. Additional highlights include a detached garage, assigned parking space, and a peaceful setting surrounded by nature. This exceptional residence offers luxury, privacy, and convenience in one of the most desirable locations in Greenwich.

Welcome to Mead Farm - exquisitely renovated and transformed midcountry Greenwich estate that blends historic character with modern luxury. Set on nearly 6 acres in a 2 acre zone, this 9,189 SF residence offers 6 bedrooms, 6 full and 2 half baths. A recent multi-year renovation by renowned designer Thom Filicia, paired with award-winning landscaping by James Doyle, elevates the property to a rare level of refinement, harmonizing timeless design with modern comfort. Originally built in 1846, the home features wide-plank floors, copper gutters, 7 fireplaces, and a wraparound porch. The rebuilt water tower adds a gym, wine room, full bath, and dramatic double-height office. Outdoors, enjoy gardens, terraces, pool with autocover, pond and a barn with loft and garages - just minutes from town.

listings.remarks: Experience exceptional craftsmanship in this new construction 6-bedroom, 6.2-bath home on a desirable Riverside cul-de-sac. Spanning over 6,500 sq. ft. across four levels, this thoughtfully designed residence blends luxury, comfort, and convenience. The main level features 10-foot ceilings, white oak floors, and a dramatic double-height family room with a gas fireplace. The show-stopping eat-in kitchen anchors the home, complemented by a formal dining room with wet bar, living room with fireplace, and private office. Upstairs, the primary suite impresses with vaulted ceilings, dual walk-in closets, a fireplace and a spa-like bath. Four additional bedrooms each with a walk-in closet-and three bathrooms complete the upper floors. The finished lower level offers a family room with fireplace, wet bar, gym, and en suite bedroom. Outside, enjoy a private oasis with a fire pit, motorized pergola, and room for a pool. Only minutes from schools, train, parks, and Old Greenwich village.

UNIQUE OPPORTUNITY! This oversize level property is one-third of an acre (.33) in an R-12 zone, in an excellent neighborhood in the heart of Glenville close to schools, shops and restaurants. The house is solid but in need of TLC and with some work could be a wonderful family home. Nice layout; the house has good bones but needs everything. House is being sold AS-IS. A new or expanded house could be up to 4,582 square feet. The house is currently 1,713 sq feet, has hardwood floors, 3 bedrooms and 2 full baths, an eat-in kitchen, a large living/ dining room and a spacious family room. Primary bedroom is en-suite. Natural Gas is available at this property if wish to convert from Oil. This property offers exclusive access to Greenwich's four beaches, marinas, a town-owned golf course, and an indoor ice rink.

Welcome to Old Greenwich! A great opportunity to own a 1-bedroom plus den, 2 full bath garden-level condo in the sought-after Old Greenwich Gables. This inviting home features a newly updated kitchen with white cabinetry and granite countertops, along with an open layout that offers comfortable everyday living. The unit has been freshly painted, and the hardwood floors have been refinished, creating a clean, move-in ready feel. Sliders lead to a private patio overlooking the beautifully landscaped courtyard. The spacious primary suite includes a luxurious bath, while the versatile den is ideal for a home office, guest room, or additional living space. Additional highlights include garage parking, central air, in-unit washer and dryer, and storage. Enjoy access to community amenities such as a pool, gym, squash court, and clubhouse. Conveniently located near the Old Greenwich train, shops, restaurants, Binney Park, Tod's Point, and the new Civic Center.  An exceptional opportunity to enjoy the Old Greenwich lifestyle.  --

A rare Shorehame Association lot with unobstructed Long Island Sound sight lines offered as an amazing opportunity to build new or reimagine the existing residence in one of Old Greenwich's most sought after waterfront settings. The .28 acre property sits within a private association that includes sandy beach access, a boat launch ramp for paddle boarding, kayaking and boating and a large communal waterfront lawn.  The current home features a large living room with direct Sound views, a formal dining room, a kitchen and family room opening to a stone patio facing Long Island Sound, and a primary bedroom suite with private bath. Three additional bedrooms and full bath occupy the upper level, sharing the same water views. Gas heating, central air conditioning and an attached 2-car garage are in place. A beautiful and serene location in a private waterfront association, Long Island Sound views and steps to Tod's Point - all within minutes of the Old Greenwich train station, Old Greenwich shops and dining and schools.

Welcome to a slice of heaven & an opportunity to own a piece of history on 2 acres in Back Country Greenwich. Upon entering through the front gate, you will be transported to a tranquil oasis and welcomed into an inviting home that was thoughtfully redesigned and renovated so that the new serves to complement the old throughout. Spacious living room with original beams, bookshelves and window seat is perfect for family time, rainy day reading or entertaining. Hallway leads to formal dining room with built-ins and French doors and also into bright eat-in chef's kitchen with vaulted ceiling and skylights. Opens to patio and beautifully planted, well maintained grounds. Romantic primary suite/FP opens to outside as well. Next level offers an en suite bedroom as well as two additional bedrooms with shared bathroom. Delightful family room, laundry room and mudroom with laundry are on lower level with access to 2 car garage. Beautiful grounds with back gate access to pond (shared with 2 families) and beyond a trail that leads to Greenwich Trails, offering direct path from garden. This special home and property offer wonderful opportunities for outdoor lifestyle and proximity to the charming town of Armonk, which is 2 miles away. Just half mile to Modern Barn Restaurant, pizza place, wine shop, deli.

100 East Putnam Avenue, Apartment 301 -- Brand-New Luxury 2-Bedroom Rental in Cos Cob, Greenwich A new standard for rental living has arrived in Cos Cob. Apartment 301 is a sun-filled, brand-new two-bedroom residence at 100 East Putnam Avenue -- a rare chance to lease luxury new construction in a town where it almost never comes to market. An open-plan layout flows from a generous living and dining space into a designer kitchen, wide-plank flooring throughout, oversized windows with multiple exposures, and integrated smart-home technology for lighting, climate, and entry. The primary suite offers a spa-inspired bath; the second bedroom is well-suited to a guest room, nursery, or home office.  The building delivers what you'd expect at this level: secure smart-building access, an expansive landscaped rooftop terrace, covered and uncovered on-site parking, and dedicated storage lockers. The location is the rest of the story. You're along the heart of Cos Cob's main corridor, moments from the town's best restaurants and boutiques, and just a 10-minute walk to the Cos Cob train station -- Grand Central in approximately 44 minutes, Stamford in 12. Greenwich Country Day School's Old Church Road campus is a short walk; the Stanwich campus is a 7-minute drive. Weekends mean Cos Cob Park, the Greenwich Botanical Center, and the quiet sophistication of this stretch of Connecticut.

An immaculate Greenwich Townhome that lives like a single-family home. Set in Cos Cob, this 3-bedroom residence offers two levels of living and outdoor space that extends your livable footprint. Park right in front and enter a bright first floor with natural light and sight lines to greenery. The living room, anchored by a shiplap fireplace, opens to a patio and lawn and flows to the dining area and pristine gourmet kitchen. Upstairs features a generous main bedroom with two additional bedrooms and a full hall bath. Enjoy nearby parks, beaches, Metro-North access, and great local restaurants.

listings.remarks: Brand-New Luxury Construction at The South Water Collection a boutique offering high-end townhomes designed to elevate coastal living in Greenwich. Offers 4,000 square feet of refined coastal living, thoughtfully designed to balance elegance, comfort, and modern functionality. Featuring 6 bedrooms and 5.5 designer bathrooms. The sun filled home features 9 foot ceilings throughout a sophisticated living area anchored by a gas fireplace, and a chef's kitchen appointed with quartz countertops and custom cabinetry. The home includes a luxury primary suite with a spa inspired bath, generous closet space, and a serene, private setting . The finished lower level provides a 6th bedroom, additional recreation space suited for media, fitness, 4th level offers an office suite with 5th bedroom +. A two car garage and curated finishes throughout complete this exceptional offering within the South Water Collection. Great location, close to local restaurants and shops!
Free Heat & Hot Water! - 2nd Floor - 3 Bedroom 1 Bath in Terrific Cos Cob neighborhood. Large Eat in Kitchen with Stove, Refrigerator, Washer & Dryer. Hardwood Floors thru-out. 1 Off Street Parking.
Large, two-bedroom apartment located downtown Greenwich.   Near the train station, shops, and restaurants.

Set on a private one-acre corner lot, this stately 1900 Georgian Colonial offers over 7,500 sqft of living space, blending timeless architecture with modern updates. Featuring 9 bedrooms, 8.5 baths, and 8 fireplaces, the home showcases exceptional scale and craftsmanship. Inside, you'll find 12-foot ceilings, intricate millwork, leaded glass windows, and custom built-ins that reflect its historic character. A sweeping central staircase anchors the home, with sun-filled formal living and dining areas that open to a full-length veranda overlooking the private grounds and gated pool.  The kitchen and bathrooms have been updated, offering modern functionality while preserving the home's original charm. A cozy den with exposed oak beams and a fireplace adds warmth and contrast to the main level. Upstairs, the primary suite includes a fireplace, dressing area, walk-in closet, and balcony with distant views of Long Island Sound. Additional bedrooms and a spacious third-floor living area provide flexibility for guests or extended living. Located in an R-20 zone with possible subdivision potential, this is a rare opportunity to own a distinctive property that combines historic elegance with long-term upside.

Backcountry Greenwich | Resort-Style Living. Total Privacy Single-Level Luxury Compound | Available Now A rare single-level luxury compound on two private acres. Comprehensively renovated in 2026, the home centers on an expansive primary suite opening directly to a gunite pool, spa, and bluestone terraces, with a spa bath, infrared sauna, and steam shower. A fully self-contained guest residence - private, entrance, kitchenette, living area, full bath, and independent HVAC - lives like a separate house, ideal foe extended family, staff, or remote work. Two additional en-suite bedrooms, three fireplaces, a custom white-oak kitchenette with 6' x 12' island, five-zone sound, whole-house generator, and an oversized four-car garage complete the offering.

Beautifully semi-furnished 1BR + loft condo (912 sqft) w/ Restoration Hardware furnishings (table, chairs, queen bed, side tables+tv & console). Bright residence features 16 ft vaulted ceilings, abundant natural light, large living/dining area, updated kitchen with new refrigerator, laundry w/ new washer/dryer, oversized bathroom, and versatile loft ideal for office or guest space. Private entrance & secluded deck offer peaceful outdoor living w/ pond and garden views. New carpeting, new wood stairs & new A/C wall units installed. Rent includes 1 parking space, heat, hot water, and maintenance. Near boutique shopping, fine dining, beach, and public transportation. Privacy, elegance, and convenience in one of Greenwich's most sought-after neighborhoods. No pets or smoking.

facts.laundryLoc: New stackable washer & dryer in kitchen

listings.remarks: Welcome to The Madrid at The Five Greenwich. Presented by Corner North Ventures & designed by Fofie & Mia's, this designer-furnished luxury townhome blends modern European-inspired design with elevated downtown Greenwich living. Thoughtfully curated interiors feature soaring ceilings, statement lighting, sculptural furnishings, layered textures, & a custom kitchen with oversized island seating. The primary suite offers a spa-inspired bath & custom closets, while a second bedroom provides flexible use. Two parking spaces, in-unit laundry, & turnkey convenience. Moments from Greenwich Ave, Metro-North, parks, cafes, fine dining, & shopping, The Madrid delivers a rare luxury rental experience in the heart of downtown Greenwich. Five Curated Homes. One Greenwich Lifestyle.

Brand-New Luxury Construction at "The South Water Collection" a boutique offering high-end townhomes designed to elevate coastal living in Greenwich. Offers 3,000 +square feet of refined coastal living, thoughtfully designed to balance elegance, comfort, and modern functionality. Featuring 4+ bedrooms and 4.5 designer bathrooms. The sun filled home features 9 foot ceilings, a sophisticated living area anchored by a gas fireplace, and a chef's kitchen appointed with quartz countertops and custom cabinetry. The home includes a luxury primary suite with a spa-inspired bath, generous closet space, and a serene, private Courtyard setting . The finished lower level provides additional recreation space suited for media, fitness, and the 3rd level offers an office suite with 4th bedroom. Curated finishes throughout complete this exceptional offering within the South Water Collection. Great location, close to local restaurants and shops!

Unmatched value in the heart of downtown Greenwich. This sun-filled 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse offers a rare blend of space, privacy, and outdoor living-right in town. Enjoy a stair-free private entry, an expansive private patio, and the ability to BBQ grill-an almost unheard-of luxury in this location.  Inside, a bright, open layout features pristine hardwood floors, a cozy wood-burning fireplace, and a spacious dining area ideal for entertaining or a stylish work-from-home setup. Brand-new windows (November 2025) flood the home with natural light while enhancing comfort and energy efficiency.  Additional highlights include abundant closet space, dual entry doors, and an in-unit washer/dryer-making this home truly move-in ready.  Set within the beautifully maintained, 13-acre park-like grounds of Putnam Park, just moments from Greenwich Avenue, Metro-North, Whole Foods, top dining, and shopping. Extra storage, plentiful free off-street parking, optional garage parking through the HOA, and property taxes included in the HOA (partially tax-deductible) add exceptional value.  A rare opportunity to own a spacious downtown townhouse with private outdoor living at an exceptional price point.  Some photos have been virtually staged to illustrate potential furniture placement and design; actual furnishings may differ.

listings.remarks: Bright, spacious and pristine townhome offering 3 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms. Sun drenched; quiet, end-unit offers private living on all 3 levels. Large, eat-in kitchen with island, granite countertops, large pantry, and lots of cabinets for additional storage. Bonus room off the Kitchen serves as a formal Dining Room, or as a private office space. Oversized living Room with wet bar, and French doors which lead to a private, fenced yard is perfect for entertaining. Beautiful hardwood floors continue upstairs to all 3 bedrooms. Primary bedroom has an oversized en-suite. 2 additional bedrooms are generous in size and have large, double closets. Walk out lower level is ideal for a playroom, gym or additional workspace. This property is beautifully landscaped, with an attached garage, and a private driveway. Close proximity to both central Greenwich and the NY border makes commuting and shopping a breeze. 2 minutes to Pemberwick Park, tennis, basketball, playground and The Mill. Available 8/13, please inquire about pets.

Elevator convenience meets in-town luxury! This sunlit Greenwich triplex townhome blends sophistication with easy living. Perfectly designed for low-maintenance lifestyles, it offers single-floor living options, a flexible floor plan, and space for family or guests. Enjoy 3+ bedrooms, 3.1 baths, two decks and just steps from downtown and top-ranked schools in Connecticut. Bonus: Dining Room or Gym can convert to an additional bedroom with bath or Office/Den. Check out the virtual staging! $1,253 Monthly HOA (paid quarterly).

Lovingly maintained by the same family for 54 years, this charming 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers the perfect blend of seclusion and convenience. Set back at the end of a cul-de-sac, it is a private, tranquil oasis. Thoughtful updates include a newer roof, gorgeous new kitchen cabinetry, fresh paint, and new lower-level flooring. An expansive yard and two stunning decks invite you to relax and soak in the outdoors, while an abundance of windows bathes every room in warm, natural light. Whether you're hosting, unwinding, or simply enjoying the peace and quiet, this home delivers. Move in as-is or take advantage of incredible expansion possibilities. Conveniently located near major transportation, top-rated schools, DeCicco's, shops, restaurants, and parks. A rare find - ready for its next chapter.

Tucked at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in one of Greenwich's most coveted school districts, this beautifully updated 4-bedroom home delivers the rare combination of move-in condition and real upside. The fully reimagined primary suite stuns with high-end marble, dual vanities, and a custom walk-in closet. Open-concept kitchen and family room -- anchored by one of two fireplaces -- flow through French doors to expansive new decks. The second level offers three bedrooms and two full baths, including a serene ensuite. A renovated basement delivers flexible living space for a gym, office, or playroom. Two-car attached garage, updated appliances, tankless water heater, split A/C, and generator check every box. Over 1,000 SF of expansion potential awaits. North Mianus Elementary.
Spacious two bedroom apartment located on Greenwich Avenue....minutes away from the train station and plenty of restaurants nearby.   In the process of being painted and carpet cleaning.

118 Halstead Avenue presents an exceptional opportunity to own a home in one of Connecticut's most desirable communities. Located in the established Pemberwick neighborhood of Greenwich, this property offers a unique combination of neighborhood charm, convenience, and long-term value.  Situated in a well-established residential setting, the home enjoys easy access to shopping, dining, transportation, and major commuter routes, making it an attractive option for those seeking connectivity to both Connecticut and neighboring Westchester County. The neighborhood is known for its strong sense of community, convenient access to a wide range of everyday amenities, and the highly regarded Greenwich public school system.  Residents enjoy close proximity to parks, waterfront recreation areas, beaches, walking trails, and a community pool that contribute to Greenwich's exceptional quality of life. From scenic shoreline settings and open green spaces to recreational facilities and year-round outdoor activities, the area offers an ideal balance of relaxation and active living.  Opportunities to enter the Greenwich market at an attainable price point are increasingly uncommon. With its desirable location, neighborhood appeal, recreational amenities, commuter convenience, and potential for future enhancement, 118 Halstead Avenue represents a compelling opportunity to establish roots in one of Fairfield County's most sought-after communities.

Nestled at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, this beautifully renovated 4-bedroom, 3.1-bath home offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and functionality.  The welcoming main level features a spacious living room with a wood-burning fireplace, seamlessly flowing into the dining area and updated kitchen. Sliding doors lead to an expansive deck and private backyard, creating an ideal setting for indoor-outdoor living and entertaining. A practical mudroom, powder room, and a bright family room or home office with direct deck access complete the first floor.  Upstairs, the generous primary suite boasts double closets, a walk-in closet, and a beautifully renovated en-suite bath with a soaking tub and separate shower. Three additional bedrooms and a well-appointed hall bath provide ample space for family and guests.  The walk-out lower level adds valuable living space, featuring a full bathroom, playroom, den, and abundant storage, offering flexibility for recreation, work, or overnight visitors.  Ideally located in a peaceful neighborhood setting, this move-in-ready home combines modern updates with timeless appeal.

Unlock the potential of this diamond in the rough in this PRIME Riverside location! Spacious and sun-filled 4 bedroom home overlooking Binney Park. Living room with fireplace, eat-in-kitchen, large family room adjacent to kitchen. Sun-room overlooks the generous slate patio and fenced-in yard. Three bedrooms on the first floor, with Primary suite on the second floor. Huge family room in the walkout lower level with fireplace and bathroom. Close to everything....schools, train, stores and Perot Library. The plot is .38 of an acre -16,553 square feet- which allows the construction of a new house of 5,269 square feet. R 12 zoning.

Welcome to 47-49 Indian Harbor Drive-an exceptional end-unit townhouse offering the perfect blend of space, style, and location in the heart of Greenwich. This beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath home features approximately 2,200 square feet of open-concept living on the main level. The inviting living room with a wood-burning fireplace flows seamlessly to sliders leading out to a private deck and fenced, landscaped backyard-ideal for entertaining or everyday enjoyment. The gourmet kitchen is designed to impress with rich cherry cabinetry and sleek black granite countertops. Upstairs, the primary suite is a true retreat with vaulted ceilings, skylights, a spacious walk-in closet, and a private bath complete with soaking tub and separate shower. Two additional sun-filled bedrooms-one with its own private balcony-share a well-appointed hall bath with convenient laundry. The finished lower level offers incredible versatility with a second wood-burning fireplace, full bathroom, workshop, and utility room with sink-perfect for extended living, recreation, or creative space. Additional highlights include a private one-car garage and an assigned outdoor parking space. Very short walk to the MetroNorth and Greenwich Train Station getting you Grand Central. Ideally located just steps from Bruce Park and the Bruce Museum, and moments to the shops and dining of Greenwich Avenue, as well as I-95 for easy commuting. Make your appointment to view today!

listings.remarks: This stunning 4 bedroom home offers an exceptional blend of elegance, comfort, and beautiful design. Featuring gorgeous finishes throughout and a fantastic floor plan, it is perfectly suited for both everyday living, and entertaining. The chef's Kitchen serves as the heart of the home, showcasing lots of cabinetry and counterspace, quality craftsmanship, and a vaulted ceiling with beams that add character and an architectural twist. The main level office/den is very comfortable with vaulted ceiling and lots of windows for natural light. A recent renovation has transformed this beautiful home into an expanded Cape by seamlessly incorporating the walk-up attic into an amazing 4th bedroom, Rec Room or guest quarters, complete with gorgeous full bathroom, added storage and customized walk-in-closet. The lower level provides outstanding expansion potential, offering flexibility for future living space, recreation, fitness, and mudroom. Outside, enjoy a private outdoor retreat with beautiful stone walls and mature trees. The patio and firepit area create the perfect setting for relaxing evenings and gatherings with family and friends, while landscape lighting enhances the property's ambiance after sunset. The stone facade and paver driveway add a unique flair to the curb appeal. Ideally located, this exceptional home is just minutes from town, train, parks, shopping, and all the conveniences the area has to offer.

Move right into this beautifully maintained 4-bedroom home in the heart of Cos Cob! The first floor offers a wonderful open-concept family room flowing seamlessly into the eat-in kitchen, creating the perfect space for everyday living and entertaining. A formal dining room, full bath, private office, and study complete the main level. Upstairs, you'll find four generously sized bedrooms and two full bathrooms, including access to a walk-up attic from one of the bedrooms, providing excellent storage or future expansion potential. Outside, enjoy a flat backyard and detached two-car garage. Ideally located just moments from parks, shops, restaurants, schools, and the train, this home offers the perfect combination of space, convenience, and lifestyle.

Welcome to this professionally landscaped, energy-efficient custom-built 4,100 sq ft home with 5 beds and 4.1 baths, located across from North Mianus School. Enjoy a bright living room with gas fireplace, sunlit dining room with large glass doors, and a custom chef's kitchen with quartzite counters. Step outside to a bluestone patio with sitting wall and built-in natural gas BBQ-perfect for entertaining. A pantry and mudroom lead to the 2-car garage. The finished lower level adds 1,623 sq ft with 9 ft ceilings, fireplace, and French doors to a second patio. Special rental for a special renter.

Enjoy this beautifully updated two-bedroom townhome in the heart of Cos Cob. This inviting residence features an open-concept layout with a gourmet kitchen complete with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a spacious pantry. The kitchen flows seamlessly into a well-appointed dining area and a bright living room with vaulted ceilings and a gas fireplace. French doors open to a bluestone patio and a small, fenced yard. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite offers an updated bathroom and generous walk-in closets. A unique loft space within the suite provides an excellent opportunity for a home office or private retreat. This level also includes a large second bedroom, bathroom, and laundry space. All of this within minutes of the train, shops, schools and The Avenue.

Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac off Sheephill Road, this new construction home - which was once a local theatre- offers 6,447 square feet of inspired living. Spanning four floors, the details blend timeless craftsmanship with contemporary design for everyday living. The chef's kitchen truly is the heart of this home, with custom cabinetry and a generous island that flows into an inviting family room with additional custom millwork and a fireplace. There are sliders which open to the terrace with an outdoor kitchen- all perfect for effortless entertaining. A formal dining room, butler's pantry, and a private en-suite office also on the main level provides flexibility for modern living. The primary suite features a vaulted ceiling with an electric fireplace, and a spa-like bath with soaking tub and steam shower, along with a large walk-in closet. 3 additional ensuite bedrooms complete the second floor. The third level offers a light filled play space and an additional bedroom/home office and full bathroom. The lower level extends your experience with a dog washing station, fitness room, recreation area, and another ensuite bedroom with a walk-out to the private backyard. Potential wine cellar and sauna spaces are available, as well as a potential pool site. Still time for bathrooms, kitchen, paint and stain customizations. Every element of this home its proportions, finishes, and flow has been designed for a life of comfort, connection, and quiet distinction.

Spectacular custom-built modern home in the heart of Old Greenwich. Flooded with natural light, this sophisticated residence features soaring ceilings, oversized windows, and seamless indoor-outdoor living throughout. The open-concept layout offers effortless flow for both everyday living and entertaining, a gourmet kitchen with an oversized island, a retractable screened porch, and a private office. Four spacious en-suite bedrooms include a beautifully designed primary suite, while the finished walkout lower level adds exceptional flexibility with an additional bedroom and en-suite space. Level yard, patios, and beautifully designed modern living complete this exceptional home. Available early August.

Majestic six bedroom manor, completely rebuilt with exceptional quality and craftsmanship, and sited on stunning 1.4 park-like acres in coveted Calhoun Drive Association. This distinguished residence is gracefully elevated to offer sweeping views of expansive lawns, lovely gardens and specimen trees. Impressive, sophisticated interiors throughout offer soaring ceilings, gleaming hardwood floors and sunlit living space. A grand foyer opens to a gracious floor plan of spacious rooms perfect for formal entertaining and casual living. Highlights include an airy sun room, coffered ceiling family room & breakfast room, all opening to a expansive terrace with stunning lawn and garden views. Generous space for a new custom kitchen. Luxurious primary suite features two marble Waterworks bathrooms, walk in closets and a sitting room with access to a private balcony. An additional private guest suite provides enhanced comfort for guests. A welcoming garden level offers a media room, wet bar, wine cellar, gym with full bath and playroom with access to a private outdoor covered terrace. The main residence has a three car garage. There is a charming two story carriage house with storage for two more cars. This stately home, located on a quiet cul-de-sac, is close to downtown Greenwich with fine shopping and dining and transportation to NYC.

Welcome to Putnam Green Apts- a garden style community offering the perfect blend of modern comfort and Greenwich charm. This beautifully updated studio apt features new modern appliances including brand new washer/dryer, stylish finishes and bright open layout. Enjoy a peaceful residential setting surrounded by lush greenery, from your private patio, while being only minutes away from renowned restaurants, cafes, boutique shopping, art galleries, and entertainment. Commuters will love the easy access to Greenwich Ave, I 95 and the Metro North train station, making trips to NYC a breeze! On site parking included.

Spacious furnished/unfurnished rental on a cul-de-sac close to beach, pool, schools and neighboring shops, offering the perfect combination of comfort, convenience and coastal living. A dramatic entry foyer welcomes you to an elegant living room featuring a fireplace. The formal dining room is ideal for hosting large family gatherings and special occasions, while the eat-in kitchen provides ample space for everyday. Adjacent to the kitchen, the 2-story family room with fireplace, offers a generous and comfortable setting. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite features a fireplace, walk-in closets and en-suite bath designed for comfort and relaxation. Two (possibly 3) additional bedrooms, 2 additional bathrooms complete the second level. Walk-out Lower level has laundry, and full bath.

Set on 8 private acres in one of Greenwich's most prestigious enclaves, 38 Partridge Hollow Road offers luxury and tranquility and the ultimate privacy. Boarded by protected land on three sides, this five-bedroom, 7.5-bath home blends timeless elegance with modern sophistication, featuring a first-floor primary suite with dual baths, separate closets, and access to a private office and gym.  Bright, sunlit interiors and a chef's kitchen flow into inviting living spaces ideal for entertaining. Outdoors, enjoy a pool, tennis court, and beautifully landscaped grounds. This exceptional estate offers both convenience and serenity.
