listings.remarks: A rare single-level luxury compound set on two private acres - Greenwich address, Stamford taxes and schools. Designed for effortless resort-style living, the home centers on an expansive primary wing opening directly to a gunite pool, spa, and sweeping bluestone terraces, complemented by a spa-inspired bath, infrared sauna, and steam shower. A fully self-contained guest residence within the home - with its own entrance, kitchenette, living and dining areas, full bath, independent HVAC, and security - lives like a separate private house for extended family, live-in staff, long-term guests, or flexible work-from-home living. Two additional en-suite bedrooms adapt seamlessly as family suites, private offices, wellness spaces, or a gym. Comprehensively renovated in 2026, the residence features a custom rift-cut white oak kitchen anchored by a dramatic 6' x 12' island, designer baths, new flooring, roof, driveway, and extensive stonework. Soaring cathedral ceilings, walls of glass, and skylights flood the home with natural light throughout. Additional highlights include three fireplaces, wet bar, five-zone integrated sound, whole-house generator, oversized four-car garage, and a 5,400+ sq ft lower level with fireplace and wine storage offering exceptional future build-out potential. Two fully usable acres with no wetlands or conservation restrictions, and privacy preserved in perpetuity.

Exceptional new construction waterfront home set on a private cul-de-sac in one of Old Greenwich's most desirable enclaves. This custom-built residence offers 180-degree unobstructed water views from every bedroom and living space, with beautiful NYC skyline views. Designed for modern coastal living, the home spans three levels with six decks and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. Walls of glass and Nano folding doors open the main level directly to the water, leading to a newly built private dock ideal for boating and entertaining. The interior features 5 bedrooms, 5 full baths, and 2 powder rooms, with wide 10-inch plank floors throughout. The chef's kitchen is centered around a 22-foot quartz island and equipped with Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, including double ovens, double dishwashers, and additional refrigerated drawers. A third-floor full kitchen offers added flexibility for guests or extended living. Spa-like baths include Lusso Stone fixtures, heated floors, towel warmers, and a Kohler smart toilet in the primary suite. Built to the highest standards with steel beam and pile construction, 16-foot FEMA compliance, and custom Marvin windows. Ideally located just moments from Old Greenwich village, train, and a short walk to schools, town, and beach, with private beach access.

Multifamily development opportunity. Currently a single family home. Ideal for investors, builders, or end-users looking to customize. Convenient access to Metro-North in a downtown up and coming Byram location. As-Is. Unit mix listed is proposed.

Welcome to this sun-drenched, impeccably maintained 3 bed, 2 bath townhouse style home offering refined, effortless living. Ideally located in downtown Greenwich, 20 mins walking distance to the train station taking you directly to Grand Central in NYC, 10 mins walking distance to Greenwich avenue, shops and restaurants, 5 mins walking distance to the elementary school, 10 minutes walking distance to the high school and to much more that Greenwich has to offer. The open concept layout flows seamlessly for everyday living. A spacious living area opens to a private balcony overlooking a tranquil courtyard. The home features one bedroom and full bath on the second level, with two additional bedrooms, a full bath, and laundry on the third floor. 2 unassigned parking spaces and pet friendly.

listings.remarks: Sport Lovers Dream - Set at end of a quiet cul-de-sac on Stillman Lane, this custom-built 2013 residence offers 4 finished levels of thoughtfully designed living space on 1.2 level acres w putting green. High ceilings, abundant natural light and seamless flow define the main level, where formal living and dining rooms connect effortlessly to an expansive open-concept kitchen and family room with fireplace. Upstairs, find a primary suite with spa-inspired bath with heated floors, whirlpool tub + steam shower plus 4 en-suite bedrooms. The walkout LL is centered around recreation + wellness w gym, golf simulator, indoor putting area, glice for skating on, rec room + wine rooms. Professionally designed landscaping by James Doyle, expansive flat lawn + outdoor kitchen complete the property.

This unit needs to be seen in person to fully appreciate an ample space it offers. All updated and polished spacious 2-story rental with a mud room at the entrance and plenty of space in the finished lower level. The unit comes with a huge deck overlooking a beautifully landscaped park-like backyard. Gorgeous new beach with swimming pools and tennis courts is only a short walking distance from the house. And it all could be yours! Ask for a private showing before this beautiful place is gone and spend summer months playing tennis, basking under the sun and swimming on the beach.

Don't miss your chance to own this two-family home or transform it into a single-family residence. Upper level (Unit 1) includes a walk-in porch, 1 bedroom, full bathroom, dining room, office, den and comfortable living room with a fireplace. This unit also has a washer/dryer hookup. The lower level (Unit 2) offers 2 bedrooms, full bathroom, living room, and home office or playroom.  Additional features include separate thermostats for each unit. Perfect for investors or owner-occupants. The property sits on a 0.13 lot, so you can enjoy a private outdoor space. Conveniently located near downtown Greenwich, train stations and I-95, making this home a must see!

This charming Old Greenwich home in the highly sought-after North Mianus/ Eastern school district is the perfect starter or the best condo alternative. A picturesque setting, this single-family dwelling comes with low property taxes, low maintenance responsibilities and costs. The first floor offers comfortable living and family room spaces, a newer kitchen with quartz countertop and stainless steel appliances, along with 1 bedroom and a new hall bath. The 2nd floor consists of 2 bedrooms (one with spacious cedar closet) and another newer full bath. The private backyard with a bluestone patio provides a serene outdoor environment, surrounded by mature trees and plantings. Many updates throughout the house; all public utilities; home is in R-7 zoning and can be expanded. This property is not in a flood zone. An Elevation Certificate and FEMA letter is available. The location is wonderful as it is quiet and convenient to all that Greenwich has to offer.

Excellent opportunity to build your dream home in the heart of Old Greenwich! This is an unparalleled location - close to all of the shops and restaurants Old Greenwich has to offer, to schools, and to the train station. Water access at end of road.  **Highest and best due Monday April 6th at noon -   Please offers to send to Michael Thomason, Attorney at Heagney and Lennon  mthomason@hlsctlaw.com  Please include all pertinent info as well as signed disclosures and attorney info.

listings.remarks: Turnkey living on a flat .57-acre lot in a quiet cul-de-sac with a beautifully manicured yard. This well-maintained Colonial offers 4 bedrooms including a primary ensuite and 2.5 baths. The home features a spacious open living and dining room, plus a comfortable family room with hardwood floors and fireplace. The kitchen with stainless steel appliances and granite countertops opens to a bright sunroom with gas fireplace and wet bar perfect for entertaining. Glass sliders lead to a spacious deck where you can watch beautiful sunsets, while the sunroom overlooks the backyard and fills the home with natural light. Lower level offers a flexible workout or playroom. Convenient to the Merritt Parkway, shopping, and all that Greenwich has to offer.

Exceptional custom built 5 bedroom stone and shingle home in a sought-after Riverside location. Across from Riverside school/playground and one block to Eastern Middle School, this beautifully designed and professionally decorated home showcases a two-story foyer, well proportioned and light-filled living spaces, high ceilings, exceptional finishes and craftsmanship. Spacious chef's kitchen has stainless steel appliances and opens to a lovely family room w/fireplace. Seamless access to the stone patio and outside kitchen overlooks the new Shoreline pool and level private yard. Elegant primary suite plus 4 generous sized bedrooms upstairs. The expansive lower level has a large recreation area, gym and bonus room with bath. Extras: 6 fireplaces, 3 car garage, covered front porch. Turnkey!

Charming home once part of a majestic Greenwich estate is set on 2.03 picturesque acres framed by classic stone walls. Thoughtfully updated while preserving its timeless charm and intimate scale, the farmhouse-style home blends character with modern comfort. Sun-filled interiors feature hardwood floors throughout, an updated kitchen that opens seamlessly to the family room & dining area, ideal for everyday living. A separate living room offers additional gathering space, while a cozy den w/ fireplace provides an inviting ambiance.The home includes 4 BR & 2.5 BA highlighted by a spacious primary suite w/ an adjoining sitting room and an upstairs family/playroom. Outdoors, the setting is truly exceptional. A large level play area, pool, stone patio & charming gazebo ideally located less than three minutes from the hamlet of Glenville and less than ten minutes from Greenwich Ave, this special property combines character and everyday convenience with endless potential to expand.

This magnificent 9,974 sq ft estate seamlessly blends grand scale, craftsmanship, and modern luxury. Set on 2.3 parklike acres in coveted Mid-Country Greenwich, just minutes from town, the home makes an immediate impression with a soaring two-story foyer introducing exquisitely appointed interiors defined by custom details and rich materials. Updated in 2026, the show stopping kitchen features top-of-the-line appliances, bespoke cabinetry, and a dramatic quartzite center island, opening to a vaulted great room with fireplace and effortless access to the pool terrace. Six spacious ensuite bedrooms include a luxurious primary retreat with sitting room, 2 private offices, fireplace, spa-like marble bath with steam shower and soaking tub, and expansive walk-in closets. A private in-law or nanny suite provides flexible living options. The finished lower level features a 2,000-bottle temperature-controlled wine cellar with tasting bar, recreation space with putting green, sauna, fitness area and ample storage. Outdoors, enjoy a 55-foot pool, spa, 3,000 sq ft sun deck, BBQ island, and sweeping lawns. Additional enhancements include a redesigned laundry room, upgraded lighting throughout, refinished floors, freshly painted interiors, smart home and automation upgrades, state-of-the art security system, new HVAC systems and a modernized garage. An iconic residence where grandeur meets exceptional craftsmanship and refined living.

Welcome to 31 Thornhill Rd in Greenwich's Riverside neighborhood, a renovated home that feels like new and is backed by a new construction warranty. Rebuilt from the ground up, the property features a reinforced foundation, all new framing and walls, plus a new roof and siding for long-term peace of mind. Inside, enjoy wide white oak floors, a custom kitchen, and a Viking appliance package designed for both everyday living and entertaining. Efficiency and comfort are enhanced with spray foam and soundproof insulation, natural gas heat, a new heating and cooling system, and Davinci aluminum-clad windows with energy-efficient glass. The home is smart-home pre-wired with Control4 automation and built-in speakers. Outdoor living includes a private patio and deck, automated sprinkler system, and garage parking, completing this thoughtfully rebuilt and move-in ready residence.

Welcome to 255 Byram Road - a charming and move-in ready Colonial that offers a thoughtful layout and updates throughout. The main level is anchored by a welcoming foyer, a living room with fireplace, and a dining room with newly refinished hardwood floors. The kitchen and powder room complete the first floor. Upstairs are three bedrooms, a full bath, and an additional room perfect for a home office or playroom. A screened porch overlooks the flat yard, and a one-car garage completes the property. The home is ideally located near downtown Greenwich, restaurants, shops, parks, and the waterfront. Proximity to the train and I-95 offers easy commuting.

Situated on over two private acres in the highly desirable Mid-Country Greenwich area, this sophisticated 5-bedroom, 3.5-bath brick Colonial is a move-in-ready home designed for comfortable living and effortless entertaining. A welcoming foyer introduces the home's spacious layout, leading to both the living and family rooms. The generous family room, featuring a fireplace, flows seamlessly into the formal dining room. The updated, oversized eat-in kitchen opens to a large deck, creating an ideal setting for indoor-outdoor gatherings. A flexible bonus room-perfect as a sunroom, den, or home office-offers sliding doors that open to the expansive, private backyard. The home includes two primary bedroom suites - one on the main level and another upstairs -offering versatility for guests, multi-generational living, or an au pair. Bright, sun-filled interiors, hardwood floors throughout, and a fully finished basement add to the home's comfort and appeal. Additional features include a three-car garage, beautifully updated bathrooms, a whole-house generator, and a fully fenced backyard. Just minutes from the amenities of Greenwich, this exceptional property offers a rare blend of privacy and convenience.

Exquisite, turnkey 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom residence located on the first floor of an elegant, full-service doorman building in the heart of downtown Greenwich. This beautifully renovated 1,250 sq ft home offers a seamless blend of sophistication and comfort. The thoughtfully designed interior features a chef's kitchen outfitted with premium Bosch appliances, opening into a gracious dining area and an additional sitting space ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. A sunken living room with a fireplace creates a warm, inviting atmosphere and leads to a private, covered terrace perfect for outdoor dining. Additional highlights include hardwood floors throughout, high ceilings, and generously proportioned rooms. Located just moments from Greenwich Avenue, 25 W Elm offers exceptional amenities, including a full-time doorman, assigned parking, and private storage unit. Move-in ready and ideally situated this is downtown Greenwich living at its finest.

listings.remarks: A rare offering in the heart of downtown Greenwich, this 2,500 sq. ft. luxury condominium delivers an exceptional blend of sophistication, privacy and effortless living. Set within a serene, tree-line enclave, the residence offers a refined retreat just moments from Greenwich Avenue. A private elevator from the garage introduces a thoughtfully designed interior where elevated finishes and timeless details define the space. The main level showcases a gracious living room with a gas fireplace and custom built-ins, flowing seamlessly into an expansive dining room designed for elegant entertaining. The chef's kitchen is appointed with high-end appliances, a bespoke breakfast nook, and opens to a private covered terrace overlooking the lush grounds. A powder rooms completes this level. The second floor reveals 2 generously proportioned bedrooms, a full bath and a stunning primary suite featuring a spa-inspired dressing room. A dedicated laundry area enhances everyday convenience. Additional amenities include private garage parking with an electric charging station and abundant storage. Offering the rare combination of tranquility, scale and premier in-town location, this residence of luxury living with the charm of a secluded "treehouse" retreat.

A rare and magnificent architectural offering designed by award-winning architect Paul Haigh, where sophisticated simplicity meets the quiet poetry of Bauhaus influence. Set along the serene Mianus River, this home is a masterful composition of nature, light, and form-where every space is intentionally designed to engage with its surroundings. From the moment you enter the oversized foyer crowned by a striking cupola, there is an immediate sense of volume, light, and quiet drama. This architectural introduction unfolds into a home that is both expansive and deeply connected to nature. Walls of glass frame ever-changing river views, while the great room-with its soaring vaulted ceiling, white brick fireplace, and curated built-ins-offers a balance of openness and intimacy. Light moves effortlessly throughout the day, casting warmth across rich hardwood floors and transforming each window into a living work of art. The kitchen is refined and purposeful, with clean lines, natural materials, and a generous central island-all surrounded by soft, ambient light. It is a space equally suited for quiet mornings or gathering with ease. Just beyond, a screened-in porch floats above the river, offering a serene vantage point for coffee at sunrise or long, lingering evenings immersed in the sounds of nature. There are four bedrooms and baths, each thoughtfully composed with a palette of stone, glass, and warm earth tones. The primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with tranquil

First Time on the Market! Set on a quiet, sought-after street, this spacious five-bedroom, three-bath split-level home spans 2,911 square feet of bright, comfortable space. The main level features an eat-in kitchen and a large open dining and family room with an electric fireplace, ideal for gathering and everyday living. Sliders off the dining and family area lead to a generous deck overlooking a level yard, well suited for indoor-outdoor entertaining. A sun-filled living room with a bay window adds welcoming charm.  The upper level includes a large great room, providing valuable flexible space for recreation, work, or relaxing. A walk-out lower level adds even more versatility, well suited to a playroom, home office, gym, or multi-generational living needs. Central air, a one-car garage, and abundant space throughout complete this desirable opportunity in Riverside.

Beautifully renovated rental in the heart of Cos Cob offering the perfect blend of modern style and comfortable living. This home features an open floor plan with soaring ceilings and abundant natural light throughout. The spacious kitchen is a true centerpiece, complete with a large island and seamless flow into the dining area, which opens directly to a patio with a gas grill, ideal for indoor-outdoor entertaining. The inviting family room showcases vaulted ceilings, creating a bright and airy gathering space. The luxurious primary suite offers a private retreat with a beautifully appointed bathroom. Upstairs, you'll find an office, two additional bedrooms and a full bath, providing plenty of space for family or guests. The versatile lower level includes an additional bedroom or office, along with a large bedroom or recreation room featuring a brand-new full bathroom and walk-out access. Set on a professionally landscaped property, the home includes an attached oversized garage and a fenced-in backyard that backs directly onto Pomerance Park, offering privacy and scenic green space. A rare rental opportunity combining space, style, and an exceptional location.

Fully Renovated Coastal View Townhouse.  Welcome to 5 Glen St #204, a beautifully renovated 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse offering style, comfort and an unbeatable location on a private dead-end street. This light-filled home features hardwood floors throughout and an open living/dining area enhanced with custom shiplap, a redesigned fireplace with new tile and mantel, and seamless flow for entertaining. The updated kitchen includes a modern yet timeless subway tile backsplash, stainless steel appliances and refreshed finishes.  Upstairs, the spacious bedrooms offer comfort and convenience, including a renovated primary bath with a large custom shower and a hallway bath featuring a relaxing jacuzzi tub. A standout upper-level loft provides incredible flexibility-perfect as a 3rd bedroom, office, or retreat-while showcasing stunning views of the Long Island Sound and NYC skyline.  Enjoy morning coffee or evening relaxation on the private deck, all while taking in the exceptional natural light. Recent upgrades include central air (2022), hot water heater, washer/dryer, updated fixtures and more.  Residents love the close-knit community feel, where neighbors gather, families play and privacy abounds. Ideally located just minutes to Byram Shore, Metro-North, Greenwich Avenue, and local dining. A truly special home offering lifestyle, views and community.

listings.remarks: A rare and distinguished offering in mid-country Greenwich, an estate of architectural significance, ready to be reimagined for modern luxury living. The Helen C. Douglas house was designed by the renowned Twachtman Brothers, this timeless brick English country home blends classic elegance with warmth, sophistication and scale. Set on 3.8 acres of beautifully landscaped, private grounds, the property features a pool, pool house, clay tennis court, and a striking allee of chestnut trees. The estate was also featured in the 2014 film ''And So It Goes'' starring Michael Douglas and Diane Keaton. A gracious front-to-back foyer invites you into the home's classic interiors. Formal living and dining rooms are complemented by a wood-paneled library, chef's kitchen, spacious family room and additional entertaining space.

Welcome to this exquisitely updated Colonial on 1.16 landscaped acres near Greenwich Country Club and minutes from town. A grand foyer with gleaming hardwood floors and sweeping staircase introduces the elegant interior. The main level includes a formal living room, dining room, two studies, and a gourmet kitchen with Wolf appliances, Palissandro marble, Thermador coffee station, a custom wet bar and a 425-bottle wine cellar. The kitchen opens to a family room with fireplace and French doors. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a sitting room, luxurious bath, office, and fireplace. Four additional bedrooms complete the level. Enjoy 3,000+ sq ft of terrace, heated saltwater pool, Viking grill, and a pavilion with sound system. The Heated and air conditioned 4-car garage adds storage and versatility.

This beautifully updated condominium, set within a restored Victorian home, blends timeless architectural character with modern luxury in a premier downtown location. The residence offers 4 bedrooms and 3.1 baths, plus a gourmet kitchen with Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances. A spacious wraparound porch extends the living space outdoors, complemented by a rare front and side yard. Parking includes a two-car garage and two additional spaces. The lower level features a 2,000-bottle wine cellar and abundant storage. Located in an intimate seven-residence boutique community, it offers exceptional privacy and refined downtown living.

listings.remarks: Rare 3BR ranch-style, one-level corner co-op in sought-after Putnam Hill-just minutes to downtown Greenwich. Sun-filled end unit with an open layout, expansive living space, and walls of windows. Updated kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining area, perfect for everyday living and entertaining. Spacious primary suite with walk-in closet and full bath, plus two additional bedrooms and second full bath.  Enjoy effortless lock-and-leave living with in-unit W/D, private balcony, hardwood floors, high ceilings, and generous storage. Elevator building with garage and on-site parking, set on 10 beautifully maintained acres. Maintenance includes property taxes, heat, hot water, and grounds.  Moments to Greenwich Ave, Metro-North, shops, dining, and parks-an unbeatable in-town lifestyle.

listings.remarks: Tucked at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in coveted Hillcrest Park, this superbly renovated 5-bedroom, 3.1-bath Colonial offers 5,213 square feet of refined living on 1.11 manicured acres in the heart of Old Greenwich, CT. Close to top-rated North Mianus Elementary School and just minutes from the Old Greenwich train station, downtown shops, and the beach, this is the rare Greenwich estate that delivers space, privacy, and walkability in equal measure. A double-height entry with gleaming hardwood floors sets the tone, opening to a sun-filled living room with fireplace and French doors, formal dining room, and a stunning chef's kitchen featuring a Sub-Zero refrigerator, Dacor double ovens, wine refrigerator, large center island, and a built-in eating area. The main level also includes a library/den, family room with fireplace and French doors to the terrace, and a powder room. Upstairs, the primary suite is a private retreat with a walk-in dressing area and bath. Four additional bedrooms, two full baths, a dedicated laundry room, and a flexible office/sitting area complete the second floor. The finished lower level adds a media room, playroom, and studio ideal for entertaining, working from home, or growing families. Additional features include central air, a 2-car attached garage, security system, expansive deck and terrace, and beautifully landscaped grounds. Renovated in 2016 and meticulously maintained.

Unit 818 at Hawthorne is a beautifully-renovated one bedroom, one bathroom unit that's ideal for downsizers, professionals, or anyone looking for a peaceful community that's just minutes from town. The kitchen, with generous storage for all your cooking needs, features GE appliances and a breakfast bar. A light and bright living room opens to a quiet backyard overlooking the woods. The generously-sized bedroom has two closets and a full bathroom with a large vanity and beautiful shower. Stacked laundry beside kitchen. Situated in the heart of Glenville, this home puts you within walking distance of local shops, restaurants, and the soon-to-open DeCicco's market, adding even more convenience to your everyday routine. A dedicated indoor garage spot is included, ensuring hassle-free living.

A rare offering in the coveted Willowmere Association, 44 Willowmere Avenue presents an exceptional opportunity in a truly special setting. This 4-bedroom residence captures beautiful water views and is nestled within exquisitely mature, curated landscaping that creates a private, garden-like sanctuary. Established plantings and seasonal blooms frame the property, evoking a sense of retreat just moments from everyday conveniences. A true mid-century modern residence, originally designed by architect William Rutherford as his personal home. Known for his celebrated landscape work at Storm King Art Center and the New York World's Fair, Rutherford brought a rare sensitivity to the relationship between architecture and the natural environment. This home reflects that vision--seamlessly integrating clean modern lines with its surrounding landscape. The existing footprint provides flexibility, while the setting elevates the potential to something truly extraordinary. Enjoy the heated pool and the ease of a walkable, highly desirable location. An exceptional opportunity for the discerning buyer to craft a one-of-a-kind residence in an idyllic coastal enclave.

Privately sited on beautifully landscaped grounds, this extensively renovated 5-bedroom residence blends modern design with exceptional comfort and energy efficiency. Thoughtfully updated throughout, the home features an open-concept layout ideal for both everyday living and entertaining, with a designer kitchen, high-end stainless steel appliances, and beautifully renovated baths with premium finishes in 2020. New windows and doors enhance the light-filled interiors, while the lower level offers flexible recreation space with the second powder room and direct access to the property. A separate guest or in-law suite with its own entrance and kitchenette provides excellent flexibility for extended family, guests, or au pair living. The home is equipped with advanced energy-efficient systems, including Tesla solar panels and Powerwalls, spray foam insulation, and upgraded water and air filtration systems. Expansive lawn areas offer endless possibilities for outdoor living, including room for a pool or tennis court, all surrounded by mature trees, natural privacy, and picturesque stone walls woven throughout the property.

If your wishlist sounds something like: ''Greenwich, updated, bright, great for entertaining, and close to everything'' than 34 1/2 Orchard St. in beloved Cos Cob is what you've been waiting for. Nestled on a 1/4 acre just a short stroll to the best restaurants, shops, and school, this stone and sustainable shingle colonial feels welcoming from the moment you come down the driveway. Whether enjoying a quiet day at home or hosting a party overflowing with friends, you'll find this residence spacious, fun, & easy to live in. Updated in 2022, the oversized Dining Room opens to the fresh Kitchen w/white quartz counters & door to the bluestone patio. The large, light-filled Living Room flows into a cozy Family Room w/a stone fireplace & sliders to the yard. Upstairs are the 4 family bedrooms - you'll love the primary bedroom with walk-in closet and full bath. The lower level, complete w/fireplace offers ''potential'' should you ever need extra room.

6 Oak Drive is on a cul-de-sac off Indian Head Road. The plot is .617 of an acre -26,872 square feet- which allows the construction of a new house of 6,046 square feet, plus the finished area in the basement and third floor. The back to the house where the family room and kitchen would be situated is south facing with amazing sun all day. Survey with a pool site, drainage plans, planting plans, soil tests and grade plane calculations have been approved with the town, the Wetlands Agency and DPW.

Experience the charm of arriving at Putnam Hill-10 acres of meticulously landscaped grounds in the heart of Greenwich. This unique community features five beautiful brick buildings, ample parking, and a welcoming residential feel, all just steps from the center of town. Leave the car at home and enjoy easy access to dining, shopping, transportation, worship, and countless local activities. This spacious residence offers two bedrooms and two bathrooms, a generous living and dining area, a walk-in closet, and a large private balcony-perfect for relaxing or entertaining outdoors. Co-mingled with the Putnam Park Cooperative Townhomes, Putnam Hill combines classic history with the ease and convenience of apartment-style cooperative living, all within a vibrant and inviting community.

listings.remarks: Situated in the heart of Pemberwick, this beautifully maintained 3-bedroom home blends classic charm with modern updates. The sun-filled, renovated kitchen opens to a formal dining room and an inviting living room with a fireplace, plus a flexible space perfect for a home office or den. Glass sliders lead out to a fully fenced, professionally landscaped backyard-ideal for gatherings, play, or peaceful relaxation. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite offers a walk-in closet and a luxurious bath with a Jacuzzi tub. Two additional generously sized bedrooms share a full hall bathroom. Set in a welcoming, family-friendly neighborhood just steps from Pemberwick Park and moments from Byram Park's beach, pool, and marina. Enjoy easy access to both I-95 and the Merritt Parkway.

Set in the desirable Edgewater neighborhood, 7 Heusted Drive offers a flexible layout, multiple living options, and exceptional convenience in the heart of Old Greenwich. The home is designed to adapt to a variety of needs, with open, well-proportioned living spaces, high ceilings, and thoughtful detailing throughout. A central kitchen with a large island connects seamlessly to the main living areas and opens to a private rear patio, creating an easy flow for both everyday living and entertaining. The second level features a primary suite with private balcony and a luxurious bath with steam shower, heated floors and soaking tub, along with additional bedrooms and a conveniently located laundry area. A finished third floor adds valuable flexible space, offering options for work, recreation, or extended living. A separate two-story cottage provides a unique and highly functional extension of the home, complete with a spacious bedroom and full bath. Ideal for guests, private workspace, or creative use, this space adds meaningful versatility. Additional highlights include flexible room configurations, ample storage, and professionally landscaped grounds designed for low-maintenance living. Located just moments from the village, train, shoreline, restaurants, schools, and shopping, the property offers a rare combination of adaptability, comfort, and convenience in one of Old Greenwich's most sought-after neighborhoods.

listings.remarks: Fabulous opportunity to personalize this home & make it your own! Located on a coveted, tree lined street, with a charming, classic neighborhood feel! Close to beaches, parks, restaurants and shops! Minutes to train and I 95 for an easy commute/trip into NYC! This one has it all!

Nestled within the Putnam Park community in the heart Greenwich, this sun-drenched 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom co-op offers effortless, single-level living in a serene, park-like setting. Spanning over 1,200 square feet, the residence features three exposures, filling the home with natural light throughout the day. The open floor plan creates a seamless flow between living and dining spaces, complemented by an updated kitchen outfitted with stainless steel appliances--ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Thoughtfully renovated bathrooms add a modern touch, while an oversized in-unit washer and dryer provide everyday convenience. Chalet d'Amour This home is priced at least a cool $1 million below the floor for comparable Greenwich houses - and below what the empty land alone would cost. So the 3,826-square-foot, architect-designed contemporary? Effectively free. Both claims are easy to check. The land: every comparable Greenwich lot - same town, same schools, two-plus acres - is offered for more than the asking price here, with no house on it at all. The sales: run these filters on Zillow - single-family houses, 3,500+ sq ft, 2+ acres, built 1985 or later, sold in the last 12 months. Fifty-five homes. Not one sold below $3.6 million, and the median was roughly $7.5 million. (Zillow flags one apparent exception, 43 Hunting Ridge Rd, but it has only 3,262 sq ft above grade - the rest is finished basement - and sits on regulated wetlands.) This home sits at least a cool $1 million below that floor, and roughly a third of the median.  And this is no teardown.  Across from Mianus River Park, Chalet d'Amour is an architecturally crafted contemporary unlike anything else on the market: soaring vaulted ceilings, two dramatic stone fireplaces, walls of glass, and light pouring in from every direction.  The first-floor primary suite features cathedral ceilings, dual baths, dual walk-in closets, and a grand whirlpool tub beneath peaked windows. Enjoy beautifully landscaped grounds and exceptional complex maintenance, including recently completed new roof and new hardie board siding ,adding both value and peace of mind. Residents also enjoy access to the complex swimming pool.

Nestled on a private cul-de-sac in one of Greenwich's most coveted mid-country locations, this beautifully updated five-bedroom residence is set on 1.1 professionally landscaped acres, offering a rare combination of privacy, functionality, and convenience. Thoughtfully designed for modern living, the home blends formal and informal spaces, features abundant natural light, and offers seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The living room with fireplace opens to a sun-filled three-exposure office or conservatory, while a second dedicated office provides exceptional work-from-home flexibility. At the heart of the home, the eat-in kitchen flows effortlessly into the inviting family room with incredible vaulted ceilings, beam work and custom light fixture, which features a second fireplace, vaulted ceilings and direct access to an expansive deck overlooking sweeping lawns and mature gardens. A versatile first-floor bedroom suite offers endless possibilities as a guest-suite, playroom, fitness studio, or additional living space. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite features a walk-in closet and an oversized bath, complemented by three additional bedrooms and a hall bathroom. The finished lower level provides valuable bonus space for recreation, media, fitness, or play, while a dedicated laundry room and an attached two-car garage enhance everyday convenience.

Sun-drenched and privately set on 1.45 level acres, this spacious 4-bedroom, 3 full bath mid-country home offers tranquility just minutes from town and steps from Mianus River Park. Sliding doors connect the indoor living spaces to the outdoor deck, creating seamless indoor-outdoor living ideal for entertaining. A finished lower level provides flexible space for a playroom or home office. Recent improvements include a newer roof, boiler, and well pump, offering a solid foundation for future updates and personal touches. Surrounded by peaceful grounds and nature, this special property presents a wonderful opportunity to create lasting memories.

Bright and Spacious 4 BA/3 BA in the Dundee/Eastern school district. Completely renovated in 2018 so all you have to do is unpack. Great kitchen with open layout makes entertaining a breeze and great flow through the French Doors to the easy maintenance expansive deck. Third floor is finished and great for relaxing or playing and could be turned into a 5th bedroom and there is plumbing for a 4th bathroom. The level .27 acre yard is perfect for playing or relaxing. Centrally located in Riverside means you're minutes to trains, shops and schools on foot, bike or car.

Old Greenwich Gables end-unit on the 1st floor on the upper courtyard near the association pool. Open floor plan with a terrace off the Living Room. A primary suite, an office, and a second full bath with shower. The washer & dryer are off the kitchen. There is one assigned parking space and storage locker are in the garage. Enjoy the easy access to Old Greenwich, Binney Park and the library.

Brand new, very rare large format Italian tile kitchen & bath. Sun pours into this renovated/old world charm gen on the Avenue! H/W floors throughout... heat + hot water included. Tenant pays electricity and cooking gas. Laundry room around back of bldg. Municipal parking lot in back of building. Blocks to train, parks, and I95 for an easy commute/trip into NYC and ferry to Island Beach... just in time for summer! Sorry no pets.

Renovated 5 BR/3.5 bath home on a quiet cul-de-sac in the North Street school district, close to shops, restaurants, parks and hiking trails, available 8/1/2026. Renovated gourmet kitchen with stainless steel Thermador appliances, double oven, and beautiful quartz countertops. On the second level, the primary bedroom suite opens to an attached office/den and luxury bath. In addition, 4 more bedrooms and 2 hall baths provide ample living and office space for the whole family. Bathrooms are luxuriously renovated with radiant heat floors, marble vanities, Waterworks fixtures, and built-in towel warmers in the primary bath. Enjoy the sunset from the spacious deck off the kitchen area or relax in the private wooded backyard.

Bright and spacious 4 bedroom, 2.1 bathroom raised ranch tucked away on a quiet street in Cos Cob. Kitchen with all newer appliances, and freshly painted throughout. Spacious Living Room/ Dining Room with wood burning fireplace, and large, renovated Family Room with a door leading out to a brand new double tiered deck. Walk out lower level has a large 4th bedroom/ Playroom/ au pair space with separate entrance and full bathroom. The private backyard has a new fence and overlooks the Pomerance Conservatory. Close to schools, trains, and shops.

Great family neighborhood. This beautifully renovated home has an updated kitchen with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances and a breakfast bar. Open living & dining room floor plan and gleaming hardwood floors throughout. There are 4 bedrooms with ample closet space and 2 bathrooms. The lower level consists of a large family room and the 4th bedroom. Walk out entrance to a patio and lovely ''private'' backyard. Pets at the discretion of the owner. Lower level renovated in 2022. Central air conditioning installed in 2022.

Nestled within a beautifully maintained and privately secluded community, this exceptional corner-unit home offers the perfect blend of comfort, natural beauty and convenience. From nearly every window, you'll enjoy views of mature trees and lush landscaping creating a serene, park-like setting that feels worlds away from the everyday. The oversized windows frame the beautiful scenery surrounding the premises, creating a seamless connection with nature, meanwhile the sun-drenched living room features large south-facing windows filling the space with natural light throughout the day and the bedrooms offer breathtaking views of winter sunsets. Thoughtfully upgraded for everyday comfort, the home features a premium three-zone heating system with separate controls for two of the bedrooms and one for the rest of the living area providing customized climate control throughout. The updated kitchen is equipped with a reverse osmosis water filtration system, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances and a breakfast bar. Step outside to the private balcony, enhanced with a brand-new composite floor, creating a perfect spot to relax, enjoy the tranquil surroundings and those morning sunrise hours. A tremendous opportunity to make this bright and turn key unit, tucked in a peaceful vacation like setting, your home. Subject to Seller Finding Suitable Housing.

listings.remarks: Tucked away at the end of a peaceful cul-de-sac characterized by minimal traffic and a genuine sense of community, this classic Cape-style residence offers a rare and sought-after blend of convenience and timeless Riverside charm. Bordered by a lush, protected forest buffer with natural expanse and dense tree canopy, the property provides privacy and an exceptional environment for everyday living, outdoor play, gardening, or simply unwinding. All of which strikes a perfect balance between a secluded neighborhood feel and the practicalities of a well-located home.  Inside, the residence features sun filled rooms, flexible living spaces, and a layout that supports both relaxed daily routines and effortless entertaining. Large windows bring in natural light throughout the day, while the surrounding greenery enhances the home's sense of calm and retreat.  A notable advantage of this location is its short distance to Binney Park and Tod's Point, providing an easy option for enjoying nearby outdoor recreation whenever desired. Convenience is another hallmark of this address with it's close proximity to neighboring Old Greenwich and Cos Cob. Nearby, local shops, restaurants, library, schools, Metro North train station (3 min) and I-95 also make commuting and weekend errands refreshingly simple.  With its quiet setting and prime Riverside address, the property presents an exceptional opportunity in one of Greenwich's most desirable neighborhoods.

Move right into this bright and beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 1-bath first-floor apartment in a meticulously maintained multifamily residence. Filled with natural light, the spacious living room is warm and inviting while the updated kitchen and bath, gleaming hardwood floors, and in-unit laundry provide modern comfort and convenience. The kitchen features newer appliances including stainless steel gas range, refrigerator, and dishwasher. Assigned parking (2 spots). HEAT & HOT WATER INCLUDED! Ideally situated on a picturesque tree-lined street, this home is just moments from parks, schools, shopping, dining, and all that Cos Cob has to offer!

HEAT, WATER, AND LANDSCAPING ALL INCLUDED! Enjoy the best of downtown Greenwich living from this updated first-floor apartment at 84 Sherwood Pl. Just a 4 minute walk from Greenwich Avenue, you'll have easy access to some of the area's best restaurants, boutique shops, Whole Foods, Greenwich Library, and a neighborhood dog park. Recent improvements include updated flooring and fresh paint throughout, and all brand new appliances. The home sits on a level lot with a private backyard perfect for relaxing, entertaining, or spending time with your pets. On-site, shared basement laundry and storage adds everyday convenience, while heat, water, and landscaping are all included in the rent. This is a rare opportunity to enjoy a quiet residential setting just moments from everything downtown Greenwich has to offer.

MAIN FLOOR HEAT, WATER, LANDSCAPING, AND SNOW REMOVAL ALL INCLUDED! Enjoy the best of downtown Greenwich living from this updated second-floor, two-level apartment with large loft bedroom. Just a 4 minute walk from Greenwich Avenue, you'll have easy access to some of the area's best restaurants, boutique shops, Whole Foods, Greenwich Library, and a neighborhood dog park. Recent improvements include updated flooring and fresh paint throughout, and all brand new appliances. The home sits on a level lot with a private backyard perfect for relaxing, entertaining, or spending time with your pets. On-site, shared basement laundry and storage adds everyday convenience, while main floor heat, water, landscaping, and snow removal are all included in the rent. This is a rare opportunity to enjoy a quiet residential setting just moments from everything downtown Greenwich has to offer.

Location, Location, Location! Enjoy the convenience of downtown Greenwich and one floor living at Putnam Hill. This bright, top floor corner apartment offers desirable western exposure, filling the home with natural light throughout the day. The spacious layout includes a generous living room & dining areas that open to the expanded kitchen and private balcony. Featuring an ensuite primary bedroom plus 2 addl. bedrooms & bath. Hardwood floors throughout & laundry is located within the unit. You'll appreciate a secure lobby entrance, and additional storage. Pet friendly with restrictions - one cat or one dog, 24 lb. max. On-Site Super. Buyer pays a one time capital asses of .5% of sale price at closing. Garage parking as avail @ $85/month. Pet friendly w/restrictions. A great community close to shopping, dining & transportation.

listings.remarks: Exceptional HOBI Award-winning shingle-style home by Argus Development on one of Riverside's most coveted streets. Thoughtfully designed for everyday living and entertaining, this home features a chef's kitchen with oversized island and banquette, family room with custom built-ins and fireplace, private study, mudroom, luxurious primary suite, and en-suite baths for every bedroom. French doors open to a covered bluestone patio overlooking a private backyard retreat with pool and spa. Renovated in 2022, the finished lower level offers a bedroom suite, full bath, kitchenette, laundry, two fireplaces, hardwood floors, and cedar closet. Minutes from schools, train, Old Greenwich Village and Tod's Point. Riverside is a lifestyle.

Located in a sought-after Cos Cob neighborhood, this spacious and sun-filled home offers approximately 3,800 square feet of finished living space across three levels. Designed for both comfortable everyday living and effortless entertaining, the main level features a gracious living room with direct access to an expansive deck, a formal dining room, and a large eat-in kitchen that opens to a dramatic family room with cathedral ceilings. A butler's pantry, mudroom, private office, and powder room complete the thoughtfully designed first floor. The second level features a primary suite with a fireplace and oversized walk-in closet, creating a private retreat. Three additional bedrooms, another full bath, and a convenient second-floor laundry room provide ample space for family and guests. The walk-out lower level offers exceptional flexibility with a large recreation/playroom, fifth bedroom, and full bath-ideal for guests, an au pair, home gym, or additional living space. Perfectly positioned for convenience, the home is just minutes from Pomerance Park, Cos Cob School, the Metro-North train station, shopping, restaurants, and all that Greenwich has to offer. Combining generous living spaces, modern conveniences, and an exceptional location, this is a rare rental opportunity in the heart of Cos Cob.

Location, location, location: Easy 5 minutes away from Cos Cob train station. Discover the beauty of waterfront living in this spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condominium at Palmer Point. Perfectly situated along the Mianus River, Unit 306 offers serene water views, a well-designed floor plan, and effortless access to all that Cos Cob has to offer. The sun-filled living and dining area is anchored by sliding glass doors that open to a private balcony-ideal for enjoying morning coffee while watching boats drift by. This unit has 2 large bedrooms, 2 Full baths, 2 Balconies, a storage room, a large attic, and Garage parking. all utilities are included in rent! Great deal. (renter only pays electric).

Welcome to 31 Connecticut Avenue, where the classic charm of a Colonial meets modern comfort in one of Greenwich's most desirable neighborhoods. Ideally situated just moments from vibrant Greenwich Avenue, premier shopping and dining, and the Metro-North train station, this beautifully maintained home offers the perfect blend of convenience and timeless appeal.  Filled with abundant natural light, the home features hardwood floors throughout, a welcoming living room with a cozy gas fireplace, and central air conditioning for year-round comfort. The thoughtfully designed layout offers spacious living areas ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Outside, a detached two-car garage and ample off-street parking provide exceptional convenience.  Enjoy all that downtown Greenwich has to offer while coming home to the warmth, character, and enduring elegance of this classic Colonial.

Extraordinary property. Exceptional location. A once-in-a- generation offering in one of Greenwich's most desirable in-town neighborhoods. Magnificently sited on 1.17 park-like acres along the sweeping curve of one Greenwich's most coveted cul-de-sacs, this custom-built residence offers an unparalleled combination of privacy, scale and convenience, just moments from top-rated schools, downtown Greenwich, fine dining, shopping, and Metro-North. Designed with timeless architecture and gracious proportions, this elegant six-bedroom, five-bath home showcases exceptional craftsmanship and remarkable flexibility for today's lifestyle. A distinctive feature is the private suite with its own driveway, entrance, and parking area--ideal for an in-law or nanny suite, home office, or multigenerational living. The breathtaking grounds are equally impressive, featuring sweeping lawns and an expansive, level backyard perfectly suited for entertaining, recreation, or future enhancements. An exceptional opportunity to own a legacy property where timeless elegance, extraordinary grounds and limitless potential converge in the heart of Greenwich.

Nestled on a peaceful cul-de-sac, this chic home boasts an open-concept layout with soaring vaulted ceilings in the family room that create an inviting and spacious atmosphere. The light wood floors enhance the natural light streaming through expansive windows, adding warmth and elegance throughout. The gourmet kitchen is connected to the family, living, and dining rooms, offering a seamless flow for entertaining. Sliding doors open to an expansive terrace, providing picturesque views of the private backyard, which features a stunning pool and spa with an adjacent patio offering a serene retreat. The second floor includes the primary suite with two walk-in closets and two additional bedrooms that share a hall bathroom. The lower level has an additional en-suite bedroom, an office, mudroom, laundry room, and a cozy sitting room. Located just minutes from shops, train stations, and top schools, this home is both light-filled and beautifully appointed.

Sun pours into this adorable one bedroom, with all utilities included! Close to shopping, restaurants, schools, park & beaches....just in time for Summer! Cats OK, sorry no dogs. One off street parking space.

Renovations just completed on this fabulous sun filled 2 bdrm unit on the Ave! Brand new kitchen & bath with modern cabinets and Italian tile. Hardwood floors throughout, charming sconces, heat & hot water included! Surrounded by 5 star restaurants & designer shops. Blocks to train and I95 for an easy commute/trip to NYC, and ferry to Island Beach! Just in time for Summer! Laundry around back of the building... municipal lots with app for parking. This one has it all! Stove has been ordered and will be installed prior to moving.

Freshly painted, bright and sunny, 2 bed, 2 bath single family home close to parks, marina, shopping and transportation. Family room could also be a 3rd bedroom with full bath. Refinished floors throughout. House is energy efficient with updated heating system and updated central A/C. Lots of storage space. Heated 1 car attached garage with additional off street parking with room for 2 more cars. Available July 1st for long term lease. No pets. Excellent credit required. ROOM SIZES: Livingroom/dining area 16/x16, Kitchen off LR/DR area 10x11, Family Room, 16x16, Double Bedroom 12x12, Double Bedroom 10x12

MOVE RIGHT IN! Glenville School District. Immaculate and recently updated, this sunny and freshly painted first floor unit is ready for you! Located at the end of a quiet street near public transportation, shops and restaurants. Offers a fabulous floor plan with living room, dining room and a super handy mudroom with plenty of storage that leads to the eat-in kitchen, featuring granite countertops and stainless steel appliances. The primary en suite is complemented by 2 bedrooms and a full bath, all with ample closet space. Enjoy central A/C and hardwood floors thruout. The expansive LL family room, newly renovated, including a beautiful tile floor, is perfect for family gatherings and boasts a fireplace, bar w/quartz countertops and French doors leading to a beautiful flagstone terrace.

Enjoy comfortable living at its best with ALL utilities included except cable, internet, phone and liability insurance. The main level features a spacious, modern open-concept layout that seamlessly combines the living room, dining area and newer kitchen. The second level offers two comfortable bedrooms with 1 full bath and 1 half bath. The windows throughout fill the space with much natural light, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere. Coin-operated washer & dryer - No pets allowed. Cul-de-sac location and close to Pemberwick Park, shops and Highways. Applicants must provide strong credit and a solid employment history.

listings.remarks: Beautifully updated first-floor apartment in the heart of Greenwich. Offering 2 spacious bedrooms with generous closet space and a large full bath, this charming home blends comfort, convenience, and style. Bright open-concept living and dining area flows into an updated kitchen featuring a dishwasher and a walk-in pantry, creating an inviting space for both everyday living and entertaining.  Freshly painted with new flooring throughout, this move-in-ready home also offers in-unit convenience with access to a washer and dryer in the basement and a dedicated storage room. Step outside to enjoy the beautifully finished bluestone patio and shared backyard-perfect for relaxing or enjoying the outdoors , grill etc!!   Laundry is located in the basement of the neighboring house (same owner). Coin-operated laundry. Off-street parking spaces available.

Set on beautifully landscaped grounds just minutes from downtown Glenville, this charming residence blends timeless historic character with modern conveniences. The home features 4 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, spacious living areas filled with natural light, and a thoughtfully designed layout ideal for everyday living and entertaining. Enjoy the beauty of the surrounding grounds from multiple outdoor spaces, creating a true private retreat just moments from shopping, dining, parks, and transportation. Additional highlights include 1st Floor bedroom option with bath, 972SF third floor with half bath perfect for guest space, art studio or playroom. EV Charger, ample parking, and the rare combination of historic charm and modern functionality in one of Greenwich's most desirable locations.

Located on a quiet mid country lane in the North Street school district, this center hall colonial offers privacy and tranquility with views of the one and a half acre property and pond. The main floor features a generously sized living room with fireplace and french doors to a sunroom with separate heating and cooling, formal dining room, powder room, and adjoining family room with fireplace and French doors to the rear yard as well as a laundry/mudroom with full bath and access to the attached 2 car garage. Second floor has an en suite primary and three additional bedrooms and hall full bath. carpeted lower level suitable as gym-playroom. Agent to Agent Rmrks: Breakfront remains in kitchen. Owner/tenant share snow removal. Tenant occupied, Appointment required. LB accompanied.

facts.laundryLoc: Laundry room and full bath on main level

listings.remarks: Enjoy the summer in this 4 bedroom Old Greenwich home, where character, comfort, and outdoor enjoyment come together. The inviting living room with fireplace creates a warm and welcoming space, while the spacious family room offers additional room to relax and entertain. A lovely formal dining room provides even more space for gatherings. The eat-in kitchen flows to the deck and private fenced backyard, where a heated swimming pool creates your own personal summer oasis. Enjoy afternoons poolside, outdoor dining, and easy entertaining in this tranquil setting. The main level features a generously sized bedroom with its own ensuite bath, offering convenience and one-level living. Upstairs you'll find 3 additional bedrooms, including an ensuite bedroom/second primary + a full hall bath. Updates include a whole house generator, new electrical panel, new boiler (2025), new roof (2019), new pool pump (2026), central a/c, and a new washer and dryer. All in a convenient location near one of Greenwich's beautiful beaches - Tod's Point, great parks, schools, shopping, dining and transportation. A wonderful opportunity to enjoy Old Greenwich and make every day feel like a vacation -- a wonderful place to call home!

Great unit in the heart of downtown Greenwich. Hardwood floors, new appliances, large living room, parking in back for 1 car. Across the street from park. All utilities included except electric. Laundromats and wash and folds nearby.

Lovely shore colonial, with formal dining room, solarium, office, eat-in updated kitchen, adjoining family room with a wall of French doors opening on to a cover porch, overlooking a swimming pool. Beautiful, private, professionally landscaped grounds. Long term rental rate unfurnished is $20K/mo. Furnished or unfurnished. Both rates are plus utilities.

Located in a desirable neighborhood in Old Greenwich, this contemporary home offers a spacious and thoughtfully designed floor plan with five bedrooms and three full bathrooms. The main level is centered around an expansive living room with a fireplace, creating a warm and inviting space for both everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen features a center island and opens to a bright breakfast nook, while a separate dining room provides an ideal setting for gatherings. A first-floor bedroom with a walk-in closet and en-suite bathroom offers flexibility for guests, multigenerational living, or a private home office. The second floor features four generously sized bedrooms, including a spacious primary bedroom, along with two full bathrooms and ample closet space throughout. Thoughtfully designed with well-proportioned living spaces and a functional layout, this home offers comfort, versatility, and an exceptional location.

Nestled on a tree-lined road, this storybook Cape offers 3 bedrooms, 1 full and 1 half bath, surrounded by lush grounds offering privacy and timeless character. A welcoming front porch, immersed in nature, is the perfect place to enjoy your morning coffee. The tiered backyard features multiple terraces and a winding path to a hilltop shed ideal as a yoga studio, home office, or creative escape. Inside, a center-island kitchen flows into the breakfast room and living room. The spacious dining room is perfect for entertaining, while the primary suite offers a sitting area, office nook, and gas fireplace. The back patio creates seamless indoor-outdoor living. Easy walk to Binney Park, town, and shopping. Offered for the first time since 1998, this enchanting retreat is truly one of a kind.

HEAT AND HOT WATER INCLUDED! Available 9/1. This first-floor apartment is spacious and full of natural light. Featuring 2 bedrooms, 1 bath, livingroom, dining room, kitchen and an ideal space for a home office off the dining room. It is located in the heart of Chickahominy. Enjoy great outdoor space with a front porch and a large backyard. Includes laundry, 1 off-street parking space, as well as heat, water, landscaping, snow plowing and garbage removal. Excellent credit required. No smoking. No pets. Close to transportation, schools, parks and beaches.

Welcome to ''The Meadow'' on the border of Greenwich. This charming updated cottage, originally built in 1750 has 4 bedrooms (primary bed/bath on first floor); cozy living room w/fireplace; dining room, office and separate laundry room. Spacious eat in kitchen opens to a new expansive terrace. Lovely open land w stonewalls and a private country setting. Surrounded by lush woods you will truly immerse yourself in the beauty of nature. Greenwich riding trails as a backdrop will make you feel you are in the Country, yet so close to both Greenwich and Stamford amenities.

Asking for best offers by Tuesday 7/21 at 9am. Welcome to 17 Rex Street, where charm & comfort come together in one of Greenwich's most convenient neighborhoods. Set within the Glenville School District, the home enjoys excellent proximity to parks, schools, shopping, dining, highways, & public transportation. Just minutes from the heart of Glenville, you'll enjoy quick access to some of Greenwich's newest restaurants, shops, & neighborhood conveniences. A welcoming front porch invites you into bright living spaces designed for easy living. The first-floor features multiple gathering spaces, a dining room, & kitchen, while the second-floor offers 3 bedrooms & 1 full bath. A flat, private backyard provides a setting for outdoor dining, play, or gardening. An unfinished LL offers addtl space. 17 Rex is a wonderful place to call home.

A rare opportunity to own a newly built 2027 residence just mins from Greenwich's finest shops, restaurants + schools. Set on .72 acres, 3 finished levels connected by elevator offer exceptional craftsmanship throughout. Main level features formal living + dining rooms, private office, family room w fireplace and a chef's kitchen w walk-in butlers pantry. The family room opens to a covered terrace w FP, Phantom screens + heaters -- ideal for year-round entertaining. Upstairs, primary suite features a FP, private deck + spa bath w wet room, accompanied by 3 additional en-suite bedrooms with walk-in closets. Finished lower level offers a gym, sauna, cold plunge, kitchenette, pool bath, guest suite + exterior access. A private yard + pool complete this exceptional in-town offering. NSS + CMS.

Welcome to Downtown Greenwich Living. Experience refined elegance and effortless comfort in this stunning 4-bedroom, 4.1-bathroom townhome, ideally situated within a private, gated association in the heart of downtown Greenwich. Every inch has been thoughtfully designed to blend upscale luxury with everyday ease. The open-concept gourmet kitchen featuring a large center island and abundant storage, flows seamlessly into a sun-filled dining area and spacious family room anchored by custom built-ins, creating the perfect setting for entertaining or relaxed everyday living. Retreat to the luxurious primary suite, complete with two custom-designed walk-in closets and a spa-like ensuite bath. Additional well-appointed bedrooms offer flexibility for family, guests, or a home office. Outdoor living is equally exceptional, with a private patio perfect for grilling and an exclusive rooftop deck offering a serene escape above it all. Just minutes from Greenwich Avenue, Bruce Park, the Metro-North station, and I-95, this home puts you at the center of it all while offering the privacy and tranquility you deserve.

A once-in-a-generation waterfront opportunity in Old Greenwich, CT. Nestled above the tranquil waters of Greenwich Cove, 1 Hendrie Drive Extension captures breathtaking sunsets, expansive water views, and direct access to ''The Cove'' and Long Island Sound. With a private dock, elevated setting, and extraordinary natural surroundings, this property offers a lifestyle rarely available on Connecticut's Gold Coast. Just moments from the village, train, beaches, and schools, it is the perfect blend of waterfront serenity and everyday convenience. Truly one of Old Greenwich's most distinctive and irreplaceable properties. Mailbox reads: 1 Cove Ridge Ln. This home is being sold As-Is.

listings.remarks: Sun-filled Colonial set on 2 private acres with desirable east/west exposures, offering exceptional privacy and natural beauty. Thoughtfully updated throughout, the home features a renovated gourmet kitchen with premium appliances, breakfast area, and seamless connection to the family room. French doors open to a terraced deck overlooking lush grounds, mature landscaping, a charming bridge, and tranquil lush green views. The second floor offers four bdrms including a spacious primary suite with luxury bath, dressing area, and custom closets.The finished walkout lower level with full bath provides flexible space for guests, recreation, home office, gym, nanny, or in-law suite. Recent improvements include Andersen windows and doors, generator, updated mechanicals, irrigation, security system and more!

listings.remarks: Welcome to this quintessential Greenwich home, fabulously refurbished and sited on a generous and private .91 acre in central Greenwich. Within an easy reach to schools, train stations and all of the amenities the town has to offer, this 4 bedroom home is move-in ready. The formality of the living and dining room is complemented by the open eat-in kitchen and family room. There are several home ''offices'' from which to chose! Perfect for the summer months, the heated pool is naturally shaped and acts as the centerpiece to the mature and landscaped garden. Two car garage is a benefit.

listings.remarks: Classic Center Hall Georgian Colonial in convenient Cos Cob location. Modern 5 bedroom 5.5 bath on a cul-de-sac street. Close to Cos Cob Elementary, Central Middle School, Greenwich High, Pomerance Nature Preserve and Library. The Cos Cob train station is a seven minute drive. Modern functional layout with open kitchen and family room with wood burning gas fired fireplace. Roomy primary bedroom with sitting area and wood burning gas fired fireplace. Primary bath has steam shower and separate jet tub. Wood floors thru out. Finished lower level rooms with walkout and fifth bedroom and full bath. Gas fueled furnace and hot water. Detached garage with attic storage.

Just minutes from downtown Greenwich, this beautifully renovated Colonial offers the ideal blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience. The bright, open interior features soaring ceilings, hardwood floors, a custom kitchen with stone countertops and stainless steel appliances, and an impressive great room with fireplace overlooking the backyard. Designed for today's lifestyle, all bedrooms feature en-suite baths, including a flexible first-floor primary suite ideal for multigenerational living, guests, or an au pair. The second-floor primary retreat offers a fireplace and private balcony overlooking the heated saltwater pool. Set on level, professionally landscaped grounds, this move-in-ready home is an exceptional offering in one of Greenwich's most desirable locations.

Enjoy easy single-floor living in this beautifully located 2-bedroom, 2-bath condominium featuring a bright, open-concept living and dining area with gas fireplace that flows to a large private deck overlooking mature trees and lush green space--an ideal setting for relaxing or entertaining. The spacious primary suite offers an en-suite bath and double-door closets, while the second bedroom features double-door closets and access to its own private terrace. Additional highlights include two underground garage parking spaces conveniently located near the elevator, and a professionally landscaped courtyard within the complex. Ideally located just minutes from the train, library, shopping, dining, and everyday conveniences, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and location. Additional storage located in garage.

Well-maintained side-by-side two-family in Byram featuring two mirror-image units, each offering 2 bedrooms and 1.1 baths. Spacious layouts include living rooms, eat-in kitchens with breakfast areas, and private outdoor space. Each unit offers hardwood floors, central air, in-unit laundry, and a 2-car tandem garage with driveway. This side-by-side duplex at 9 Columbus Ave sits on a quiet dead-end street in Chickahominy - offering the perfect house-hack setup: live in one unit and rent the other, or hold both as a turnkey investment. Each unit features 2 bedrooms and 1.5 baths across 1,112 sq ft of well-designed living space, for a total of 2,280 sq ft.   Built in 1997, this move-in ready property offers newer construction quality that's hard to find at this price point in Greenwich.   Whether you're an owner-occupant looking to offset your mortgage or an investor seeking cash flow in one of Fairfield County's most desirable towns, 9 Columbus Ave delivers flexibility, privacy, and long-term value on a peaceful street just minutes from Greenwich Avenue, the train station, and all that downtown Greenwich has to offer. A smart property with the updates, location, and flexibility to match.

An expansive primary suite, generous en-suite bedrooms and a top-level retreat while flexible spaces accommodate guests, work and play. Outside, two stone patios, a covered grotto with fireplace, garden shed and hillside stone tower invite quiet mornings and unforgettable evenings. Walk to schools, a neighborhood deli and wine shop, with two public boat launches across the street and train stations minutes away. A rare combination of design, nature and access to NYC, this is not simply a house you see. It is one you feel.

This room is large enough for big gatherings of family and friends, but also comfortable for everyday living.

The unit also includes a comfortable bedroom with closet storage and a full bathroom. Landlord requires a minimum of 700 credit score.

Great opportunity to live in a beautiful and completely renovated 2 Bedroom, 1 Bath top floor apartment, surrounded by well maintained landscape grounds with mature trees and terrace. Sun filters through brand new windows and reduces utility bill. New carpet and fresh paint throughout. 2 well appointed bedrooms with new ceiling light/fan fixtures. Large eat-n kitchen, completely renovated, equipped with all new appliances and ambiance lighting under the kitchen cabinets. The bathroom also remodeled with new vanity, shower walls, fixtures and porcelain tiled floor. Onsite assigned tenant parking and guests parking. Additionally, the apartment includes a large storage room and onsite coin-operated laundry facility. Conveniently located near Norwalk Hospital, Highways, train station, just minutes away from The SoNo Collection Mall and vibrant Norwalk Downtown. This apartment offers modern style, convenience and comfort. See Requirements and Schedual private showing and experience all this unit has to offer.

Welcome to this beautifully renovated 3 bedroom, 3 full bathroom home located on a peaceful dead-end street. This move-in ready property features a spacious and functional layout with modern updates throughout. Enjoy a finished walk-out basement offering additional living space perfect for a family room, home office, or guest area.  The home has been thoughtfully updated with brand new central A/C and heating, and upgraded 200-amp electrical service for comfort and efficiency. Step outside to a good-sized deck ideal for entertaining or relaxing.  Conveniently located within walking distance to the train station, this home is perfect for commuters while still offering privacy and tranquility.

Pristine elegance meets modern convenience in this sophisticated condo located in the highly sought-after Maritime Building in SoNo. This corner unit boasts an abundance of natural light, thanks to its floor-to-ceiling windows that frame stunning views of the surrounding area. The open layout is complemented by sleek bamboo floors and a contemporary kitchen outfitted with a new refrigerator and dishwasher. Both bathrooms are thoughtfully styled, offering a spa-like retreat. Step onto your private balcony to enjoy the fresh air, or take advantage of the building's luxury amenities, including a fitness center, common room, and secure garage parking. With a new HVAC system and water heater, this home is truly move-in ready. Perfectly situated just steps from SoNo's vibrant dining scene and the train station, this condo combines style, comfort, and unbeatable convenience.
