listings.remarks: Welcome to 13 Elliott Street, a charming Colonial nestled in the highly sought-after Marvin Beach neighborhood of Norwalk. Just a short walk to the water, this home offers the perfect blend of coastal living and timeless character. Lovingly and meticulously maintained by the same owner for over 30 years, this residence showcases consistent care and thoughtful upkeep throughout. From its inviting curb appeal to its warm and comfortable interior, the home reflects a true sense of pride in ownership. This well-maintained Colonial is ready for its next chapter, offering a wonderful opportunity for a new owner to move right in and make it their own. Whether you're enjoying morning strolls to the shoreline or relaxing in a home that has stood the test of time, 13 Elliott Street delivers both lifestyle and location. Don't miss your chance to own a piece of Marvin Beach-where charm, community, and coastal convenience come together.

43 Brooklawn Ave, Norwalk. Spacious single-family rental offering 5/6 bedrooms. The upper level features 4 bedrooms, while the main level includes 2 additional bedrooms or the option for a home office, along with a living room and dining room. The home features hardwood floors, freshly painted interiors, and refinished flooring. Updated with new windows and siding, and filled with natural light throughout. The finished lower level includes a full bath and laundry. Additional highlights include a garage and a large private yard. Conveniently located close to all amenities, including the SoNo Mall, restaurants, parks, and shops.

Spacious and beautifully maintained 1-bedroom apartment located in the heart of vibrant SoNo. This bright unit features hardwood floors throughout, exposed brick accents, and large windows that fill the space with natural light. The modern kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances, and the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer adds to the comfort of everyday living.  Enjoy being just steps away from the SoNo train station, waterfront, parks, restaurants, and the SoNo Collection mall. Perfect for those looking to experience the best of city living with everything right at your doorstep.

Welcome to 43 Gregory Blvd, a tastefully renovated gem nestled in the heart of East Norwalk's sought-after beachside community. This beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, newly renovated 2-bath home blends timeless charm with modern comfort, offering exceptional convenience and style in one of Fairfield County's most desirable locations.  Step inside to discover sun-filled living spaces highlighted by gleaming hardwood floors and central A/C throughout. The thoughtfully designed layout features a spacious living room, a dining area perfect for entertaining, and a bright, updated kitchen that seamlessly connects the main living areas. A charming three-season porch offers the perfect spot to enjoy morning coffee or unwind with a glass of wine in the evening. A full basement provides ample storage along with a washer and dryer.  Upstairs, three well-appointed bedrooms offer flexibility for family, guests, or a home office. Outside, the lush, fenced-in yard creates a private and secure setting for pets or outdoor gatherings, while the detached one-car garage provides added storage and convenience.  Ideally located within walking distance to Calf Pasture Beach, Taylor Farm Dog Park, and Norwalk Cove Marina. Enjoy all that East Norwalk has to offer, including local restaurants, golf, shops, and the Metro-North Railroad for an easy commute.

Welcome home! This bright and well-maintained condo offers comfortable, low-maintenance living in a prime location. Situated in a small, well-managed building with just 12 units, featuring an open living and dining area perfect for entertaining, filled with natural light and hardwood floors throughout. An updated kitchen with ample cabinetry, wine fridge, and a generously sized bedroom with walk-in closet space. Secure, designated parking is located in the garage below. Centrally located just steps from vibrant SoNo, enjoy easy access to restaurants, the harbor and marina, The SoNo Collection, The Maritime Aquarium, and more. Perfect for commuters with close proximity to the Metro-North and quick access to I-95.

COMMUTERS DREAM!! ..Stunning, Penthouse Condo with Water &City Views on a beautiful deck!! precisely located on the Norwalk River ONLY 2 BLOCKS away from BOTH the East Norwalk train station AND entrances to I95 , Enjoy your exclusive top suite with Soaring ceilings, with Skylights offering lots of natural light, updated. Featuring a cook's kitchen with Marble counters and a center island perfect for entertaining. Living room with huge windows, master bedroom with full bath and a nice sized 2nd Bedroom with plenty of closet space. Laundry in the unit. Reserved parking in the complex parking garage plus an additional reserved space outside.~2 miles from Calf Pasture Beach & Shady Beach ~1.5 miles from famous Stew Leonard's Grocery,-1.4 miles to SoNo Collection Mall ~1 mile away from Downtown SoNo and Veteran's Park (home of the famous Oyster Festival).Come home to tranquility. Nothing to do but put your feet up and enjoy!! Reasonable HOA fees and property taxes!! This unit is PRICED TO SELL!! Don't Miss OUT, Inventory is very scarce!!..Buyer Agents appreciated!!

listings.remarks: Welcome to 19 Oriole Drive, a meticulously maintained 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home set on a spacious 0.75-acre lot. It effortlessly combines modern updates, timeless style, and everyday comfort. Inside, enjoy a newly renovated kitchen and half bath with sleek, contemporary finishes.  A new A/C unit installed for the main floor and efficient two-zone heating and cooling provides year-round comfort, while wood floors throughout add warmth and charm.  Step outside to enjoy the screened-in porch, large patio area, in-ground pool, and a brand-new shed, providing extra storage for all your outdoor gear and seasonal items.  The large driveway also includes a brand-new basketball hoop, ideal for outdoor recreation, and room for plenty of parking. The roof, just 8 years old, provides peace of mind for years to come.  Ideally located in a convenient and walkable neighborhood, the home is just a short walk to local schools and minutes from popular shopping, including Stew Leonard's, restaurants, and major commuter routes.   Move-in ready and thoughtfully updated, this home offers the perfect combination of modern upgrades, comfort, and convenience in one of Norwalk's most accessible locations. Agent related to seller.

Well maintained one-bedroom end unit in a terrific location adjacent to Flax Hill Park. Just a short walk to downtown SoNo and the Metro-North train station. This unit features an in-unit washer and dryer and two parking spaces. Enjoy convenient commuting by train, bus, or car with easy access to major highways. Close to beaches, parks, dining, and the SoNo Collection Mall. Low HOA fees make this an excellent opportunity for an owner occupant or investor and a more affordable alternative to renting.

Love where you live (or invest) in this prime, central location! Step inside to a sweet surprise -impressive in both size & condition. The open & airy living room beams with natural light from the extra-large slider windows & borrowed light from the easy to access modernized kitchen. The eat-in kitchen with GE stainless steel appliances has a true breakfast nook. The bedroom is very spacious with ceiling-height double-closets ensuring no negotiation needed. The gorgeous bathroom was recently remodeled & features a refreshingly full-sized, fully-tiled walk-in shower & window for great natural light. Stunning style & colors are integrated throughout this pristine home from the beautiful hardwood floors, to the kitchen's sparkling quartz countertops & subway tile backsplash, to the bathroom's marble hexagon tile flooring & light fixture - beauty abounds. Heat, hot water & very convenient reserved parking included. Also enjoy the perks of private storage, laundry on site & plenty of visitor parking. Within 1-3 miles almost everything you would need or want. From SoNo RR to I-95; to a simple commute to schools & hospital; to restaurants, entertainment & retail (Washington Prime, Donovan's, Kazu, Maritime Aquarium, theaters, Apple, Nordstrom to name a few); to all that is just around the corner (Stew Leonard's, Stop & Shop, Wegmans, Starbucks, parks, beach, golf, tennis etc), settle right in to warmth, comfort & convenience today!

Light, bright, totally updated and recently painted end unit townhouse with new dishwasher, stove, washer, drier, bathroom mirrors. Newer carpeting throughout. Lots of closet space. Large walk in storage room on lower level. Newer blinds in bedrooms. Great bright family room (or guest bedroom) with closet. Minutes to schools, shopping, train. Heating gas hot air and electric, and central a/c. 2 Reserved parking spaces.  Well maintained small complex. Must have confirmed appointment. Tenant in place until April 30, 2026

7 Douglas Drive, Norwalk, CT is being offered for sale for the first time in over 50 years. Lovingly maintained by the same owners, this well cared for home sits on a private wooded interior lot in desirable West Norwalk, offering a rare combination of neighborhood convenience and peaceful seclusion while remaining close to major highways, shopping, and multiple Metro North train stations for an easy commute. Inside, the home features a bright layout with a spacious living room and hardwood floors throughout, including beneath the carpets. The expanded dining room was designed as a sun filled sunroom with vaulted ceiling and paddle fan, while the kitchen features raised ceilings with skylights and opens to an expanded deck overlooking the peaceful backyard. Upstairs offers comfortable bedrooms and a renovated primary bathroom with skylights. A flexible office or 4th bedroom addition with adjoining one car garage provides extra space for whatever lifestyle calls for. A new architectural roof and exterior paint were completed within the past two years. Additional improvements over time include gutters with gutter guards, central air on the upper level, a wall unit AC on the main level. This home is also connected to city water and sewer. With approximately 2,400 square feet including a spacious basement, beautiful natural surroundings, and a sought after West Norwalk location, this well cared for home offers a wonderful opportunity to move right in and make it your own.

Welcome to 47 Lockwood Lane, a timeless stucco charmer nestled in the sought-after Bettswood neighborhood of East Norwalk. Brimming with character and architectural detail, this inviting home blends classic craftsmanship with thoughtful updates and a warm, welcoming layout. Beautiful hardwood floors flow throughout and a dramatic double-height entry leads to the second floor. A stunning curved staircase with decorative metal railing creates a striking focal point and sets the tone for the home's historic charm. The main floor offers a gracious living room anchored by a wood-burning fireplace, plus a charming den with its own fireplace that offers a wonderful secondary living space-ideal as a playroom or home office. Rounding out the main level is a formal dining room, an updated kitchen with sliders that open to a deck overlooking the backyard, plus a powder room. Upstairs, you'll find three well-proportioned bedrooms with ample closet space, a full bathroom, and a terrace that provides a lovely outdoor escape. The basement offers excellent storage space, laundry, garage access, + room for a home office, gym, or recreation area. Outside, the property features a serene, level backyard with plenty of room for entertaining + gardening. A true commuters dream, this home is conveniently located near the East Norwalk Metro-North station, Stew Leonards, Calf Pasture Beach + town Green.

LIGHT & BRIGHT 2 BEDROOM ON FIRST FLOOR! - WOOD FLOORS AND FRESH PAINT - UPDATED KITCHEN WITH STAINLESS STEEL APPLIANCES - UPDATED BATHROOM - WASHER / DRYER IN UNIT! - LARGE STORAGE CLOSET - OFF/ST PARKING FOR 2 CARS - NO PETS!!

Welcome to 8 Dorset Road, a secluded Norwalk sanctuary located in the Wolfpit neighborhood of Cranbury where peaceful tranquility meets everyday convenience. Nestled on a picturesque corner lot directly across from a protected wooded town reserve, this home offers a rare sense of privacy and a serene connection to nature - all just minutes from Metro-North, major commuting routes, neighborhood schools, shopping, and Norwalk's beautiful coastline. Located in a quiet community on a low-traffic street, perfect for jogging or walking your dog with proximity to the playground in Cranbury Park. Offering an impressive 2,462 square feet of living space, this home provides exceptional flexibility for today's lifestyles. The upper levels feature 1,257 square feet with a sun-drenched living room which serves as the heart of the home, featuring vaulted ceilings, skylights, and a cozy wood-burning fireplace that creates an inviting space for gathering. Gleaming hardwood floors flow through the main living areas and upper bedroom level, adding warmth and character throughout. The kitchen blends charm and functionality with a farmhouse sink, subway tile backsplash, stainless steel appliances, and granite countertops. A casual eat-in area transitions seamlessly into the formal dining room - perfect for both everyday living and special occasions.

Spacious 1 bedroom/1 bathroom apartment in East Norwalk, offering approximately 750 sq. ft. of comfortable living space. The unit features brand-new vinyl flooring. The kitchen comes fully equipped with a stainless steel gas range and refrigerator. There is a common laundry area in the basement for added convenience. Parking includes 1 off-street parking space. Utilities & Responsibilities: Tenant is responsible for all utilities including heat/hot water, electricity, cooking gas, internet, etc. Great location close to SoNo, beaches, parks, dining, and shopping. Perfect for commuters: 5 minute drive to I-95 and 3 minute drive/13 minute walk to East Norwalk Train Station (Metro-North Railroad New Haven line).

*2 occupants max* Welcome to this updated 2nd-floor apartment located on a quiet dead-end road in the desirable Harbor Shores neighborhood. The home features a spacious living room with beautiful views of Long Island Sound and Sheffield Island. The newly updated kitchen offers ample space for a dining table and includes a large pantry for extra storage. Washer and dryer are conveniently located on the main floor for communal use. Enjoy the coastal lifestyle with the ability to launch your kayak or paddleboard at the end of the road. Additional features include off-street parking for two cars. This prime location offers easy access to nearby amenities including Woodward Park with pickleball courts just a stone's throw away. Metro-North is only a 5-minute drive, Downtown Washington Street offers a wide selection of restaurants and shopping, and Calf Pasture Beach is just minutes away!  Ideal for two working professionals, with strong credit, proof of income, and references. (No Pets, don't ask)  Available ASAP

Looking for a diamond in the rough. 39 Bayview Ave Located in a CD2 Zone. Classic 1900 Tudor with original details, ready for a new owner to rejuvenate and restore its timeless charm. Entryway leading to a good sized Living room with wood burning fireplace, off the living room a reading nook; and sunroom/office. Spacious eat in kitchen, dining room (currently being used as a bedroom #6) wall in archway can easily be opened back up. Second floor - 3 good sized bedrooms and Full hall bath. 3rd Story is finished with bedroom #4 and a full bath. Thru the 3rd bedroom you will find the staircase leading to the 3rd floor and hall to the attached studio with Full updated bath. Studio/Possible in-law can also be accessed from an exterior staircase in rear of house. Basement was finished but had water and now is very moldy. Ice damming occurred and there is a leak at the base of the staircase. Field card states 6 bedrooms- this includes the DR as one of the bedrooms. Buyers and Agents to do their own research/diligence as this is a Strictly AS-IS Sale. Inspections will be for informational purposes only. Additional photos and Floor plans will be coming .

RARE in ClockTower- True 2-bedroom End Unit that offers one of the best layouts in the complex. A large useful space that has separate living, dining and office areas.You will be impressed from the moment you walk into this pristine one level unit (no stairs) with an open concept floor plan that offers loads of natural light. Featuring soaring windows with 13.5' ceilings, private bedroom with custom built-ins in the closet and hallway closet, updated full bath with Kohler and Moen fixtures and marble vanity. Kitchen offers newer stainless steel appliances, garbage disposal and opens to the dining area, living room and separate office area. The Clocktower Close is a historic building that has been renovated to provide fabulous living space and community areas throughout the premises, including an outdoor courtyard, a full gym and a full locker room w/sauna, a business meeting room, a full community kitchen, a billiards room and a dog run. Easy access to highways, train station and public transportation. Minutes to shopping, new SoNo mall, restaurants, parks and to the beach.

This incredible 1 bedroom unit found in the heart of Norwalk, is a great opportunity for anyone trying to move here at an affordable price! This unit has hardwood throughout, a stainless steel fridge, a newly updated bathroom, and has 1 reserved parking space! There is also a basement with coin-operated laundry. This apartment is conveniently located near major highways, parks, restaurants, and shopping plazas! $300 move-in for pets an additional $35/monthly per cat and $45/monthly per dog. Apply before it's too late!

Move right into 18 Soundview Avenue, Unit 1! This beautifully updated first-floor 3-bedroom apartment offers the perfect blend of modern upgrades and everyday convenience. The home features stainless steel appliances, in-unit laundry, central air, and an energy-efficient tankless water heater. Enjoy spacious bedrooms, bright living areas, and a comfortable layout designed for easy living. On-street parking plus access to private parking adds extra convenience. With its updated features, generous space, and desirable first-floor location, this rental is a rare find-schedule your showing today before it's gone.

This beautifully renovated 2 bedroom 1 bath ranch home is ideally sited in the desirable Ledgebrook community. As you step inside its lovely entry way, you are immediately welcomed with wide plank floors and decorative wainscoting. The adjacent living room provides the perfect setting for relaxation and tranquility with its grand beehive fireplace and large picture window that offers captivating outside views of the private, wooded backdrop and natural rock garden. The tastefully remodeled kitchen with stainless steel appliances and granite countertops blends contemporary design with the conveniences of today's lifestyle. The spacious primary bedroom has newly installed plush carpeting, a generous closet and scenic wooded outdoor views, while the second bedroom offers fresh carpeting and a sizable walk-in closet. The updated full bath has heated floors and is conveniently located near the in-unit full size washer and dryer. The screened-in porch allows shaded enjoyment of the outdoors in the warmer months and provides an easy, additional access to the exterior of the property. The Ledgebrook community is highly regarded for its professionally landscaped grounds with seasonal perennials, pond, and walking paths, along with the amenities of an in-ground pool and clubhouse with fitness room and library. The prime West Norwalk location is convenient to shopping, dining, train and major highways.      $7,000 special assessment paid in full.

listings.remarks: *The sellers have received multiple offers and are requesting all offers be submitted by 4:00PM on Wednesday, 3/25/26.* This well-maintained Ranch in the sought-after Cranbury neighborhood of Norwalk offers the ease and comfort of true one-level living. The functional layout makes everyday living simple, while a screened-in sun porch provides the perfect space to relax and enjoy the level, fully fenced in half acre backyard-ideal for outdoor entertaining, pets, or gardening. A one-car garage and storage shed add practicality, and the manageable lot makes this home easy to maintain for those seeking a low-maintenance lifestyle. Conveniently located just minutes from Metro-North train service, major commuter routes, shopping, and dining, this property offers both comfort and accessibility. Central air, house generator hook-up and city water add another layer of convenience and reliability to this well situated and convenient home. Contingent on sellers closing on their new home, they are under contract and through inspections. House is sold as-is.

East Norwalk Rare opportunity to own a legal 3-family restored Victorian house with separate barn and 2-car garage. This amazing one of a kind property is perfect for owner occupant or investor. Incredible income and low maintenance with many updates and improvements. Some of the features include Separate updated mechanicals, new roof, off street parking for 6 vehicles, Partly finished basement with washer/dryer/1/2 bath, enclosed front porch, refinished hardwood floors, and just painted on the interior/exterior. The second building on the property is a charming converted studio barn with vaulted ceilings and beams and attached 2-car garage completed in 2008 with separate panel & fully insulated. 5 minute walk to East Norwalk train station, Beaches, parks, neighborhood restaurants, and South Norwalk (SoNo). 5 minute drive to Westport.

Perched on a gentle knoll on a Cranbury acre and the end of a quiet cul de sac, sits this 1950's ranch with open floorplan, two car garage, over-sized decking, electric skylights and completely private back yard. The large living room has hardwood flooring, fireplace and walls of glass offering terrific options for creative furniture placements. Add in the roomy ensuite primary and primary walk-in closet with two additional sizable bedrooms. Ready for immediate occupancy as your next home for years to come.    ***The seller has requested highest and best offers to be received no later than 4pm on Thursday, April 9th.***

***HEAT AND HOT WATER INCLUDED*** Spacious and updated West Norwalk 2 bedroom, 2 bath Victorian with hardwood floors, on two levels with generous sized private deck overlooking lush greenery and shared yard. Appliances include washer/dryer, refrigerator, dish washer, range, microwave and two a/c wall units. AVAILABLE IMMEDIATELY.

Please submit highest & best offers by noon Tuesday 3/24. Welcome to 143 Partrick Ave, conveniently located in one of Norwalk's most desirable neighborhoods. Offering graciously scaled rooms, high ceilings, and beautiful details through out, you will feel right at home when you step inside. Immaculately maintained and filled with natural light, the living spaces flow seamlessly-creating the perfect setting for both entertaining and everyday living. All four bedrooms are located on the second level, providing comfortable, private retreats, while a versatile first-floor flex space with full bath, adjacent to the dramatic library with loft space, offers ideal accommodations for guests, a home office, or additional living space. The beautiful brick patio and fenced garden offer space to relax, play, and entertain outdoors. Recently refreshed with a new roof, hot water heater, paint, and numerous other upgrades. Ideally located just minutes from town, beaches, train, and Westport, life at 143 Partrick Ave is easy, elevated, and turnkey.

Welcome home to this peaceful top-floor retreat, where a private deck overlooks a serene wooded backdrop. Bathed in natural light, this bright and airy residence offers an inviting open-concept layout, centered around a cozy wood-burning fireplace-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Brand-new wall-to-wall carpeting, along with updated thermopane windows and a sliding glass door, enhance both comfort and energy efficiency.  The beautifully renovated kitchen is a true highlight, featuring sleek quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, a new sink, and freshly painted cabinetry-blending modern style with everyday functionality. The bathroom has also been tastefully updated.  Additional features include an under-house garage, a spacious storage room with interior access, and an assigned parking space.  Ideally situated for commuters, this home is within walking distance to public bus lines and the Metro-North train station. Enjoy the best of Norwalk living with nearby beaches, dining, and a wide range of recreational opportunities.  Offering the perfect balance of comfort, convenience, and charm-this is an opportunity you won't want to miss!

listings.remarks: Cozy 3rd-floor apartment located in desirable Harbor Shores! Enjoy clear views of Long Island Sound and Sheffield Island from both the living room and private balcony. The unit features an updated kitchen with a dishwasher and a spacious walk-in closet offering plenty of storage. Situated on a quiet dead-end street, with easy water access at the end of the road-perfect for kayaking or paddleboarding during the summer months. Off-street parking available for two cars. Conveniently located just a stones throw away from the park with pickleball & tennis courts. Commuter-friendly location: only a 5-minute drive to the train station. Vibrant Washington Street, with its restaurants and shops, is just a 5-minute drive away. Not to forget minutes away from Calf Pasture Beach!  No pets. Applicants must have strong credit, proof of employment, references, and no prior evictions or criminal history.

facts.laundryLoc: To the left of front door

listings.remarks: Welcome to East Norwalk! This bright and beautifully maintained studio offers an unbeatable location with easy access to everything you need. Just steps from the East Norwalk Train Station, local restaurants, shopping, fitness centers, and everyday conveniences. Enjoy nearby Calf Pasture Beach and Veterans Park, with quick access to I-95 and the Merritt Parkway-perfect for commuters. Schedule your showing today-this one won't last!

Renovated and move-in ready, this home is set on a quiet street in Norwalk's desirable Wolfpit neighborhood. Tucked among winding roads perfect for walking and biking, the setting offers a true neighborhood feel. Enjoy easy access to Norwalk and Westport beaches, parks, shopping, dining, and Metro North for a convenient commute. Don't miss this great opportunity to settle into one of Norwalk's most established and well-loved areas.

This storybook stone cottage is such a perfect retreat - it's hard to believe that access to shopping, restaurants and Route 15 is so conveniently close. Built to complement the Frazier Peters main house, the carriage house boasts modern conveniences with charming details and craftsmanship. The main level includes the living/dining room with fireplace and a bay window overlooking the rear yard. Hardwood floors and 9' beamed ceilings elevate this space. Modern kitchen with washer and dryer plus a full bath complete the first floor. Upstairs you'll find an open loft bedroom with very spacious closet, plus a cozy sitting room or dressing room or office. This is a real jewel. Landlord/Owner pays all exterior maintenance, snow removal and trash. All applicants are asked to submit a Rent Spree Credit/Background report. EXCELLENT credit and references required.

Set well back from the road, this charming 1930's vintage cape offers flexible living and is comfortably perched with glorious east/west exposures that provide naturally bright interiors throughout the day. Fresh paint throughout all interiors, hardwood floors, recessed lighting, multiple bay windows and an oversized kitchen with expansive granite counters and maple cabinets. The two car attached garage leads to a fabulous mud room with tile floor for easy clean up, built in cabinetry, bench seating and rear yard access. The window walled sunroom has sliders out to the maintenance free deck overlooking the private, level rear yard. Nestled in Cranbury on the Westport/Wilton border minutes to Route 15, the 227 acre Cranbury Park and the quaint Cranbury Shopping Center. Flexible living in a most convenient location, not to be missed.

Step into timeless charm with this beautifully restored 1915 Farmhouse located on desirable East Norwalk Street. This home blends historic character with modern updates, featuring stunning original woodwork, stained glass windows, and classic built-ins that showcase the craftsmanship of the era. The first floor offers a bright, open layout with a updated kitchen that flows seamlessly into the living room and dining area. Perfect for everyday living. The second floor features four bedrooms and updated full bath. Outside, enjoy the manicured flat backyard that is fully fenced and perfect area to relax or entertain. Conveniently located 5 minutes from the train station and just minutes from the beach, local shopping. This home offers the perfect combination of charm, comfort, and location.

ALL UTILITIES INCLUDED. An oversized 2 bedroom unit in the heart of South Norwalk's Golden Hill District. A perfect blend of the homes original victorian charm and today's modern touches makes this unit a true gem. The oversized kitchen, with brand new quartz countertops and appliances, has a large peninsula as well as a dining area that leads directly out to the private, stone patio and fenced in back yard. The bathroom has new finishes in the tub/shower and the unit has a full washer and dryer located in the lower level as well as storage. Get ready to be impressed with the large primary bedroom with fireplace, beautifully, refinished hardwood floors, oversized windows and 9ft ceilings. Enjoy spending time on the screened in front porch and landscaped yard, all just a short walk to the heart of South Norwalk.

Welcome to 10 Marion Avenue, where timeless Marvin Beach charm meets thoughtful modern updates in one of Norwalk's most coveted waterfront neighborhoods. This home embodies the timeless character and coastal charm that define Marvin Beach. Warm, inviting, impeccably maintained, and full of character, it reflects the pride of ownership that is evident throughout. One of the home's most special features is the welcoming front porch, where you can enjoy peaceful water views and the coastal lifestyle that makes this neighborhood so desirable. Inside, classic architectural details blend seamlessly with tasteful updates, creating a home that is both charming and move-in ready. The spacious primary suite is a true retreat. Bright, comfortable living spaces and a thoughtfully designed layout make everyday living and entertaining effortless. Whether you're relaxing on the front porch, taking a short stroll to the water, or simply enjoying all that this exceptional neighborhood has to offer, 10 Marion Avenue captures the very best of Marvin Beach living. A rare opportunity to own a beautifully cared-for home in one of East Norwalk's most beloved waterfront communities.

Untouched LAND! Build your dream home or a spec home on this park like parcel of beautiful untouched land. A generous 0.4165 acre (just shy of a 1/2 acre) is a very rare find in Norwalk. Hollow Spring Road and Topping Lane are private streets in the sought-after Brookside neighborhood with high value properties. The lot is level with a charming stone wall facing the road. Very private, beautiful trees, shovel ready. City water in the street. Possible sewer hookup to Highland Ave or septic. Close to all major Norwalk attractions, transportation, shopping and schools.

Move-in ready 1BR condo in the desirable Silvermine community, featuring an attached 1-car garage and a spacious additional storage area. This end unit offers extra natural light with added windows in both the bedroom and bathroom. The living room includes a sliding glass door leading to the deck. Gleaming hardwood floors run throughout, complemented by a recently updated in-unit washer and dryer. Ample guest parking available. Ideally located with easy access to NYC via the nearby Merritt 7 train station, and just minutes from the Merritt Parkway and connector. Enjoy convenient access to shopping and dining. Low common charges under $200/month. Pet-friendly and investor-friendly.

listings.remarks: RECENT PRICE CHANGE!! Welcome to Sasqua Hills in East Norwalk. Perched high above Shorehaven Golf Club with sweeping views of Long Island Sound, the iconic estate at 7 Sasqua Road is a rare generational treasure. Built in 1950 and lovingly held by the original family for the past 76 years, this remarkable home has been cherished by five generations.  Often described as "Old Hollywood Glamour," the interior has long been a setting for unforgettable gatherings, where Broadway legends and jazz icons once performed in the grand living room. Rich in character and originality, the home offers an extraordinary collection of preserved period details throughout.  The inviting family room features warm pecan wood paneling, a custom bar, walls of built-in bookshelves, a fireplace, and a spectacular picture window. The formal dining room is equally impressive, with carved wood built-ins and ample space for a table of twelve. At the heart of the home, the dramatic sunken living room showcases a barrel ceiling, featuring twin baby grand pianos, a wall of full-height windows, and original hardwood floors, creating a one-of-a-kind atmosphere for entertaining and music.  The original eat-in kitchen has served as the backdrop for countless family meals and celebrations. A stunning powder room with its original custom mirror niche adds another distinctive architectural touch. A long, dramatic hallway leads to two spacious main-level en-suite bedrooms.

Welcome to The Maritime, a modern luxury high-rise in the heart of SoNo. This bright, lightfilled 2 bedroom, 2 bath condo is movein ready. Terrazzo tile bathroom floors with Kohler fixtures, programmable Nest thermostat, automatic black out window shades, and a pantry with a thoughtfully designed custom California Closet system to add space and convenience. The living and dining area open to your private balcony, where you can relax and look out over the harbor with unobstructed views of the harbor and Long Island Sound.  The Maritime offers great amenities, including a gym, TV and rec room with a pool table and kitchenette, conference room, and garage parking. The petfriendly building sits on a treelined street just a short walk to the train for a quick commute to NYC, as well as, the vibrant shops and restaurants on Washington Street, the waterfront, the Maritime Aquarium, and the SoNo Collection mall, so everyday errands and nights out are incredibly easy and fun! The condo comes with two parking spots: one in the attached gated garage and one in the outdoor lot.

Ideally located near the Norwalk River Valley Trail and Route 123/New Canaan Avenue, this home combines tranquil suburban living with convenient access to shopping, dining, and recreation.

Set on expansive 1 acre lot in a desirable West Rocks/Cranbury neighborhood, this beautifully updated 4-bedroom, 2 full bath home offers the perfect blend of space, comfort, and refined living. The main level showcases a welcoming living room with a cozy gas log fireplace, Crown lighting and hardwood floor, a spacious dining room, and a stunning remodeled kitchen featuring granite countertops, center island, an abundance of white cabinetry and top-of-the-line appliances. The main level includes a fully renovated bath with a modern stall shower and a 3-season sunroom with stone flooring and large windows creating the perfect space to enjoy your morning coffee, read a book, or enjoy nature. Upstairs you will discover, four generously sized bedrooms, a beautifully updated full bath with tub and a convenient laundry area. The semi-finished lower level offers space for recreation or use your imagination! Designed for both comfort and efficiency, the home features central AC with newer ductless mini-splits, and the fully paid solar panels transfer to the new owner, delivering long-term energy savings and added value. Outdoors, you will enjoy a beautifully maintained yard, private hot tub and swim spa, gardening areas and open space across the oversized lot. A 2-car attached garage plus a newly constructed 1-car detached garage offer ample storage and versatility This home is convenient to shopping, great restaurants, RT15, I-95 and Metro North making it a commuters dream!

Walk to grocery stores, shopping, gym, pharmacy, restaurants, and a little over a mile to SoNo train or SoNo Mall from this nicely updated condo in super-convenient location! Open floorplan, central air, newer flooring throughout, stainless steel appliances in tidy kitchen, renovated bathrooms. Sliders to large deck and grassy area off dining space. Large bedrooms with huge closets, pull-down stairs to attic with even more storage. In-unit laundry, 2 car off-street parking. Move right in! *** HIGHEST & BEST OFFERS REQUESTED BY 4PM WED 4/22 ***

Welcome to this lovingly maintained 4-bedroom home in the highly desirable Cranbury section of Norwalk-proudly built and cherished by its original owner since 1960. Filled with warmth, character, and decades of treasured memories, this home is ready for its next chapter. At the heart of the home is a stunning living room featuring a gorgeous stone fireplace-perfect for cozy evenings and holiday gatherings. One can easily imagine Christmas carols being sung around the baby grand piano, creating the kind of memories that make a house truly feel like home. The layout offers wonderful flow for both everyday living and entertaining, with the living room, dining room, kitchen, and a delightful sunroom seamlessly connected. The sunroom provides a bright and inviting space to relax and enjoy views of the outdoors throughout the seasons. Four well-proportioned bedrooms offer flexibility for family, guests, or a home office. A huge unfinished basement presents endless possibilities-whether you envision a home gym, playroom, workshop, or additional living space, the potential is yours to explore. Conveniently located just minutes from shopping, major highways, and public transportation, this home combines timeless charm with everyday practicality. Recent updates include a newer roof, adding peace of mind for years to come. Set in an established neighborhood known for its accessibility and appeal, this is a rare opportunity to own a home filled with history, heart, and endless potential.

Tucked into one of East Norwalk's most desirable streets in Sasqua Hills, 22 Cavray Road presents 7,800 sq ft of refined, flexible living space in a location defined by both convenience and coastal appeal-just minutes to the beach, train, and the centers of Westport and South Norwalk.  Designed with both scale and elegance in mind, the home features sun-filled interiors, oversized windows, high ceilings, hardwood floors, and custom millwork throughout. The kitchen serves as a central gathering space, appointed with a generous island, quality appliances, and a spacious breakfast area, and flows seamlessly into the home's principal living spaces-well suited for both everyday living and entertaining.  The main level offers a balanced composition of formal and informal rooms, anchored by two honed stone fireplaces that lend warmth and architectural character. Three sets of French doors open to a bluestone patio with outdoor fireplace and koi pond, creating a private & inviting outdoor setting. A separate lower-level bedroom, full bath, and den provide a well-considered arrangement for guests, in-laws, or au pair. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a quiet retreat with two walk-in closets and a luxurious bathroom finished in Carrara marble. Three additional en-suite bedrooms, a media room, and a finished third floor provide exceptional flexibility for a variety of living arrangements. A rare opportunity in the coveted Sasqua Hills neighborhood!

listings.remarks: Nestled on a quiet street in the desirable Wolfpit area of Norwalk, 27 Fairweather Drive is a wonderfully maintained raised ranch offering comfort, flexibility, and charm. This inviting home features 3 spacious bedrooms and 1.5 bathrooms, providing an ideal layout for both everyday living and entertaining. The main level is bright and welcoming, while the lower level offers a versatile basement-perfect for a home office, guest room, or additional living space. A one-car garage adds convenience, and the home's thoughtful upkeep is evident throughout. Step outside to enjoy the great back porch, an ideal spot for relaxing or hosting gatherings while overlooking the peaceful surroundings. A fantastic opportunity to own a well-cared-for home in a sought-after Norwalk neighborhood.

Charming and sun-filled Cape in a convenient, commuter friendly location. This inviting home features a spacious living room with hardwood floors, an eat-in kitchen, a bright sunroom, and four generous sized bedrooms with two full baths. Enjoy the ease of a two car garage with an EV charger. The home has been recently painted and offers excellent natural light and a flexible layout for living, working, or relaxing. Landscaping, including fall and spring cleanup, is handled by the landlord for added convenience. Move in ready and close to shopping, train, and major highways-this is a wonderful place to call home.

Be the first to rent this newly renovated first floor apartment in the Brookside neighborhood of Norwalk. This apartment provides the flexibility of quiet suburban living and a buzzing downtown atmosphere. Located just minutes from I95 and Train Stations, this is a commuters ideal location. The unit features a completely remodeled kitchen outfitted with a separate washer/dryer room. A remodeled bathroom sits conveniently on the main floor just off the kitchen. Two spacious bedrooms provide comfort and privacy.

Located on a quiet street in the sought-after "Cranbury" section of Norwalk, this single-family home offers approximately 2,800 square feet of comfortable living space with a layout ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The sun-filled main level features a seamless flow between the living and dining areas. Upstairs, the primary suite includes a private full bath, while two additional bedrooms that share a full bath provide flexibility for guests, a home office, or long-term needs. The finished basement adds approximately 1,200 square feet of versatile space-perfect for a media room, gym or playroom. The low-maintenance backyard offers a great setting for outdoor enjoyment. Conveniently located near schools, parks, shopping, dining, and commuter routes. This is a must see!!!

Welcome to 140 Ponus Avenue, a sun-filled 4-bedroom split-level in desirable West Norwalk. This meticulously maintained 2,200+ sq ft home sits on a peaceful 0.36-acre lot with a fenced backyard overlooking beautiful woods, creating a private retreat. Enter through the central foyer and step into an impressive open floor plan connecting the living room with fireplace and skylights to the dining area, and completely renovated kitchen featuring butcher block countertops, center island with Bosch dishwasher, pull-out pantry cabinets with oak doors, and 2021 Bosch three-door refrigerator. The family room has cathedral ceilings and more skylights and flows from the kitchen seamlessly. It opens to the yard with a large wall of windows and a slider to a 2018 cedar deck. The upstairs has 3 bedrooms and another updated full bath. With a completely unique layout, two lower levels expand your living space with two recreation rooms or a fourth bedroom, a full bathroom with slate flooring, oversized walk-in shower, and Dornbracht fixtures, laundry room/bathroom, and ample storage. This home has been loved and upgraded extensively: 2017 roof, 2019 C/A, 2021 boiler and hot water system with zoned heating, 2023 Andersen windows, 2022 electric car charger, 2024 driveway work, 2025 new fence, and 2026 refinished floors and fresh paint throughout (and more). The circular driveway and extra basement storage add convenience. A rare find that's move-in ready close to everything you may need!

370 Rowayton Avenue is a sun-drenched home that perfectly blends comfort, style, and functionality. Throughout the home you are greeted by bright, inviting spaces. At the heart of the home is a beautifully renovated chef's kitchen full of natural light and open to family room with a charming wood-burning fireplace. Large French doors open bringing fresh air and views of the expansive and private property. A formal living room, bar area and dining room with access to porch and patio are divine for entertaining. Four well-appointed bedrooms, including a convenient main-level bedroom perfect for guests or flexible living. Upstairs, the generously sized primary suite serves as a true retreat, complete with vaulted ceilings, a large walk-in closet, and a spa-like bathroom featuring a soaking tub, separate shower, and dual sinks. With its thoughtful layout, modern updates, and serene setting, 370 Rowayton Avenue presents a wonderful opportunity to enjoy both elegance and everyday comfort in Rowayton.

Tucked in Norwalk's Broad River neighborhood, this distinctive single-family home offers the charm of a ski chalet with the convenience of an in-town location. Soaring vaulted ceilings and abundant natural light define the main living space, creating an airy and inviting atmosphere. The recently updated kitchen features white quartz countertops and new stainless steel appliances, blending modern finishes with the home's warm character.  The flexible layout includes a loft area with a private balcony, previously used as a sleeping space, while the home is town-designated as a one-bedroom. A finished walkout lower level adds valuable versatility, ideal for a home office, guest space, or alternative sleeping area.  Enjoy peaceful views of Broad River Park just across the street, offering a sense of openness rarely found at this price point. A private driveway and rear patio provide added convenience and outdoor enjoyment. Ideally located near shopping, dining, I-95, and the South Norwalk train station.  A rare opportunity to own a unique single-family home as a true alternative to condominium living-offering privacy, independence, and no HOA fees.

Beautifully remodeled 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom second-floor apartment in the heart of vibrant SoNo. This bright and updated unit features a newly remodeled kitchen with stainless steel appliances, a fully renovated bathroom, and new carpeting throughout. Enjoy off-street parking for two cars and the peace of mind of a meticulously maintained property with landlords living on-site.  Ideally located within walking distance to the train and the upscale SoNo Collection, and just minutes from the restaurants and retail shops along Connecticut Avenue.  (One garage bay may be available for a fee of $100/month)

Tucked away on a peaceful one-acre+ property, this charming summer retreat offers privacy and comfort in a serene setting. The home, optimal for one level living features 3 bedrooms and 2 full baths on the main floor, with sun-filled living spaces, hardwood floors, a cozy fireplace, and an amazing screened-in porch. Enjoy central air, a finished lower level, and seamless indoor-outdoor living perfect for summer entertaining. Outside, the parklike grounds provide room to play, dine al fresco, and take in the tranquil surroundings. The beautiful gunite, salt water pool is the piece de resistance for this rental - it's heated, has a hot tub, and there is an adorable pool house perfect for changing into your suit or for use as a playhouse. One car garage has additional refrigerator and EV charger. Conveniently located near shopping (Trader Joe's, Costco, and Wegman's are just around the corner), dining, and commuting routes, this seasonal rental offers the perfect blend of quiet retreat and accessibility to all of Fairfield County. Ideal for enjoying a memorable Connecticut summer. 31-day minimum

Completely renovated, turnkey Cape-style beach home in coveted East Norwalk waterfront neighborhood. Steps from Long Island Sound with kayak-direct water access from your front porch. This move-in ready 3-bed, 2-bath home has been extensively updated top to bottom. The gut-renovated kitchen features all-new lux-appliances, warming drawer, ice maker with water filtration, new Wolf gas range, custom bar area, walk-in pantry, and new hardwood flooring. Welcome to 8 Ledge Road, a beautifully updated coastal home in the heart of Rowayton. This 4-bedroom, 3-bath residence offers bright, open-concept living with expansive windows and thoughtfully designed spaces ideal for today's lifestyle. The sun-filled chef's kitchen anchors the home, seamlessly connecting to the main living and dining areas for easy everyday living and entertaining. The spacious primary suite features a walk-in closet and a well-appointed bath.  Additional living space includes a finished attic and a walk-out lower level with a playroom, office space, full bath, laundry, and separate entrance- ideal for guests, extended family, or au pair use. Extensive updates completed in February 2025 include new hardwood floors, energy-efficient windows, exterior siding, HVAC, water filtration system, solar panels, propane for cooking and fireplace, WiFi-enabled underground sprinklers, and a Ring security system. This turnkey home is move-in ready and situated on a quiet street in a convenient location close to the train, downtown Rowayton, and Darien, with easy access to the beach and local amenities.

Experience the charm of Silvermine Riverfront living. This first floor ranch style condo offers effortless one level living in a beautifully updated setting. This 2 bedroom, 1.5 bath home features a stylish kitchen with stainless steel appliances and refreshed bathrooms, including a sleek walk in shower. The open layout flows seamlessly from the living and dining areas into the kitchen with bar seating, creating a perfect space for both relaxing and entertaining. The bedrooms are generously sized with abundant closet space and additional storage, plus a private storage unit in the basement. Step outside to your own deck overlooking the tranquil river, a perfect spot to unwind and recharge. Complete with in unit laundry and a pet friendly setting, this home offers comfort, convenience, and a lifestyle you will love.

listings.remarks: Tucked away on a very special private road, 4 Topping Lane offers a rare sense of privacy and charm in Norwalk. This sweet and inviting 2-3 bedroom home features a flexible layout that easily adapts to your needs, whether you're seeking a cozy residence or room to grow. Newly painted and well cared for, the home is ready for its next chapter, with expansion possibilities that offer exciting future potential.  The property is further enhanced by beautiful mature landscaping and remarkable specimen trees, including a striking Threadleaf Sawara Cypress estimated to be 50-75 years old, creating a serene and timeless setting.

Wonderful first floor apartment with many new amenities. Open floor plan, lots of sunlight and a cozy living room. Newer appliances, new bathroom, and freshly painted. Off street parking and and coin-op laundry on-site. Convenient access to I-95 and the E. Norwalk train station.

Nestled on the tranquil West Norwalk-New Canaan border convenient to the Merritt Parkway, RT 7 and I 95, this magnificent gated modern colonial was completely rebuilt in 2019, retaining only the garage from the previous structure. The house offers 5,397 square feet of living space on a 1.57-acre lot, featuring a high-quality stucco and natural stone exterior complemented by a durable slate roof. The interior showcases high ceilings, hardwood floors, abundant light, and an open-concept layout, including a living room with an elegant fireplace, a sophisticated kitchen with high-end appliances, a formal dining room, a dedicated office and a versatile first-floor bedroom and full bath. The second floor, accessed by a refined stairway with a glass and stone wall, hosts the Primary suite with an en-suite and walk-in closet, a large adjacent room ideal for a gym, family room or another bedroom with its own bathroom and jacuzzi. Three additional bedrooms, and a laundry room. For outdoor entertainment, the property provides a covered patio with stone a fireplace and a built-in outdoor kitchen. Additionally, the property includes a small storage building and a legal, charming, and totally renovated 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom cottage with a new deck overlooking the back portion of the property and the pond and a barn. In all a total of 7 possible bedrooms and 6 full baths.

listings.remarks: Welcome to 6 Lighthouse Lane. A Raised Ranch with a layout a bit better than the rest. This home boasts an expansive living room, formal dining room, and good sized kitchen. Three bedrooms: Primary with en-suite and 2 closets, two additional bedrooms and full hall bath. Newly refinished hardwood floors throughout the main level. The lower level adds flexibility with brand-new carpeting, a spacious family room with a wood-burning fireplace, and a fourth bedroom (currently opened up, as the wall was removed). An additional flex space that was the 4th bedroom is now with cabinets and countertops enhances the in-law potential, along with a full bath, dedicated laundry area, and a two-car attached garage. Landscaped lot with a covered rear deck, this home offers more space than meets the eye. With a few updates, this home will be brought back to its full potential. Solar panels will convey with the property. Interior of house freshly painted, seller makes no warranties to the condition of the fireplace. House generator included in sale. Professional photos coming Friday!

26 Flicker Lane sits on a sunny corner lot on one of Rowayton's most popular streets. Step inside this charming Farmhouse Colonial and be prepared to be wowed. Filled with natural light, the main floor boasts a lovely fireplace with a sitting area, an open family room, an updated kitchen with new appliances, and a dining area with a custom-built-in banquet. In addition, there is a separate office that doubles as a guest room or library, and a large deck off the dining area provides incredible additional space. Upstairs, the Primary bedroom has a new walk-in closet, an updated ensuite bathroom and a hidden slide-out for working out. The two additional family bedrooms have custom closets and drawers. Outside, enjoy the new stone patio, perfect for a night by the firepit. With expansion potential and a separate garage, this home offers endless possibilities. There are so many upgrades inside and out, too numerous to list here; you simply don't want to miss this one! Ideally located just a short walk to Rowayton's shops and restaurants, Pinkney Park, the riverfront and Bayley Beach.

Silvermine Cottage: Large, enchanting Cottage with private patio located in the heart of the vibrant Silvermine Community. This unique, charming cottage offers versatile space whether you are downsizing or work from home or just want a home surrounded by nature. Natural light pours in through oversized windows on both levels. The cozy living room offers oversized windows, room for a dining table and built-in shelving. The second floor loft space would make a great work studio or additional sleeping space. Step out to the large private patio and side yard to relax, grill and entertain. A wonderful retreat close to Gray Barns, The Mercantile, Silvermine Art Center and Silvermine Golf Club.

Beautifully maintained and spacious 2 bedroom Ranch style condo conveniently located in a desirable area of town. You enter the unit through a lovely stenciled patterned doorway. Hardwood floors throughout living and dining area and fully updated modern eat-in kitchen with all stainless steel appliances.Both bedrooms are bright and airy with ample closet space. Very quiet and tucked away yet conveniently close to highway access and Metro North train station, perfect for commuters. Also easy access to SoNo collection, restaurants, shopping and community garden. Large private finished storage area with window could be used as a home office, gym or craft studio. Low Common charges. A must see to appreciate !!

AVAILABLE JULY 1ST! Charming 3BR, 1.5BA Victorian blending classic character with modern updates. Relax on the inviting front porch. Gracious foyer with high ceilings leads to a spacious, light-filled living room and formal dining room-ideal for entertaining. Updated kitchen features center island, stainless steel appliances, gas range, dishwasher, wine fridge, decorative fireplace, and separate workspace. Upstairs offers a generous primary bedroom with two large closets, two additional bedrooms, and a full bath with claw-foot tub. Walk-up attic provides abundant storage. Lower level includes washer/dryer. Level backyard with large deck for seasonal entertaining. Private off-street parking for 2 cars. Hardwood floors, central air, and natural gas heat. Pet friendly. Excellent credit, references, and proof of income required. Prime location-walk to South Norwalk train, SONO dining, shopping, nightlife, and the Maritime Aquarium.

*Please submit highest and best offers by 12pm Monday 5/4* Welcome to this beautifully updated 2 bedroom, 2.5 bath condo set within the highly desirable Fawn Ridge complex featuring pool and tennis courts. Thoughtfully designed for both comfort and style, this home features newer hardwood floors, updated windows, brand new hot water heater, and a versatile den/office just off the kitchen-perfect for a home office, playroom, or cozy sitting area. This unit also has a large finished basement for extra flex space in addition to overflow storage. The spacious and functional layout offers an ideal flow for everyday living and entertaining. Enjoy the warmer weather lounging on the back deck and take in the beautiful pool and courtyard view out the front door. Ideally located close to shopping, dining, and commuter routes, this is effortless living at its best!

Stunning newer-construction townhouse in desirable Silver Ledge! - Fantastic open floor plan on the main level with large kitchen, featuring granite counters, subway tile backsplash, and stainless steel appliances! - Main level flows into dining area and large living room with gas fireplace! - Lots of natural light as this unit is an end unit + doesn't have a neighbor to the right side as most units do - Primary bedroom features a tray ceiling, walk-in closet, and en-suite private bath - 2 additional bedrooms and a full bathroom on 2nd level - Hardwood floors throughout the 1st and 2nd floor - BONUS finished lower level offers another family room / office / flex space + additional full bathroom! - One-car attached garage for parking & storage + additional off-street parking - Private patio through sliding door in living room! - Pull down attic stairs for storage - NEW gas furnace in Nov. 2024 + New fridge in 2025 - Located in central Norwalk with easy access to SoNo, East Norwalk, shopping, dining, and more!

Welcome to 4 Glenwood Avenue, Unit B7-where location truly does all the talking. Perfectly positioned in the heart of Norwalk, this well-situated residence offers unmatched convenience for today's on-the-go lifestyle. Commuters will appreciate the quick access to I-95, Route 7, and the South Norwalk train station, making travel to Stamford, Westchester, and New York City seamless. Enjoy being just minutes from vibrant downtown South Norwalk (SoNo), known for its top-rated restaurants, waterfront dining, nightlife, and attractions like the Maritime Aquarium. Daily errands are effortless with nearby shopping centers, grocery stores, and local boutiques all within close reach. Outdoor enthusiasts will love the proximity to Calf Pasture Beach, Veteran's Park, and scenic coastal areas-perfect for relaxing weekends or evening strolls. Whether you're heading to work, grabbing dinner, or enjoying Norwalk's waterfront lifestyle, this location delivers exceptional accessibility and convenience. If you're looking for a rental that keeps you connected to everything Norwalk has to offer, Unit B7 at 4 Glenwood Avenue is the perfect place to call home. Schedule your appointment today!

104 Comstock Hill Ave is tucked away in the Silvermine area of Norwalk. If you're looking for peace & quiet this is certainly the place for you. Right next to what used to be a strawberry farm. Updated cabin/cottage vibe including 1 spacious bedroom, 1 full bathroom, 1 half bath, living room, dining area/office & kitchen. Interior access to basement for storage & laundry. Large private yard perfect for grilling & entertaining. Plenty of parking in the driveway/lot for visitors. High Ceilings, hardwood floors, plenty of windows & cabinets/closets for comfort. Minutes from New Canaan & South Wilton. Tenants must have good credit, proof of income & references.

Additional street parking. Coin operated laundry in basement. Credit report, references required. Two months security.

Well-maintained 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhouse offering a comfortable and functional layout. Located near a variety of local amenities, including shopping centers, restaurants, parks, and public transportation, this townhouse provides both convenience and a great place to call home.

Completely renovated in 2025, this stunning home offers a seamless blend of modern design, quality craftsmanship, and thoughtful details throughout. Situated on approximately 1.5 acres, the property provides exceptional space, privacy, and outdoor enjoyment.  Inside, the home showcases high ceilings and 6" white oak hardwood floors that create a warm and sophisticated atmosphere.  The beautifully designed kitchen is equipped with brand-new high-end appliances, including a Wolf range, Sub-Zero wine cooler, Miele coffee system, delivering both style and functionality.  The first floor includes a bedroom with its own en-suite bathroom, offering flexibility for guests, multi-generational living, or convenient main-level living.  The second floor offers a thoughtfully designed layout, highlighted by a spacious primary suite with a spa-like en-suite bathroom, walk-in closet, and private deck overlooking the heated pool, a perfect retreat to relax and unwind.  An additional bedroom features its own en-suite bathroom, while two more bedrooms share a beautifully designed full bathroom. A conveniently located laundry area completes the upper level.  Bathrooms have been meticulously designed and feature radiant heated floors, offering comfort and luxury. Additional upgrades include a durable slate roof for long-term peace of mind.

Recently updated 2-bedroom, 2-bath first floor rental just two blocks from the water, offering easy coastal living in a prime East Norwalk location. The layout includes primary bedroom en suite. You will also find a bright eat-in kitchen with plenty of room to gather, along with the convenience of in-unit washer and dryer, off-street parking and the Landlord takes care of the yard. There is plenty of extra storage in the lower level. This is a dream spot for anyone who loves the outdoors-paddleboarding, kayaking, and peaceful waterfront walks are all just steps away. You're also within walking distance to local favorites like Harbor Harvest, plus a variety of nearby restaurants and shops that give the neighborhood its relaxed, coastal vibe. Commuters will love the convenience of being just an 8-minute walk to the East Norwalk Metro-North Station, making trips into Manhattan simple and stress-free. When you're ready to unwind, you're only minutes from Calf Pasture Beach and the lively dining and nightlife scene in South Norwalk.

This very affordable quiet spacious 1 bdr unit is in the heart of historic Norwalk and close to the beach, Westport border, shops, SONO, the Merritt, I-95 and a Train Station. Wake up by the bells from the two churches built in 16th and 17th century. Relax in the park and gazebo across the building or stroll to Stew Leonard's for a cone of frozen yogurt. The condo has just been painted in crispy white, it has a brand new carpet and it's in an immaculate condition. Plenty of free parking. Make an appointment before this rare unit is gone.

Updated Home in Prime Norwalk Location! This beautifully maintained 2-bedroom, 1-bath residence offers an excellent alternative to condo living, featuring thoughtfully designed living space throughout. The main level boasts an eat-in kitchen with gas range and direct access to an expansive deck-ideal for relaxing or entertaining with added privacy. A bright and sun-filled living room with hardwood floors, two generously sized bedrooms, and a full bath complete this level. The upper level includes a spacious 792 sq ft unfinished attic, perfect for storage or potential future expansion. The lower level offers a laundry area, mechanicals, and a one-car garage. Recent upgrades include central air conditioning and a gas furnace, making this home truly move-in ready. Ideally situated near shopping, dining, major highways, and train stations, this property provides convenient access to all that Norwalk has to offer. A fantastic opportunity for first-time buyers or those seeking low-maintenance living in a highly desirable location. Please schedule your private viewing before it's gone!

Welcome to 20 Linden Heights, a beautifully maintained detached single-family home in Norwalk's sought-after Linden Heights community. Set in a picturesque and beautifully landscaped setting, this inviting residence offers the perfect blend of comfort, privacy, and easy living. Inside, you'll find a spacious and airy layout with vaulted ceilings, sun-filled living spaces, and a warm, welcoming flow ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The eat-in kitchen opens to a large private deck, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor connection and a perfect place to relax, host guests, or take in the home's wonderful sunset views. The great room with a fireplace adds warmth and charm, while the finished walk-out lower level offers versatile space for a playroom, media room, home office, gym, or guest area. The spacious primary suite provides a peaceful retreat, and the home's thoughtful layout offers flexibility for today's lifestyle. Complete with a two-car attached garage, manicured landscaping, and the benefits of community maintenance, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy a detached home in one of Norwalk's most desirable residential enclaves. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, parks, and major transportation routes, 20 Linden Heights offers an exceptional combination of serenity, convenience, and neighborhood appeal.

Amazing Location | Turnkey Updates | Sun-Drenched Living! Welcome to this beautifully updated, light-filled ranch set on over half an acre in Norwalk's desirable Cranbury section, bordering Westport. Freshly painted inside and out, this move-in-ready home blends classic charm with thoughtful modern upgrades.   The spacious, flexible layout features 3 bedrooms plus a versatile additional room-perfect for a home office, gym, nursery, or guest space-and 2 full baths, including a newly renovated primary bath. The brand-new kitchen shines with modern finishes (Samsung Bespoke appliances & hand-made porcelain tiles from Spain as backsplash) and functionality, while newly refinished hardwood floors add warmth and continuity throughout. At the heart of the home, a bright living room with exposed beams and a wood-burning fireplace creates an inviting atmosphere. Additional living spaces include a dining room, family room, and an eat-in kitchen with a walk-in pantry-ideal for both everyday living and entertaining.    The primary suite offers a private retreat with an en suite bath with walk in shower and an adjacent room with its own entrance-perfect for today's flexible lifestyle needs. Two additional bedrooms and a full bath are thoughtfully situated for added privacy.  Brand new washer/dryer.

Tucked away in a quiet Norwalk setting, this bright and inviting apartment blends comfort with thoughtful updates and an easy, livable layout. Step into a sun filled living room where vaulted ceilings and warm hardwood floors create an open, airy feel that instantly feels like home. The flow continues into a spacious eat in kitchen, complete with tile flooring, ample cabinetry, gas range, dishwasher, and all the essentials for everyday living and entertaining. Just beyond, a dedicated dining area offers the perfect spot for casual meals or hosting guests. Both bedrooms are nicely sized with hardwood flooring and great natural light, while the full bath features clean finishes and a whirlpool tub with shower. Central air keeps things comfortable year round, and the convenience of in unit washer and dryer adds to the ease of living. Off street parking is included, along with a peaceful back patio and yard, and tucked away setting that still keeps you close to shopping, dining, and major routes. Available for immediate occupancy, this well maintained rental offers a balanced mix of space, function, and location. Agent/Owner

INCREDIBLE waterfront 2-family in the heart of East Norwalk! Soak in breathtaking water views from your sizable backyard, two outdoor decks, covered patio, and from all three floors inside the home! - The first floor features a welcoming living room, two spacious bedrooms, and an updated bathroom. The large eat-in kitchen leads directly to a gorgeous sun room with a propane wood stove for year-round usage, and sliders out to the deck overlooking Mill Pond - The finished basement is completely updated, with its own stainless steel refrigerator, tile floors, a separate heating zone, recessed lighting, and a remodeled bathroom - The second floor unit is the sunniest of all, with two skylights, updated vinyl floors, two additional bedrooms, and outdoor access via the eat-in kitchen - The property's two asphalt driveways provide plenty of parking, and the garage offers additional storage. You simply cannot beat the location: walkable to the East Norwalk train station, Vet's Park, and several amazing local restaurants, plus just a few minutes by car to Calf Pasture beach and I-95! A prime location combined with excellent cash flow! Schedule your showing before this unique gem is snatched up! Possible 3-family with the basement as a separate unit - buyer to do their due diligence!

Welcome to 46 Ponus Avenue, a charming home in the heart of Norwalk offering great potential and flexibility. This property features bright living spaces, a functional layout, and comfortable bedrooms suited for everyday living. While the home may benefit from some updates, it is ready for occupancy and presents an excellent opportunity to make it your own or invest.  The lower level includes an extra room, perfect for a home office, guest space, or additional living area. Outside, enjoy a nice-sized backyard ideal for relaxing or entertaining. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, and major highways, this property offers both value and location.  A great opportunity for homeowners or investors alike-don't miss it! Property is being sold As-Is.

MULTIPLE OFFERS: HIGHEST AND BEST TUESDAY 5/5 AT 5PM Welcome to 103 Ponus Ave, a move-in ready hi-ranch nestled in the highly desirable West Norwalk neighborhood. Offering 2,702 square feet of living space on nearly half an acre, this home combines comfort, flexibility, and a beautifully private, fully fenced backyard.  The main level features a sun-filled layout ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. A spacious family room with soaring ceilings creates an inviting place to relax and flows seamlessly into the dining area. The adjoining sunroom bathes the space in natural light and offers versatile use, complete with a new washer and dryer and direct access to the back deck overlooking the serene yard.  Down the hall, you'll find three generously sized bedrooms and two updated bathrooms, including a sought-after primary en-suite.  The lower level adds exceptional flexibility, currently configured as a spacious accessory-style living area with its own full bath, washer/dryer, kitchenette, and expansive living space-perfect for guests, extended family, or movie nights with the built-in projector setup.

Updated 3 bedroom townhouse in Nor-West!! - Stunning kitchen with white shaker-style cabinets, quartz counters, subway tile backsplash, and stainless steel appliances!! - Kitchen also features custom filtered-water & instant-hot water faucet! - Light and bright unit with hardwood floors throughout! - Very unique and rarely available townhouse layout offers direct / private entry into the unit (no shared hallways) - Spacious living room features recessed lighting and sliding door out to private patio space! - Updated first floor bathroom with distressed shiplap feature wall - 2nd floor features primary bedroom with updated en-suite bathroom & walk-in closet! - 2 additional bedrooms, and another updated bathroom featuring subway tile walls - Private washer / dryer in unit - Pull down attic stairs for great storage + additional storage locker in the complex - *HOA fee includes heat & hot water!* - Short walk to the beautiful association pool + clubhouse! - Park-like setting with large, central grass courtyard - All located on the Westport border, and convenient to shopping, dining, and all that Norwalk and Westport have to offer! - Reserved parking spaces just outside the unit (234 & 235), 3rd parking space can be rented for $20 / month

It stands apart with a rare combination of history, character, and exceptional privacy. Thoughtfully integrated into the landscape, surrounded by mature perennial gardens, the home reveals itself through winding stone staircases and curated approach points. Inside, a soaring vaulted living room is anchored by a striking stone fireplace, showcasing the quality craftsmanship and artistry of an earlier era. The space is both dramatic and inviting, offering warmth, texture, and architectural presence. A defining feature of the home is its unique interior layout, designed with a clear separation between living and private spaces. A light-filled hallway with oversized windows leads to the bedroom wing-down to secondary bedrooms or upward to a private primary suite. The primary suite is set apart for privacy and features a vaulted ceiling and a full bathroom: an elevated retreat within the home. The additional 3 bedrooms offer separation/flexibility for guests, home office space, or extended living needs. The interior has been renovated to meet highest of expectations, including updated kitchen, bathrooms, finished walk-out lower level, and HVAC systems.

listings.remarks: Welcome to 100 Winfield Street, a charming Cape Cod-style home in the highly coveted East Norwalk area, ideally located near the Westport line and close to top local amenities.  This home offers a rare layout for a Cape, featuring three bedrooms on the upper level-a setup that lives more like a Colonial and is ideal for those who prefer all bedrooms together. With two full bathrooms, one upstairs and one on the main level, the home offers comfort and convenience. Fueled by natural gas, the property provides efficient heating for New England winters. The location is a standout. Enjoy a 10-minute walk to the East Norwalk train station for an easy NYC commute. You are just 7 minutes to Calf Pasture Beach and 6 minutes to Taylor Farm Dog Park. Washington Street in SoNo, known for dining and nightlife, is also 6 minutes away. Everything you need is within a 10 minutes. Located in C zoning, the property may offer potential for conversion to a legal two-family, subject to approvals. A compelling opportunity in one of Norwalk's most convenient neighborhoods.

Beautifully maintained raised ranch featuring 3 bedrooms and 2 full baths. Enjoy a remodeled kitchen and updated bathrooms, along with a newer roof and siding offering peace of mind. The home boasts a finished basement with a classic old-fashioned bar-perfect for entertaining or relaxing evenings. Step out to the enclosed porch or the expansive deck overlooking a fenced, level yard, great for gatherings, pets, or play. Add a shed for additional storage. Situated on a level lot in a prime location with easy access to major highways, railroad stations, shopping, and restaurants. Move-in ready and full of charm! Waiting for your personal finishing touches!

listings.remarks: HIGHEST AND BEST by 12 noon Tuesday! Perfectly situated on the Darien and New Canaan borders, this home is nestled within a highly sought-after neighborhood known for its mature trees, established landscaping, and strong property values-offering both charm and exceptional value. Set on a picturesque, level half-acre on a quiet dead end street, the property is ideal for outdoor living, entertaining, or simply enjoying the peaceful setting.  Inside, the home features a light-filled interior with hardwood floors throughout, complemented by updated kitchen and baths -including one in the primary suite - and a clean, modern aesthetic. A sun-drenched sunroom overlooks the private, beautifully landscaped backyard-creating a perfect space to relax and enjoy year-round.  Designed with flexibility in mind, the home offers a spacious family room and a full lower level (including the sunroom, it is an additional approx. 1000 SQ ft of usable space), providing ample room for living, working, or recreation. Major system updates add peace of mind, including a whole-house Generac generator, Weil-McLain furnace, Andersen windows, and Connecticut Basement waterproofing system.  Conveniently located just minutes to train stations, major highways, shopping, dining, and recreation-this home offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and timeless appeal.
