listings.remarks: Beautifully renovated and move-in ready, this charming 3 bedroom, 2.5-bath home is tucked away at the end of a quiet street in the heart of vibrant South Norwalk, offering added privacy and minimal through traffic.  Updated in 2024, the home combines modern comfort with timeless charm and features hardwood floors, central air, an updated kitchen with newer appliances, and a bright, welcoming layout throughout. The main level offers a spacious primary bedroom with a full en-suite bath, along with a convenient half bath for guests.  Upstairs, you'll find two additional bedrooms and a full bath. The finished lower level adds valuable space perfect for a home office, gym, playroom, media room, or cozy recreation area, plus laundry hookups and additional storage. While the lower level features lower ceiling height, it offers great versatility and functionality for everyday use and includes a separate walk-out entrance providing direct access to the backyard. Enjoy being just minutes from South Norwalk's restaurants, shopping, waterfront, Metro-North train station, and I-95, making commuting and daily living easy and convenient. Additional highlights include an in-ground sprinkler system and invisible electric pet fence. The corner lot may offer potential for a future garage with access from either Avenue A or Couch Street, subject to verification and municipal approvals.

This well-loved 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath Cape Cod offers a fantastic blend of cozy living and flexible space. The main level features two comfortable bedrooms, along with a generously sized living room anchored by a fireplace, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. An eat-in kitchen provides a functional layout for everyday living, while the sunporch adds a bright, relaxing space to enjoy year-round.  Upstairs, you'll find two additional finished rooms that offer great potential for extra bedrooms, a home office, or creative space-tailor them to fit your needs. Hardwood floors lie beneath the carpeting on the main level, just waiting to be revealed and restored.  The partially finished basement expands your living options even further, complete with a second fireplace-perfect for a recreation room, media space, or home gym. A dedicated laundry room in the basement adds convenience and practicality.  Step outside to a private, fenced-in backyard with plenty of room for entertaining, gardening, or simply enjoying the outdoors in peace.  Ideally situated for commuters, this home provides quick access to the Merritt Parkway, I-95, and nearby train service, making daily travel a breeze.  A great opportunity to personalize a home with solid bones in a highly convenient location-come see the possibilities!

Bright 1 Br Unit on 2nd floor, freshly painted, new carpets, recently renovated bathroom/kitchen. Quiet and still close to everything. Good size rooms, walk to train, easy on easy off 95. Minutes to waterfront restaurants, beach, all major shopping.

Welcome to the "Eastview" - a sophisticated, stylish, and completely move-in ready condo in the much sought-after Eastview Condominium complex. This unit offers modern living with exceptional convenience. Enter through your private entrance or directly from your attached garage into a bright, beautifully updated space that lives far larger than its footprint. The refreshed kitchen features sleek quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a clean contemporary design perfect for everyday living and entertaining. The spa-inspired full bath has been thoughtfully renovated with a stunning walk-in shower, modern finishes, and elevated fixtures. Central air conditioning and heat provide year-round comfort, while in-unit laundry adds effortless functionality. Sliders open to a private outdoor deck, creating the perfect extension of living space. Eastview is a well-managed, intimate complex known for its low common charges and prime location-just minutes to SONO, Norwalk Hospital, and all major commuting routes. Turnkey, modern, and ideally located-this is Norwalk condo living at its best.

A very special home and location! This warm and charming expanded 3 bedroom - 2 bath split level on .57 acre has been updated and designed for large families, indoor/outdoor entertaining, and/or working from home. Incredible flexibility including a possible In-law apartment conversion located on the main floor. With a blend of classic design and open floor plan this home is an ideal haven for creating lasting memories and enjoying family. The Main floor includes the oversized dining room, living room, full bath, and family room with a central fireplace creating a welcoming atmosphere. From the dining room is an expanded/updated country kitchen with light oak custom cabinetry and travertine tile backsplash. A few steps away is the enclosed porch and large deck overlooking a beautiful, private backyard for family gatherings. Just off the kitchen is the lower family room and office with laundry and attached garage. The upper floor creates privacy with full bath and 3 bedrooms including the primary bedroom all with hardwood floors. Additional features attached garage. Minutes to East Norwalk Train/Metro North, I-95, Merritt Parkway, shopping/dining and seconds from track/field at All Saints School and West Rocks Middle School.

There are two skylights on the first and second floors; with the abundance of windows, this is a very happy sunny home. The landscaped yard is lovely, and the new crushed stone driveway will be the perfect place to park your cars. It is located only steps to the kitchen entrance! The first and second floors each have a full bath with tubs and showers.The basement is not heated, but could be an exercise room, playroom part of the year, workshop or for storage. It can not be used as a bedroom. GARAGE NOT INCLUDED

Wonderful one bedroom unit in Sutton Place complex in sought after Wolfpit area. Walking friendly to shopping, restaurants and transportation. Great opportunity both for investors or first time homeowners. Features sunny living room, dining area, and one bedroom. Remodeled kitchen and bathroom is in the remodeling process with newly painted cabinets, new countertops, new flooring and tile backsplash. Remodeling should be finished approximately in 10 days. Heat, hot water and cooking gas is included in the common charges. wall to wall carpeting in Living room and bedroom. Complex has on site coin operated laundry. Wall unit air-conditioning.

PLEASE NOTE: HIGHEST AND BEST BY MONDAY. MAY 4th BY 3:00 pm.  Beautiful refreshed and move in ready. This 2 bedroom, 2 full bathroom condo offers a bright, welcoming and spacious interior for easy living. Every wall has been freshly painted and brand new carpet has been installed throughout the entire second level and loft area. The living room and dining area have warm hardwood floors, a cozy fireplace and a sliding door leading out to a private deck overlooking a peaceful river setting. The perfect place to unwind in the evening. Upstairs, you will find two generously sized bedrooms, both featuring vaulted ceilings. The primary suite has two closets and a private full bath, along with access to it's own private balcony. The second bedroom has a walk in closet. A spiral staircase leads to a versatile loft space, perfect for a home office, creative studio or just a fun space to hang out. The attached garage has a new garage door and additional storage space. This is all minutes away from both 95 and the Merritt Parkway making it convenient for your commute.

Welcome to 30 Marlborough Road, a 4-bedroom, 3-bath Colonial set on a cul-de-sac in Wolfpit, offering 1,974 square feet on over half an acre. Enter through the central foyer, which flows into the heart of the home: a living room with vaulted ceilings, a fireplace, and large windows. The family room and dining room sit adjacent to the spacious eat-in-kitchen, creating a relaxed, everyday living space, while a convenient laundry room keeps chores tucked away. The first floor also features a private bedroom with an attached, fully updated full bath, ideal for guests or multi-generational living and a large den with a slider to the back patio. Upstairs, the primary suite spans the home and includes two closets and a private bath with a whirlpool tub and separate shower. Two additional bedrooms share a full bath with a tub/shower combination. The basement provides ample utility and storage space. Outside, the generous 0.52-acre lot offers room to roam, and the attached two-car garage adds convenience. Built in 1963, this home combines classic Colonial charm with functional living spaces. Located in a desirable neighborhood, all the amenities of Westport Avenue are within reach, including Stew's, the movie theater, and more. I-95 and the Merritt Parkway are equidistant, and downtown Westport is just minutes away. Everything you need comes together in this exceptional offering in a sought-after location.

This one checks all the boxes! This 1 bed 1 bath Town house style home features updated kitchen and bathroom, hard wood floors throughout, built in air conditioners, ample closet space, and a full private basement with in unit laundry, and TONS of storage. Use lower level as work out room, office, storage, let your imagination go wild! Close to Merritt Parkway, Route 7, and train stations.

Set in beautiful and historic Silvermine, this classic Colonial Farmhouse offers the rare combination of character, space, and opportunity on 1.29 idyllic acres. Set back off the road, the property enjoys a peaceful setting while remaining just moments from Grey Barns, schools, and major commuting routes. A welcoming front porch introduces interiors that are filled with warmth and natural light. Rich hardwood floors, a striking stone fireplace, and graciously scaled rooms create an inviting atmosphere for both everyday living + entertaining. The formal living and dining rooms flow effortlessly, while the spacious EIK offers generous workspace, room for a center island, and direct access to the rear deck overlooking the private grounds. The 2nd floor features 4 spacious bedrooms, while the entire 3rd level has been thoughtfully transformed into a private primary suite. Skylights, a full bath, generous closet space, and charming architectural details create a peaceful retreat tucked away from the rest of the home. Outside, the property offers endless possibilities. The expansive lawn, mature landscaping, and tiered gardens provide an ideal backdrop for outdoor entertaining, recreation, or future enhancements. A detached three-car garage with a walk-up loft offers tremendous flexibility for storage, a workshop, studio, or potential finished space. Offering the charm of a historic New England setting with the space and flexibility today's buyers seek, this is a rare opportunity!

Spacious First-Floor 2-Bedroom Apartment for Rent. Welcome to this updated first-floor apartment offering comfort, convenience, and ample space. This well-maintained unit features 2 generously sized bedrooms and 1 full bathroom. The apartment has been recently updated and includes brand-new appliances. Enjoy the ease of first-floor access along with an abundance of storage space throughout the unit. Conveniently located with easy access to local amenities, shopping, and transportation.

Welcome to Magical Marvin Beach-where waterfront living is a year-round lifestyle! Spend summers swimming, kayaking, and paddle boarding across three private neighborhood beaches, or take advantage of the members-only marina just steps away for effortless boating access. The community truly comes alive with sunset beach gatherings, movie nights, and a full calendar of seasonal events including an Easter Egg Hunt, Fourth of July parade and BBQ, Steak & Lobster dinners, Ice Cream Socials, Halloween festivities, and holiday celebrations with Santa and caroling. This charming circa 1923 Colonial has been thoughtfully expanded to offer both character and modern comfort. Set on an oversized lot, the property features a private backyard with lush gardens and deck overlooking the grounds. The two car garage has an attached shed. Inside, on the main level there is a living room, dining room, den or home office, eat in kitchen and mudroom. The home offers four bedrooms and a full bath on the second level. A partially finished basement provides excellent storage and flexible space. Ideally located with easy access to the Metro-North train, I-95, and the vibrant dining and shopping scenes of East Norwalk and SoNo. Nearby recreational amenities include Ludlow Park with a pickleball court, basketball courts, ball fields, and playground. A short walk to Calf Pasture Beach and Taylor Farm Dog Park. A rare opportunity to enjoy coastal living in one of Norwalk's most desirable communities.

listings.remarks: Extremely spacious end unit with four floors of usable and move-in ready living space! Freshly painted, this unit is available for immediate occupancy. Special and custom features include a private side entrance with ramp for easy and/or handicap access to the unit and an elevator from the Entry Level to the Main Living Level where a light/bright and "dine-in" kitchen with stunning black granite countertops and stainless appliances, as well as a center island, is located. Also on this floor is the generous sized living/dining area with deck access. The Second Floor bedroom level has a full-size laundry adjacent to the primary bedroom which has a vaulted ceiling, bay window and en suite bath with heated floor, jetted tub and separate shower. Step outside to multiple newly built decks overlooking the river, perfect for relaxing or entertaining, while the outdoor fire pit creates an inviting setting surrounded by nature. Additional amenities include a dedicated laundry room and seamless indoor/outdoor living spaces. A rare opportunity to enjoy the beauty, charm, and tranquility of this one-of-a-kind Silvermine gem. Please schedule your private viewing before it's gone!

Welcome to this beautiful Silvermine home where timeless charm meets spacious everyday living. Filled with an abundance of natural light, this 3-bedroom home features soaring vaulted ceilings, stunning hardwood floors throughout the house, a beautiful fireplace, and multiple living spaces including both a formal living room and a spacious family room perfect for entertaining or relaxing. The kitchen is equipped with granite countertops and offers both functionality and style for everyday living. The oversized primary bedroom suite features dual wardrobe closets along with a walk-in closet, creating exceptional storage and comfort. The second and third bedrooms are also generously sized, with abundant closet space and storage found throughout the entire home, including additional storage in the basement. Step outside and enjoy the warmer months on the expansive back deck and patio complete with a fire pit, creating the perfect setting for outdoor gatherings and peaceful evenings at home. This home is perfectly situated in a highly convenient location, just minutes from shopping, dining, and major highways, making everyday living and commuting exceptionally easy. This exceptional Silvermine property combines warmth, space, and character in a highly desirable setting you will not want to miss.

This immaculate and move-in ready home located in the Spring Hill area offers a thoughtful layout with flexible living space throughout. The main floor features a brand-new kitchen with all new appliances, a formal dining room with plenty of space for entertainment, and a primary bedroom as well. Neutral tile flooring runs through the kitchen and dining room, while the rest of the main floor features beautiful hardwood floors. An office or bedroom and a full bathroom complete this level. With second floor flexibility, you will find three additional spacious bedrooms and full bath, making it easy to create a second primary suite if desired. There is also extra space that could be used as a den or family room, offering potential for an in-law setup or income-producing tenant with a separate entrance. A good-sized deck off the second floor provides a bird's-eye view of the neighborhood. A small basement with a garage entrance, contains a laundry room and storage. The landscaped yard features irrigation, perennial plantings, and a lovely fenced-in area. This home is ideally located for commuters, with quick access to Route 95, Route 25, Metro-North and the Merritt Parkway, along with many nearby amenities. Great location for commuting to NYC! This property with five bedrooms must be seen in person to fully appreciate its condition and versatile possibilities. Five bedrooms at this price point is rare. Bring your offers!

Welcome to Winnipauk Village, where comfort meets convenience! This spacious 2-bedroom, 1-bath garden-style condo offers an inviting open floor plan, perfect for everyday living and entertaining. The oversized living room features a cozy fireplace, abundant natural light, and sliding doors leading to a private covered patio overlooking peaceful green space. The thoughtfully designed layout includes a beautifully updated kitchen with white cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, stylish backsplash, and an adjoining dining area. Both bedrooms are generously sized, including a spacious primary with large closets, while the renovated bathroom offers modern finishes. Additional highlights include updated flooring, in-unit laundry, and plenty of storage throughout. The floor plan provides an efficient layout with a large living room, spacious bedrooms, and covered patio. Enjoy resort-style amenities including a pool, fitness center, tennis and pickleball courts, and beautifully maintained grounds. Ideally located just minutes from shopping, restaurants, beaches, Metro-North, I-95, Route 7, and the Merritt Parkway, this move-in-ready home offers low-maintenance living in one of Norwalk's most desirable communities.

BEST AND FINAL OFFERS DUE MONDAY JUNE 1, 2026 @ 6PM. Ideally located in the Wolfpit neighborhood adjacent to the Westport border, this 4-bedroom 2 full, 2 half bath Colonial blends timeless character with comfortable everyday living and exceptional convenience. Set on .53 acres with mature trees, a circular driveway, and expansive patio space with a new hot tub designed for effortless indoor/outdoor entertaining, the home offers a warm and welcoming layout filled with natural light, hardwood floors, thoughtful updates, and custom millwork throughout. A gracious foyer opens to an office and dining room, while the heart of the home is the spacious open-concept kitchen, family room, and music room. The country kitchen features stainless steel appliances, abundant cabinetry, a coffee/beverage bar, flowing seamlessly into the inviting family room anchored by a rustic stone fireplace. Upstairs, four generously sized bedrooms provide peaceful retreats, including a spacious primary suite with a walk-in closet and en-suite bath featuring a steam shower and soaking tub. The lower level offers an opportunity for additional living space. Enjoy easy access to Westport and Norwalk train stations, beaches, shopping, dining, and commuter routes from this desirable and well-connected location.

Charming 2 (or possibly 3) Bedroom Cape With Skylights And Vaulted Ceiling in An Oversized Eat In Kitchen. Hardwood Floors, Living Room With Fireplace And Potential In-Law In Lower Level (Sep Entrance). Located Near End Of Woodward. Extra room on upper level currently being used as a large walk-in closet. Rear deck off kitchen has a roof and temporary siding (a makeshift additional storage room for seller). Patio in private fenced backyard. 300 feet away from Woodward Park - a 4.2 acre public park that includes childrens playground, athletic field, ballpark, tennis courts, pickleball courts, basketball court, open fields for picnics, walking path, on-site restroom and water access available.  More info online at: https://www.norwalkct.gov/3319/Woodward-Park

The lower-level accessory apartment has its own private entrance and includes a bedroom, full bath, eat-in kitchen, living room, and separate washer/dryer. Currently producing $2,200/month in rental income, the space is ideal for buyers looking to offset expenses, create long-term income potential, or accommodate multigenerational living.

LIGHT & BRIGHT 2 BEDROOM ON 2ND FLOOR - HARDWOOD FLOORS! - STAINLESS STEEL APPLIANCES! - DISHWASHER IN KITCHEN - WASHER / DRYER IN UNIT! - WELL-MAINTAINED COMPLEX - OFF/ST PARKING FOR 2 CARS - NO PETS!!

Very spacious and updated 2-bedroom, 2-full bath condo located in the well-maintained Ledgebrook community in West Norwalk. Thoughtfully updated with a refreshed kitchen, recessed lighting, and a newly renovated bathroom, this home offers both comfort and functionality. The oversized main living area opens to a private balcony, creating a bright and inviting space ideal for relaxing or entertaining. The primary bedroom suite features a full bath, walk-in closet, and an additional storage room. The second bedroom includes an adjoining space perfect for a home office, reading nook, or sitting area. Full-size laundry is conveniently located on the main level along with another dedicated storage room. Residents of Ledgebrook enjoy a lifestyle centered around convenience and wellness with access to a clubhouse, pool, indoor hot tub, sauna, and fitness center. Ideally situated close to I-95, the SoNo Collection, restaurants, shopping, and everyday conveniences including Costco, Wegmans, Lowe's, and more. Strong credit, verified income/employment, and references required.

2 bed, 1.5 bath end-unit townhome nestled in a well-maintained and quiet West Norwalk association. Enter into a living room with recessed lighting and crown molding. The eat-in kitchen opens up to a deck perfect for sunbathing, dining al fresco, or enjoying your morning coffee. A powder room completes the first floor. Upstairs is the primary bedroom with pull-down stairs to additional storage in the attic. A comfortably-sized second bedroom and full bath complete the second floor. The lower level features the laundry area, private garage, and a spacious storage room. Well run, self managed condo association with low HOA and pool! Conveniently located near Oak Hills Park, featuring a public 18-hole golf course, walking trails, and tennis courts. Screen door to be replaced by HOA

Endless possibilities in this 3 room 1 Bed condo located in East Norwalk! -Walk to East Norwalk train station, all the amenities within short distance to calf pasture beach, great restaurants, SONO, Veterans Park. Low common charges which include heat and hot water.

What if you could have the privacy and tranquility of an artist's nature retreat without giving up space, convenience to Westport, Norwalk and Wilton, great commuting, and everyday amenities? Located in the highly desirable Cranbury neighborhood, this exceptional light-filled 5BR Colonial offers exactly that. A dramatic two-story foyer welcomes you into beautifully designed living spaces featuring newly refinished hardwood floors, elegant dining room with coffered ceiling, bay-windowed living room with fireplace. Just off the kitchen, the stunning family room features a soaring vaulted ceiling, wood-burning fireplace and sliding doors to the deck-creating a seamless connection to nature and effortless indoor-outdoor living. The spacious kitchen includes double ovens, center island, and walk-in pantry/mudroom just a few steps up from the garage. A main-level office makes working from home a pleasure. Upstairs, the expansive primary suite includes a large bath, walk-in closet/laundry, and a flexible adjoining room perfect for a second office, nursery or 2nd walk-in closet. Three additional bedrooms and two full baths complete the upper level. The bright, beautifully finished lower level with full bath and 5th bedroom offers incredible versatility for guests, recreation, fitness, or play and was an artist's studio for this seller. Surrounded by privacy and the peaceful sounds of nature, this is a home designed to enjoy, entertain, and truly live in.

Very rare opportunity to own a multi-family in Rowayton! - Walk / bike to the center of Rowayton and along the water from this fantastic 2 family home! - Also just across the street from the Rowayton Metro North train station, making this property a commuter's dream! - Home has been well-maintained with many updates over recent years! - 1st floor unit was totally renovated in 2022, and features an updated kitchen with white shaker-style cabinets, quartz counters, custom tile backsplash, stainless steel appliances, and a shiplap feature wall! - Brand new stove and microwave (2026) - Hardwood floors throughout, LED lighting, and freshly painted - Updated bathroom with subway tile shower and newer vanity - Newer vinyl windows - Great mudroom entry area offers lots of extra space! || 2nd floor unit features a large, eat-in kitchen with stainless steel range - Updated bathroom with subway tile shower - Hardwood floors - Walk up attic / unfinished 3rd floor for lots of storage + potential expansion || The stone patio at the front corner of the house is great a lounging / grilling / hangout area - Newer driveway leads to a detached 2 car garage with additional unfinished storage loft above the garage! - Each unit has its own separately metered electric, hot water, and forced-air oil furnace! || ** Multiple offers - Highest and Best due by Thursday 5/28 @ 12 noon **

Welcome to 36 Dairy Farm Road! A picture perfect 4/5 BR, 2.5 bath colonial, situated on a level .32-acre landscaped lot in a desirable yet conveniently located neighborhood. 2966 SF of inviting, well thought-out living space make this home a perfect blend of charm & function for modern living and effortless entertaining. A commuter's delight,close to train & highways. Walk to schools & just minutes from the lovely beaches of this shoreline CT town. The foyer enters to a warm 1st floor family rm with fireplace.The open,large EIK is uniquely equipped with 2 gas ranges & sinks to handle large holiday gatherings & meal prep with ease. It also offers direct access to the outdoor deck, seamlessly blending indoor & outdoor dining. Host unforgettable gatherings in the large formal dining room, which overlooks a grand, sunken living room. This sophisticated "WOW" room boasts elegant crown molding & 2nd beautiful marble fireplace that serves as a stunning focal point. Gleaming hardwood floors flow seamlessly throughout. 1st flr 1/2 bth w/laundry. Step into the serene rear heated sunroom, a retreat that opens directly to the outdoor deck. The deck steps down to a lovely private level backyard, offering the perfect backdrop for summer barbecues, gardening or outdoor play. The second floor features a primary bedroom complete w/private ensuite bath & 3/4 add'l Brms with a shared full bath. LL finished rec room add'l 560 SF. 2 Car Gar w/workshop & attic storage.

Start your summer at the picturesque and peaceful Winnipauk Village-offering more amenities than most communities! Residents enjoy two sparkling pools, Newer tennis and pickleball courts, beautifully landscaped grounds perfect for walking or jogging, a fitness center with a racquetball court, and a clubhouse ideal for gatherings and events. This freshly painted, two-bedroom townhouse-style condominium features laminate flooring in the entryway and the LR, tiles at kitchen and half bath, wall to wall carpet at the BR and stares and hall way at second floor. The spacious living room includes a dedicated dining area and sliding doors that open to a large private deck for entertainment and relax at all time. Additional highlights include central air, an in-unit laundry closet conveniently located on the upper level, a reserved parking space, and plenty of visitor parking nearby. Winnipauk Village is ideally situated in a prime Norwalk location-just a short drive to Calf Pasture Beach, Cranbury Park, historic So No, Public Golf Course, schools, shopping, Metro-North train stations, major highways and more. Approximately 51 miles to Midtown Manhattan. Don't miss this opportunity to enjoy resort-style living all summer long!

listings.remarks: HIGHEST AND BEST DUE BY JULY 23RD AT 2PM. Wonderful West Norwalk Colonial with a stunning new kitchen is waiting for you to be the next owner! 2024 Kitchen with GE Cafe appliances complete with a wine chiller, quartz counters and three smart electric shades. You'll want to cook here! Kitchen/dining room bay window overlooks a beautifully landscaped front yard. New LVP flooring on the first floor and hardwood flooring on the second level. The exterior of the home was painted in May 2026 and some interior painting was done at the same time. Updated 200 amp electrical panel, waterproofed the exterior and replaced the sewer lateral from the house to the street. Three bedrooms are located on the 2nd floor and a 4th room on the first floor which is currently functioning as a bedroom with an en-suite bath. Attached two car garage. Central AC is on the main level and split units can be found on the second floor. The roof is approximately 10 years old. Having an outdoor function? In inclement weather you can enjoy the festivities in the large screened in back porch. Solar panels are installed and the buyer would need to be approved to assume the payments. The monthly cost of the solar is $194.88 and is less than the lowest electric bill the owner has received and there is no escalation for the life of the agreement. Schedule your private showing today on this truly wonderful Norwalk Colonial.

An amazing updated home loaded w/ charm, curb appeal and nestled on a quiet cul de sac awaits - Welcome home to 14 Winfield Court. A picturesque front porch greets you and creates an inviting first impression, offering the perfect place to enjoy a morning coffee or unwind at the end of the day. There is so much to love about this cheerful home including hardwood flooring throughout, amazing natural light, solid wood beam ceiling accent in the eat-in kitchen, and fresh paint. The main level provides comfortable living and entertaining spaces, including a spacious living room that opens to the formal dining room and an eat-in kitchen. Both the dining room and eat-in kitchen provide seamless access to the expansive rear deck, creating an effortless indoor-outdoor lifestyle. A convenient partial bath completes the first level. Upstairs, you will find 2 generous sized bedrooms and a beautifully renovated hall bath. Step outside and be pleasantly surprised by how private and expansive this back yard is, your own peaceful escape. The oversized deck, is ideal for outdoor dining, entertaining guests or relaxing while simply enjoying your natural surroundings. Added bonus features to this beautiful home include a detached garage and a lower-level w/ a dedicated laundry area + abundant storage space. Ideally located and a quick walk to the neighborhood "Spot Deli" for convenience and close to dining, parks and transportation. This is the East Norwalk home that you have been waiting for.

HIGHEST & BEST BY 2:00PM MONDAY, JUNE 8th. Beautifully updated 3 bedroom, 3 full bathroom home featuring hardwood floors throughout and an updated kitchen designed for both everyday living and entertaining. The main level is enhanced by elegant crown molding, while a newly created laundry area adds convenience. Enjoy outdoor living on the private deck overlooking a low maintenance backyard. Additional highlights include central air conditioning, a newer roof, and a finished lower level offering valuable extra living space. Ideally located just seconds from Stew Leonard's, shopping, restaurants, and everyday conveniences, with easy access to the train, Merritt Parkway, and I-95 for a seamless commute.

Located in Norwalk's desirable Cranbury neighborhood, 38 Stonecrop Road North offers the ease of one-level living paired with exceptional indoor-outdoor flow. Filled with natural light and meticulously maintained, this home is designed for relaxed living, effortless entertaining, and everyday enjoyment.  The updated kitchen and main living areas open seamlessly to an expansive patio and private fenced backyard-creating a natural extension of the home and an ideal setting for summer barbecues, outdoor dining, and gatherings of any size. Vaulted ceilings and a striking floor-to-ceiling brick fireplace bring character and scale to the family room, creating a space that feels both warm and open.  The thoughtfully designed floor plan offers a wonderful balance of connection and privacy, with inviting living spaces, generously sized bedrooms, and a primary suite with its own bath. Hardwood floors, central air, a whole-house generator, and numerous improvements enhance the home's move-in-ready appeal.  Set on .64 acres in the heart of Cranbury, just moments from beloved Cranbury Park and convenient to Westport, Metro-North, shopping, dining, and major commuting routes, this is easy Connecticut living at its best.

Excellent opportunity for buyers looking to add their own personal touch! This duplex-style residence is one side of a 4-unit complex offering low HOA, generous living space, abundant natural light, and strong long-term upside potential. A great opportunity to personalize, renovate over time, and build equity in a highly desirable South Norwalk location. Conveniently located near the South Norwalk train station, major highways, waterfront attractions, restaurants, shopping, and nightlife. Enjoy close proximity to the vibrant SoNo district, known for its popular dining scene, walkable downtown, The SoNo Collection, Maritime Aquarium at Norwalk, and waterfront entertainment. Whether you're looking for your next home or a property with long-term potential, this home offers exceptional opportunity in a prime location. Property being sold as-is.

listings.remarks: What if you had waited long enough to find your perfect house, and then it appeared? Crafted as the builder's own residence, every decision was made to create a home of EXTRAORDINARY QUALITY, design and lasting value. The Kitchen features 2" marble countertop on the 8' island, quartz countertops, 48" range, wine refrigerator, abundant natural light, butler's pantry/wet bar, plus a 2nd pantry. Open to the Family room with fireplace connecting to a fabulous covered porch with fireplace. And then...there are THE VIEWS! Rolling lawns on the 1.6 acre property lead to the pond waterfront for the most peaceful setting in all seasons. A mudroom with shiplap, 2nd powder room, and ample closet space keeps mess contained. Two private offices-one on the main level and one on the third floor-offer dual workspaces. The second floor includes a primary suite with two WIC's, three additional bedrooms with ensuite or jack-and-jill bath and a huge bonus/playroom. The newly finished third floor serves as a private retreat with a large sun-filled gym, 5th bedroom, full bath, and large private office for concentration above the fray. The huge 3-car garage is enhanced by a 2nd-level EV charger. Whole-house generator. This one is different--so solid and elegant, in a beautiful quiet neighborhood, and set on land that one just cannot find anymore. Don't wait!

Welcome to 37 Seaview Ave in the attractive East Norwalk! EVERYTHING IS NEWER! Water views of the L.I Sound won't disappoint. Just a hop, skip and a jump from the L.I Sound/Veterans Park (Oyster Festival), SONO, many shops/restaurants & MORE! Enjoy the 4th of July Fireworks from the front yard! Commuter friendly also! Just minutes from East Norwalk/South Norwalk Train Stations, I95 (Exit 16), Rt7 & MORE! This second floor unit includes 1 spacious bedroom, 1 full bathroom, living room & EIK. Hardwood floors throughout, newer kitchen/bathroom, plenty of closet/cabinet storage + many windows for natural light make you feel right at home. Additional storage + Laundry in basement. Natural Gas for heat, hot water & cooking help keep utilities cost LOW! Yard space for grilling, relaxing & enjoying WATER VIEWS! Tenants must have good credit, proof of income & references. Plenty of parking on Seaview Ave or Betts Place. Pets are case by case basis/ No smoking allowed.

Nestled on one of Rowayton's favorite cul-de-sacs, 22 Ledge Road offers the perfect blend of charm, space, functionality, and outdoor living. Set on an oversized, flat lot, this beautifully updated 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath home spans over 3,400 square feet above grade plus finished lower-level space. Originally built in 1954 and fully renovated in 2015, the home features an open kitchen, stunning primary suite with custom walk-in dressing room and en suite bath, beautiful laundry room, wood flooring throughout, and thoughtful updates inside and out. Recent improvements include a professionally designed patio with fire pit, extensive landscaping, exterior lighting, automated irrigation, and flourishing raspberry and blueberry bushes. A welcoming foyer opens to the heart of the home, where the kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining room, living room with wood-burning fireplace, and family room with access to the patio. Four bedrooms are located upstairs, including the primary suite and an additional en suite bedroom. The fifth bedroom and full bath are on the main level, ideal for guests. The finished lower level provides flexible living, recreation, or gym space. The expansive backyard offers ample room for entertaining, relaxation, and future pool possibilities. The train, schools, village center, beaches, and waterfront are all just a short walk away. A rare opportunity to enjoy the best of Rowayton living.

Spectacular home completely rebuilt from the ground up into a stunning brand new Colonial, offering the perfect blend of modern design and quality craftsmanship. Featuring a bright open floor plan with wide plank hardwood floors throughout, this home is designed for today's lifestyle. The gorgeous custom kitchen boasts a large center island, ample cabinetry, and flows seamlessly into the main living areas. The first floor also offers a versatile office/guest room/bonus room to fit your needs. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite features a beautiful spa-like bath and walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms are serviced by another stylish modern full bath. The finished lower level adds approximately 740sf of additional living space and includes a stunning full bath with a large walk-in shower, perfect for extra room for the family or as a potential in-law set up. Situated on a beautiful lot in a highly desirable and convenient location close to shopping, restaurants, beach, schools, train, and major highways. Everything is new, nothing to do but move in.

Welcome to Mallard's Landing, where exciting improvements are underway, including brand-new siding and new decks that will give the complex a fresh, updated look. This bright and spacious second-floor condominium has an peaceful view of landscaped grounds and trees from the deck. It offers convenient one-level living with two generously sized bedrooms and two full bathrooms. The primary bedroom features a walk-in closet and a private ensuite bath complete with both a tub and shower. The open-concept floor plan connects the living room, dining area, and eat-in kitchen. Sliding glass doors lead from the living area to a private deck, creating the perfect space for fresh air and to relax outdoors. Recent updates include fresh paint and recent carpeting throughout much of the home. The convenience of in-unit laundry adds to its appeal. Additional highlights include a dedicated storage unit, a carport plus an assigned parking space and access to the community's well-maintained in-ground pool. Ideally situated on the Norwalk/Darien border, this desirable location set back from the road offers exceptional convenience with easy access to Route 1, I-95, SoNo, the train station, and walking distance to a wide variety of shopping, dining, and everyday amenities.

listings.remarks: This considerately renovated 1880 Victorian is steps to the East Norwalk Green. Its 2019 updates include the bathrooms, kitchen, walls and floors, roof, insulation, central air, tankless water heater, portions of the siding, plumbing, and electrical systems. The modernization provides the benefits of current living while preserving the home's period appeal. Offering three levels of living space, the main level has a foyer/parlor with carved staircase, living room, and dining room connected by classically detailed openings. There are two staircases, front and rear for convenience. The classic kitchen includes marble countertops, stainless steel appliances, chef's range, island w/ second sink, a pantry, and an eating area. Adjacent are a mudroom and a powder room. The main level's gracious rooms feel settled, substantial, and timeless. The second floor includes the primary suite with two closets and a sophisticated ensuite bath. Two additional bedrooms share a double-sink hall bath with tub/shower. The third floor offers two additional bedrooms, including one with an en-suite bath (tub only), plus a double-sink hall bath. Additional features include a full unfinished basement with washer and dryer; detached two-car garage; and level yard. Set on an in-town street of classic homes, think sidewalks and strolls to amenities, while also having this convenient location minutes from train, beaches, shopping, schools, and major transportation routes. Agent/Landlord.

Welcome to 43 Soundview Avenue #4! This spacious and versatile condo features an open-concept main living area with hardwood floors and an updated kitchen complete with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, abundant cabinetry, and a large center island perfect for entertaining. The flexible floor plan offers two generously sized bedrooms, including a sun-filled primary bedroom with a skylight and loft! The finished lower level includes a kitchen, full bath, and versatile space ideal for guests, a home office, gym, or recreation area. Garage has been converted into a separate finished space that provides additional flexibility for a studio, hobby room, office, or fitness space. Step outside to the two tiered expansive rear deck, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, transportation, and Norwalk's amenities, this unique home offers exceptional space and versatility rarely found in condo living.   Unit has #1 on Exterior

Welcome to this pristine 3-bedroom Colonial in the highly sought-after Cranbury neighborhood. Move-in ready and meticulously maintained, this inviting home features hardwood floors throughout, a formal living room with a fireplace, a dining area, and a well-appointed kitchen with an eating area. The spectacular great room with soaring ceiling creates a bright, airy gathering space at the heart of the home.  Enjoy year-round relaxation in the heated sunroom overlooking the private backyard. Outside, a heated swimming pool, deck, and mature landscaping provide a private setting for entertaining or quiet enjoyment. Two full baths and a partially finished lower level with abundant storage complete the home's thoughtful layout.  Conveniently located near shopping, dining, parks, and the SoNo train station, this exceptional property combines comfort, functionality, and outdoor living in one of Cranbury's most desirable locations. A must see!

Don't miss this wonderful rental in quiet convenient location. Offers great living space, formal living room with fireplace, dining room, eat-in-kitchen, spacious family room with walls of windows overlooking private, beautifully manicured backyard with gazebo, and stone patio. 3 bedrooms, lower level includes playroom, office, full bath and laundry.

Newly Remodeled, Sun-Filled Cape for Rent. 4 Bedrooms and 1 Full Bath, Fully Updated. Eat-In Kitchen. Washer/Dryer in unfinished basement. Hardwood floors. Three-Zone New High-Efficiency Gas Boiler/Heater. Off-Street Parking. Two Generous Sized Bedrooms and a Full Bath on Main Floor and Two More Bedrooms on Upper Level. Easy Access to Shopping, Restaurants, Schools, Parks, Train, I-95 & MERRITT PARKWAY. Available immediately.

Nestled at the end of a quiet West Norwalk cul-de-sac, this distinctive Mid-Century Modern home offers a rare combination of architectural character and natural beauty. Set on nearly an acre along the scenic Five Mile River, the property provides a peaceful waterfront setting with wooded views and exceptional privacy. The tenant is responsible for electricity and internet service.  A charming, beautifully updated apartment in an outstanding location offering convenience, quality, and easy living.

A rare opportunity to live, earn, or invest, all in one property!  Stylishly renovated main residence paired with a fully renovated one bedroom cottage, creating a rare opportunity for supplemental income, multigenerational living, or a private home office.  Both residences are currently leased below current market, offering immediate upside for future income potential. Each home has been updated to provide comfortable, easy living with layouts that suit today's lifestyle, while maintaining separation and privacy between the two residences.  Whether you are looking to live in one residence while generating income from the other, accommodate extended family, or secure a property with long term investment potential, this unique offering delivers flexibility rarely found in today's market. Please note:  The cottage has the heat pump for heating and cooling. Updated in 2020.  The main house has the forced air oil heat and central air for heating and cooling. Updated in 2020.

Newly constructed 1-bedroom, 1-bath apartment at Heights Crossing, a luxury apartment community in the Noroton Heights neighborhood of Darien. Conveniently located across from the Metro-North train station, offering direct access to New York City and close proximity to everyday conveniences.  This residence features an open-concept floor plan with luxury vinyl plank flooring throughout and a Juliet balcony off the living room. The kitchen includes Quartz countertops, a center island with seating, custom cabinetry, GE appliances, designer tile backsplash, and pantry. The primary bedroom offers dual closets and an en-suite bath with a glass-enclosed stall shower. Additional features include a foyer, side-by-side in-unit washer and dryer, and central air.  Community amenities include secure entry, elevator, first come, first-serve garage parking, on-site management, fitness and wellness center, golf simulator, resident lounge with fireplace, co-working spaces, reservable event room, bicycle storage, trash chutes, landscaped courtyard with fountain, and a dedicated mail and package room. Community charge of $70/month includes 1 GB high-speed internet, water, sewer, and trash service.

listings.remarks: Discover elegant coastal living in this updated 4-5 bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home offering 3,553 sf of thoughtfully designed living space on a flat, private .65-acre property. Ideally located a short distance from Weed Beach and only steps from Darien's award-winning Blue Ribbon elementary school, this home combines convenience, comfort, and versatility. Located within the desirable Noroton Manor Association, homeowners enjoy private tennis courts, waterfront access, and an active neighborhood community. Inside, a beautifully renovated gourmet kitchen showcases high-end stainless steel appliances, while hardwood floors and custom millwork add warmth and sophistication throughout. The versatile floor plan offers multiple options for today's lifestyle, including a private office with its own bath that can easily function as an additional bedroom. Not to be missed are the abundant storage options and radiant-heated floors in the primary and upstairs bathrooms. Above the attached two-car garage, a spacious, versatile finished room with a half bath provides endless possibilities as a playroom, guest suite, home office, or additional bedroom. Designed for both everyday living and entertaining, the home features an expansive 700+ sf deck overlooking the private backyard. The property is enhanced by an irrigation system and offers ample space for outdoor activities and entertaining.

listings.remarks: Set on 9.4 acres, this exceptional estate offers a private, sophisticated retreat at the end of a Bradford pear-lined gravel drive. The property includes a 10,000-square-foot main residence with pool and pool house, a two-bedroom guest cottage, and a remarkable field house designed by architect Louise Brooks. The main house blends timeless elegance with modern design, while the field house delivers a one-of-a-kind recreational and entertaining experience, featuring an indoor batting cage, two-lane bowling alley, resistance pool, and stylish lounge spaces. This offering is for all three parcels, each with its own address and private entrance, offering rare flexibility, exclusivity, and privacy.

Welcome to 1015 Boston Post Road, a beautifully appointed 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartment ideally located in the heart of Darien. Just moments from the town's restaurants, boutiques, and everyday conveniences, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and accessibility. Inside, an open-concept floor plan seamlessly connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas, creating an inviting space that's ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. The living room features soaring ceilings and oversized windows that fill the home with natural light, enhancing its bright and airy feel. The kitchen is complete with marble countertops, a breakfast bar, and ample cabinetry, while the adjacent dining area provides the perfect setting for everyday meals or hosting friends. An in-unit washer and dryer adds to the home's everyday convenience. Perfectly situated for commuters, the apartment is within walking distance of the Darien train station and just minutes from I-95, making travel effortless. Enjoy everything Darien has to offer from this exceptional location where shopping, dining, and transportation are all just outside your door.

Available as early as 8/16. Beautiful modern farmhouse, recently totally refreshed both inside and out. Set way back off the road, You'll love this home's great layout and it's spacious and scenic private back yard setting. All new landscaping and driveway. Huge detached storage building. Super convenient location close to schools, shopping, highways, trains etc. This one won't last! Interior photos coming soon.

Step into this stunning sun-drenched colonial, where classic architectural character has been lovingly and meticulously restored to perfection. Set on a generous, private .89 acre lot on one of Darien's most sought-after streets, this thoughtfully remodeled home offers five spacious bedrooms and 2.5 baths across a layout designed for both effortless entertaining and comfortable family living. Walk to town and the train station in minutes a rare convenience paired with this level of privacy and space. Gorgeous natural light floods the living room with its inviting fireplace, while the elegant formal dining room sets the stage for memorable gatherings. The heart of the home is the brand new kitchen, featuring a large center island, premium finishes, and stunning French doors that open seamlessly to an expansive deck for morning coffee or sunset entertaining, with sweeping views of the yard. Adjacent to the kitchen, the family room beckons with a striking stone fireplace, while the thoughtfully placed mudroom and laundry room keep daily life organized and streamlined. Downstairs, the finished lower level provides flexible space with a playroom and convenient kitchenette. Additional highlights include a two car garage and a large, flat, private backyard a rare oasis for play, gardening, or simply unwinding in complete tranquility. Ideally located, this exceptional home is just moments from town amenities, the train, and Cherry Lawn Park. Charm, character and location!

Perched high in the coveted Delafield Island Association, this beautiful colonial with pool and cabana offers a rare combination of privacy, natural light, and effortless indoor outdoor living. Inspired by the relaxed elegance of a California design, the home unfolds with open, airy spaces and dramatic scale. A spectacular two-story wall of windows fills the eat in kitchen with sunlight, creating a striking focal point and connecting the home beautifully to the surrounding landscape. On the other hand, the family room features an oversized fireplace and expansive views of the backyard, with seasonal views of Scott Cove adding to the sense of place. The kitchen flows seamlessly into the living room, creating a natural gathering space at the heart of the home. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a deck overlooking the pool, walk in closet and private bath, complemented by four additional bedrooms that provide flexibility for family, guests and a designated office that opens out to a porch. The windows throughout this home make this home sundrenched! Outside, the property truly shines. An expansive level lawn leads to a heated gunite pool and fully equipped cabana with sink, refrigerator, lighting, bathroom, and storage. Whether hosting summer gatherings or enjoying quiet afternoons locally by the water, the setting is designed for relaxed coastal living. A premier Delafield Island location close to town, train, and beaches, makes this a truly special offering.

Modern ranch perfection in one of Darien's most sought after neighborhoods. This exceptional home was stripped down to the studs and completely rebuilt, offering the rare combination of one-level living with the style and confidence of a near-new construction renovation. Thoughtfully re-imagined with clean and modern finishes and an easy, open flow, this home is designed for today's lifestyle- comfortable, clean-lined and turn-key. Outside the property has undergone a dramatic transformation. Dozens of trees were removed and extensive work on the drainage was conducted. New landscaping was installed to create an epic, expansive yard- ideal for entertaining, play, pets and future outdoor living enhances.  A detached garage offers additional bonus space ready to be transformed to an office, gym, studio, playroom. This location is unbeatable- right near Darien High School, trains and shopping!

This gracious Colonial blends timeless 1930s charm with thoughtful modern updates, ideally located on one of Darien's most sought-after in-town streets, known for its traditions and strong sense of community. Set on a level, one-acre property in a coveted half-acre zone, the home offers rare expansion potential and exceptional lifestyle appeal.Extensively renovated and expanded, the home features a reimagined layout designed for today's living. The updated kitchen with custom cabinetry, granite countertops, and high-end appliances opens seamlessly to the family room with fireplace. A butler's pantry, walk-in pantry, mudroom, and dedicated home office add both functionality and convenience. A versatile room above the garage offers flexible living space, ideal as a fifth bedroom, guest retreat, or potential in-law suite. Recent improvements include renovated bathrooms and a luxurious primary suite with spa-like bath featuring heated floors, soaking tub, marble walk-in shower, and custom built-ins. Mechanical upgrades include multiple air handlers, updated HVAC systems, full-house generator, new boiler and hot water heater, and replaced roof & windows. Classic details such as original hardwood floors and elegant millwork preserve the home's character throughout. The private, level property is framed by mature plantings and features a thoughtfully designed patio-ideal for entertaining, recreation, or future expansion. A rare combination of location, land, community & charm

Spectacular quintessential New England home in Darien has it all! Step into a world of refined elegance with this stately 8,000+SF Colonial masterpiece. Set back on nearly two acres of manicured grounds, boasting a custom 2021 Gunite pool, outdoor kitchen, new patio, huge backyard and firepit, this treasured residence is the ultimate venue for indoor & outdoor living and entertaining. The main level features a soaring 2-story foyer that transitions into a formal living room w/fireplace & stunning formal dining room w/ butlers pantry, wet bar, wine fridge & food pantry. Step into the chef's kitchen w/ 16ft marble island, Miele range, dual Sub-zeros & sun-drenched breakfast area. The kitchen flows into a massive family room w/ stone fireplace & adjoining sunroom w/ 25ft stone fireplace w/French doors to backyard & pool. There's a large, office w/ custom paneling & coffered ceiling, a mudroom w/built-ins, plus a full bath, a powder room and back staircase to upper level rooms. The 2nd floor primary suite is a private sanctuary, defined by 11-foot barrel vaulted ceilings, a fireplace, 2 walk-in closets and a spa-inspired marble bath w/double sink, soaking tub & steam shower. There are 4 additional en-suite bedrooms, a laundry room & open space for study/gaming. The 3rd floor has over 2,400sqft of storage/ potential living space!

Set along one of Hollow Tree Ridge Road's most desirable stretches, 366 Hollow Tree Ridge Road is a masterfully restored and expanded residence that artfully blends historic character with refined modern living. Reimagined by renowned builder Bo Malpass, the home offers 6 bds, 5.1 baths across 7,356 sq feet. Original character is preserved through antique beams and wide plank wood floors, while modern updates introduce a seamless flow and elevated functionality. Interiors curated by Kristen Fine enhance the home's cohesive aesthetic with understated luxury and timeless finishes. Sun-drenched living spaces unfold effortlessly, creating an ideal setting for both everyday living and elegant entertaining. The custom-designed Poggenpohl kitchen serves as the heart of the home, complemented by multiple inviting gathering spaces. A spacious primary suite and well-appointed secondary bedrooms provide comfort, scale, and flexibility. Set on 1.75 acres of beautifully landscaped grounds, the property features a Gunite pool and a charming guest cottage connected by a breezeway ideal as an in-law suite, private retreat, or dedicated work-from-home space. Ideally located with convenient access to town, train, and Darien's top-rated schools, this exceptional offering presents a rare opportunity to own a turnkey home where historic integrity and modern sophistication converge.

Located at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in Darien, this updated 5-bedroom Colonial combines space, comfort, and convenience. The main level features a newly renovated eat-in kitchen with modern finishes and ample space for everyday living and casual entertaining. Upstairs, there are five bedrooms, including a primary suite with an updated bath and a full wall of custom closets with sleek sliding doors. The walk-out basement adds flexibility, complete with a wine cellar and additional space ideal for a rec room, gym, or private in-law suite. Outdoor spaces are equally inviting, with a deck just off the kitchen for outdoor dining and a backyard fire pit for relaxed evenings. Conveniently located within walking distance to downtown, Metro-North, Royle Elementary School, and Tilley Pond Park, this home offers a quiet setting with easy access to everything Darien has to offer. A rare rental opportunity that truly feels like home!

This highly desirable corner Norwood unit, with a newly redone private patio and secluded backyard is located in a great spot in the Kensett community. The 4 bedroom unit has high-end finishes throughout including professional appliances, extra thick granite countertops and beautiful plantation shutters. The light filled open floor plan with high ceilings invites casual entertaining or cozy time in front of the beautiful gas fireplace. The main floor sun room with two walls of windows and additional fireplace affords private space for a home office. Upstairs the luxurious master suite has a huge walk-in closet with built-ins, and a beautiful master bath with a soaking tub, large shower and double marble topped vanity. Two additional large bedrooms, both with private baths and walk-in closets complete the second floor. The lower level has large finished area for entertainment or recreation. There is another study area with a full bath and walk- in closet which could be an additional office or 4th bedroom. There is additional storage space and an owner's locked closet. Come enjoy the easy, highly energy efficient life style at Kensett including a heated pool, clubhouse, fitness center and firepit. The complex abuts a 4 acre land trust complete with walking trails.

listings.remarks: This lovingly maintained four-bedroom, three-and-a-half bathroom home is the ideal blend of comfort, convenience and natural surroundings. Filled with natural light from its north-south exposure, 34 Intervale Road features nine-foot ceilings, refinished hardwood floors, and generously proportioned living spaces throughout. Recent renovations include master bathroom and powder room, quartz countertops in both the kitchen and wet bar, new kitchen backsplash, along with basement flooring. Mechanical upgrades include a full-house generator, new air handler, boiler, and newer hot water heater - all connected to natural gas. Enjoy outdoor living on the deck overlooking a private backyard that abuts Woodland Park, offering more than 60 acres of trails and open space. Located in one of Darien's most adored neighborhoods, it's walkable to all three schools, Noroton Heights train, shopping, and restaurants. A true move-in ready home in a prime Darien location.

Masterfully renovated and expanded by renowned architect Chad Nehring, this 1929 Colonial features a chef's kitchen boasting a centerpiece 10' island, heated gunite pool, and seamless indoor-outdoor living. Set on beautifully landscaped, private, and fully fenced-in grounds and thoughtfully designed for both elegant entertaining and everyday comfort. This home offers a gracious living room with wood-burning fireplace, formal dining room with custom paneling and hand-painted walls, and a stunning kitchen with Vermont White quartzite countertops, custom cabinetry, GE Monogram appliances, Viking refrigerator and freezer columns, dual Bosch dishwashers, and a well-appointed bar area. Completing the main level is a family room with custom built-ins, a music room for your grand piano, a private office with three desk areas, and a thoughtfully designed mudroom and powder room with radiant heated floors. French doors from the family room open to an expansive bluestone and granite terrace with custom stonework and outdoor kitchen, overlooking the private yard and heated 16'X32' pool with automatic cover. Upstairs, the primary suite features a spa-like bath with soaking tub, oversized shower, radiant heated floors and custom walk-in closet. Three additional bedrooms and two full baths complete the second level. A finished third floor with full bath offers flexibility for a guest suite, office or playroom, while the lower level includes a gym, gaming room, and recreation area.

listings.remarks: Welcome to this beautifully renovated Colonial in the heart of Darien, where timeless design meets modern luxury. Offering four bedrooms and three full bathrooms across four finished levels, this move-in ready home delivers exceptional space, style, and functionality for today's lifestyle. The home features a bright and airy layout with thoughtfully updated interiors throughout. The stunning renovation seamlessly blends classic architectural charm with high-end finishes, creating inviting living and entertaining spaces on every level. The main floor offers an effortless flow, perfect for both everyday living and hosting, while the upper levels provide well-appointed bedrooms and flexible spaces for work, relaxation, or play. The fully finished lower level adds incredible versatility-ideal for a media room or a gym. Set in a prime, in-town location, this home offers unparalleled convenience. Just moments to the train, top-rated schools, restaurants, shopping, and Darien's beautiful beaches. A rare opportunity to own a turnkey luxury home in one of Darien's most sought-after locations.

Set gracefully above the scenic Goodwives River, this exceptional 1930s stone residence blends timeless character with 3403sq ft of sophisticated modern updates. Fully restored and renovated in 2003, the home preserves its architectural integrity with casement windows, slate roof, 9ft ceilings, and dramatic floor-to-ceiling stone fireplcs. 2020 improv include refinished hardwood floors throughout, a renovated primary bath with new shower and vanity, custom built-ins and window bench seating in the primary bedroom, enhanced third-floor suite storage and closet space, and a refreshed lower level with built-in office workspace and laundry area. The chef's kitchen features Carrara marble countertops, center island, premium appliances, wine refrigerator, and opens seamlessly to the family room with coffered ceiling and fireplace-ideal for everyday living and entertaining. The primary suite is a private sanctuary with fireplace, sitting room, and spa-inspired bath featuring dbl vanities, soaking tub, and separate shower. Addl bedrooms are ensuite with updated baths. A sun-filled living room with windows on three sides overlooks the grounds and includes a wet bar with direct access to the patio and deck for effortless indoor-outdoor living. Set on over one acre of fully fenced property, offers privacy and gated access leading to Gorham's Pond-perfect for kayak, paddle, and recreation. A short walk or bike ride to Great Island and the beach. Minutes to train, shopping and dinin

Picturesque 1928 farmhouse set on a quiet, private neighborhood street, offering a seamless blend of timeless character and thoughtfully renovated modern style. Featuring 9-foot ceilings, pine hardwood floors and original oversized pocket doors, this home is rich in classic details while providing a well-designed layout ideal for both entertaining and everyday living. Gracious dining and living rooms flow effortlessly to a charming screened porch and into a spacious eat-in kitchen, creating a warm and cohesive living space. The second floor features three bedrooms and an updated hall bath highlighted by a beautiful clawfoot tub, along with a dedicated office space perfect for working from home or study. The finished third floor offers exceptional flexibility as a primary suite or playroom, complete with a cozy sitting room and a beautifully renovated full bath featuring mosaic marble floors and Waterworks fixtures. A full, unfinished basement provides generous storage and opportunity for future expansion. Outside, the beautifully landscaped grounds showcase a welcoming patio ideal for outdoor entertaining, along with a lush, level lawn offering ample space for recreation and relaxation. A thoughtfully constructed stone retaining wall enhances both the property's architectural appeal and functionality. Conveniently located close to everything Darien has to offer, this special home combines charm, comfort, and everyday convenience in a truly inviting setting.

Discover the potential of this charming four-bedroom Colonial located in one of Darien's most desirable neighborhoods. Set on just over an acre of beautifully flat, private land with a sparkling pool, this property offers endless possibilities. Built in 1953, the home exudes character and classic appeal, ready for a new owner to renovate, restore, or reimagine.  Within walking distance to local schools and just minutes from town, the train, this location is truly exceptional. Flag football on the lawn, basketball/pickleball on the sports court or a bbq pool party in the backyard; too many options for fun! Whether you choose to enhance the existing home with your own personal touches or build your dream residence from the ground up, this property presents a rare opportunity in a sought-after neighborhood. Dont miss this opportunity to have the most enjoyable time this summer in Darien.

Set on nearly 2 private acres in coveted northern Darien, this exceptional custom Colonial offers refined living with timeless design and superior craftsmanship throughout. Detailed with exquisite custom moldings, the home exudes elegance in every space. A dramatic step-down living room with fireplace creates a warm and inviting atmosphere, while the spacious formal dining room is perfectly complemented by an adjacent butler's pantry-ideal for effortless entertaining. A richly appointed library with its own fireplace provides a quiet retreat. The gourmet kitchen opens seamlessly to a generous family room with fireplace, forming the heart of the home, and is supported by two conveniently located powder rooms. Upstairs, a second family room offers additional flexible living space, an office and five well-proportioned bedrooms and four full baths, including a luxurious primary suite. The lower level is designed for both recreation and lifestyle, featuring a walk-in wine cellar, a large level playroom/craft room with double sinks, and a dedicated workout room. Outdoors, the professionally landscaped grounds provide a private oasis with a beautiful pool and an outdoor fireplace-perfect for relaxing and entertaining year-round.  Complete with a three-car garage, this remarkable property combines elegance, comfort and functionality in one of Darien's most desirable settings.

Welcome to 8 Pasture Lane, a property that redefines FUN in luxury living with resort-style elegance in one of Darien's most desirable locations. This stunning 6-bedroom, 5,500 sq. ft. home offers impeccable design, thoughtful architecture & an extraordinary flow that's as unique and functional as it is beautiful. From the moment you step inside, the first floor sets the tone for a home that's both inviting & impressive. Its seamless layout creates an open and effortless connection between spaces, with true showstoppers including the awesome kitchen-family room & vibey primary suite. A rare change from the everyday Darien offering this home just invites easy living & serious entertaining. But the magic doesn't stop indoors. Sitting on just under an acre, the landscaped grounds feel like your own personal retreat. Whether it's a refreshing dip in the gorgeous heated pool, a soak in the spa, or relaxing in the private back yard, there's something here for everyone. The turf field, in particular, is a dream for athlete's training or a little outdoor fun-it's perfect for practices, games, or simply running around. Want more? The finished basement offers endless versatility, ready for a playroom, or your own private media center. And let's not forget the unbeatable location-just minutes from beaches, shops, top-notch restaurants, & the train, 8 Pasture Lane seamlessly combines convenience with tranquility. A lifestyle designed for making memories & savoring every moment.

Set on a beautifully landscaped acre along one of Darien's most coveted residential lanes, 10 Queens Lane is a timeless 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath Colonial offering the space, character, and setting that make it truly special. With 3,694 square feet of living space, this home strikes the perfect balance between classic New England charm and everyday comfort. The gracious layout features generously sized rooms throughout, ideal for both relaxed family living and easy entertaining. The main level flows effortlessly from formal to casual spaces, while four spacious bedrooms upstairs offer the room to grow. There is also potential to expand the second floor over the family room and update the finishes to reflect your own personal style. The expansive one-acre lot provides exceptional privacy with ample room for outdoor play, or simply enjoying the tranquil surroundings. Located just off Old Kings Highway South, this sought-after address puts you minutes from the Darien train station, Downtown Corbin district, library, top-rated schools, and all that this beloved shoreline community has to offer, including nearby beaches and Great Island. Whether you are commuting to the city or settling into the rhythms of coastal Connecticut living, don't miss this home!

Set at the end of a coveted Fox Hill cul de sac on a private 1 acre lot, this spectacular 5 bedroom, 6 bath home offers an exceptional lifestyle defined by luxury, comfort, and effortless entertaining. Completely redesigned, the home is surrounded by open, beautifully manicured grounds with a premium lawn and expansive feel, combining privacy and serenity with a setting that feels both special and inviting. Designed for modern living, the home features four fireplaces, a stunning chef's kitchen with soaring ceilings, a statement center island, and high end appliances, as well as a private home office, theater room, gym with sauna, and a first floor in law suite with full bath. Outside, the resort style backyard is the ultimate private retreat, complete with a pool, hot tub, outdoor fire pit, and expansive mahogany deck for seamless indoor outdoor living. Warm, inviting, and beautifully designed, this is a rare opportunity to own a private oasis in one of Darien's most sought after locations.

Your homestead starts here-welcome to 30 Shipway Road, a private waterfront retreat set on 1.49 incredible acres in sought-after Noroton Bay. Designed by renowned architect Chad Nehring, with coastal interiors by Pear Tree Point Design, this 5 bedroom home blends timeless style with modern comfort. Nearly every room takes in sweeping, unobstructed views of the harbor and Long Island Sound, creating a peaceful, picture-perfect setting all year long. The main living spaces flow easily outdoors to a deep water dock, beautiful pool and spa, lush grounds, and gas fire pit - perfect for relaxing or entertaining by the water. The primary suite is a true escape, with vaulted ceilings and its own private balcony overlooking the water-ideal for morning coffee. There's also a two-car attached garage, plus a detached three-car garage with a well-appointed apartment above, great for guests or extended family. A rare opportunity in one of Darien's most desirable waterfront neighborhoods, this home truly captures the best of coastal living.
