listings.remarks: Charming and beautifully maintained Cape set on a secluded, flat, .46-acre lot. This updated home offers four bedrooms and three full baths, including a spacious main-floor primary suite. The kitchen opens to a large, sun-filled family room, creating an easy flow for everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen and baths were tastefully renovated in 2016. Enjoy a fully fenced backyard oasis with a screened-in porch and firepit - perfect for summer gatherings and relaxed outdoor living. The basement has additional 800 sq feet of space with full gym. Move-in ready and walkable to school.

This expansive 4,400 sf colonial, fully rebuilt in 2013, offers a refined blend of comfort, scale and thoughtful design. A welcoming entry leads to a gracious living room with a fireplace, flowing seamlessly into a formal dining room well suited for both intimate dinners and larger gatherings. At the center of the home, the sunlit gourmet kitchen features marble countertops, a 6 burner range, double wall ovens, and a large island, opening seamlessly to the family room with fireplace, custom built-ins, and sliding doors to the patio. Outdoor living is equally well considered, with a bluestone patio extending into a level, professionally landscaped yard that supports both relaxation and recreation. The first floor also offers a private office (or guest suite) w/full bath and a mudroom designed for everyday convenience. Upstairs, the primary suite features cathedral ceilings, two walk-in closets and a spa-like, marble bath w/soaking tub and separate shower. three additional bedrooms, a library/homework room, and a spacious laundry room provide comfort and efficiency. The bright third floor and finished lower level provides additional living space and invite imagination-movie room, home gym, playroom, or gathering space. Ideally located steps from the 65-acre Woodland Nature Preserve and within walking distance to the train, shopping, and restaurants. This home has exceptional flow and offers the perfect blend of space, function and convenience.

This quintessential colonial sits on a quiet cul-de-sac only minutes from town. The main level consists of an updated kitchen, multiple family/living rooms that serve as functional gathering spaces with three wood burning fireplaces, a dining room, two powder rooms and a large three car garage. Front and back staircases lead you up to six bedrooms which includes a primary bedroom with gas fireplace and four full bathrooms. Finished lower level is perfect for a playroom/theater room with a gym and workshop. French doors lead you out back where you will find a large saltwater pool with a beautifully landscaped lawn, a new fence and an outdoor firepit - the perfect space to entertain. New roof in 2025. Don't miss this meticulously maintained home!

Ideally located just moments from downtown, train to NYC, and schools, 33 Fairview Avenue offers the very best of Darien living. Thoughtfully transformed by the current owners, this home seamlessly blends timeless charm with modern sophistication, featuring detailed millwork, beautiful built-ins, refinished floors, updated bathrooms, and a stunning kitchen refresh with new countertops and appliances. The first floor is both elegant and functional, beginning with a formal sitting room adorned with custom paneling and built-ins, which flows effortlessly into a private office complete with a hidden Murphy bed - perfect for guests. The formal dining room is dinner-party ready with chic mural wallpaper by Susan Harter and designer lighting, and connects to a fabulous butler's pantry featuring a second sink, dishwasher, and abundant storage. The open kitchen and family room is truly the heart of the home - an entertainer's dream with an eat-in area and sliders that lead to a spacious deck for seamless indoor-outdoor living. Upstairs, four well-appointed bedrooms provide comfortable retreats. The primary suite is a standout, offering a serene escape with a marble bathroom and exceptional storage, including a dreamy walk-in closet and an entire wall of custom built-in closets and dresser space. Located in the sought-after Royle School district, this turnkey home is a rare opportunity to enjoy refined living in one of Darien's most convenient and desirable neighborhoods.

Set at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac on sought-after Stephanie Lane, this beautifully updated four-bedroom colonial sits on over an acre of professionally landscaped property and offers the kind of space, flow, and setting that are hard to find. With over 3,300 square feet of living space, the open-concept layout is light-filled and well-suited for both everyday living and entertaining. The updated kitchen connects to the family room, dining room, and living room - each space distinct yet flowing seamlessly into the next. The family room, complete with a dry bar, and the living room, anchored by a wood-burning fireplace, both open directly to the patio, making indoor-outdoor living effortless. A screened-in porch extends the space further, offering three seasons of enjoyment. Rounding out the main level are a dedicated office or den and a well-proportioned mudroom. Upstairs, the Primary Suite offers a walk-in closet and spa-like bathroom with radiant heated floors. Three additional spacious bedrooms are arranged across the second floor, one en-suite and two bedrooms sharing a large hall bath. Located in the Ox Ridge school district, this is a home that checks a lot of boxes without sacrificing character. Classic New England architecture, generous indoor and outdoor space, and a private cul-de-sac setting make this a rare opportunity. 2-car garage and walk-up attic.

Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac in the sought after Ox-Ridge school district, this beautifully updated 4 Bedroom, 2.5 Bath Colonial offers an exceptional blend of timeless elegance and modern sophistication. Thoughtfully designed for both refined living and effortless entertaining, the home features a stunning renovated kitchen and spa inspired baths, all finished with quality craftsmanship and attention to detail. The large deck is perfectly designed for effortless seasonal entertaining, offering an ideal setting for everything from summer gatherings to cozy fall evenings outdoors.  Sunlight pours through expansive windows, illuminating the home's spacious, well-proportioned interiors and creating a warm, inviting ambiance throughout. The finished walk-out lower level adds a versatile extension of flexible living space-perfect as a playroom, media lounge, or home gym.  Ideally located just moments from town, shops, and everyday conveniences, this home combines the serenity of a private setting with the ease of in-town living. Complete with a two-car garage, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy comfort, style, and convenience in one exceptional offering.

18 Phillips Lane offers a rare combination of neighborhood energy and privacy, set on one of Darien's most sought-after cul-de-sacs. Phillips Lane is known for it's close-knit community; enjoy spontaneous yard-to-yard socializing, biking on the cul de sac with friends, trick-or-treating, and walks to school. Inside, natural light pours through more than 4,200 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space (plus additional 356 sqft. lower-level space). The heart of the home is a stunning great room with vaulted ceilings, a gas fireplace, and a fully outfitted wet bar, all seamlessly connected to the outdoor living area. The kitchen is magazine-worthy, featuring quartz countertops, white oak cabinetry details, and high-end appliances. A bright sunroom and built-in banquette create the perfect everyday dining space, complemented by a formal dining area and living room with a wood-burning fireplace. Upstairs, the oversized primary suite offers a luxurious en suite bath with a double shower and a spacious walk-in closet. Three additional bedrooms and two beautifully updated full baths complete the second floor. Outside, enjoy a large +1330 sqft. deck, app-controlled hot tub, outdoor kitchen, and gas fire pit. Natural stone steps lead to a flat, private yard-perfect for both entertaining and quiet moments. 18 Phillips Lane is an incredible opportunity, book your showing today.

Beautifully sited expanded cape on open level 1.5 acres renovated by Fox Hill Builders. This open-concept home features 4 bedrooms, 4 and 1/2 baths, and sun-filled, spacious rooms built for easy living and entertaining. The kitchen offers stainless steel appliances, custom cabinetry, a large center island, and granite countertops. The family room, open to the kitchen with New England colonial fireplace, opens to a bluestone patio overlooking the professionally landscaped lawn with mature plantings. Large living and dining rooms, both with wood-burning fireplaces, offer ample space for entertaining. A separate den could be used as a home office. The walk-out lower level has 2 large, finished areas and a full bath. This home has a very flexible floor plan with plenty of room for expansion or to live comfortably as is. A full-house generator completes the package of this meticulously maintained home. A popular central location close to schools, train, and downtown Darien. Lower level is included in the square footage.

Classic center hall Colonial with thoughtful updates and wonderful natural light throughout. Renovated kitchen with Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances features a cheerful breakfast nook overlooking the yard. A spacious living room with wood-burning fireplace, bright family room, and formal dining room complete the first floor. Well-proportioned bedrooms provide comfortable living, while the walk-up attic presents exceptional opportunity for future expansion. Renovated lower level includes a playroom, laundry room, and flexible office or guest bedroom space. Additional highlights include natural gas heat and hot water, on-demand generator, and a two-car garage with EV charger. Large fenced yard and expansive patio create a wonderful space for entertaining, relaxing, and play. Ideally located within easy walking distance to Metro-North Railroad and the shops and restaurants at Darien Commons. A rare opportunity to enjoy comfort, style, and convenience in one exceptional Darien home.

A haven for those seeking refined living, this Annual Rental provides an unparalleled lifestyle in a coveted locale. The proximity to amenities and serene natural beauty ensures a perfect balance of comfort and convenience. Discover a world where elegance meets everyday living at this extraordinary address. Your dream home awaits, offering a unique opportunity to embrace gracious living in a truly remarkable setting. This elegant residence spans an expansive 5,466 square feet, offering a harmonious blend of luxury and tranquility. Designed for both relaxation and sophisticated entertaining, this home boasts five generously proportioned bedrooms and five elegantly appointed bathrooms. The property sits on an impressive 2.25 acre lot, where manicured grounds lead to a serene pond, inviting you to enjoy moments of quiet reflection amidst nature's splendor. An in-ground pool provides an idyllic setting for summer gatherings or peaceful solitude, perfectly complementing the lush surroundings.The home backs up to a prestigious golf course, offering sweeping views and a sense of boundless space. Architectural elegance is evident throughout, with spacious living areas that invite natural light and offer a seamless connection to the picturesque outdoor landscapes. Don't miss the opportunity to make this, Home. (option to have unfurnished)

listings.remarks: Nestled on a sought-after cul-de-sac in the coveted Hindley School district, this beautifully updated 5-bedroom, 4 full bath Colonial offers the perfect blend of coastal charm and modern luxury. With direct water access to Holly Pond, enjoy a true waterfront lifestyle complete with a private neighborhood dock - ideal for paddle boarding, kayaking, or simply soaking in the serene surroundings. Inside, the home exudes an effortless beach vibe with sun-filled spaces, tasteful updates, and a relaxed yet sophisticated feel throughout. The stunning updated primary suite bath creates a spa-like retreat, while spacious living and entertaining areas provide flexibility for today's lifestyle. Three private balconies showcase amazing water views, creating the perfect backdrop for morning coffee, sunset cocktails, or peaceful evenings overlooking the pond. Whether hosting summer gatherings by the water or enjoying quiet moments surrounded by nature, this exceptional home offers year-round vacation living in one of Darien's most desirable neighborhoods.

Step into timeless charm at 21 Fairfield Ave, Darien, where classic farmhouse colonial design meets modern luxury. This fully renovated 4-bedroom home features a stunning white high-end kitchen and baths, complemented by an open-flow layout and oversized triple pane windows that bathe the spaces in natural light. Downstairs, a finished basement offers incredible versatility with an additional bedroom, heated floor full bath, and an expansive playroom-perfect for guests or family needs. Practicality shines with abundant storage and a spacious laundry room. Outside, the large, level fenced yard is a private retreat, complete with a serene pebble seating area under a majestic Japanese maple, a huge garden space, a storage shed, and a modern deck ideal for entertaining or relaxing. Located on a sought-after neighborhood street, this home is as mindful as it is beautiful, boasting eco-friendly, green-rated upgrades. Its prime location puts you just steps from the train, restaurants, and local shops, blending convenience with lifestyle. 21 Fairfield Ave offers the perfect balance of style, function, and location-a home designed to enhance your everyday living.

Welcome to 182 Hollow Tree Ridge Road, a delightful, sunlit home meticulously maintained and thoughtfully updated. Nestled on a .33-acre lot, the property is adorned with mature trees and lush landscaping, featuring a spacious backyard perfect for recreation and gardening. The bright and inviting living room, complete with a fireplace, seamlessly connects to a charming dining area that overlooks the patio and backyard, ideal for entertaining. The dining space naturally transitions into the turn-key, eat-in kitchen. A generously sized office provides versatile functionality. The serene primary suite boasts his-and-her walk-in closets, while three additional bedrooms on the same level offer comfortable spaces for family guests or remote work. The attached garage and finished lower level add extra flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Located in the heart of it all, this home is just a short stroll to Noroton Heights vibrant restaurants, shops, train station, and top-rated schools.

Tucked away at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac known as Tokeneke Ridge, this impeccably maintained 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers privacy, space, and easy everyday living. The inviting floor plan features formal living and dining rooms, an eat-in kitchen, and a flexible bonus space just off the kitchen - ideal as a playroom, home office, media room, or teen hangout. The family room opens to a deck overlooking a large, flat backyard, perfect for play, entertaining, or simply enjoying the outdoors. Upstairs, the primary suite is joined by three additional bedrooms, creating a comfortable and practical layout. Set back from the road yet walkable to town and train, 115 Tokeneke Road blends classic charm, generous outdoor space, and a warm, welcoming feel in a truly special setting.

Walking distance to everything Darien has to offer! Conveniently located to downtown, the new Corbin District with shops, restaurants, train station and I95. Charming 2 bedroom/1 full bath half duplex with new flooring, ample off-street parking, new appliances, washer/dryer, energy efficient windows and freshly painted inside and out. Ready to move in with tons of natural light. Storage available in the basement. Tenant responsible for credit check, 2 months security (1 month if 62 or older) and 1st month rent, all utilities including electricity, heat (oil), hot water, internet/cable, trash collection and personal and liability insurance. No smoking. One cat would be considered. Incredible value in a must see location!

Along the storied Five Mile River, in Darien, Connecticut, a beautifully remodeled 1810 colonial cottage offers the perfect waterside retreat that rests the mind and soothes the soul. Recently updated with exacting attention to detail and craftsmanship, this home offers a unique mix of warmth and quiet sophistication. Walls of windows flood every inch of this carefully curated sanctuary with the most amazing light as well as offering the peaceful views of the water across the way.  The first floor flows seamlessly from room to room, yet can offer many places for gathering, unwinding, and relaxing.The eat-in kitchen, with a cozy breakfast nook and bay window, allows for the enjoyment of the beautifully transformed gardens. French doors throughout dissolve the boundary between interior and exterior, opening onto a flagstone patio and a newly re-imagined landscape. On the first floor, an office with an ensuite bathroom offers flexibility as a fourth bedroom, a guest suite, or a private work-from-home space. Upstairs the 3 bedrooms are oriented towards the serene and ever-changing Five Mile River, its boats, its shifting light, its wildlife, its seasons. Waking up here is its own daily pleasure. The exterior of the house has been totally re-worked and updated with new shingles, trim, railings, and custom light fixtures. A two-car garage completes the offering. Elevated on the property, the home carries no flood insurance requirement.

Exquisitely renovated center hall colonial set on two perfectly manicured acres at end of quiet, private cul-de-sac, offering exceptional space & timeless appeal for both everyday living & entertaining. Renovated in 2023 by ERI Building & Design, this stunning six-bedroom home with private office, four full & two half baths showcases impeccable craftsmanship & sophisticated design throughout. Dramatic open-concept kitchen features two oversized islands, walk-in pantry, Sub-Zero refrigerator & freezer, & an inviting breakfast area flowing seamlessly into soaring great room overlooking expansive rear lawn & tennis court with room for pool - perfect setting for gathering with family & friends. Light-filled sunroom provides ideal spot for relaxing with morning coffee while enjoying peaceful views of property. Designed for elegant entertaining, the home features gracious formal living room with fireplace, stunning bar & lounge area, wine pantry, & formal dining room with butler's pantry. Luxurious first-floor suite provides exceptional comfort & privacy for visitors. Upstairs luxurious primary suite with fireplace & spa-like ambiance, creates peaceful retreat. Four additional generously sized bedrooms feature beautifully appointed jack-jill baths. Private office just across hall creates ultimate work-from-home setting. Thoughtfully designed lower level provides flexible, ample space for gym or playroom. This truly exceptional home offering elegance & an unparalleled lifestyle.

Expertly styled, 11 McLaren Rd S offers an exceptional blend of modern luxury, architectural elegance, and prime in-town living in one of Darien's most sought-after neighborhoods. Flooded with natural light, the bright and sunny open floor plan creates a warm, welcoming flow perfect for both daily life and sophisticated entertaining. The heart of the home is the top-of-the-line kitchen, featuring premium appliances, beautiful cabinetry, expansive counter space, and a large island. It opens seamlessly to the spacious living room with custom built-ins and a cozy fireplace-ideal for relaxing gatherings. Just off the kitchen sits a sophisticated den boasting dramatic cathedral ceilings and a second fireplace, adding height, warmth, and architectural character to the space. The formal dining room, conveniently located off the kitchen, includes sliders that open onto a beautiful bluestone patio overlooking a private, professionally landscaped backyard. This serene outdoor oasis is perfect for al fresco dining, entertaining, or quiet relaxation in complete privacy. Upstairs, the second level is thoughtfully divided for maximum flexibility and comfort. One wing offers a convenient sitting area, two generously sized bedrooms, and a full bathroom-ideal for guests, children, or a quiet retreat. The primary bedroom suite provides a luxurious private sanctuary, complemented by two additional bedrooms, bringing the total to five bedrooms.

This stunning custom-built home, completed in 2005, showcases exceptional craftsmanship and timeless design throughout. Rich millwork, refined architectural details, and high-end finishes create an elegant yet inviting atmosphere across every level.  Ideally situated in a quiet, sought-after location, the home offers the perfect balance of privacy and convenience, just moments from town, restaurants, and local shops.  The second floor features five spacious en-suite bedrooms, offering both comfort and privacy for family and guests alike. A versatile third-level bonus space provides endless possibilities-ideal for a media room, additional lounge, or creative retreat-alongside a dedicated home office and private gym to suit today's lifestyle needs.  The fully finished walk-out lower level is designed for both relaxation and recreation, featuring a generous playroom that seamlessly connects to the backyard. This level is complete with a full bath and a thoughtfully designed craft room, perfect for hobbies or additional flexible use.  A rare opportunity to own a beautifully appointed home with exceptional space, functionality, and an unbeatable location.

Immaculate + Sun-filled in the heart of vibrant & desirable Noroton, this enchanting home offers walking distance to the metro north train as well as popular neighborhood restaurants + shops, grocery and more! Flexible & updated, you'll find 3-4 bedrooms (including a 1st floor bedroom option), 2-full baths, open kitchen/dining/family room, formal living room with fireplace, 2-car garage, central air, large & level fenced back lawn with patio and front porch for outdoor relaxation and enjoyment. This property is pet friendly. Available in July, come see, PET CAUTION. VIEWING BY APPT. ONLY.

Privately set within Darien's Tokeneke School District , 45 Old Farm is a remarkable custom estate by award-winning builder Oliver Wilson. A tree-lined drive framed by natural stone pillars sets the tone for this exceptional property. Inside, every room is thoughtfully composed with striking sight lines and abundant natural light. The chef's kitchen is a true centerpiece, anchored by a dramatic 17-foot honed Calacatta Picasso marble waterfall island, and flows seamlessly into the family room with floor-to-ceiling custom windows and a striking travertine fireplace. The resort-style exterior features a custom 45-foot pool and spa, outdoor kitchen, and fireplace designed for effortless indoor-outdoor living. The upper levels offer five spacious bedrooms, including a serene primary suite with a bespoke dressing room and spa-like bath. A separate private wing offers ideal flexibility as an office or sixth bedroom, complete with a wet bar, full bath, and private terrace. The lower level impresses with soaring 11-foot ceilings, expansive recreation space, wine room, private gym, sauna, full bath, and space for a golf simulator. Defined by timeless design, impeccable craftsmanship, and extraordinary attention to detail, 45 Old Farm Road is THE listing of 2026.

Welcome to 333 West Avenue, a stunning residence nestled within the Noroton Green Association-a boutique enclave of just six homes. Built in 2012 by the renowned Hertz Construction, this home is a harmonious blend of timeless craftsmanship and modern luxury. From the moment you step inside, you'll be captivated by the soaring ceilings, intricate millwork, and custom built-ins that frame the inviting living spaces. A cozy fireplace anchors the main living area, while the chef's kitchen steals the show with its high-end white cabinets, Thermador appliances, gleaming finishes, and thoughtful design. The home boasts four generously sized bedrooms, including a show stopping primary suite with a spa-like marble bath, a freestanding soaking tub, and an enviable walk-in closet. Three additional bedrooms, 3.5 baths, including a third-floor retreat with an extra bedroom and living space provide ample room for family and guests, office space or additional living space. Enjoy the ease of maintenance-free living with HOA-covered perks, leaving you more time to enjoy life. A spacious two-car garage adds convenience, and the location is second to none-stroll along sidewalks to the train station, Darien Commons, and Heights Crossing. This is more than a home; it's a lifestyle.

listings.remarks: Escape to your own private waterfront sanctuary at this hidden gem on Holly Pond, where relaxing on a back porch with a gentle breeze as the sun sinks into the water is your daily reality. Seamlessly designed for effortless entertaining and coastal living, the main level features a formal dining room and a fully renovated chef's kitchen (2021). The spacious living room, anchored by a cozy fireplace, and a light-filled three-season sunroom offer breathtaking water views, spilling out onto the updated porches (2023)-the perfect vantage point to look out over the beautiful yard and gardens leading to the water. Upstairs, you will find three bedrooms and a dedicated home office, highlighted by a primary bedroom that serves as a private oasis with an expansive second-floor porch and unforgettable, panoramic vistas. Outdoor living is truly unmatched here, boasting 65 feet of direct, prime waterfrontage on Holly Pond complete with a private dock (2021) and a brand-new roof (2026), making this home as turn-key as it is beautiful. Whether you are taking a boat cruise, launching a kayak, or enjoying an evening by the water, this property offers a seamless lifestyle. As part of the coveted Noroton Manor association, you'll enjoy exclusive amenities including tennis courts and private beach access, all paired with unbeatable proximity to downtown Darien, local beaches, the YMCA, Metro-North, and top-rated schools. Welcome home to the ultimate coastal lifestyle!

listings.remarks: Waterviews!! Welcome to 8 Seagate Road, a rare opportunity to live in one of Darien's most sought after waterfront communities! Enjoy views of Holly Pond from this custom-built home, offering a terrific layout. The large living room offers built-in cabinetry, a cozy fireplace & leads to the formal dining room, both with beautiful water views! The bright kitchen is nicely sized, with quartz counters, stainless steel appliances & breakfast bar. Adjacent to the kitchen is the family room with vaulted/beamed ceiling & wood burning stove. A den, or home office, as well as a full bathroom completes the1st floor. Upstairs is a fantastic primary bedroom with amazing views of Holly Pond and beyond! There is full bathroom with a tub and separate shower, as well as a walk-in closet. Three additional bedrooms & another full bath complete this floor. A full basement too! Outside at 8 Seagate is a terrific place to be! Enjoy the hot tub on the back patio, or the elevated patio is also a great place for outdoor entertaining, with beautiful views and a bonus storage area below. Finally, The Seagate Association offers its residents a private cove with dock to access Holly Pond. Nearby are the Darien YMCA, Weed Beach, restaurants and shopping. New HVAC August 2025 and new hot water heater April 2026. A wonderful place for your next home! The patio is over an original storage garage that was built in 1949. The home you see today was built in 1987.

Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac setting just off a private road, 201 Middlesex Road offers a rare combination of turnkey luxury, convenience, and timeless family living in one of Darien's most sought-after neighborhoods. Extensively renovated and beautifully maintained, this 4-bedroom home is ideally located close to town, Metro North, shopping, parks, and Darien's award-winning schools, including highly coveted Ox Ridge Elementary. Designed for both modern living and effortless entertaining, the home features sun-filled interiors, an open layout, and gracious entertaining spaces. The chef's kitchen serves as the heart of the home with a stunning Carrera marble waterfall island, custom cabinetry, Viking appliances, granite countertops, and French doors opening to the private backyard. The inviting family room features a wood-burning stone fireplace, custom wine bar, and oversized gathering space overlooking serene pond and fountain views. A built-in sound system and alarm system provide additional comfort and convenience. The property offers exceptional year-round enjoyment, from backyard games, tree swings, and firefly-filled summer evenings to winter ice skating during colder months, all within the warmth of a quiet, close-knit neighborhood setting. Just minutes from Darien Commons, Noroton Heights Metro North, Highland Farm, and local favorites including Palmer's Market and Raphael's Bakery, the home combines everyday convenience with a true neighborhood feel.

listings.remarks: Newly rebuilt to perfection in 2019 this 4 bed, 3.1 bath Colonial offers the ideal blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience. Just 2 blocks to Noroton Heights train station, Darien Commons, and Heights Crossing, the home provides easy access to shopping, dining, schools, and commuting. Perfect for both everyday living and entertaining, the open floor plan boasts 9+ft ceilings and gleaming hardwood floors throughout. A spectacular chef's kitchen is the heart of the home w/Carrara White quartz countertops, center island w/seating, Viking gas range & beverage drawers. The kitchen flows seamlessly into the family room w/gas fireplace and breakfast area w/wet bar and wine fridge. Sliders open to a private fenced backyard featuring bluestone patio and professional landscaping, creating exceptional indoor-outdoor living. A formal dining room, mudroom w/powder room and attached garage complete the 1st floor. 2nd floor primary suite has a fabulous luxury spa bath w/ soaking tub, stall shower, double sinks & walk-in closet. 2 additional bedrooms w/shared bath and convenient hallway laundry. A finished 3rd floor offers a 4th bedroom, full bath, and expansive media/playroom ideal for guests or an au pair, home office, or kids' retreat. Full basement with ample storage space and access to backyard. Set in a wonderful neighborhood with the ability to walk or ride bikes to Holmes Elementary, Middlesex Middle, and Darien High, this turnkey home offers the very best of Darien living.

**Best and final offers provided to seller agent by Wed (6/3/26) at 5pm. Seller will have a decision by Noon on Thursday.**  Move right into this beautifully updated Darien home offering an exceptional blend of modern luxury, open-concept living, and commuter convenience. Designed for both effortless entertaining and comfortable everyday living, the sun-filled interior features soaring ceilings, hardwood floors, and a stunning chef's kitchen with quartz countertops, smart appliances, and seamless flow into the family room and oversized deck.  Step outside to a private, fenced backyard backing directly to Woodway Country Club-creating a serene, scenic setting just minutes from downtown Darien and New Canaan, Talmadge Hill train station, and the Merritt Parkway.  A versatile first-floor bedroom suite with full bath and its own private deck is ideal for guests, in-laws, or an au pair suite. Upstairs, the expansive primary suite offers dual walk-in closets and a spacious bath, along with four additional bedrooms (total of 5 bedrooms), a full bath, and a convenient second-floor laundry room. An oversized attached garage and large basement playroom make this a must see!  Thoughtfully maintained with significant capital improvements, including updated mechanicals and a newer roof, this turnkey home presents a rare opportunity in a prime Darien location.

A true GEM!! Don't miss this truly beautiful 5 bedroom/3.1 bath home on a flat, dry half acre of lush landscape on one of Darien's premiere streets! This special home seamlessly blends generous proportions with a long list of new renovations including: roof, hvac/natural gas, and primary bath to name just a few.Step inside to over 3600sf of living space perfect for modern living and large-scale entertaining. The first floor offers an oversized eat-in kitchen with banquette and 4 additional oversized rooms for living and dining that accomodate everyone's needs and offers great flow to the gorgeous outdoor areas. The sprawling primary suite serves as a private sanctuary, complete with 2 walk-in closets and a newly transformed, spa-like bathroom. Generously sized secondary bedrooms offer ultimate flexibility for family, guests, or a dedicated home office. Outside, the property features a beautifully manicured flat yard (.51 acres), 2 tier composite deck with built-in grill to truly enjoy and experience seamless outdoor dining and entertaining. Unmatched for convenience, this premier address places you just minutes from top-rated schools, shopping, dining, train, and Woodland Park. Move right in and enjoy!

listings.remarks: Darien's Luxury Designer-Furnished Turnkey Rental - Available August 15, 2026. 19 Weeds Landing is Darien's fully furnished, flexible-term, luxury rental. Perfect for those renovating, relocating, testing out life in Darien. Located at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac on Holly Pond with sweeping views of Long Island Sound, this home offers privacy, convenience, and a true waterfront lifestyle. Heated pool, spa, dock, and quick access to Weed Beach, train, shops, and restaurants. Simply arrive and enjoy Darien's best address - turnkey living at its finest.

3 br, 2 bth -Understated elegance, modern conveniences and a peaceful, wooded location come together to create a community that feels like a tranquil retreat in the heart of Darien, Connecticut. Our heated pool, sleek fitness center, lounge and co-working areas are designed for connection and wellness. Classic finishes, like shaker-style cabinets, chrome hardware and tiled back splashes give our homes a timeless and versatile feel, while modern conveniences, such as Energy Star appliances, gas ranges and ample storage in kitchens and baths are designed for easy living. Minutes away to shops, restaurants, the MTA station, and I-95.

Fully renovated and expanded, this stunning 5-bedroom, 4.1-bath residence offers approx. 4,000 SF of light-filled living on a private 1-acre setting along a quiet road near the golf course. The open floor plan showcases large windows, abundant natural light, and effortless flow throughout. A luxurious kitchen with high-end appliances opens directly to an expansive stone patio, ideal for seamless indoor-outdoor entertaining. The main level features a primary bedroom plus three additional bedrooms and two baths. Upstairs, a private primary suite retreat offers an office/sitting room, two walk-in closets, and a spa-like bath.

You won't want to miss this charming New England Cape Cod, sited on a level 1 acre, in one of Darien's most sought-after neighborhoods. The eat in kitchen with sky lights and sliders to the deck, is the center of this home. It offers an easy flow to the living room, dining room and family room. The large deck and blue stone patio, overlooking the private backyard creates the perfect area for sports and entertaining.

Sun-drenched and full of character, this beautifully updated English Colonial is set on a quiet, picture-perfect street in one of Noroton Heights' most desirable neighborhoods, a quick walk to the elementary school, a mile to middle school, steps to Woodland Park, and moments to shops, restaurants, and the NYC train. Blending timeless 1920s charm with thoughtful modern upgrades, the home welcomes you with an inviting foyer that opens to a gracious open plan living room with fireplace and dining room, perfect for entertaining, plus a private study that also makes a great playroom. The updated chef's kitchen includes a Wolf range and quartz countertops, and flows to an expansive entertaining patio and fully fenced backyard, complete with an irrigation system. Upstairs are three spacious bedrooms and an additional office. The finished daylight/walkout lower level offers a versatile playroom, along with a recently upgraded mudroom and laundry. New central air conditioning added in 2025. New washer and dryer in 2023. Improvements in recent years also include 2 fully renovated bathrooms, refinished hardwood floors, fresh interior paint, updated lighting, Nest thermostat, and an electric pet fence. Current owners have also added extensive plantings to the landscaping in the home's pretty and private property. City water/sewer/gas. Ask about garage and primary bath plans. Enjoy an easy and engaging lifestyle full of charm, style and easy access to all Noroton Heights has to offer!

Classic charm meets modern living in this updated colonial, set on over an acre with a stunning wood roof, stone walls, and a circular driveway. Entirely new second floor added. Now you have 4+ bedrooms, 4 full baths, and flexible living spaces on both floors. The main level features a spacious living room, den/office, guest suite/office, large playroom, eat-in kitchen, family room with the kitchen, bar room, and formal dining room. Upstairs, the primary suite offers vaulted ceilings, dual walk-in closets, and a marble double shower. You'll find a bedroom/nursery off of the primary suite plus an easy way to make a third bedroom. There is ample yard space to add a pool or party barn. Just minutes from local golf and tennis clubs and easy access to the Allwood neighborhood. Curb appeal, privacy, and possibility - this is the one.

10 Cross Road is custom built and thoughtfully designed by Louise Brooks & Artisan Builders. No expense has been spared...extensive millwork and moldings, soaring 10-foot and cathedral ceilings! In the heart of the private Tokeneke Assoc. on a hilltop with southern exposure, multiple French doors create a seamless indoor-outdoor lifestyle. Enjoy a custom pool, spa, & waterfall beautifully integrated into lush gardens and refined hardscaping. Meticulously maintained, this private backyard offers a true oasis - you won't want to leave! A chef's kitchen appointed with Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, a dble. island and a cozy dining area with expansive windows and fireplace is open to a grand family room. Formal living and dining room with entertaining butlers parlor and mature office complete the main floor. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite offers a sitting area, walk-in closets and serene bathroom. 3 ensuite bedrooms provide luxurious accommodations. The 3rd floor offers a large playroom space with 2 adjacent bedrooms sharing a jack-and-jill bathroom. Additional amenities include a 3-car heated garage, theater, gym, sauna and partial heated driveway. Many recent improvements - including a new cedar roof, newly paved driveway, full exterior painting, new front stone wall, and pool enhancements - further elevate the home's turnkey appeal. Come experience the beauty, history, and prestige of Tokeneke at its finest, a private coastal community just a short distance from town.

Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac in the Hindley School district, 3 Salt Box Lane East offers the perfect blend of timeless charm and modern comfort. This beautifully maintained home features sun-drenched living spaces thoughtfully designed for both everyday living and effortless entertaining. At the heart of the home, a spacious gourmet kitchen flows seamlessly into a vaulted family room with a cozy fireplace, creating an inviting space to gather.  Upstairs, four generously sized bedrooms provide comfort and flexibility, including a serene primary suite with an updated bath. The finished lower level offers additional living space ideal for a playroom, home office, or gym. Step outside to a private backyard retreat complete with a stone patio, outdoor fireplace & hot tub - perfect for relaxing or entertaining year-round. Conveniently located close to town, train, schools, and beaches, this is a home you won't want to miss!

19 Circle Road is located near the end of a quiet, private street, backing-up on three sides into the serene and tranquil Selleck's Woods Nature Preserve. An updated five-bedroom home offers a thoughtful floorplan, privacy, and convenience just minutes to downtown Darien. The large eat-in-kitchen by DEANE is the heart of the home, opening to a bright sunroom with peaceful wooded views. The flexible layout includes a first floor bedroom with full bath, ideal for guests or a home office. A gracious living and dining room with wet bar creates an easy flow for everyday living and entertaining. Upstairs features a spacious primary suite plus three additional bedrooms with balcony overlooking the backyard. A generous laundry room finishes the second floor. The oversized family room above the garage is filled with natural light and conveniently located off of the eat-in kitchen. With three full baths, one half bath, a full basement for storage, and a walk-up third floor with expansion potential, this home offers both comfort and future opportunity. Enjoy the rare combination of privacy backing to nature while being moments from everything Darien has to offer.

listings.remarks: LOCATION, LOCATION, LOCATION! Beautiful English Tudor-style home in the Noroton Manor Association with access to a private beach and tennis. An updated gourmet kitchen opens seamlessly into the family room, creating an easy, comfortable flow for everyday living and entertaining. Five bedrooms are located on the upper level, including a spacious primary suite with a fireplace, Juliette balcony, and radiant-heated bathroom floors. The walk-out lower level offers an additional bedroom and kitchen-perfect for guests or an au pair. The backyard is a standout, featuring a bluestone terrace, firepit, and outdoor TV.

Set on a quiet cul-de-sac within Darien's prestigious Tokeneke Private Association, this beautifully updated 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath Colonial offers refined living in one of the town's most coveted coastal neighborhoods. Thoughtfully renovated with sophisticated transitional design, the home blends timeless elegance with a fresh, modern aesthetic. Situated on 1.4 private acres, the property offers exceptional natural light, expansive living spaces, and effortless flow. The dramatic family room features vaulted ceilings and generous scale, ideal for everyday living and entertaining. Working fireplaces in the living room and private office create warm, inviting spaces, while the sunroom opens to the serene outdoor setting and swimming pool nestled in the landscape. The beautifully updated eat-in kitchen serves as the heart of the home, featuring brand new quartz countertops, a striking slab backsplash, and refined finishes - perfect for both intimate gatherings and larger entertaining. Recent improvements include new light fixtures, a refreshed primary bath, and freshly painted interiors, creating a move-in ready experience. Surrounded by Tokeneke's natural beauty, this exceptional offering is moments from Scott's Cove, Tokeneke School, the train, and downtown Darien's Corbin District. A rare opportunity to enjoy privacy, elegance, and the unparalleled Tokeneke lifestyle.

This beautifully designed residence seamlessly blends timeless charm with modern sophistication, showcasing sun-drenched interiors, inviting fireplaces, and refined architectural details throughout. A secluded stone patio overlooks the sparkling in-ground gunite pool and pool house, all set within a serene, park-like landscape - an idyllic backdrop for both intimate gatherings and grand entertaining. The home's exceptional flow connects the formal living and dining rooms to the newly renovated kitchen, featuring brand new stainless steel appliances, striking quartz countertops, and a sunlit breakfast area. Designed for effortless living, the layout is both elegant and functional. A dramatic family room with soaring cathedral ceiling, wet bar, and impressive stone fireplace offers direct access to the extensive new deck and private yard - a perfect setting for celebrating life year round. The main level primary suite is privately situated in its own wing, complete with spa-inspired bath and dedicated office. A separate wing on the main floor features a remarkable 42 foot media/playroom with custom built-ins and two spacious ensuite bedrooms. Upstairs, two additional bedrooms share a bath and offer abundant storage. Meticulously maintained and thoughtfully updated, this exceptional property is ideally located just minutes from town, train, beaches, and approximately one hour to New York City.

Introducing an exceptional new-construction home set in a neighborhood, thoughtfully designed for today's lifestyle and sophisticated entertaining. This home offers five well-appointed bedrooms on a single level, four full baths, and two half baths. At the heart of the home is a sun-filled, open-concept kitchen featuring a generous center island, eat-in dining area, and expansive pantry, seamlessly flowing into the inviting family room. Formal living and dining rooms add elegance and versatility to the main level. The second floor is anchored by a serene primary suite with a spa-inspired bath and walk-in closet, complemented by a Jack-and-Jill bedrooms suite, two additional bedrooms, a shared hallway bath, and a full laundry room. The expansive third floor provides flexible space ideal for a home office or media room. The finished lower level offers a playroom, space for a fitness studio or bedroom, full bath, and ample storage. Ideally located near parks, schools, shopping, and commuter routes, this impeccably crafted home delivers refined living in a setting you've been waiting for.

Welcome to this beautifully renovated two-bedroom condo in one of Darien's most convenient locations. Just steps from Goodwives shopping center, the Metro-North train station, and the vibrant energy of downtown Darien, this home offers the perfect blend of modern comfort and walkable lifestyle. Pass through the private gate and be greeted by a serene personal courtyard and garden. A sliding glass door from the living area provides seamless access to this peaceful outdoor retreat-ideal for morning coffee, evening relaxation, or entertaining. The open-concept main level features a bright, updated kitchen that flows effortlessly into the dining and living areas. A cozy fireplace anchors the living room, creating a warm and inviting space for gatherings or quiet nights in. Upstairs, the primary suite impresses with dramatic vaulted ceilings and an enviable en-suite bathroom. Soak in the large soaking tub or enjoy the separate shower after a long day. A second en-suite bedroom and laundry is also located on this level. This turnkey condo is move-in ready with thoughtful updates throughout. Whether you're looking for an easy commute to New York City, a low-maintenance home base near shops and restaurants, or simply a stylish retreat in the heart of Darien, 4 Sedgwick Village Lane delivers

World class one of a kind newly constructed modern masterpiece designed by award winning architect Vita design with stunning unobstructed water views from every room in the house. This custom coastal build sets luxury to the highest level. The home features tall ceilings with an abundance of open space filled with natural light coming in through the floor to ceiling oversized European style windows. The home was thoughtfully designed to form an effortless flow between indoor and outdoor living. Intimately private, yet close to all the great amenities of Darien and Rowayton town center and a convenient drive or train ride to New York City. Set on a spacious 1 acre lot with a pool this home is the perfect setting for coastal living. The master suite has its own scenic balcony where you can wake up to your own amazing ocean views. The gourmet kitchen and exquisite bathrooms are all fitted with carefully designed, high end finishes. The home feature all bedrooms with ensuite baths, home office, dining room, mud room, and a basement with space for a recreation room and bar. This luxury modern property reflects the best Darien has to offer in an amazing seashore oasis.

Designed by custom home builder Vita Design, this exciting newly constructed modern residence is a refined architectural statement that balances scale and light, capturing direct 5 Mile River views and a connection to its natural surroundings. Finished across four levels, the home features dramatic 10- and 16-foot ceilings and a main level wrapped in floor-to-ceiling European-style windows filling the interior with natural light, creating seamless indoor-outdoor living. All living spaces are designed for flexibility and function. The kitchen showcases an oversized center island, Leicht mahogany cabinetry, Miele appliances, huge pantry and spacious dining area overlooking the river. The primary suite offers a private retreat with balcony, water views, lux bath and generous closets. All other bedrooms feature en-suite baths with high-end, individual finishes. Lower-level and third-floor bedrooms provide privacy and adaptable use. Outdoor living centers around the covered wrap around patio and heated pool with retractable cover, enhancing the home's resort-like feel. Additional amenities include home automation, mudroom, laundry room, and a fully finished lower level with large recreation / home gym space. An oversized three-car garage completes the home. Minutes to world class Darien, Rowayton, Long Island Sound, and easy access to New York City & New Haven by train or car. Coastal CT at its very best!

Nestled on a quiet neighborhood, this quintessential cape exudes charm and elegance. The house boasts a brand new kitchen, complete with state-of-the-art appliances, and new washer/dryer. Recently painted walls and beautifully finished hardwood floors add a touch of sophistication to the interior. A plush new carpet runner offers both comfort and style. With immediate availability, you can move in and start enjoying the space right away.  The first floor of this home features a spacious living room, dining room, cozy den/office and one full bath. Additionally, there is a delightful three-season sunroom, perfect for relaxation and soaking up the sunlight. Upstairs, you will discover three inviting bedrooms, ensuring ample space for everyone, along with the additional full bath.

Beautifully designed 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence featuring an open-concept floor plan in the heart of Noroton Heights. Thoughtfully laid out with foyer entry, spacious living and dining areas, and a dedicated full laundry room within the residence. The kitchen is appointed with GE Profile appliances, generous cabinetry, and an oversized island anchoring the main living space. Both bedrooms feature en suite baths and walk-in closets, blending refined finishes with everyday functionality.    Residents enjoy secure building access, elevator, garage parking, fitness and wellness center, coworking spaces, golf simulator, fireside resident lounge, landscaped courtyard, and curated ground-level retail. Walkable to shopping, dining, coffee shops, grocery stores, and train access.

listings.remarks: Heights Crossing, Darien's premier new development, offers refined luxury living with immediate access to NYC via the Noroton Heights train station just across the street. Located on the third floor, this 1-bedroom + den, 1-1/2-bath residence features a foyer entry, open-concept living and dining area, and a den located off the primary bedroom.  Interior finishes include GE Monogram appliances, custom cabinetry, quartz countertops with seated island, and wood-style luxury vinyl plank flooring throughout. The spacious primary suite features two generous walk-in closets and a stall shower. Additional highlights include a full laundry room and half bath.   Community amenities include secure building access, garage parking, elevator, on-site management, fitness center, golf simulator, co-working spaces, resident lounge, bicycle storage, and package/mailroom. An additional required monthly community contribution covers 1GB high-speed internet via Frontier, water, trash and recycling, snow removal, on-site staffing, and more. Pet restrictions and charges apply, please inquire. Photos represent are for illustrative purposes only. Actual residence may vary.

listings.remarks: Welcome to 333 West Avenue, a stunning residence nestled within the Noroton Green Association-a boutique enclave of just six homes. Built in 2012 by the renowned Hertz Construction, this home is a harmonious blend of timeless craftsmanship and modern luxury. From the moment you step inside, you'll be captivated by the soaring ceilings, intricate millwork, and custom built-ins that frame the inviting living spaces. A cozy fireplace anchors the main living area, while the chef's kitchen steals the show with its high-end white cabinets, Thermador appliances, gleaming finishes, and thoughtful design. The home boasts four generously sized bedrooms, including a show stopping primary suite with a spa-like marble bath, a freestanding soaking tub, and an enviable walk-in closet. Three additional bedrooms, 3.5 baths, including a third-floor retreat with an extra bedroom and living space provide ample room for family and guests, office space or additional living space. Enjoy the ease of maintenance-free living with HOA-covered perks, leaving you more time to enjoy life. A spacious two-car garage adds convenience, and the location is second to none-stroll along sidewalks to the train station, Darien Commons, and Heights Crossing. This is more than a home; it's a lifestyle.

listings.remarks: Quintessential Darien colonial in the Hindley School district! This 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath Colonial, perfectly sited on a coveted, sidewalk-lined street, designed for both quiet relaxation and entertaining. The main level features a formal living room with fireplace leading to a formal dining room with sliders to the almost-new private deck. The spacious family room impresses with vaulted ceilings and also direct access to the deck-the ultimate setup for summer BBQs and indoor-outdoor living. The spacious eat-in kitchen offers abundant cabinetry. Retreat upstairs to a primary suite plus three additional bedrooms, all featuring newly refinished hardwood floors. For even more space, the finished basement-complete with brand-new flooring-offers the perfect footprint for a playroom, home gym, or media center. Enjoy your morning coffee on the front porch or host gatherings in the beautifully landscaped, private backyard. Freshly painted throughout, with an attached two-car garage and a location that puts you minutes from Darien's best shopping, dining, and transit, this home truly has it all.

Rent a newer construction luxury apartment at conveniently located Pemberton16! Enjoy spacious one-floor living, 9' ceilings & open floor plans. Just steps from Darien's Tilley Pond Park, train station & downtown shops, dining & entertainment. Additional amenities: elevator, auto garage opener for gated garage w/assigned parking, washer/dryer in unit, hardwd flrs thru-out, sec. sys. Pets allowed (w/restrictions). For 62 and older.

Privately positioned within Darien's sought-after Noroton Greens community, this exceptional residence offers a sophisticated blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience. Thoughtfully designed for effortless living and entertaining, the home features expansive living spaces, timeless finishes, and an ideal layout for today's lifestyle. Oversized windows fill the home with natural light, while custom plantation shutters add warmth, elegance, and privacy throughout. The gracious floor plan provides seamless flow between the living and dining areas, creating an inviting atmosphere for both everyday living and special gatherings. The spacious kitchen offers abundant cabinetry, generous workspace, and easy access to the home's main living areas. A standout feature is the large private primary suite, offering a peaceful retreat complete with a spacious changing room/walk-in closet and a well-appointed en-suite bath. Generously sized secondary bedrooms and flexible living spaces provide room for guests, a home office, fitness area, or an additional lounge space. Outside, a private flagstone patio overlooks beautifully landscaped gardens, creating a serene setting for outdoor dining, entertaining, or relaxing among mature plantings and greenery. Enjoy a low-maintenance lifestyle in one of Darien's most desirable communities, just a short walk to Darien Commons and the Noroton Heights Train Station. Downtown Darien, beaches, parks, restaurants, and I-95 are all just a short drive away.

listings.remarks: Welcome to this classic Coastal Connecticut colonial, ideally situated in the coveted Tokeneke Association - offering space, comfort, and versatility for every member of the family.  With 5 bedrooms - including a convenient first-floor guest suite and four bedrooms on the second level - this home is designed for gracious everyday living. The main floor features a formal living room, elegant dining room, casual dining area, and a spacious office, all flowing effortlessly together. The chef's kitchen opens to both casual dining and a warm, fireplace-lit gathering room, the heart of the home. A large mudroom with garage and back-entrance access, plus a separate laundry room, adds everyday ease.  Retreat to the private primary suite, complete with an en-suite bath and two walk-in closets. The second floor also offers a second en-suite bedroom, two additional bedrooms sharing a beautifully renovated hall bath, a versatile sitting/work area, and abundant storage throughout.  The finished basement boasts a spectacular wine room, that holds 1600 bottles, and casual sitting area - perfect for relaxing or entertaining.  The attached garage holds two-cars plus, and a third bay is in the "barn" - a blank canvas ready to become a guest quarters, entertaining space, second-floor hangout, studio, or whatever you can imagination.  Outside, unwind on the beautiful stone patio, set against an expansive, green yard.  A rare opportunity in one of the most sought-after associations.

Nestled on a quiet, tree-lined lane in one of Darien's most desirable neighborhoods, this expanded cape offers the perfect blend of timeless charm, generous living space, & endless potential. A welcoming foyer leads to elegant formal living & dining rooms, where the inviting living room is anchored by a dramatic floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace, while the spectacular oversized family room impresses with soaring ceilings & walls of windows overlooking the private backyard. The kitchen features granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, & seamless access to an expansive deck designed for effortless indoor-outdoor entertaining. Step outside to a beautifully landscaped backyard framed by mature trees & exceptional privacy. The second level features a spacious primary bedroom with multiple walk-in closets & an adjoining oversized bonus room, offering the ideal space for a private home office, nursery, or the opportunity to create a luxurious primary suite. Two additional generously sized bedrooms & two full baths complete the upper level. The finished lower level provides flexibility with a spacious recreation room featuring a second stone fireplace, abundant storage, & unfinished space for future expansion. Perfectly positioned just moments from award-winning Darien schools, Woodland Park, Metro-North, dining, beaches, & major commuter routes, this exceptional home offers the ideal balance of privacy, convenience, & the quintessential Darien lifestyle.

Summer starts at 6 Ward Lane! Enjoy the pool, clubhouse, and carefree lifestyle at Villager Pond. This bright, airy and freshly painted townhouse is ideally situated less than a mile from Darien Train Station, downtown, shopping, dining, and beaches. Sun-filled living spaces feature an open floor plan connecting the living room and dining area, with a fireplace adding warmth and character. High ceilings and oversized windows enhance the sense of space. The private patio provides an intimate outdoor setting, perfect for morning coffee, afternoon cocktails, or quiet evenings. Kitchen and 1/2 bath complete the main level. Upstairs, the primary suite offers new carpeting, a walk-in closet, and a beautifully updated bath, with a washer and dryer conveniently located adjacent to the suite. An attached garage adds everyday ease, complemented by attic and crawl space storage for added storage. Pets Allowed / No Smoking

Tucked in the Delafield Island Association and moments from the beach, town, train, & schools, this custom built 5-bedroom residence offers an ideal blend of timeless elegance & modern comfort. Thoughtfully designed with soaring ceilings, an open floor plan & sun-filled interiors, nearly every main living space enjoys beautiful views of the pool & private backyard. A dramatic two-story foyer welcomes you into gracious dining room and parlor, creating a dramatic first impression. At the heart of the home is a spectacular eat in chef's kitchen featuring two expansive islands, abundant custom cabinetry, & seamless flow into the spacious family room & opens to a covered terrace with built-in heaters, creating the perfect setting for year-round indoor/outdoor entertaining. 2 home offices, breakfast nook, 2 powder rooms, & a large mudroom, complete the 1st fl. The luxurious primary suite is a true retreat, highlighted by a vaulted ceiling, lg walk-in closet & spa-inspired bath w radiant heated floors, soaking tub, double vanity, & oversized shower. An adjoining sitting room offers the perfect space for a private lounge, gym or nursery. 4 addl generously sized BRs & 3 full baths provide room for all, while the spacious 2nd fl landing is an inviting area for reading/relaxing. Finished huge basement w high ceilings has versatile space to add a golf simulator. 3rd fl is framed & plumbed, offering an outstanding opportunity to create a bedroom suite w bath tailored to your needs

This Dockside home is a short paddle away from Five Mile River. Quietly iconic. Effortlessly cool. Live large without living complicated. This is the rare waterfront home that offers the lifestyle of a grand estate with the ease of a true lock-and-leave retreat. Set on just over an acre in the private Tokeneke Association it's designed for living well not maintaining endlessly. There are four private bedrooms in the main house and several places to kick back. Escape whenever you choose a weekend, a week, or all the days in between. Paddle over to Rowayton for lunch, entertain under the stars by the fire, or spend an afternoon with a great book by the pool. A private guest cottage with multiple sleep configurations offers family and friends their own retreat while preserving yours. Waterfront homes that live this effortlessly are incredibly rare. A manageable home, beautiful grounds, a dock, freeform pool, an abundant vegetable garden and even a chicken coop, all within the security of Tokeneke including optional home check-ins while you're away. Make coming and going completely carefree, an easy house, an extraordinary life.

listings.remarks: Rare opportunity for an investor or user! Two (2) buildings consisting of front building with two (2) residential units and rear building consisting of offices over warehouse (three storage bays) with separate overhead door access and an additional storage shed to the rear. Great for contractors or any small business requiring warehouse/storage or vehicle storage with income from residential units. Rear office and warehouse are vacant available for use. Potential for conversion of rear office to residential. Gross potential income based on market rents of $108,000. Expenses total approximately $20,000, which includes $9,100 real estate taxes and insurance at $4,500.Projected Net Income is $88,000.

Discover the perfect blend of modern luxury and suburban convenience at 322 Noroton Ave. This beautifully renovated residence offers a bright, sparkling interior where every room feels generous and inviting. From the moment you step inside, the crisp aesthetic and thoughtful updates create an atmosphere of effortless sophistication.  The heart of the home is the stunningly renovated kitchen, featuring high-end finishes that flow seamlessly into the spacious living areas. On chilly evenings, the living room serves as a cozy retreat, centered around a classic fireplace. For those seeking versatility, the floor plan includes an optional fourth bedroom that can easily transition into a secondary lounge or home office to suit your lifestyle.  The primary suite is a true standout, boasting a gorgeous, spa-like bathroom and impressive closet space. Downstairs, the finished basement adds significant value, providing a large recreation room perfect for a home gym or playroom.  Step outside to find a large, fenced backyard-a private oasis complete with a deck designed for outdoor dining and relaxation. The property is situated in a prime Darien location with sidewalks that make it easy to explore the vibrant surrounding neighborhood, including nearby Darien High School and Middlesex Middle School.  This property offers flexibility; it is available for rent unfurnished at $11,000 or furnished at $12,500 per month. Experience the best of Darien living in a home that truly has it

DARIEN APARTMENT LOCATED IN A CLASSIC PRE-WAR TUDOR STYLE BUILDING WITHIN WALKING DISTANCE TO TRAIN HAS BEEN TOTALLY RENOVATED. THIS TWO BEDROOM APARTMENT HAS A LIVING ROOM, DINING ROOM WITH ADJOINING KITCHEN WITH GRANITE COUNTER TOPS, GAS STOVE, REFRIGERATOR, DISHWASHER, MICROWAVE AND GARBAGE DISPOSAL. PANTRY AND HARDWOOD FLOORS.. PRIVATE ENTRANCE. NO COMMON HALLWAYS. RENT INCLUDES HEAT & HOT WATER. PRIVATE STORAGE ROOM AND LAUNDRY ROOM ARE DIRECTLY ACCESSIBLE FROM THIS APARTMENT. TWO ASSIGNED TANDEM PARKING SPACES. ENJOY DARIEN PARKS AND SPECTACULAR BEACHES. NO PETS. NO SMOKING.

Discover the pinnacle of modern luxury in the heart of Darien. Exclusively designed for adults aged 62 and over, this custom condominium flawlessly pairs high-end craftsmanship with effortless living. Inside, soaring ceilings and massive windows flood the open-concept living, dining, and entertaining spaces with natural light. The gourmet chef's kitchen features premium appliances and custom cabinetry, while the main-level primary suite serves as a private oasis with its spa-inspired bath.  Flexibility is built right in, with extra rooms perfect for a dedicated home office or fitness space, plus an expansive, unfinished basement with 9-foot ceilings. Outside, a private bluestone patio with an outdoor fireplace offers a serene escape. Complete with an attached garage and located just steps from the vibrant new Corbin District, this property offers a premier New England lifestyle without the upkeep.

Charming and move-in ready, this sun-filled 4-bedroom, 2-bath home is ideally located in the heart of Darien. Filled with natural light, the inviting floor plan features an open living room and dining room, along with a separate office or den offering flexibility for today's lifestyle. The finished lower level provides valuable additional living space, perfect for a family room, home office, or gym. A detached two-car garage and an expansive private backyard offer endless possibilities for outdoor enjoyment, entertaining, or future expansion. Freshly painted with newly refinished floors, this turnkey home combines charm, versatility, and a desirable location. Situated on a beautiful property, 62 Camp Avenue provides an exceptional opportunity for easy living in a prime location close to everything Darien has to offer. Generator included.

Nestled in one of Darien's most coveted neighborhoods, this exceptional light-filled 5 bedroom 3.5 bath home with 2 car garage offers the perfect blend of comfort, storage, convenience and timeless appeal. Thoughtfully designed for todays lifestyle with open floor plan for everyday living and effortless entertaining. The chef's kitchen with high end appliances, wine refrigerator, white quartz countertops & oversized island extends seamlessly to the outdoor expanded bluestone patio surrounded by mature plantings, professionally curated perennial gardens and elegant outdoor lighting - perfect for entertaining. Additional main floor highlights include both a living room and family room with fireplaces, and a welcoming mudroom with custom built-in storage and shiplap detailing. The primary suite offers a generous walk-in closet and spa-like marble bath. The versatile third floor provides incredible flexibility with a fifth bedroom, full bath, and spacious additional family room-perfect for guests, home office, au pair or nanny suite. While the finished lower level playroom space provides an additional 504 square foot of living space ideal for recreation, media/playroom or fitness area. A rare opportunity to move right in and embrace the best of summer in Darien. Ideally situated just moments from the train for easy NYC commuting, top-rated schools and the vibrant Darien Commons, this beautifully appointed home offers the rare combination of turnkey living and a premier location.

This magnificent Round Meadows estate with a fantastic 9700 sf house on 5.346 acres of private property is now on the market for the first time in more than 54 years. Located in the private Tokeneke Association with protected land trust property to the East and West of it, Round Meadows is the ultimate in privacy and natural beauty. The owners had the vision to preserve, restore and ultimately combine the best of an elegant and storied past of the original grandeur of its early twentieth century origins with new and soaring modern spaces. They meticulously recreated the splendor of the arches, moldings, windows, light fixtures and even the original sweeping driveway while updating it for the state-of-the-art fine living of today. Round Meadows' totally renovated 19 room home has 7 bedrooms, 7 full baths, including a spectacular primary suite with spa, 3 half baths, library, office and guest suite. Enter through the 2 story foyer with soaring ceilings to the 3 large entertaining rooms, comprised of the living room, sunroom with bar, and an elegant formal dining room with fireplace. The inviting gourmet kitchen is seamlessly connected to a cozy family room with a fireplace which opens onto extensive terraces that overlook acres of manicured lawns and gardens. Add the 3 car garage off a grand mud hall with bath and laundry. Round Meadows honors the past as it pays forward an aspirational essence in the new construction feel, anchored by old world sophistication.

listings.remarks: Welcome to 85 Hecker Avenue, a stunning custom rebuild in the heart of Darien's coveted Noroton neighborhood, where modern luxury meets everyday convenience. Thoughtfully designed with 4 spacious bedrooms and 5 full bathrooms, this turnkey home features an open-concept floor plan centered around a beautifully appointed kitchen and inviting living spaces, along with a dedicated home office for today's flexible lifestyle. The finished walkout lower level offers exceptional bonus living space, perfect for entertaining, guests, a gym, or media room. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite serves as a private retreat, while the additional bedrooms provide generous space and comfort. Step outside to your own resort-like setting featuring a covered patio with a fireplace, a private fire pit, and a picturesque waterfall, creating the ultimate backdrop for year-round entertaining and relaxation. Just minutes from the Noroton Heights train station, I-95, Darien Commons, Heights Crossing, Equinox, Sweetgreen, Gregorys Coffee, and some of Fairfield County's best shopping and dining, this exceptional home is also served by the highly sought-after Tokeneke Elementary School. A rare opportunity to enjoy brand-new construction quality, incredible outdoor living, and one of Darien's most desirable locations.

This beautifully updated four-bedroom, four-and-a-half-bath home sits on the picturesque seven-acre Mather Pond-often compared to Thoreau's Walden Pond-offering a rare blend of tranquility and modern comfort.  Thoughtfully renovated by its designer owner, the residence features a versatile layout with custom built-ins, generous storage, and a brand-new gourmet kitchen. Light-filled living spaces balance elegance and warmth, creating an inviting setting for both everyday living and entertaining.  The property also offers room for future expansion, giving you the flexibility to tailor it to your needs. Outside, enjoy timeless pursuits like fly fishing, ice skating, gardening, or simply relaxing with a book by the water's edge.  Perfectly situated just 2.5 miles from downtown Darien and 3 miles from New Canaan, 63 Dorchester Road combines peaceful seclusion with convenient access to shops, dining, and community amenities.  This is a rare opportunity to own a home of modern sophistication in a truly idyllic setting.

Nestled on more than two private acres, 6 Cloudy Lane presents an exceptional opportunity to own a classic estate property in one of Darien's most coveted neighborhoods. A thoughtful renovation by renowned designer Louise Brooks introduced timeless architectural elements that continue to define the home today. Expansive rooms, elegant detailing, and walls of windows fill the interiors with natural light while framing serene views of the surrounding property. With approximately 5,900 square feet on two levels, the layout is designed for both sophisticated entertaining and comfortable everyday living. An inviting living room with a fireplace and a light-filled dining room with a bay window create elegant gathering spaces. The generous kitchen, featuring double islands and an eat-in area, flows effortlessly into the expansive family room, where a coffered ceiling, wood-burning fireplace, and French doors open to the outdoors-perfect for indoor-outdoor entertaining. Upstairs, the primary suite serves as a private retreat with tranquil views of the property, while four additional bedrooms provide comfortable accommodations for family and guests. The beautifully landscaped grounds include a tennis/pickleball court as well as a charming brick potting shed, offering endless possibilities as a changing room for tennis or a future pool. With its expansive lawn and mature trees, the property offers the potential to create a truly resort-like outdoor setting.

Welcome to 28 Crooked Mile Road! Privately sited at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in North Darien on a private road in the Ox Ridge school district, this handsome cedar shingle-clad colonial sits on two beautifully manicured acres with mature trees and planting beds. The property offers wonderful western and southern exposure, the house is truly flooded with sunshine throughout the day. The home underwent a major renovation in 2007 and more recently, in 2020, the kitchen and bar area had a fabulous redo!. The classic shaker style kitchen shares an adjacent family room with a fireplace and access to the patio beyond. Formal living and dining rooms and an office anchor the first floor, along with a magazine worthy, newly renovated sunroom (complete with wet bar)! The second floor holds 5 bedrooms. Four are en-suite and positioned along the south side of the house, while a 5th (and potential 6th) bedroom sit on the North side - well suited for guests, older children or an au pair. Also, up the back stairs, is a generous bonus room, perfect for any number of activities! In 2025 the entire roof was replaced, and an array of solar panels were installed on the rear of the home. An electric car charger in the 3-car garage and generator complete this very well-equipped house. Don't miss the chance to make this well maintained and beautifully updated colonial your forever home!

Welcome to the heart of Noroton Heights nestled on one of the most sought-after streets in Darien. This incredible neighborhood offers the perfect blend of community, convenience, & everyday amenities just moments from your door! Renovated in 2008 with a significant addition, this home combines timeless charm, curb appeal & plenty of room for any lifestyle. Inside, you'll find 5 beds/ 3.5 baths, tons of natural light, hardwood floors, & recessed lighting throughout. The first floor features a formal living room, dining room, guest bedroom & bath, mudroom & office. The open-concept family room flows seamlessly to the backyard w/ sliding glass doors leading to a stone patio, perfect for indoor/outdoor entertaining. From the moment you step inside, you'll be captivated by the attention to detail, from soaring ceilings and oversized windows that flood the space with natural light to premium materials that exude sophistication.
