listings.remarks: Tucked away on a quiet private cul-de-sac, 15 Waterbury Lane offers exceptional privacy on a beautiful one-acre property in the heart of Darien. This spacious residence features 5 bedrooms, 4 full bathrooms, and 2 half baths, with a thoughtful layout ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Generous living spaces provide flexibility for work, gathering, and relaxation, while well-sized bedrooms offer comfort and retreat. Enjoy the rare combination of a peaceful, secluded setting with excellent proximity to Darien's highly regarded public schools, making this home a standout opportunity for those seeking space, privacy, and convenience.

Located in one of the most sought-after CT gold coast communities, this meticulously maintained 3-bedroom, 3 full bath expanded colonial home offers an open, light-filled layout designed for everyday living and entertaining. Highlights include a living room with a gas fireplace, a family room, an eat-in kitchen with center island, abundant cabinetry, and a new Bertazzoni gas range. The primary suite features a private roof deck, dual sinks, a jetted tub, and a separate shower. Two additional bedrooms with full bath are located on the second floor. Additional features include energy-efficient windows, multi-zoned heating and cooling, central vacuum, irrigation system, security system, washer and dryer on the main level, and new architect grade shingle roof (May 2025). The property offers a long double-width driveway and fenced rear yard with terrace. It is conveniently located to all the amenities of Heights Crossing & Darien Commons mixed use developments that include shops, market, multiple restaurant venues, the Goddard School and of course Noroton Heights Metro North train station.

Welcome to this beautifully maintained 3,000+ square-foot home on .65 acres offering the perfect blend of space, comfort, and location. Featuring 4 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms, plus a fully finished basement adding 500+ additional square feet of living space, this home is thoughtfully designed to accommodate both everyday living and special gatherings.  Abundant natural light fills this home throughout! The main level features formal living and dining rooms for entertaining or everyday use, bright kitchen with oversized eat-in space opens to a spacious family room with vaulted ceilings, creating an airy, inviting setting for relaxation or gatherings.  The first floor also features a generously sized mudroom and laundry room, adding everyday convenience and organization to busy lifestyles. A flexible first-floor layout allows for a potential home office or guest suite to suit your needs.  Upstairs, the primary suite serves as a peaceful retreat, complete with vaulted ceilings, an oversized walk-in closet, and a private full bath. Two additional spacious bedrooms and a full bath complete the second level. The finished basement provides even more flexible living space-ideal for a recreation room, media room, home gym, or play area. Set in a highly desirable community known for its top-rated schools, this home is conveniently located just minutes from downtown, train, and popular shopping destinations.

Serene cul-de-sac retreat bathed in sunlight, only steps from schools, train, restaurants and The Commons best describe this beautifully renovated 3,395 sq ft home with 5 spacious bedrooms, 3 full updated baths, and a 3-car garage. The open living room flows to the dining room which is adjacent to a gourmet eat-in kitchen with vaulted ceilings, Wolf range, stainless appliances, and granite counters. A deck overlooks a flat, fenced backyard with a flagstone patio perfect for indoor-outdoor entertaining. The luxurious master suite features a vaulted ceiling, dual walk-in closets, full bath with double vanities, an oversized shower, and sitting area. Four generous additional bedrooms share two baths. Lower level Family Room with fireplace provides extra living space or cozy retreat. Prime walkable location meets modern comfort and privacy. A true must see!

Meticulously maintained and built in 2016 by Doherty & Deleo Development, this five-bedroom colonial offers four levels of thoughtfully designed living on a highly desirable in-town cul-de-sac. The home features a bright open layout, 9' ceilings, hardwood floors throughout, and a spacious kitchen with walk-in pantry that flows seamlessly into the main living areas. An oversized mudroom, powder room, and two-car garage complete the first floor. Upstairs the primary suite includes a vaulted ceiling, walk in closet, and oversized bathroom. The finished third floor and lower level with wine cellar provide flexible space for work, recreation, or guests. Energy-efficient features include Andersen Energy Star windows, high-performance insulation, high-efficiency HVAC, and recently added solar panels delivering significant cost savings. Set on a large, flat property, the backyard offers wonderful outdoor living space with a flagstone terrace and site plans for a future pool. Located with convenient access to nearby parks, shops, beaches, and other town amenities in the coveted Hindley school district - all just 60-minutes to NYC.

CLOSE TO NOROTON HEIGHTS AND TRAIN  Welcome to this beautifully updated 5-bedroom, 4 full bath Cape on a quiet cul-de-sac in the desirable Noroton Heights neighborhood and Hindley School District.  This spacious home offers the perfect blend of classic charm and modern updates, featuring 5 generously sized bedrooms and 4 full bathrooms-ideally for today's flexible living needs. Enjoy a bright, open layout, updated gourmet kitchen and baths, and comfortable living spaces designed for both everyday living and entertaining.  Close to Noroton Heights village shops, dining, and the Metro-North train for an easy commute. Just minutes to beautiful local beaches, parks and all that Darien has to offer.  A rare opportunity to own a move-in-ready home in an unbeatable location!!!

Location, location, location! Welcome to 3 Hickory Lane, where charm meets luxury in a priceless setting. Nestled in a sought-after neighborhood with quiet tree-lined lanes, this move-in ready home is walking distance to top-rated elementary, middle and high schools and Woodland Park, with easy train access for NYC commutes. This fully renovated and meticulously maintained home with 4 bedrooms, 4 baths offers nearly 3000 SF of sunlit interiors, open floor plan, and a kitchen designed to inspire-complete with high-end appliances and a spacious island perfect for gatherings. The living and dining areas flow seamlessly, with oversized windows framing serene nature views, while the primary suite is a tranquil retreat with a luxurious en-suite bath. Outside, the private yard invites relaxation, from morning coffee to summer BBQs. Don't miss your chance-schedule your private showing of 3 Hickory Lane today!

Charming, renovated Noroton Heights colonial, with an easy walk to train, dining and shopping, awaits! Beautiful kitchen with breakfast nook, breakfast bar and large dining area opening to a large family room will please all cooks and allow for flexible use. Three bedrooms, renovated bathroom with double sinks, and a walk-up attic (lending itself to expansion possibilities) complete the second floor, while a newly finished lower level with laundry and storage provides extra room to play, work or relax. Great street, great location and move-in ready!

A Rare Opportunity to live on the Coveted Tilley Pond Park with Sweeping Park & Water views. Beautifully designed for effortless living & entertaining, offering a rare blend of natural beauty, walkability, & coastal town charm. On the Pond - where mornings begin with coffee, peaceful water views and evenings end with sunsets reflecting off the park. Stroll along an idyllic street to downtown Darien's charming shops & restaurants in minutes, or walk just steps to the train for an easy commute to NYC. Spend the afternoon at the park, bike to one Darien's two beautiful beaches then stroll to town. Vaulted ceilings at the front and rear create a light-filled, open atmosphere, while expansive windows frame the beauty of Tilley Pond. Unwind in the tranquil family room, prepare meals in the chef's kitchen & gather by the fireplace to watch the game. The floor plan is seamless for entertaining, while the backyard & deck offer the perfect setting for al fresco dining. Working from home it offers a bright office at the front of the house overlooking the park. The lower level provides flex finished space for an additional bedroom or gym with large laundry room, & ample storage. This home offers exceptional potential to expand with a future second floor & the creation of additional beds/baths while enjoying this extraordinary Waterfront setting. Ideal as a full-time time residence, weekend retreat, or an expansion opportunity rarely found in such a coveted walk to town & train location.

Ideally situated between the coveted town centers of Darien and New Canaan, this exceptionally and recently completely redesigned colonial rests on 2.4 acres of pristine, park-like grounds. Enveloped by a perimeter of mature trees, a rare sense of serenity is felt upon arrival.  Finished with an uncompromising attention to detail, a sophisticated design aesthetic and superior craftsmanship throughout, curated to deliver both timeless elegance and modern comfort. The heart of the home is a stunning chef's kitchen complemented by a walk-in butler's pantry and an exquisitely appointed bar. Expansive walls of glass bathe the interiors in natural light while seamlessly connecting indoor and outdoor living. Large family room, living room and dining rooms are part of the open floor plan. French doors open to an impressive flagstone terrace - the perfect setting for al fresco dining, sunset gatherings, and tranquil mornings overlooking the private grounds. A dramatic recreation room with soaring cathedral ceilings provides a striking architectural statement and an abundance of space for leisure and relaxation. The oversized three-car garage offers generous storage and flexibility to accommodate today's lifestyle needs. A luxurious master and additional 3 bedrooms complete the second flr. A 5th Bedroom can be found on the third flr. 15 Marianne Rd represents a rare opportunity to acquire a meticulously renovated estate where luxury, privacy, and location converge in perfect harmony.

Conveniently located just minutes from Rowayton Village, downtown Darien, and a variety of shopping and dining options, this home offers exceptional lifestyle appeal in a prime location.

Welcome to 473 Hollow Tree Ridge Road in Darien - a custom built, stone and shingle Colonial set on 1.3 professionally landscaped acres offering exceptional indoor and outdoor living. This 5-bedroom smart home blends timeless architecture with extensive upgrades and modern technology throughout. The resort-style backyard features a pool with spa, pool house with nano doors, outdoor shower, custom outdoor bar, Lynx grill, fireplace, and covered patio. A slate roof, horseshoe driveway, whole-house 25kW Generac generator, and oversized 3-car garage with heated epoxy floors, built-ins, and wainscoting provide both convenience and peace of mind. The fully remodeled kitchen includes a Wolf range, additional wall oven, Sub-Zero double refrigerator/freezer, double islands with prep sink and second dishwasher, Negresco granite and quartz countertops, island seating, and a wet bar with glass dishwasher and ice maker. A paneled office, homework stations, guest/au pair suite with private access, oversized mudroom, laundry, and two powder rooms complete the main level. Upstairs, the primary suite features a renovated spa bath with heated floors, freestanding tub, oversized shower with rain head, and custom walk-in closets. Two additional ensuite bedrooms, a fourth bedroom with hall bath, game room with full wet bar, media room, and office/workstations provide flexible living.

Welcome to 66 Stanton Road. Set on 1.34 landscaped acres, this classic 1938 clapboard colonial blends architectural charm with thoughtful updates, including a full renovation and expansion completed in 2009. A gracious foyer with sweeping curved staircase is flanked by sunlit living and dining rooms. The open kitchen and family room anchor the home, featuring Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, double ovens, a walnut island, generous pantry, and casual dining area. A vaulted, wood-paneled family room with exposed beams, fireplace, and a wall of windows overlooks the backyard. A wet bar with second dishwasher and built-in desk sits just off the kitchen. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite offers a vaulted ceiling, dressing area, reading porch, and spa-like bath with steam shower and soaking tub. Five additional bedrooms include two en suites and a Jack-and-Jill layout, plus a flexible lounge/study area and walk-up attic storage. The lower level includes a bar, fireplace lounge, climate-controlled wine room, and full gym. Outdoor living shines with a screened porch, patio with grill, and a recently added gunite pool with spa and electric cover. Lush lawns and vibrant plantings create privacy and seasonal color for both quiet enjoyment and lively gatherings.

Located on a quiet cul-de-sac in Darien's sought-after Ox Ridge School district, this inviting 4 bedroom home offers timeless character, privacy, and versatile living. Adding to the home's versatility is a 2-bedroom guest cottage, connected to the main house by a breezeway-ideal for extended family, visiting guests, au pair living, or a private home office. Outside, beautifully landscaped, park-like grounds surround a heated pool and patio, providing the perfect setting for relaxation and entertaining. A rare opportunity in one of Darien's most desirable neighborhoods.

Three additional spacious bedrooms, all with hardwood floors, share a well-appointed hall bath with double sink vanity and tub/shower. The walk-out lower level features a generous recreation room with bay window and full bath, opening to a back patio for endless options and hours of fun. A workshop, mudroom and abundant storage areas provide exceptional flexibility and opportunity for additional finished space. Two-car attached garage, new HVAC (2023/2024), and a full house generator. Opportunities abound to renovate, expand, or build the home of your dreams on this exceptional property. Close to schools, trains, Great Island, beaches, clubs, downtown, shopping/dining, golf courses.

The library is wrapped in floor-to-ceiling bookshelves, creating an intimate space to read beside the fireplace, enjoy a drink from the wet bar or relax on the adjoining covered patio. The dining room, centered around a grand fireplace, is equally striking and complemented by a butler's pantry with wet bar for seamless entertaining. At the heart of the home, the well-appointed chef's kitchen features an expansive island with seating for five and opens to a great room, where a fireplace and sunlit dining area create a natural gathering place while opening up to the backyard patio for easy entertaining. Bathed in afternoon light, the formal living room is an elegant setting for fireside conversation and quiet relaxation. Upstairs, a thoughtfully designed office with built-in desks leads to 4 ensuite bedrooms, a huge rec room, laundry facilities and a gracious primary suite, complete with a sitting area, fireplace, dressing room and 2 primary baths for refined tranquility. A new sprinkler system keeps the yard vibrant, and the home's convenient location near the train and shopping ensures easy living. Don't miss this opportunity! listings.remarks: A cottage in Darien! Well-maintained 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home on a quiet street, conveniently located near the beach, shopping, and approximately a 10-minute walk to the train. The kitchen opens to a spacious family room with double sliders leading to the backyard and bluestone patio-ideal for indoor-outdoor living. A built-in work/study area and a mudroom off the garage add everyday functionality, and the living room features a wood-burning fireplace. Upstairs includes four bedrooms and two full baths, plus easy access to walk-up third-floor storage. Laundry is located in the mechanical area off the mudroom. Situated within the Hindley School district.

This exceptional 5-bedroom, 41/2-bath Nantucket-style Colonial blends refined architecture with relaxed coastal living. Thoughtfully renovated in 2012 by Steven Mueller Architects LLC and refreshed by the current owners in 2021, the home welcomes you with a dramatic two-story foyer and beautifully designed interiors filled with natural light.  Crisp millwork, shiplap detailing, coffered ceilings, and custom built-ins create a timeless backdrop throughout. The elegant yet inviting living spaces include a serene living room centered around a sleek fireplace with symmetrical built-ins and wide-plank floors, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining.  Water views from many rooms enhance the home's peaceful coastal setting, filling the interiors with light and openness. Outdoors, elegant bluestone patios, an elevated second-floor deck positioned for sunset views, and professionally landscaped grounds overlook the scenic Five Mile River-an idyllic setting for both quiet moments and memorable gatherings.

Step into the effortless elegance of 23 Greenwood Ave., Darien, CT - a fully renovated 5-bedroom, 21/2-bath home offering approximately 2,200 square feet of light-filled living space designed to be felt as much as seen. From the moment you enter, the warmth of brand-new oak flooring flows underfoot throughout the home, creating a natural sense of comfort and continuity.  At the center of it all, the custom chef's kitchen invites you to gather, cook, and connect. Wrapped in stunning quartz countertops with a dramatic full quartz backsplash, the space is anchored by a striking quartz island-perfect for morning coffee, casual meals, or lively evenings entertaining friends and family.  Upstairs, everyday living feels effortless with a conveniently placed laundry area just steps from the primary bedroom, adding ease and practicality to your daily rhythm.  Step outside and take a deep breath as the backyard opens to the peaceful waterfront of the Noroton River. Here, the setting feels calm and restorative-an ideal backdrop for outdoor dining, quiet mornings, or simply unwinding as the water gently flows beyond your yard.  All of this is just a five-minute drive to the train, making your commute to New York City seamless while allowing you to return home each day to the tranquility and charm of Darien living.  Come experience a home that invites you to slow down, settle in, and truly enjoy where you live.

The main level offers a wonderful open floor plan, creating an easy flow for living and entertaining. Spacious living areas connect seamlessly, making the home feel both comfortable and welcoming. Outside, the property truly shines with its meticulously landscaped, fenced garden and backyard-an ideal setting for relaxing and entertaining. Upstairs, the primary suite provides a private retreat complete with a walk-in closet and en-suite bathroom designed for comfort and relaxation. 3 additional bedrooms and bath complete the second floor. The fully finished lower level adds generous flexible living space-ideal for recreation, hobbies, or a home office. Also features a full laundry room. With bright interiors, modern touches, and classic charm, 3 Abbey Road offers a wonderful opportunity to enjoy easy living in one of Darien's most desirable communities.

Nestled on one of Noroton Heights' most sought-after streets, this sun-drenched coastal charmer seamlessly blends classic appeal with thoughtful modern updates. With newly renovated bathrooms, a new deck, and beautifully refinished hardwood floors, this home captures the essence of Darien living with an enviable walk-to-everything location. The fully fenced, level backyard has been lovingly landscaped, creating a private outdoor retreat ideal for entertaining, play, or simply relaxing. The lower level expands the home's living space with 440 square feet of finished recreational area. Don't miss the opportunity to make this gem of a house your new home.

Sun-filled, Beachy Colonial ideally located beside a coveted private cul-de-sac just moments from the Darien train & Darien Commons. Thoughtfully updated with numerous improvements and upgrades, including a stylish, top-of-the-line eat-in kitchen designed for both everyday living and effortless entertaining.The open, flexible floor plan offers the rare option of a primary suite on either the main level or the second floor. Four bedrooms and two full baths provide comfortable living, complemented by a formal living room and a bright, elevated office/playroom - perfect as a work-from-home space or Peloton room - set among the treetops with beautiful views. Outside, enjoy a fully fenced yard and inviting patio ideal for gatherings, outdoor dining & relaxed afternoons. The charming private court is known for its welcoming sense of community, hosting block parties and cozy fireside evenings. Enjoy exceptional walkability to the train, restaurants, beaches & town. Upstairs, you will find a serene primary suite complete with private bath. There are two more generously sized bedrooms which share a newly updated, hall bath. The stone entertainment patio, equipped with a full outdoor kitchen, TV and hot tub, is ideal for hosting gatherings or simply relaxing in your own private oasis. Nestled on a tree lined cul-de-sac with a friendly community vibe, Wakeman Road is more than a home, it's a lifestyle.

Nestled down on one of Darien's most sought after streets, this charming farmhouse offers five bedrooms, three full/one half bath, and lots of privacy. Sun filled interiors create a warm and inviting home a long with many different options to make this a dream property. Steps to Five Mile River and walking distance to Rowayton. Ideally located just minutes from town, train, beaches, this rare offering captures the essence of Darien's coastal lifestyle.

Located at the end of dead-end street. Only a few blocks away to the train station and shopping and restaurants. Updated last years including new appliances, refinished hardwood floors, new siding, etc. Bright inside with skylights and large windows. Private large, one-third acre leveled fully fenced backyard with patio. This move-in-ready property offers exceptional privacy, charm, and convenience in desirable location. A multi-year lease is preferred.

Few homes in Darien offer this combination: five bedrooms, five indoor entertainment spaces, a private elevator, gunite pool, hot tub, and pool cabana with wet bar-all on a private .70-acre lot in the Tokeneke School district. Fully updated 2021-2026 and just a walk to Metro-North and downtown. Spanning three fully finished floors, the main floor is built for living and entertaining: a formal living room with fireplace, sunroom with, family room with fireplace, and a renovated chef's kitchen open to the dining room, featuring new cabinet doors, hardware, countertops, sink, faucet, pantry, and updated lighting. The primary suite features a dressing room and a cedar walk-in closet. Upstairs: home office and home gym. The at-grade lower level-built into natural ledge with no below-grade space-opens via French doors directly to the pool and features a pool entertainment room, three bedrooms, playroom, game room, cabana with wet bar, a mudroom, and two attached garages (a two-car garage and a separate third garage bay). Outside: gunite pool, new hot tub (2025), new pool heater (2024), pool cabana with wet bar and fridge, stone patio, large custom playset, full irrigation, fenced yard, and professional landscaping. Updated 2021-2026: two central A/C units, Ecobee smart thermostats, new appliances, refinished hardwood floors, renovated bathrooms, and painted exterior. No deferred maintenance. A private world of its own.

listings.remarks: Welcome to this absolutely charming bungalow-style cottage set in a desirable and convenient location, where timeless character and thoughtful updates throughout come together beautifully.  From the moment you arrive, the inviting front porch sets the tone-perfect for morning coffee, evening unwinding, and everything in between. Inside, the home has been beautifully updated throughout, featuring a chef's kitchen with top-of-the-line Viking appliances, complemented by stunning soap stone countertops and refined finishes.  The first-floor primary suite offers both convenience and luxury, with a fully renovated bathroom and generously sized closets. Every detail has been carefully considered, from the new lighting fixtures throughout to the seamless blend of classic charm and modern comfort.  One of the home's most versatile features is the finished 2 car garage, offering an additional 600 sqft of flex space-perfect for a home office, gym, playroom, or garage - whatever suits your lifestyle. The lower level adds an additional 200 square feet of finished space for recreation or playroom.  Step outside to your private backyard oasis, complete with a beautiful gunite pool-an exceptional amenity that elevates everyday living and makes entertaining effortless.  All of this, just moments from town, train, and schools. This is the kind of home that doesn't come around often-where charm, quality, and lifestyle come together seamlessly. Don't miss it!

Welcome to 96 Holmes Avenue, a beautifully updated farmhouse that perfectly blends classic charm with modern amenities. Nestledin a prime location, this home offers 5 bedrooms, 2 1/2 bathrooms, 2,347 square feet of living space, providing convenience, comfort, and style. Enjoy a bright and airy open floor plan with inviting living and dining areas-ideal for entertaining or relaxing by the fireplace.Unwind on the serene screened-in porch or retreat to the level 0.52-acre fenced backyard, an outdoor haven for relaxation. The light-filled bedrooms continue the home's warm ambiance. Located in the highly sought-after Holmes School District and less than a mile from the Noroton Heights train station and shopping center, this property offers easy access to top-rated restaurants, retail, and amenities. Just minutes from town beaches and Great Island Park, this home combines convenience with coastal charm. Available for an annual lease-don't miss this incredible opportunity to experience the best living in Darien.

A beautiful modern interpretation of a traditional colonial, this 3,482 SF residence was built by award winning Hemingway Construction and is ideally located near the train, town, beaches and Great Island all short walk away. The neighborhood is zoned for Blue Ribbon award-winning Hindley Elementary School, where everyone can enjoy biking and walking to school together. The first floor features classic living spaces enhanced with custom built-ins, wet bar, wine refrigerator, butler's pantry, along with access to an outdoor terrace with fireplace perfect for entertaining. The second floor offers 4 bedrooms, including a spacious primary suite with bath and fireplace as well as two additional bathrooms, laundry room and abundant closet space. A finished third floor with an additional bedroom and full bath along with a finished lower-level with full bath provides flexible living space with endless possibilities. Hardwood floors run throughout the home while a painted lower level offers a versatile recreational space ideal for hockey or roller skating. Large windows fill the home with natural light creating a bright and inviting atmosphere. Meticulously maintained, the home has been consistently serviced by its original contractors. Pre-wired for audio and video. 480 SF in lower level is included in total square footage.

This gem of a home, in a prime Darien location, is ideal for both entertaining and casual living! As the charming entry sweeps you in, you immediately are surprised by the vaulted ceilings in the spacious living room which is centered around a soaring wood burning fireplace, clad in shiplap and marble. The library serves both as a place to read a book or grab a drink while entertaining in the adjoining family room which is flooded with light and made cozy by a gas fireplace. The dining area is spacious enough for large gatherings and opens to the updated and well-equipped kitchen, with adjacent mudroom and laundry area. Upstairs, the primary suite has a spacious dressing area, an updated bath, and a treasured balcony overlooking the property and providing tranquil sunset views. There are three additional bedrooms, an updated, full bath and the most picturesque, interior balcony where you can grab a moment away. Outside the patio is a favorite gathering spot and overlooks the fully fenced yard with plenty of space to play catch or kick a soccer ball. Getting your steps in, playing fetch with your dog, or simply enjoying the peaceful privacy afforded by Woodland Park Nature Preserve adds to the allure of this home. 1-car garage. Walk to schools, restaurants and the train, this fresh and modern cape is one you shouldn't miss.

Welcome to Darien Place, a thoughtfully designed residence built in 2021 that seamlessly blends the character of the original 1928 brick structure with modern living. This 1-bedroom, 1-bath home features 9+ foot ceilings, exposed brick, and an open layout to flood the space with natural light.   The kitchen is appointed with Bosch appliances and clean, modern finishes, while the spacious bedroom with ensuite full bath includes a walk-in shower. Additional features include in-unit washer and dryer and privacy window treatments.  The building offers controlled access to the lobby, elevator, and stairwell. One reserved parking space and a private storage cage are included.  Ideally located in the heart of downtown Darien, with close proximity to restaurants, shopping, train, library, and everyday conveniences. No smoking. Pet restrictions apply; please inquire to learn more.

Welcome to 25 Patricia Lane, where timeless elegance meets modern convenience. Nestled on a highly desirable street in Darien, this 2006 Hemingway built pristine 5-bedroom, 4 full and 2 half-bath Colonial offers over 5,700 square feet of beautifully designed living space. Step inside to discover a bright, airy layout with exceptional flow, perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. The heart of the home is the stunning white eat in kitchen and great family room with fireplace, ideal for todays lifestyle. Retreat to the luxurious primary suite, complete with two expansive walk-in closets and large bath, while spacious additional bedrooms ensure comfort for all. A finished basement and third floor provide endless flexibility-think bedroom, playroom, home gym, or office space.  Beyond the home itself, the location is second to none. Situated in the coveted Hindley school district, this property also boasts unparalleled walkability. Walk or bike to nearby Darien beaches and Great Island, or take advantage of the close proximity to Darien's charming shops, restaurants, and train. Outside, the flat, level yard invites outdoor fun and relaxation. Impeccably maintained and flooded with natural light, this home is ready to welcome you. Don't miss the opportunity to live on one of Darien's most sought-after streets!

217 Mansfield Avenue presents a rare opportunity to secure a full, flat acre in one of North Darien's most desirable and rapidly evolving neighborhoods. Set on beautiful, level land, the property currently features a charming but dated Cape Cod-style home ready for its next chapter. Buyers may choose to renovate and restore the existing residence, bringing new life to its classic bones, or take advantage of the exceptional lot to build a substantial new construction home. The surrounding area supports significant value, with many newer homes commanding prices in the $4M-$6M range. A standout feature is the detached garage with a legal accessory apartment above-ideal for guest quarters, rental income, au pair space, or a private home office/studio. Whether you're an end user looking to customize, an investor, or a builder seeking a premier site, this property offers flexibility, value, and long-term upside in a highly sought-after Darien location.

Beautiful, light-filled apartment in nearly new construction offering refined living with convenient access to Darien beaches and Great Island. This 1-bedroom, 1.5-bath residence spans approximately 1,116 square feet and features a loft located in an elevator building.  The open-concept kitchen, dining, and living area is ideal for both everyday living and entertaining, highlighted by cathedral ceilings, abundant natural light, and a gas fireplace. Chef's kitchen features a center island with breakfast bar seating, quartz countertops, premium Bosch appliances, and ample storage.  Spacious primary suite includes a walk-in closet and modern full bath with oversized shower. Upstairs loft provides additional flexible living space.  Additional amenities include guest half bath, in-unit washer/dryer, basement storage space, and one dedicated parking space with ample guest parking available.  Tenant responsible for credit check, liability and personal property insurance, gas heat, electricity, internet/cable, water (separately metered to unit), and hot water. Please inquire regarding pet restrictions. No smoking. Maximum occupancy of three permitted.

Beautifully renovated four-bedroom home in Darien on a quiet street with water views. The front door opens from a charming front porch to a living room with built in bookcases. This leads to a dining area and a bright, white, renovated kitchen with tiled backsplash and modern appliances. There is a first-floor bedroom, renovated white full bath and den/office. The upstairs boasts three bedrooms and two full baths. There is a basement playroom with a half bath and laundry on the lower level. The back yard and patio complete this charmer. Deeded water access - bring your kayak.

Welcome to 54 Camp Avenue in the heart of Darien - a beautifully updated, move-in ready home offering the perfect blend of comfort, style, and functionality. This inviting 4-bedroom, 2 full bathroom residence features recently renovated bathrooms with heated floors and a thoughtfully designed layout. The dining and living area opens seamlessly to an expansive new deck that overlooks a private and serene property where you can enjoy peaceful views of the large, private backyard...an ideal setting for gatherings, play, or quiet relaxation. The home also includes a finished lower level, providing valuable additional living space that can be used as a family room, home office, gym, or guest area. With its turnkey condition, modern updates, desirable location and scenic property 54 Camp Avenue presents a wonderful opportunity to enjoy easy living in Darien.

The moment you step onto the inviting front porch, you'll feel the warmth and charm of this exceptional 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath Colonial perched on a quiet cul-de-sac. Experience sophisticated design, unparalleled comfort, and an unbeatable location. Welcome to your dream home in Darien. The heart of the home is the chef's kitchen, fully renovated and featuring top-of-the-line appliances, a leathered black quartz island, and space for everyone to gather. Flowing through french doors to the spacious family room, adorned with custom built-ins and the sun-drenched playroom that opens to the professionally landscaped backyard and terrace-your private oasis for outdoor living. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite is a true retreat, boasting a cozy fireplace, an expansive walk-in closet, and a spa-inspired bathroom with a double vanity, oversized shower, and a classic clawfoot tub. The additional 4 bedrooms all gift generous size, oversized closets and 3 more fully renovated bathrooms. The great room wows with size and soaring exposed beams, a striking stone fireplace. A fun, warm and inviting spacee for all to enjoy. Don't forget the basement with finished space, workout area and a hockey shooting room. Situated just minutes from school, the train, parks, downtown shops, and acclaimed restaurants, this property offers luxury living along with convenience and a true sense of community.

Rarely do you find a property that has it all: a spacious move-in ready house with a pool, and a private one-acre parcel close to everything Darien has to offer. Tucked away at the end of a cul-de-sac, steps away from the newly reimaged town center, and close to beaches, this thoughtfully renovated 5 bed/4.5 bath home strikes just the right balance between comfortable living and sophistication. With tons of natural light, the first floor features an open living/dining room with access to the deck overlooking the pool, a kitchen with cozy banquette, family room with built-in desks and shelving, and a mudroom with laundry and custom cubbies. There are 4 spacious bedrooms and 3 baths upstairs, including a luxurious primary suite with vaulted ceiling, office, and generous walk-in closet and bathroom. The 5th bedroom, and 4th full bath, are in the walkout lower level which also offers a large "hang out" room with plenty of space for both relaxing and working out. For the car enthusiast, the detached barn, with heat and A/C, has an additional 2 garage bays as well as a workshop. Surrounded by nature, and awash with lush gardens, this is an unexpected oasis in the center of town.

listings.remarks: Set on a beautifully landscaped and expansive property, 28 Old Farm Road offers a rare blend of refined elegance and modern comfort. Thoughtfully designed with impeccable attention to detail, the residence features five spacious bedrooms, each with its own en suite bathroom. An exceptional primary suite was designed as a private retreat. This serene space includes a separate lounge area, an oversized walk-in closet, and a spa-inspired bathroom with views of a manicured, sprawling lawn and a beautifully designed pool complete with a safety cover, ideal for both relaxation and entertaining. Every outdoor element has been carefully curated to enhance the sense of luxury and privacy. Inside, the home has been recently reimagined by renowned designer Naomi Stroh, whose sophisticated vision brings a fresh, elevated aesthetic to every room. The finished lower level offers versatile space perfect for recreation, a home gym, or additional living, all complemented by ample storage. The interiors seamlessly blend timeless style with contemporary finishes, resulting in a warm yet striking living environment. This is a rare opportunity to own a move-in-ready, design-forward home in one of Darien's most desirable locations in the private Tokeneke Association.

This beautifully renovated 5,200-square-foot home offers an exceptional blend of timeless elegance and modern luxury in one of Darien's most coveted central locations. Step inside to discover a spacious, light-filled open floor plan designed for both everyday living and effortless entertaining. The inviting family room with fireplace flows seamlessly into the gourmet kitchen and expansive breakfast area, creating the heart of the home, while an additional oversized living space added during the 2019 expansion offers incredible flexibility for relaxing, gathering, or entertaining. A dedicated office provides a quiet workspace, and the beautifully appointed formal dining room is ideal for more elegant occasions. Every bathroom in the home has been thoughtfully redesigned with high-end finishes, and the residence was extensively expanded and renovated in 2019. Upstairs, five generous bedrooms provide plenty of space for family and guests, including a retreat-like primary suite complete with a spa-inspired bath. The finished lower level includes a gym and additional recreation space. Outside, a handsome bluestone patio overlooks the private yard - perfect for morning coffee, summer barbecues, or relaxing evenings at home. Ideally situated in the heart of Darien, this move-in-ready home is just a short walk to top-rated schools, parks, town, and train, offering a rare opportunity to own a meticulously renovated home in one of Darien's most desirable locations

Set on one of Darien's most sought-after, multi-million dollar cul-de-sacs, this sprawling wood and brick ranch offers exceptional scale and endless potential for the discerning buyer, renovator, or builder. Positioned on a remarkably private 2.5 acre lot, abutting another 10+ acres of protected wetlands, the setting affords unmatched peace, natural beauty, and exclusivity. The interior boasts a versatile layout. The back of the home features expansive walls of glass, with a fully enclosed glass terrace, which creates a seamless visual connection to the serene, wooded surroundings. Highlights include 3 generously sized bedrooms, 3.5 baths, a sauna, a spacious living room anchored by a beautiful stone fireplace, a formal dining room, and a large eat-in kitchen, with a large breakfast area. Designed with an indoor-outdoor flow in mind, the substantial multi-purpose room anchoring one end of the house, can be used according to any family's needs: a playroom, family room, studio, in-law suite. With its sliding doors that open to the flagstone terrace and the private free-form pool, it shows the flexibility of the design. Whether remodeling, renovating, expanding, or building new, this is a special one-of-a-kind opportunity to create your dream in your new home. Agents please check confidential remarks.

listings.remarks: The perfect blend of charm, location, and space, 267 Brookside offers the very best of Darien living. Set on 1.55 level acres with views of the Country Club of Darien golf course, this beautifully renovated and expanded home feels both private and inviting. Inside, graciously scaled, light-filled spaces include an updated open kitchen and family room with breakfast nook and fireplace, complemented by formal living and dining rooms with high ceilings and custom built-ins. With four bedrooms and three full and one half baths, the home offers both comfort and flexibility for today's lifestyle. Ideally located near Ox Ridge Elementary School, Cherry Lawn Park, and just minutes to both downtown Darien and downtown New Canaan, this is effortless living in a truly exceptional setting.

listings.remarks: Set along a picturesque stretch in one of Darien's most sought-after neighborhoods, 234 Brookside Road offers a rare blend of timeless architecture, privacy, and modern comfort. Surrounded by mature trees and beautifully landscaped grounds, this exceptional property provides a serene, retreat-like setting just minutes from town, top-rated schools, and the coastline. This HOBI award-winning residence welcomes you with a gracious entry that opens into expansive, light-filled interiors designed for both elegance and ease. A thoughtfully planned, free-flowing layout connects formal living and dining rooms-ideal for entertaining-with inviting casual spaces suited to everyday living. The well-appointed kitchen serves as the heart of the home, featuring high-end appliances and seamless flow to family gathering areas and outdoor living spaces. Upstairs, the tranquil primary suite features a vaulted ceiling, dual walk-in closets, and a spacious spa-inspired bath. Each of the four additional bedrooms offers an en suite bath, ensuring comfort and privacy for family and guests. Complementing the approximately 5,700-square-foot main house is a fully equipped 1,100-square-foot guest house with living and dining areas, a full kitchen, a wood-burning fireplace, and a private suite with a full bathroom. Set on 1.4 level acres, the outdoor spaces include a gunite pool and spa, outdoor kitchen, and fireplace-perfect for entertaining or relaxing in complete privacy year-round.

Some homes are ready for a new life the moment the door opens. This is one of them.Tucked into one of Darien's most beloved cul-de-sac neighborhoods, this beautifully updated four-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bath colonial strikes the balance every renter is looking for: the warmth of classic New England architecture with every modern comfort already in place. No projects. No waiting. Just move in and settle in. A showpiece eat-in kitchen anchors the main level alongside a formal dining room and bright living room. The family room, centered around a fireplace, is the kind of space that keeps people in the room. A dedicated home office, private workout room, and large finished playroom give everyone their own corner of the house. Outside, a welcoming patio opens to a beautifully framed backyard with stone walls, mature plantings, and built-in irrigation. A two-car garage, central air, and whole-house generator provide comfort and peace of mind in every season. Talmadge Hill Metro-North is just moments away, with easy access to New Canaan and Stamford. And beyond the commute, Darien delivers: private beaches, boating, tennis, boutique shopping, and a community calendar that fills itself. Available May 1, 2026. Credit check, rental application, and two-month security deposit required.

This is it! A renovated in-town rental that perfectly blends comfort, convenience, and modern living. Ideally situated just steps from vibrant shops, popular restaurants, and easy transportation options, this home offers an easy lifestyle in a prime location.  Enjoy the ease of single-floor living with a thoughtfully updated interior made up of two bedrooms and one and half baths with plenty of storage. All new appliances as part of the updates.  Step outside to your own private, fenced-in yard-perfect for relaxing, entertaining, or enjoying a bit of outdoor space in the heart of town.  Whether you're commuting, dining out, or simply enjoying the neighborhood, this home puts everything you need right at your doorstep. An opportunity to enjoy updated living with privacy and convenience all in one. Tenant responsible for all utilities, credit check, two months security deposit. No smoking.

This is the One! A beautifully updated four-bedroom Colonial set on a quiet street in coveted North Darien, offering the perfect blend of classic charm and modern living.  The home features gracious formal spaces including a sun-filled living room, elegant dining room, and inviting den. At the heart of the home, a stunning updated kitchen opens seamlessly to a spacious family room, creating an ideal layout for everyday living and entertaining. A playroom and dual home offices provide the flexibility today's buyers are looking for.  Perfectly positioned on the Wee Burn Country Club, the property enjoys sweeping, picturesque views that set it apart. Outdoor living is just as exceptional, with a beautifully designed stone patio featuring sitting walls and a fireplace-perfect for gathering year-round-plus a large, flat yard ideal for play and recreation.  A detached three-car garage is complemented by a fantastic space above-perfect as a media room, private office, or creative studio. A rare opportunity to own in an unbeatable location with both privacy and views.

listings.remarks: A beautifully maintained home with thoughtful updates throughout, this property blends comfort, style, and everyday convenience-especially with the elementary school just a short walk away. The first floor was just recently renovated, and the main level also offers a dedicated office, while the walkup third floor provides a spacious bonus room ideal for flexible living. The heart of the home is a kitchen to die for, complete with a butler's pantry and a cozy fireplace that adds warmth and charm. Outdoor living shines with a welcoming covered front porch and a bluestone patio set within a private fencedin yard. It's a truly moveinready home in a prime location.

Don't miss this amazing opportunity to rent in a sought-after neighborhood just a short walk from Hindley Elementary, Weed Beach, Great Island, restaurants, shopping, and the train station. This classic 4 BR, 3 BA Colonial, renovated in 2003, sits on a prime corner lot. The open eat-in kitchen features granite counters and a center island, connecting to the family room and formal dining room. The formal living room has a wood-burning fireplace, leading to a spacious great room with a custom wet bar and access to a side patio or year-round sunroom. The master suite includes French doors to a Juliet balcony, a spa tub, and a marble shower. Pet-friendly landlords and excellent walking trails complete the package.

Fully renovated Colonial directly across the street from Woodland Park and .5 miles to Noroton Heights Train Station, newly built Darien Commons & Heights Crossing. This 2 bdrm, 1.1 bath has over 1,500sqft of living space, high ceilings, central air & hardwood floors throughout. Remodeled eat-in-kitchen w/ granite countertops, dining area, SS appliances, half bath, pantry & double-sided gas fireplace that looks through to the massive living room. 2nd floor has 2 bdrms w/ remodeled full bath and ample closet space. Lower level w/ playroom, laundry and storage space. Step through the French Doors to the fenced in backyard with patio & deck, 1 car garage, and turf for easy maintenance/pet cleanup.

DARIEN LIVING IN A PRIME, CONVENIENT LOCATION! Ideally situated near the new Darien Commons, this well-maintained 3-bedroom, 2 full bath home combines comfort, flexibility, and exceptional value. Located in the desirable Noroton Heights neighborhood, the home features a spacious, level backyard, ample parking, and an oversized garage. The flexible floor plan includes one main-level bedroom-perfect for a home office-along with a full bath on each level. Enjoy a bright, eat-in kitchen, convenient main-level laundry, and hardwood floors throughout. The inviting living room features a fireplace, while the patio just off the kitchen provides the perfect spot for morning coffee or outdoor relaxation. Set between Noroton Avenue and Edgerton Street, this is a commuter's dream with easy access to the train, schools, beaches, shopping, and dining.

listings.remarks: Location, Location, Location!!3BR/1.5BA home with flexible layout, including main-level bedroom and half bath. Freshly painted and clean, ready for updates. Features include hardwood floors, detached 2-car garage, large enclosed sunroom, spacious unfinished basement, and long driveway. Close to town, shopping, dining, and top-rated schools. Incredible opportunity to get into the Darien market. Bring your vision and make it your own!!

Welcome to 36 Sedgwick Village-a rare, private end unit, offering the ease and comfort of single-level living. Step into your own serene retreat, complete with a private courtyard patio where you can unwind, surrounded by lush greenery and the calming embrace of nature. Sunlight pours into every room, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere throughout the home. Nestled in the heart of Sedgwick Village, this residence offers both privacy and convenience, featuring an attached garage and ample storage. Just moments away from grocery stores, dining, shops, and downtown Darien right at your fingertips.

Like a new home! This property is FULLY furnished and located in private Salem Straits Beach Association. Rebuilt by Fox Hill builders with impressive gourmet kitchen, heated pool and every imaginable amenity. Built-in Espresso maker? Yes! Move right in with gorgeous furniture throughout. Convenient flow of spaces and great views from living areas - especially main level with a walk-out to pool & expansive patio areas. Both uncovered and covered patio spaces for sun, swimming or outdoor dining & entertaining. 2 convenient Laundry Rooms on main and upper levels. Salem Straits residents have their own private beach, dock, storage for kayak, and a neighborhood to bike or run free. 2 blocks to private Salem Straits beach and dock. Also close to one of Darien's town beaches, Pear Tree Beach. Move right in Aug 1, with an all inclusive price of 45,000. Annual lease with tenant having additional costs, 35,000. month.

listings.remarks: Welcome to this exquisite Mid-Century Modern home, nestled on a private acre in the highly sought-after Delafield Island Association in Darien. This peaceful property is situated on a quiet cul-de-sac, offering both privacy and convenience - minutes to town, train, schools, Pear Tree Point Beach and Great Island. The living room features a wood burning fireplace and three expansive picture windows, which flood the home with natural light and views of mature landscaping. The dining room, a proper solarium, offers a bright and open setting for dining. A spacious eat in kitchen and open floor plan seamlessly connect the living spaces, elevating the home's modern sensibility. With four generously sized bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, 22 Sunswyck exhibits effortless single-level living, in comfort and sophistication.

A rare opportunity to own in the rapidly evolving Noroton Heights neighborhood-where walkability, convenience, and lifestyle converge. Steps from the Noroton Heights train station, restaurants, and everyday conveniences, 281 West Avenue sits at the center of one of Darien's most sought-after and increasingly vibrant areas.  This three-bedroom Colonial presents an inviting blend of classic New England character and modern practicality. Hardwood floors, a generous light-filled living room, and a formal dining room create warm, welcoming spaces suited to both everyday living and easy entertaining. The updated kitchen anchors the main level with stainless appliances and a clean, efficient layout. A first-floor sunroom with updated powder room adds a highly usable extension of living space-equally suited as a home office, playroom, or relaxed sitting area. Upstairs, three bedrooms share a renovated full bath. The partially finished lower level provides valuable bonus space-well-suited for a media room, home gym, or dedicated work-from-home setup. Outside, the fenced yard offers ample outdoor space for children, pets, or entertaining. Numerous recent updates have been made to support today's modern, hassle-free lifestyle.

Welcome to 44 Maple Street, a beautifully maintained and thoughtfully updated home in one of Darien's most convenient locations. Just half a mile from Noroton Heights' shops, dining, and train, this property makes everyday errands simple, and commuting a breeze. Originally built by Giannattasio builders in 2017 and enhanced with quality updates by Ruddy Builders, the home has been meticulously cared for. The layout features 5 spacious bedrooms and 5.5 bathrooms, including finished spaces on both the third and lower levels. The heart of the home includes a dream kitchen overlooking a family room with vaulted ceilings. The separate dining room, library and mudroom complete this perfect first floor. 4 of the 5 bedrooms are on the second floor, 2 of which have their own bathroom, and the other two share a generously sized bathroom. The primary suite is a true retreat, with a beautiful en suite bathroom, a large walk-in closet, and plenty of additional closet space. The third floor includes a media/rec room, while the lower level offers additional space. The property also boasts a generous backyard, offering ample space for entertaining, play, or relaxing outdoors. Move-in ready and ideally located, this home combines a functional floorplan, beautiful construction, thoughtful updates, and everyday convenience in the heart of Darien.

Just in time for summer-this exceptional property offers the ultimate in luxury living and outdoor enjoyment.  Imagine relaxing poolside by your new heated pool and spa, surrounded by beautifully landscaped grounds and sweeping views of the golf course. Inside, the home is equally impressive. The expansive primary suite is a true retreat, featuring a private sitting room that opens onto a deck overlooking the pool-perfect for morning coffee or evening unwinding. The suite also boasts a beautifully updated bath and two spacious walk-in closets. The second level is thoughtfully designed with four additional en-suite bedrooms and a versatile playroom, offering comfort and privacy for family and guests alike. At the heart of the home is a stunning new gourmet kitchen, outfitted with top-of-the-line appliances including a Wolf range, two Sub-Zero refrigerators, a separate freezer, and three dishwashers-an entertainer's dream. The lower level is equally striking, featuring an elite gym, a playroom, and abundant open space for recreation and play-perfect for entertaining, relaxing, or staying active without ever leaving home. This remarkable colonial seamlessly blends elegance, comfort, and modern convenience-perfect for making unforgettable summer memories and beyond.

Central A/C system. 3 BR, 2 BA townhouse-style unit where all three levels are loaded with charm and character. Features include a Mansard roof (tall ceilings on 2nd floor), wide plank flooring, hand hewn beams, multiple fireplaces, newer kitchen with stainless steel appliances and washer dryer in unit. French doors lead to bluestone patio overlooking large, private backyard with plenty of level play area. Located in award-winning Hindley School district. Walk to train, schools, beaches, shopping. Convenient to I-95 and ideal commute to Stamford or NYC. House is currently fully furnished. Unfurnished is possible with 1+ year lease. The bright open layout features hardwood floors throughout, detailed millwork, and a spacious kitchen with Viking and Miele appliances, custom cabinetry, and honed granite countertops. The heart of the home flows seamlessly into the main living areas, including a living room, dedicated dining room, and family room complete with a wood-burning fireplace. A convenient mudroom and powder room complete the first floor. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a spacious oversized bath and two walk-in closets. Three additional bedrooms include one en-suite bedroom, while the other two are connected by a Jack-and-Jill bathroom. The finished walk-up third floor with an updated full bath provides a private and flexible space for work, recreation, or guests. Plus a full finished basement provides the perfect playroom, home gym, movie watching, and extra space. Detached two-car garage provides ample storage. Set on a flat, usable property with wonderful outdoor space, this is a rare opportunity on one of Darien's most beloved streets in the coveted Hindley Elementary School district.

Perfectly positioned at the entrance of a highly sought-after cul-de-sac, this home combines timeless design with modern comfort. A spacious two-story foyer welcomes you upon entry, featuring a sweeping staircase and dramatic ceiling heights. Bathed in natural light, the sun-filled interiors showcase elegant architectural details and a thoughtfully designed, flexible layout suited for today's lifestyle. The heart of the home is the open-concept kitchen and family room, anchored by a gas fireplace-ideal for both everyday living and effortless entertaining. French doors lead to a covered deck overlooking a level, private backyard featuring a heated gunite pool with an electronic safety cover. The formal dining room is enhanced by a wet bar and beverage refrigerator, creating an inviting space for hosting. A dedicated home office offers a quiet retreat for work or study. Upstairs, a spacious bonus room provides versatility as a recreation room, playroom, or sleepover space. Two substantial bonus rooms offer endless possibilities for a fitness studio, media lounge, or recreation space. Outdoors, the expansive stone patio and level grounds are as rare as they are beautiful, offering ample room for entertaining and recreation.

This storybook charmer sits on a rare half acre of flat, dry land directly abutting Woodland Park, creating a setting that feels both private and enchanting. The four-bedroom, two-and-a-half bath layout offers great flow, with the kitchen opening to the family room and a classic dining and living room arrangement anchored by a fireplace. All of this in one of Darien's most beloved neighborhoods, walkable to schools, train, and shopping.

listings.remarks: Set on two private acres in coveted northern Darien, this exceptional Colonial offers refined living, timeless design, and superior craftsmanship throughout. A gracious living room with fireplace provides a warm and sophisticated gathering space, while the formal dining room is perfectly complemented by an adjacent butler's pantry, ideal for seamless entertaining. A richly appointed study/library with its own fireplace offers a quiet and distinguished retreat.At the heart of the home, the expansive kitchen and family room open effortlessly to the spectacular outdoor living areas, creating the perfect setting for both everyday living and large-scale entertaining. Outside, the grounds have been transformed into a true private retreat featuring a pool, renovated pool house, outdoor kitchen, BBQ pit, pergola and fire pit - offering an exceptional backdrop for entertaining and year-round enjoyment. The fully remodeled lower level is thoughtfully designed for recreation and relaxation, featuring a custom theater room, walk-in wine cellar, and luxurious sauna. This remarkable property seamlessly combines luxury, comfort, and modern functionality in one of Darien's most desirable locations.

Set on 1.66 level, lushly wooded acres along Stony Brook, 6 Blueberry Lane is the rare offering in central Darien: a storied 1950 home beautifully reimagined for today's lifestyle. The bones of a quiet, classic property - generous lot, brook frontage, and a coveted location moments from town, train, and the Sound.  Ceilings have been raised throughout, giving the principal living spaces the volume and light buyers expect at this tier - an instant departure from the typical mid-century cottage feel. The heart of the home is a stunning kitchen built for cooks who actually cook. Sub-Zero refrigerator and Wolf oven/range anchor a space tailored for both daily family life & entertaining at scale, w/custom cabinetry, generous prep surfaces, and a layout that flows seamlessly into the adjacent gathering rooms and out to the property. The original wood-burning fireplace remains - one of the few period notes intentionally preserved, and the room you'll instinctively reach for on a cool fall evening. Three bedrooms and two-and-a-half baths are configured for ease and privacy, with the addition of a brand-new powder room solving the single most common gripe buyers have with vintage Darien homes of this size.  1.66 level acres on Stony Brook is an exceedingly rare lot profile in this pocket of Darien w/room for a pool, a sport court or simply privacy & birdsong. Minutes from Darien schools, Metro-North stations, town beaches & downtown.  Turnkey!

Charming turn-key home in Darien. This 3 bedroom, 2 full bath property was fully renovated with high end finishes throughout in 2020. The centrally located eat-in kitchen opens to dining area with vaulted ceiling and family room. A fully finished basement offers a mudroom, extra living space and office. Conveniently located within walking distance to the brand new Darien Commons shops and restaurants, Noroton Heights train station and McGuane Park. Only 2 miles to both town beaches.

Nestled at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in Darien's sought-after Tokeneke School District, this beautifully renovated and expanded six-bedroom home offers exceptional living inside and out. Renovated in 2015, the home features a stunning gourmet eat-in kitchen with top-of-the-line appliances, two oversized islands with quartzite countertops, soaring ceilings, and skylights and oversized windows that fill the space with natural light. The adjacent family room with a gas fireplace creates the perfect setting for both everyday living and entertaining. Enjoy seamless indoor-outdoor living with a spacious deck, outdoor fireplace, and private fenced backyard. Conveniently located just minutes from the Darien train station, shopping, restaurants, Costco, Wegmans, and all the amenities Darien has to offer.

Tucked in the heart of Darien's coveted Noroton Manor neighborhood, this timeless 1926 home is filled with warmth, character, and endless potential. Set on a beautiful flat half-acre with a detached garage, the property offers the perfect blend of charm, space, and opportunity in one of Darien's most beloved locations, just moments from Weed Beach and Great Island. From the moment you step into the inviting foyer, the home unfolds with an exceptional circular floor plan designed for both everyday living and effortless entertaining. A spacious eat-in kitchen opens beautifully into the surrounding living spaces, while the oversized living room, formal dining room, family room, and dedicated office create an ideal balance of openness and privacy. Upstairs, four bedrooms and two full baths are thoughtfully spread across the second and third floors, offering wonderful flexibility for family, guests, work-from-home space, or future expansion possibilities. Outside, the expansive yard provides endless room to play, gather, garden, or simply enjoy the peaceful setting. Residents of the Noroton Manor Association enjoy access to two Har-Tru tennis courts, a private sandy beach, and water access to Holly Pond - an incredibly special lifestyle amenity woven into this cherished coastal community. Rich with original character and architectural charm, this is the kind of home that rarely comes to market.

This is the one you've been waiting for! Don't miss your chance to own on one of Darien's most sought-after streets. This beautifully updated Colonial truly has it all-just over 3,600 sf, 4 BR, and 4.5 BTH, with a bright, open layout and fantastic flow that makes everyday living and entertaining effortless. A welcoming foyer leads to a flexible office/playroom then opens into spacious open concept living and dining area designed for gathering. Hardwood floors, high-end appliances, recessed lighting, designer fixtures, and freshly painted interior and kitchen make this home completely move-in ready. The walk-out lower level is a game changer-fully renovated with a full bath and wet bar, perfect for a media room, gym, guest space, movie night or whatever your needs. Plenty of storage throughout, plus, brand new HVAC systems (2025) with warranty mean peace of mind from day one. Outside, the home continues to impress. Enjoy a new fully fenced yard (2023), a tiered blue stone patio, flat usable lawn, sprinkler system, and upgraded landscape lighting-all surrounded by mature landscaping for total privacy. Even better, the protected land behind the property means no future building-this peaceful setting isn't going anywhere. All this less than 10 mins from the Noroton Heights Train (55 mins to GC), Heights Crossing, schools, daycare, restaurants, coffee shops, Equinox, grocery stores, beaches, and the train - this home checks every box.

Storybook Cape nestled in one of Darien's most sought-after in-town neighborhoods. Ideally located just moments from downtown Darien's shops, restaurants, and train, this exceptional home combines timeless character with modern living in an unbeatable location.

A wonderful opportunity to enjoy a move-in-ready home in a highly convenient neighborhood.

Steeped in history and thoughtfully updated for modern living, this charming 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home seamlessly blends the character of its 1884 origins with today's conveniences. Relax on the welcoming front porch overlooking the picturesque tree-lined street, or unwind in the private backyard featuring a peaceful patio-perfect for summer gatherings, morning coffee, or quiet evenings outdoors. The beautifully renovated kitchen, updated just three years ago, features stylish finishes, modern appliances, and a functional layout that opens to the spacious family room. Adding to the home's appeal is a detached one-car garage with a studio apartment above-ideal for guests, an in-law or nanny suite, home office, creative studio, or potential rental income.  Ideally located just minutes from Rowayton Village, the train station, downtown Darien, and the shores of Long Island Sound, this home offers the perfect combination of historic charm, versatile living space and ideal location.

The dramatic great room showcases soaring 30-foot cathedral ceilings, exposed wood beams, an oversized picture window, and a classic fireplace anchoring the open living and dining spaces. The chic kitchen flows seamlessly for effortless entertaining and everyday living. A desirable first-floor primary suite opens directly to the bluestone patio, while two additional bedrooms upstairs include one with a private balcony. Walk to restaurants, shops, spas & gym. Laundry in unit. Don't miss your chance to live in this beautiful beachside community with the Top rated schools in Connecticut.

listings.remarks: Originally the sole residence on Wildcat Road, this distinguished 1925 stone manor blends timeless architectural elegance with a commanding setting. Located within Darien's coveted Delafield Island private association, the property is approached by a sweeping circular drive and surrounded by mature landscaping offering a rare sense of privacy, grandeur, and permanence, just minutes from downtown Darien, the Metro-North train, beaches, and Great Island.  Rich in character and craftsmanship, the residence showcases architectural details rarely found today, including soaring 12-foot ceilings, a dramatic circular staircase, five fireplaces, Juliet balconies, vintage servant bells, graceful arches, skylights, and a sun-filled glass solarium. Thoughtfully designed for both grand entertaining and comfortable everyday living, the spacious country kitchen opens to an expansive deck overlooking the surrounding natural landscape.  Adding to the property's exceptional appeal, several acres of protected land trust border the rear of the home, preserving a tranquil backdrop and enhancing the estate-like setting. Whether hosting family gatherings, entertaining guests, or simply enjoying the peace and beauty of its surroundings, 15 Wildcat Road offers a unique opportunity to own one of Delafield Island's most distinctive and historic homes.

Classic 5-bedroom center hall Colonial nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac in one of Darien's most convenient locations, just a short walk to school. Beautifully sited on a level lot, this meticulously maintained home offers the perfect balance of privacy, outdoor space, and timeless charm. Designed for today's lifestyle, the thoughtfully crafted floor plan flows effortlessly from room to room, while the screened porch and expansive deck create seamless indoor-outdoor living, ideal for year-round entertaining and everyday family life. Move-in ready, the home has been lovingly cared for and thoughtfully updated with numerous quality improvements, including a new high-efficiency boiler and a full whole-house generator for ultimate peace of mind. Enjoy the very best of Darien, with award-winning schools, beautiful beaches and parks, a vibrant downtown filled with exceptional shopping and dining, and convenient access to Metro-North and major highways. This exceptional, turnkey home offers the lifestyle today's buyers are seeking-a rare opportunity not to be missed.

Picture yourself in a welcoming, walkable community where neighbors become friends, evening strolls are part of everyday life, and parks, shops, and local amenities are just a short distance away. This meticulously maintained Colonial blends timeless charm with modern updates, offering a home that's as inviting as the neighborhood surrounding it. Set on a beautifully landscaped property with a sweeping lawn, this home has been beautifully renovated with stylish finishes throughout. The sun-filled main level features an eat-in kitchen, formal dining room, cozy living room with a fireplace, an office and a comfortable family room with French doors leading to a sunny deck. Upstairs along with a spa-inspired bath are 3 bedrooms including a primary bedroom with vaulted ceilings and a generous walk-in closet. The finished lower level offers a full bathroom/laundry room and versatile space for a home gym, playroom, or recreation room. If you're looking for entertaining space, the spacious deck provides room for bbq's, dining, and lounging with friends while overlooking the spacious, level and professionally landscaped and fenced lawn. Complete with a home generator and a two-car garage, this exceptional home delivers the perfect balance of historic character, modern comfort, and everyday convenience in a friendly, vibrant neighborhood you'll love coming home to.

Set on 2.19 private acres in a prime Darien location, 222 Brookside Road offers exceptional space, privacy, and opportunity just minutes from town and Cherry Lawn Park. With more than 7,000 square feet above grade, plus an additional 3,000 square feet on the lower level, this expansive 4-bedroom, 5.5-bath residence provides an incredible canvas to create a home tailored to your vision. Generously proportioned rooms and tall ceilings create a wonderful sense of scale throughout, while a flexible floor plan offers endless possibilities, including the potential for a first-floor in-law or guest suite. The exceptionally spacious lower level provides abundant room for entertaining, relaxing, and recreation. Outdoors, the expansive property is highlighted by a pool and well-appointed pool house featuring a full bath, laundry hookups, and full kitchen with a range and space for a refrigerator-creating a private setting for summer gatherings and relaxation. An attached four-car garage, plus an additional detached two-car garage, provides parking for six cars and even more flexibility. A rare opportunity to enjoy significant acreage, remarkable space, and endless potential in an incredibly convenient Darien location.

listings.remarks: New construction from foundation up and ready for 2026! On a coveted Darien cul-de-sac, this modern colonial boasts 6500sf of elegance and comfort. The custom kitchen is a true centerpiece, with a grand stone island, Thermador appliances, an oversized range, and abundant cabinetry. Surrounded by windows, the sunlit breakfast room flows effortlessly to the kitchen/great room, where a gas fireplace and beamed ceiling create warmth and character and flow out to an huge deck overlooking 1.2 private acres. A first-floor office with full bath offers flexibility for work, guests, or a quiet retreat. Everyday ease continues with a mudroom, half bath with stunning, floating quartz vanity, and an attached two-car garage. Upstairs, the primary suite is a serene escape with vaulted ceilings, a walk-in closet, and a private balcony overlooking the lush and private yard. Three additional en-suite bedrooms each feature custom walk-in closets, blending function with elegance. Welcome to 36 Richmond Drive! Tucked into a great Darien neighborhood, this three-bedroom, two-bath ranch is close to everything, bike to Cherry Lawn Park, walk to local shops and restaurants, or hop on the train in minutes. Inside, you'll find a lower level that's perfect for hanging out, with a playroom, bar, and a cozy wood-burning stove. Whether you're ready to update and make it your own, or you're looking for a project with great potential, this home is a terrific opportunity. All in the award-winning Ox Ridge Blue Ribbon School district!

Welcome to 20 Locust Hill Road, a stunning in-town, new construction opportunity in Darien, CT. This now completed modern colonial/farmhouse-style home, constructed by an experienced builder renowned for high-end residential properties throughout Fairfield County, offers 5 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms, and an expansive 4,897 square feet of living space. Situated on a generous .50 acre in-town lot, this home provides ample space for comfortable living and entertaining. Upon entering, you'll be greeted by the spacious layout, featuring a thoughtful floor plan with an abundance of natural light and high-end finishes. The main level boasts a chef's eat-in kitchen with top-of-the-line appliances, a welcoming family room, formal dining room and home office plus a convenient 3-car attached garage. Upstairs, the sumptuous primary bedroom suite with his & her walk-in closets, creates a serene retreat. 4 additional generously sized bedrooms, a bonus room and an oversized laundry room round out the two upper level offerings. Located near the new Corbin Drive Downtown Darien Development, this home offers easy access to a range of amenities, including both town beaches. Don't miss the chance to make this exceptional property your own.

Welcome to 142 Brookside, a beautifully updated and partially furnished rental where timeless style meets modern convenience. This spacious 5-bedroom home features beautifully modernized finishes throughout, including gleaming hardwood floors, and fresh and inviting decor. The open-concept kitchen is equipped with all updated high-end appliances and flows seamlessly into bright living and dining spaces-perfect for both relaxing and entertaining. Upstairs, you'll find generous bedrooms with stylish furnishings and ample closet space. Outside, enjoy a spacious landscaped front & back yard providing ample room for entertaining or unwinding outside. Conveniently located close to town, schools, parks, and transportation, 142 Brookside combines turnkey living with a warm, contemporary aesthetic-just unpack and settle in!

(Don't miss the spectacular waterfront video). On the water in the Tokeneke Association, Short Rocks Manor is poised at the very tip of Arrowhead Way, high above Scotts Cove and Long Island Sound. This breathtaking, updated 1925 English-style stone manor sits on 2.11 acres which includes .362 acres of designated OPEN SPACE. The 5,823 square feet of exquisite craftmanship houses five bedrooms - including a private-entrance apartment perfect for guests or family. Up the circular drive, you enter through a private stone rose-filled courtyard into the fabulous foyer with fireplace and step in the soaring two-story great room with floor to ceiling windows of glass that open directly onto your waterfront terrace, with the cove and Sound shimmering beyond. Every principal room has been oriented to capture the water. The primary bedroom suite window wall overlooks the ever-changing beauty of the sea. The kitchen leads to a private patio. Acres of landscaped gardens unfold across multiple levels, a private swimming pool is nestled within its own secluded garden sanctuary, and a whimsical Fairy Path winds upward to a hidden garden perched high above the cove creating a bird and wildlife sanctuary. The separate viewing terrace overlooks the water and your own private dock and is perfect for evening cocktails or simply watching the sun set over Long Island Sound. This home and property are rare. Make it your own.

Peace, Privacy, and Timeless Elegance in Darien Discover the perfect antidote to busy life in this beautifully refreshed, custom-built colonial. Step into a grand two-story foyer with herringbone oak floors, leading to formal spaces rich in architectural detail-including a step-down living room with a fireplace, a private library, and a formal dining room featuring elegant custom paneling. The heart of the home is the gourmet kitchen, equipped with custom inset cabinetry, premium stainless appliances, and a walk-in pantry, opening seamlessly to a dramatic step-down family room with a fieldstone fireplace.
