A masterful renovation by architect Peter Pennoyer preserves the home's historic integrity while introducing refined, livable spaces. Interiors by acclaimed designer Katie Ridder bring a fresh yet classic sensibility, blending color, texture, and bespoke detail throughout. The main residence offers 7 bedrooms and 6 full baths, anchored by five fireplaces that add warmth and character across its gracious living spaces. A classic carriage house offers a fully equipped 2-bedroom, 1-bath guest residence with its own kitchen, providing exceptional flexibility-ideal for extended stays, in-law living, or a private home office retreat. The grounds, designed by renowned landscape architect Janice Parker, are a true highlight-lush, structured, and beautifully layered for year-round interest. An in-ground saltwater pool completes the estate-like setting, creating a private retreat perfect for both entertaining and quiet enjoyment. Rich in history and elevated by a world-class design team, 16 East Trail offers a rare opportunity to own a piece of Darien's architectural legacy-seamlessly tailored for modern living.

The formal living room, w/classic wood-burning fireplace, is complemented by a handsome library w/fireplace and wet bar, while an elegant dining room, detailed w/wainscoting and custom built-ins, sets the stage for memorable gatherings. At the heart of the home, a gourmet kitchen with custom cabinetry and oversized island flows into a sun-drenched family room w/fireplace and a wall of glass opening to the expansive terrace - perfect for indoor/outdoor entertaining. The luxurious primary suite features generous walk-in closets and spa-like bath with dual vanities, soaking tub and radiant-heated floors. Four additional bedrooms each enjoy private baths. A separate wing with bedroom, bath and playroom offers an ideal retreat for guests. Additional amenities include a private vaulted-ceiling office, first-floor gym, mudroom, laundry, two-car garage and generator. Beyond the interiors lies a secluded oasis: a level lawn, tranquil pond and fountain, charming footbridge, and secret garden, w/protected land-trust property beyond. A rare expression of privacy, beauty, space, and enduring distinction

Andersen A-Series windows, glass railings, refined finishes create bright, elegant living spaces. The bluestone patio provides an inviting outdoor retreat.The flexible layout includes four ensuite bedrooms, a luxurious primary suite featuring a spacious walk-in closet, spa-inspired bath, and private balcony with water views. A first-floor bedroom with private access and a finished lower level with a separate entrance offer versatility for guests, extended family, or a home office.At the heart of the home, a chef's kitchen is anchored by an oversized quartz island and appointed with Sub-Zero, Wolf, Cove, and Kohler fixtures. Additional highlights include second-floor laundry, a detached garage, pre-wired audio and security systems, underground utilities, whole-house generator connection, and modern mechanical systems.An exceptional opportunity to enjoy the convenience of new construction in one of Darien's premier locations. Deeded Noroton Bay Beach rights; buyers to verify.

listings.remarks: Beautifully renovated inside and out. This home features extensive exterior upgrades, including a new irrigation system, masonry steps and walkway, and lush new landscaping with tall trees creating a park-like setting. Step inside to discover a sparkling, brand-new kitchen, elegant full and half baths, and a spacious lower-level family room-perfect for entertaining. Additional highlights include top-of-the-line window treatments, a new heating and central air conditioning system, and a fully updated electrical system. A new laundry area with built-in storage adds convenience, while the expansive, oversized deck offers the privacy and serenity of a two-acre estate. Truly a must-see property that blends modern luxury with natural beauty. Arborvitae plantings on front lawn will be continued to end of fence.

PRICE NEGOTIABLE Ranch style unit with interior access to the basement where you have your storage, washer and dryer included (right of the bottom of the steps). You have an eat-in kitchen and/or dining area in the living room. Updated kitchen and bath with hardwood flooring throughout. Private two-car tandem parking on the left of the home between stone pillars. Landlord is responsible for regular yard maintenance, cleaning of snow from house to street. OIL HEAT INCLUDED. NO Pets; NO Smoking! NO Exceptions!

Escape to your perfect summer retreat in this stunning colonial home, where comfort, style, and tranquility come together seamlessly. Nestled at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, this spacious residence offers an ideal blend of privacy and convenience. Step inside and discover generous, light-filled rooms with gleaming hardwood floors throughout. Three fireplaces create a cozy ambiance, perfect for unwinding after a day of summer fun. The home boasts fantastic common spaces for relaxing and entertaining, while the lower level features a fully equipped playroom and gym to keep everyone active and happy. Outside, you'll find a heated pool surrounded by a lush, park-like setting-your own private oasis for sun-soaked afternoons and refreshing swims. Located just moments from main roadways, this retreat offers easy access to nearby shops and restaurants while feeling worlds away from the hustle and bustle. Available as a one-month summer rental, this home promises everything you need to create lasting memories. Don't miss the chance to experience this incredible getaway!

Discover serene living at 95 Louise's Lane, a modern oasis available for rent at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac. This stunning home offers breathtaking pond and river views, blending tranquility with proximity to vibrant downtown New Canaan and nearby Pound Ridge. Featuring 5 spacious bedrooms with nature-inspired views, this home is perfect for those seeking comfort and elegance. The open first-floor layout, with sleek white floors and walls framed by expansive windows, creates a bright and inviting space ideal for entertaining. Upstairs, a versatile great room with a loft is perfect for cozy movie nights or memorable gatherings. Outside, enjoy a private bluestone terrace and a refreshing dip in the cutting-edge modpool. Experience sophisticated rental living in a peaceful setting.

Super convenient In-town flexible term furnished rental. This is an opportunity to get to know what it's like to live in the wonderful town of New Canaan CT. Walk everywhere, enjoy living in the village center, new library complex, town pool, public tennis courts, Waveny Park with gardens & walking trails, Irwin Park, Kiwanis Park, farmers market, a plethora of gourmet alfresco dining options and so much more. Private front & back entry. Sunny great room with fireplace and sitting balcony. Spacious eat in kitchen. Three ensuite bedrooms and an office. On site 2-3 parking spaces. Walking distance to Metro North NYC express train & village.

Welcome to 40 Church Street. Where comfort meets chic. This thoughtfully updated home will lure you in with its warmth and charming details. The front porch and patio are the perfect setting for a summer barbecue. Enjoy the open floor plan, gourmet kitchen, three en-suite bedrooms and cozy family room. Ideally located in the heart of New Canaan. Just a short stroll to town center, parks, train and restaurants. THIS HOME IS AVAILABLE AS A SUMMER RENTAL or SHORT TERM - May 1st through October 31st. Renter responsible for monthly cleaning service. $10,000/month.

An extraordinary one of a kind loft in a posh enclave of town houses. Your private elevator opens to your fabulous loft overlooking the Village of New Canaan. Sophisticated open floor plan - for the pinnacle in modern living. This 2 bedroom, 2.5 bath Loft with gorgeous wide plank white oak floors, custom build-ins, fireplace with marble surround, designer chef's kitchen, ensuite baths with artisan cut marble counters, and primary bath with heated floors. Lofts have an incredible 1,000 sq/ft roof deck and lounge with kitchen, grill, and spaces perfect for entertaining, dining, and socializing! The loft has 2 reserved parking spaces. Incomparable location, just steps to top restaurants and the finest shopping in the prettiest New England village.

Live Your Best Life in the Heart of New Canaan... Imagine starting your morning with coffee on your private patio, then strolling into town for lunch or catching the train to the city - all without getting in your car. This is the effortless lifestyle waiting for you in this stunning, thoughtfully updated rental. Designed for Modern Living, This exceptional two-bedroom residence has been meticulously updated with today's discerning renter in mind. Each spacious bedroom features its own luxurious en-suite bathroom and generous walk-in closet - no more sharing space or schedules. The convenience of an in-unit laundry room means no more lugging baskets to a common area or planning your life around laundry day. Seamless Indoor-Outdoor - Flow Step through your separate mudroom entrance-perfect for keeping the rest of your home pristine-and enjoy your own private patio, an outdoor sanctuary ideal for morning coffee, evening wine, or weekend entertaining. It's your personal retreat right outside your door. Location, Location, Lifestyle... The true luxury here is location. Walking distance to New Canaan's charming downtown, the train station, and premier shopping means everything you need is just steps away. Skip the car, embrace the walkability, and enjoy the kind of convenient, connected lifestyle that's increasingly rare to find.  This isn't just a rental-it's your new New Canaan lifestyle.

Welcome to this charming house. 680 Weed Street is a hidden gem in one of New Canaan's most desirable neighborhoods! This beautifully maintained home offers the perfect blend of classic New England charm and modern comfort, surrounded by lush greenery, a perfectly sited pool, and hot tub. All this located just steps from downtown New Canaan, parks and the train station A sun-filled living spaces, beautiful hardwood floors with an inviting layout are ideal for everyday living and entertaining!   Features include an expansive first floor primary suite with his and her bathrooms and large walk-in closets! Also included are: three additional bedrooms, two with en-suite bathrooms. The family room and dining room adjoin the kitchen making it ideal for family living and entertaining. The sunroom with wet bar, overlooks the heated gunite pool, hot tub and private back yard.   The serenity of the beautifully landscaped grounds provides a complete sense of privacy within walking distance to town.  Central air, a large basement/flex space, attached two car garage and ample storage throughout are included.  Additional opportunity! On property is a restored carriage house which could be a home office, or for gatherings or additional storage space. ($2,000 additional per month.)

listings.remarks: Beyond a private gated entrance and sweeping circular drive lies a 2.5-acre sanctuary that redefines New Canaan luxury. Originally envisioned by Douglas Carter Architects and recently reimagined by its designer-owner, this estate seamlessly merges architectural pedigree with contemporary soul. The residence spans four finished levels, where soaring ceilings and walls of glass invite the lush landscape inside. At the heart of the home, a newly updated gourmet kitchen serves as a culinary showpiece. The primary suite is a true retreat, offering a private balcony, fireplace, and the rare luxury of dual bathrooms. Each of the six bedrooms in the main house features an ensuite bath, ensuring absolute privacy for family and guests alike. The amenities rival the world's finest resorts: a walk-out lower level equipped with a theater and wine room, and a 30x50 lagoon-style pool. The 2020-built pool house (700+ sq. ft.) provides a full guest experience with its own kitchen, bath, and flexible sleeping quarters-all just five minutes from the boutiques and bistros of New Canaan's vibrant village center.

A 1920s Treasure with Park Views and a Walk-to-Everything Lifestyle!     This enchanting 1920s Dutch Colonial Townhouse has been meticulously renovated, offering the best of both worlds: the enduring grace of historic architecture paired with the ease and style of contemporary amenities.  Set directly across from Mead Park, the property enjoys serene, tree-lined views of the sparkling trout-stocked lake. Morning walks, summer picnics, or a casual game of tennis or pickleball are just steps from your front door, bringing the park's natural beauty and vibrant energy into your everyday life.   Inside, sunlight streams through thoughtfully updated interiors that balance warmth and elegance. With three bedrooms (currently configured as two bedrooms plus a versatile office/media room), the home offers flexibility to suit your lifestyle-whether you're working from home, hosting guests, or simply seeking a quiet retreat.   The location is as convenient as it is idyllic. Just a four-minute stroll brings you to the New Canaan train station, known affectionately as "the next station to heaven." From there, you're guaranteed a seat for the just-over-an-hour ride to Grand Central Terminal--a rare luxury for commuters and city lovers alike.   Whether you're drawn by the home's classic architecture, the vibrant neighborhood, or the seamless commute, 89 Richmond Hill offers the best of New Canaan living-all wrapped in effortless charm and updated style.

Sustainable Chic Meets Village Charm: The Ultimate New Canaan duplex - Discover the perfect fusion of eco-conscious innovation and high-end sophistication in this 1,640+ sq. ft. bespoke residence at The Quartier. This sun-drenched, duplex features a private entrance with a front terrace, 7" white oak flooring, and an expansive open-concept great room anchored by a gourmet chef's kitchen with Leicht cabinetry and quartzite surfaces. While the en-suite primary retreat offers a spa-like escape, the building itself serves as a five-star sanctuary, boasting sustainable solar energy, a full-time concierge, a state-of-the-art golf simulator, entertainment lounge with catering kitchen and a professional fitness studio. Whether you're hosting at the outdoor firepit or heading to the nearby NYC train, this 2-bedroom gem puts world-class dining and boutique shopping right at your doorstep-offering a lifestyle of "white-glove" convenience in the heart of New Canaan.

listings.remarks: Discover boutique-style living at Husted Commons, where timeless elegance meets contemporary design in a prime downtown New Canaan location, just 50 miles from NYC. Enjoy easy access to the Metro-North train station, Main and Elm streets, and a wide array of retail and dining options. This distinctive new complex built in 2024 features 12 residences, offering one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and two-bedroom loft options. The loft residences feature private rooftop decks. Each unique residence boasts open layouts that flood with natural light, soaring 9+ foot ceilings, and beautiful white oak flooring. Experience chef-inspired kitchens equipped with custom cabinetry, premium appliances, and quartz countertops. Master bedroom suites are designed for comfort, complemented by bathrooms with heated floors. Enjoy the benefits of smart home technology, in-residence washers and dryers, private security system, and custom solar shades for added convenience. Husted Commons also features elevator service, private balconies or terraces in select residences, reserved underground and courtyard parking for two cars with car charging stations, and inviting outdoor green spaces, making it the ideal choice for in-town living!

Your Private 7-Acre Summer Resort on the Silvermine River - Trade the ordinary for an extraordinary summer at 637 Valley Road, a sprawling 12,000-square-foot stone estate where "vacation mode" is the only setting. Whether you're perfecting your serve on the private tennis court, hosting legendary poolside barbecues on the bluestone patios, or winding down with s'mores at the oversized fire pit, this 7-acre park-like playground is built for sun-drenched memories. Inside, the luxury is just as effortless, featuring eight cozy fireplaces for cool riverfront evenings, a billiards room for rainy-day tournaments, and a sleek chef's kitchen ready for farm-to-table feasts. With a separate guest wing and a charming detached cottage, you'll have plenty of room to host the whole crew. Located just minutes from the Long Island Sound and the train, this is more than a rental-it's your own private country club for the season.

listings.remarks: Gracious center hall colonial set back from road. Living room, family room and primary bedroom have fireplaces. A large, eat-in country kitchen walks out to a lovely, private terrace and in-ground pool. Family room opens out to a cozy screened porch with fireplace. Spacious dining room, office, sunroom plus 5 bedrooms. Walk-up attic for storage, basement playroom and a 3-car garage. Owners will be responsible for lawn mowing.

This charming story book French country house nestled on 2.96 acres with terraces, patios and in-ground free form pool make this home the perfect retreat. An open floorplan with many gathering areas in living room, media room, and family room make it a perfect home for both entertaining guests and enjoying private living. The home is drenched in natural sunlight from the many windows and skylights throughout. The kitchen features a butler's pantry. Step up from the kitchen to dance the night away in the "disco ball" room while the fires are blazing in the living room and media room. 3 bedrooms and 2 baths are included on the second level while the main level features a guest suite and bath. Above the two-car garage is a modern and spacious home office equipped with heat and air conditioning making the perfect work from home setup. This property is conveniently located minutes from the town of New Canaan. Whole house audiophile-grade audio system. Level-two EV charger in garage. ADT Alarm with exterior cameras. 6 zone HVAC system. High speed fiber optic internet with whole house WiFi mesh system. Option for furnished or semi-furnished. Listing ID 24173427 is for Summer rental only.

Spacious 1 bedroom apartment in town. Close to train, shopping and restaurants. Well maintained complex with easy parking, laundry and storage on premises. Two pools on premises, heat and hot water included.

This bright and airy two-bedroom duplex spans two levels and offers picturesque views of Main Street. Fully reimagined through a complete gut renovation, the residence seamlessly blends modern design, exceptional comfort, and top-tier energy efficiency.  The sun-filled open-concept layout features gleaming white oak floors, expansive windows, quartz countertops, and a sleek Bosch stainless steel appliance suite. Both bedrooms offer beautifully appointed ensuite, spa-inspired bathrooms, while additional highlights include a home office space, recessed lighting throughout, and a charming private porch. Ideally situated in the heart of town, this exceptional home is just moments from acclaimed restaurants, boutique shopping, the commuter express train, and the very best of in-town living.

Welcome to this stately, sun-filled brick townhome, built by renowned builder the late Archie Stewart, celebrated for quality construction, generous room sizes, and exceptional storage. Tucked within a quiet, private enclave, this residence offers an ideal blend of classic charm and everyday convenience. The spacious living room, centered around a fireplace, opens directly to a private patio, perfect for outdoor dining, relaxing, or entertaining. Upstairs, you'll find two large ensuite bedrooms, including a gracious primary suite, both featuring abundant closet space, plus the ease of second-floor laundry. Additional highlights include a full walk-up attic, full basement, central air conditioning, central vacuum, and a security system. Extra parking is available in the St. A's parking lot. Best of all, you're just a stone's throw from New Canaan's unique shops, award-winning restaurants, and the Metro-North train. A rare opportunity for comfortable, low-maintenance living with space, light, and storage to spare, right near the village of New Canaan. St. Aloysius' priests live in the adjacent unit. Small dog ok.

Spacious 1 bedroom apartment in town. Close to train, shopping and restaurants. Well maintained complex with easy parking, laundry and storage on premises. Two pools on premises, heat and hot water included.

This exquisite 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath home with elevator is ideally located directly in the heart of New Canaan, offering true in-town living with shops, restaurants, train station, and everyday amenities right at your fingertips. Meticulously designed and crafted by a renowned local builder, this residence offers a fresh, like-new feel throughout with an open-concept floor plan, 9-foot ceilings, 4 impeccably finished levels, and abundant natural light. At the center of the home is a stunning chef's kitchen featuring premium Thermador appliances, quartz counters, custom cabinetry, generous prep space, and bar area with wine cooler. The main level flows beautifully between the kitchen, dining, and living areas, highlighted by a gas/wood fireplace and refined finishes throughout. Additional features include a 2-car garage, custom elevator, generator, security system, and beautifully landscaped and fenced-in yard with patio and underground sprinklers. The primary suite features a walk-in closet with built-ins and a spa-like bath with soaking tub. Each additional bedroom is thoughtfully designed with ample closet space, and the finished 4th floor and lower level provide versatile spaces for an office, gym, playroom, guest area, or media room. Whether hosting gatherings or enjoying everyday life, this home delivers the best of New Canaan living right at your doorstep.

This special property offers many lovely outdoor spaces to enjoy, the inviting covered porch, complete with Adirondack chairs and dining, convenient stone terrace with wood burning fire pit and of course, poolside relaxation. Four additional fireplaces, including the private wood panelled study, library, living room and primary suite.  The primary suite has tray ceilings, door to deck, lovely bath and a handsome fireplace. There are 3 additional bedrooms (one ensuite) and two baths on the second floor. On the third floor, two more delightful bedrooms and bath, ideal for guests or a quiet getaway.   Enjoy a peaceful summer in New Canaan on Hemlock Hill!

Poised at the end of a private Lane with gated entry high atop 3.8 professionally landscaped acres, this estate is a rare nature sanctuary just minutes from the heart of town. Exceptional Craftsmanship: Built to endure, this steel-reinforced residence features a classic brick exterior and a 100-year slate roof. Inside, the 7,300 SF floor plan is grand and light-filled, offering a flexible layout perfect for a multi-generational lifestyle. Soaring 10-foot ceilings define the spacious interiors, which include 6 generous en-suite bedrooms and 3 dedicated home offices and a library designed for the modern professional. Outdoor Oasis: The park-like grounds are anchored by a 50' x 20' heated pool with an electric cover and a professional-grade greenhouse-perfect for year-round horticultural pursuits. Utility & Security: Every convenience is considered, featuring a 5-car heated garage and a full-house automatic generator for seamless, year-round comfort and peace of mind. Unrivaled Location: Experience the serenity of a private retreat with the convenient sought after neighborhood location.

Luxury New Construction in the Heart of New Canaan!    Experience the finest in modern living with this exceptional new home by Kaeser Custom Homes, renowned for quality craftsmanship and timeless design. Ideally situated near Mead Memorial Park and Bristow Bird Sanctuary, this elegant residence offers the perfect blend of nature, convenience, and luxury-with sidewalk access to town for ultimate enjoyment.   Spanning over 6,600 square feet across four beautifully finished levels, this 5 ensuite bedroom, 6 full and 2 half-bath masterpiece is thoughtfully designed for both everyday living and stylish entertaining.   Highlights include:  Gourmet chef's kitchen with top-tier appliances opens to a spacious family room with a fireplace.  Luxurious primary suite with fireplace, spa-like bath and walk-in closet. Private home office, formal dining, and flexible living spaces. Finished lower level ideal for a gym, media room, or golf simulator.   Set on a picturesque lot with professionally landscaped grounds, this home is a rare opportunity to own a newly built property in one of New Canaan's in-town neighborhoods. Pool Site Permit has been approved!

This stately Colonial home, featuring six bedrooms and six full bathrooms plus three half baths, offers an impressive blend of elegance and comfort. Upon arrival, you are greeted by beautiful landscaping and meticulously maintained gardens, setting a tranquil tone for the entire property. The entryway immediately captivates with its twin staircases and a soaring ceiling, creating a dramatic and welcoming first impression for guests and residents alike. Designed with ample room for everyone, the home boasts a comfortable living room perfect for relaxation, an inviting solarium filled with natural light, a chef's kitchen ideal for culinary pursuits, and a generous family room that serves as a central gathering space. During the summer months, enjoy leisurely days by the pool or savor picturesque sunsets from the comfort of the screened porch, making outdoor living a delightful experience. With four fully finished floors, this home provides all the space and amenities needed to accommodate contemporary living in style and comfort. Sale is subject to Probate Court Approval.

Beautifully maintained three-bedroom split-level home offering refined yet comfortable living. Highlights include an elegant living room with fireplace, a spectacular sunroom wrapped in three walls of windows, a private den, and a fully finished lower level. Exceptional flexibility for both everyday living and entertaining, enhanced by a stunning custom-built terrace overlooking a serene, tree-lined property. Ideally situated near New Canaan and Wilton, just minutes to top schools, shopping, dining, the New Canaan train station, and The Lake Club.

Welcome to 199 Mariomi road, a modern colonial/farmhouse set on 2 acres. Four finished levels offer a generous living space with high - end kitchen, first floor bedroom with full bathroom and an office with attached deck. Large blue stone patio with build in grill is ready for outdoor entertaining. Glass staircase railing leads to the second floor where large master suite with walk in closet awaits you. Three additional bedrooms and two full bathrooms provide a comfort and space for family and guests. The walk up finished attic offers additional space for gym, playroom or office. The walk out 1179sf lower lever is ideal for a gym, playroom or a media room.

This enchanting stone home is on the market for the first time in 40 years. It is in the heart of downtown New Canaan presenting a rare opportunity to embrace a property rich in character. Nestled on nearly half an acre of meticulously landscaped grounds, this charming colonial offers a private and tranquil atmosphere just a short stroll from the vibrant town center. Over the years, certain areas of the home have been beautifully updated and maintained, while other areas may benefit from renovation. The home being sold "as is" spans 3,557 square feet across three levels, the generous first floor layout features a comfortably sized living and dining room filled with charm, leading to a well-equipped open-concept kitchen and a spacious family room with glass doors that open onto secluded patio areas. A first-floor full bath completes the main level. The second floor hosts the primary suite with a full bathroom, two additional bedrooms, and another full bath. The third floor can be utilized as extra sleeping quarters or office space. This property is enhanced by a detached oversized three-car garage which also includes a large loft above boasting over 700 square feet of unfinished space. It is a blank slate, ready to be transformed into additional living, work or studio space. This home is a unique gem in New Canaan, with immense potential to become a cherished town icon.

Refined Colonial: A 4-Acre Private Sanctuary of Classic Elegance & Modern Luxury. Experience the perfect harmony of timeless Colonial architecture and contemporary luxury in this spacious 4,000+ SF home. Nestled on 4 lush, private acres within the prime, sought-after West Road estate area, this property offers a true sanctuary of nature without sacrificing a moment of modern convenience. Step Inside to Light-Filled Living. The interior flows effortlessly into the heart of the home: a stunningly refreshed chef's kitchen. Reimagined for 2025, this culinary space is designed for both casual living and grand-scale entertaining, featuring: dual islands & sinks: offering maximum prep space and utility.Brand-new quartz countertops, a modern tile backsplash, and a high-end cooktop. Sun-Drenched Breakfast Nook: A windowed corner perfect for peaceful morning coffee.This home has elegant and versatile Living spaces. The home's layout provides both formal and relaxed areas for every occasion: Grand family room: features dramatic vaulted ceilings, custom built-ins, bookshelves, and a cozy fireplace. Formal living room is a sophisticated retreat with a fireplace flanked by elegant built-ins and bookshelves; sliders provide access to the serene back yard. Nature-inspired dining room: Host dinner parties surrounded by floor-to-ceiling windows that perfectly frame the property's natural views.

Welcome to this bright and inviting two-bedroom townhouse ideally located in the desirable Heritage Hill community. This light-filled home features a spacious living room that opens to your own private terrace-perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxation. Enjoy modern comfort with new windows installed in 2020, in-unit laundry on the lower level, and 1 full and 1 half bath designed for convenience. Heritage Hill offers a tranquil setting with beautifully maintained grounds and two sparkling swimming pools for residents to enjoy during the warmer months. Whether you're a first-time homebuyer, down sizing, or simply looking for easy, maintenance-free living close to downtown New Canaan's shops and restaurants, this lovely home has it all. Don't miss this opportunity to own in one of New Canaan's most desirable townhouse communities! Special plantings to the left and right of the front door are Taxus Baccata, and Irish Yew that the current owner had planted.

Renovated stone and shingle home, offering an abundance of character and modern amenities in a prime Main Street location. The residence features four finished levels with 5 bedrooms and 4 full baths, including a finished basement suitable for a playroom or gym. Perfectly sited on a large .56-acre in-town lot, the property includes a private backyard with an identified pool site.  This home was renovated by SILWEL in 2022 and has been further updated by the current owner. The ideal location includes sidewalks, making it an easy walk to the train, village center, schools, and parks, providing convenient access to everything New Canaan has to offer.

Nestled on 2+ beautifully landscaped acres with a spectacular heated in-ground pool, this exceptional Colonial has been completely renovated to the highest standards, offering the perfect blend of timeless elegance & modern luxury. Thoughtfully redesigned inside & out, every major component has been updated, including the roof, siding, windows, mechanical systems, & generator, providing true turnkey living. Designed for both everyday comfort & effortless entertaining, the home features a modern, flowing floor plan w/sun-filled living spaces & seamless transitions throughout. At its heart is a beautifully appointed kitchen that opens to inviting gathering areas and outdoor living spaces, creating the ideal setting for family & friends. The lux primary suite serves as a private retreat, highlighted by a spa-worthy marble bath with sophisticated finishes & timeless appeal. Step outside to your own backyard oasis featuring the impressive heated pool, expansive entertaining patios & professionally designed landscaping providing exceptional beauty and privacy throughout the seasons. Whether hosting large gatherings or enjoying a quiet evening at home, the outdoor living experience is second to none. Car enthusiasts, hobbyists, & collectors will appreciate the custom outfitted oversized 2.5-car garage offering for vehicles, storage, & workspace. Rarely does a home of this quality, condition & setting become available. Simply move in & enjoy the very best of New Canaan Living!

Welcome home to this fabulous condo in Downtown Stamford! Filled with natural light, this large one bedroom, one bathroom unit has everything. Enjoy a generous sized living room that can also easily accommodate a desk and/or table. The kitchen has ample counter space with a built in bar alongside plenty of cabinets. The bathroom has been completely renovated featuring new floors, wall tile and vanity. The complex is ideally situated close to everything including Scalzi Park, Starbucks, LA Fitness, Stop and Shop and more. Schedule a tour to see this beautiful unit today!

In the Heart of New Canaan, enjoy the best of "in-town living" with this lovely refreshed 2-bedroom condo, ideally located directly across from Mead Park. Start your mornings with a peaceful walk in the park and take advantage of everything this vibrant neighborhood has to offer: close to New Canaan Train Station, local shops, restaurants, and grocery stores, this home offers unmatched convenience for commuters and those who love being close to everything! Freshly painted, the home feels bright, clean, and move-in ready. Enjoy the ease of first-floor living with both a front and back door, providing easy access to your parking spot. HEAT and WATER are INCLUDED in the rent, adding extra value and comfort. A rare opportunity to enjoy a prime location, modern updates and effortless living, right in the center of charming New Canaan. Photos coming soon...

Experience elevated living in the heart of downtown New Canaan with this exquisite boutique enclave offering just 7 luxury residences. Built with the best finishes in mind, this home features 2,954 sq ft of finished space, Elevator, large-pane oversized windows, and a thoughtfully designed layout that centers around your gourmet kitchen featuring custom cabinetry, gorgeous island with 2" countertops, chefs appliances, and breakfast area that opens to the family room with gas fireplace and sliders overlooking the fabulous terrace creating the perfect indoor/outdoor living experience. Exquisite mill work, white oak floors, custom staircases, and built-ins truly show meticulous attention to detail. Absolutely spectacular primary bedroom with walk-in closet, and spa inspired bathroom that will take your breath away featuring a 8ft x 4ft walk in shower, soaking tub, floating vanity, and heated floors. Take the elevator or stairs to the finished 3rd floor and enjoy sunsets from your private rooftop deck overlooking Mead Park. "The Enclave on Richmond" offers privacy, elegance, and convenience with just a few steps to New Canaan's shops, restaurants, and Metro-North station. Truly a one-of-a-kind residence.

Behind the gates of the once star-studded estate lies a rare opportunity to create a legacy property in one of New Canaan's most peaceful and desirable settings. Part of the former storied estate once associated with famous actors, musicians, and industrialists, the property carries a sense of history and character rarely found in today's land offerings.   Set on over four flat acres with mature trees, this unique property offers an increasingly rare combination of privacy and beauty minutes from downtown New Canaan, NYC train service, and walkable to nearby Clubs.  The land itself is the true standout: level, framed by large mature trees, creating an ideal canvas for a homesite that has been approved for a six-bedroom septic system. Electric utility infrastructure has been installed, significantly shortening the path toward development.  An added perk is a Nature walking trail through recently restored acre of improved wetlands  Unlike a typical land offering, buyers have the opportunity to collaborate with an experienced builder/design team to help streamline the process. Options may include building a fully custom residence or working from thoughtfully developed architectural concepts tailored specifically for the property and setting. Part of a limited collection of estate homesites that will ultimately define one of New Canaan's most compelling settings.

listings.remarks: 190 Brookwood Lane is set in one of New Canaan's most unique and desirable residential settings - a bucolic landscape of rolling meadows, mature woodlands, and gently flowing streams set on just over 3 acres of quintessential New England beauty. Situated in the heart of New Canaan, the property offers a peaceful and established neighborhood setting where quiet roads, mature trees, and estate-scale properties create an atmosphere increasingly difficult to replicate. This extraordinary proposed residence blends timeless New England architecture with refined modern living. Designed by Tanner White Architects as the quintessential New Canaan colonial with gracious proportions and exceptional scale, the home is envisioned with approximately 7,500 square feet across the first and second floors, including expansive entertaining spaces, dramatic 10-foot ceilings on the main level, generously scaled bedrooms, and seamless indoor-outdoor living throughout. The proposed floor plan includes 6 bedrooms, 8 bathrooms, 3-car garage, and pool with the opportunity to finish attic and lower-level spaces for more than 10,000 total square feet. The oversized homesite provides exceptional flexibility for estate level outdoor amenities while maintaining tremendous privacy and natural beauty.

One block from New Canaan's fine restaurants, shops and train. Spacious 3 bedroom, 2.5 bath townhouse in professionally maintained complex of 8 units. Rare first floor primary. Unit was renovated in August of 2025. Hardwood floors throughout the EIK, dining room and Living room. LR has a wood burning fireplace, and slider to flagstone patio. Primary bedroom is on the first floor with its own bath. Second floor has two bedrooms that share a hall bath and a rec/den room.  Tenant pays rent, utilities and $500 sewer. Credit of 720+, credit check, first month's rent and two month's security deposit. Professional landlord maintains the exterior, landscaping, snow removal. No pets per HOA. Available 8/15/2026. No Co-Signers or Guarantors allowed. 500k Limited liability ins. required. Addendum to lease required.

Land opportunity priced under 1 million on quiet cul-de-sac overlooking Milne Lake. This vacant property offers a serene setting with stunning reservoir views, combining natural beauty with exceptional convenience. Located in a premier New Canaan neighborhood, at the very end of the street, this tree-lined spot is perfect for walking, biking, and enjoying nearby nature reserves. While it feels worlds away from the bustle, it is only minutes from local amenities and offers easy Metro-North access to NYC. Whether you are looking to create a weekend retreat or a forever home, this property is the perfect canvas for your custom build.
Breathtaking waterfront acreage. High flat land w/ meadow, pond, stone walls.
Wonderful Opportunity To Build Your Dream Home On This Prime, level 2 Acre Lot With An Approved Five Bedroom Septic. Maps Are Available for review.

Beautiful flat waterfront acreage - never developed, with magnificent reservoir views. Access to property provided by right of way from 469 North Wilton Road, access road is unpaved but roughed in and visible.

Beautifully renovated and reimagined, this home appears as if it were lifted directly from a designer's showhouse. Perfectly situated in a prime neighborhood, the residence offers the ideal balance of privacy and convenience, located just minutes from town, schools, and the train. Nestled at the end of a private cul-de-sac on over two acres of park-like property, this 5 bedroom 3 full 2 half bath, Colonial home spans more than 4,000 square feet. The sun-drenched interior is designed for effortless entertaining, featuring an expansive layout with vaulted ceilings and an abundance of windows that flood every room with incredible natural light.  The sparkling, renovated chef's kitchen is equipped with premium Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances and includes a charming breakfast room with a bay window. The main level flows seamlessly from the formal living room-complete with a fireplace and vaulted ceiling-to the formal dining room. The inviting family room also features a fireplace and oversized windows, while the sunroom provides a serene retreat overlooking the lush backyard and an expansive outdoor deck. The entire second floor has been reconfigured to create a luxurious owner suite including marble bath soaking tub and walk in closets. Functional luxury abounds in the mudroom, which offers custom built-in cubbies, ample closet space, heated floors, and a convenient half bath. This one is special.

listings.remarks: Tucked away at the end of a coveted cul-de-sac, this storybook expanded Cape blends timeless charm with exceptional craftsmanship and beautiful indoor-outdoor living. Surrounded by spectacular gardens, this special home offers four bedrooms, four full and one half baths, and thoughtfully designed spaces filled with warmth and character.  At the heart of the home are inviting living and entertaining spaces, including a gracious living room, elegant dining room, cozy family room, and a sun-drenched sunroom wrapped in glass doors that open to the breathtaking grounds beyond. An office tucked beneath the dormers provides a private and inspiring workspace, while recently added first-floor laundry room adds everyday practicality with built ins, storage and a wine refrigerator. The serene primary suite is a true retreat, featuring a large west-facing deck perfect for enjoying sunset views over the gardens. Every room reflects the quality and care with which this home was built and lovingly maintained. Offering the rare combination of privacy, charm, and an exceptional cul-de-sac location, this is a home that feels both timeless and welcoming from the moment you arrive. Once there, you won't want to leave!

Fantastic downtown location within walking distance to the town center, train station, and park. This spacious townhouse-style condo offers the comfort of no HOA needs. The updated kitchen features granite countertops, a Sub-Zero refrigerator, and a Miele dishwasher. The living and dining area opens directly to a lovely outdoor terrace and a private garden-style backyard-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. All bedrooms are located on the second floor along with a full bathroom. The finished basement provides additional living space, including a full bathroom, cedar closet, and laundry room. Enjoy the convenience of an attached one-car garage plus two additional outdoor parking spaces.  Recent updates include a 2-year-old roof, freshly painted siding (2025), a new hot water heater, and a renovated second-floor bathroom (2026). Move-in ready and waiting for its new owner!

Set on six spectacular acres in one of New Canaan's most picturesque settings, this exceptional estate offers timeless elegance, expansive living spaces, and breathtaking natural beauty. Surrounded by rolling lawns, mature trees, and serene water views, the property is a private retreat less than 10 minutes from town. Designed for both grand entertaining and comfortable everyday living, the residence features five/six bedrooms, six full baths. The gracious main level includes a formal living room, elegant dining room, soaring vaulted-ceiling family room, private office, and a stunning open-concept eat-in kitchen that serves as the heart of the home. A sun-filled four season room provides year-round enjoyment of the spectacular grounds. Two powder rooms and two laundry rooms add exceptional convenience. The second level is highlighted by a luxurious primary suite featuring dual bathrooms and abundant dressing and closet space. Four additional bedrooms and three baths provide ample accommodations, while a dramatic coffered-ceiling great room offers flexibility as a sixth upstairs bedroom, media room, or private guest suite. The finished lower level includes a spacious recreation/playroom and full bath, creating additional living and entertaining space.  Outdoor living is equally impressive with multiple stone terraces overlooking a tranquil pond fed by the Mill River, providing a magical setting for relaxing, entertaining, and enjoying nature.

Beautiful, spacious fully furnished townhome available for one year rental beginning late August/early September.   Enjoy easy living, close to town, with community swimming pool.   There is a 2 car attached garage and a private outdoor terrace as well as three balconies.  Landlord flexible with respect to furnishings and household items depending on the tenants needs.

Relax and enjoy country living in this nearly 5,000 SF, 5-bedroom meticulously maintained rustic colonial. This home overlooks a large and serene pond with access to a canoe, a paddleboat, skating and fishing. In the winter season, enjoy a crackling fire in the family room or relax reading a book in the cherry paneled library. The large chef's kitchen steps out to views from the stunning stone patio making this home perfect for entertaining and casual everyday living. There are 4 finished floors, including a double story entry, handsome living room and dining room, and private office on the 3rd floor. Workout in the gym or just relax in one of the many spaces this home offers.  Enjoy Grace Farms, Irwin Park, Waveny Park, shopping and restaurants just minutes away from this spectacular location.

A classic 18th-century New England farmhouse, reimagined for the 21st century after a comprehensive five-year renovation. Thoughtfully modernized, the home retains its original character while seamlessly integrating contemporary comforts and style. Light-filled, open living spaces create an airy, modern feel, grounded by whitewashed Douglas fir flooring and anchored by a large, updated kitchen with a working fireplace. Generously sized bedrooms include a primary suite with a custom walk-in closet and a beautifully appointed bathroom featuring a soaking tub. Throughout the home, period details pay tribute to its rich heritage, while extensive mechanical upgrades ensure effortless, move-in-ready living. Set on a beautifully landscaped acre filled with mature trees and flowering shrubs, the property offers a peaceful retreat. A sun-drenched pool is discreetly nestled in the rear, and a charming covered porch provides the perfect setting for summer gatherings, quiet mornings, or evening entertaining. Additional highlights include an expansive walk-up attic offering potential for future expansion. Ideally located across from Waveny Park and just under two miles from downtown New Canaan and its top-rated schools.

GOLF FAIRWAY VIEWS! Set on nearly 4 private acres abutting the 16th fairway of the Country Club of New Canaan, this charming Colonial offers a rare combination of privacy, views, and location. Sun-filled interiors include a gracious living room with built-ins and a wood-burning fireplace, opening seamlessly to the formal dining room for easy entertaining. The bright kitchen features updated appliances and a lovely bay window overlooking the grounds. A spacious primary suite with full bath, two additional bedrooms, and a large family room with fireplace provide comfortable living spaces throughout. Expansive lawn, mature landscaping, and picturesque golf course views create a truly special setting in one of New Canaan's most desirable locations. A GREAT BUILDING OPPORTUNITY!

Lives Like a Townhouse - Spacious, Sunny & Conveniently Located  Enjoy the comfort and privacy of townhouse-style living in this bright and spacious four-bedroom rental just 0.7 miles from the New Canaan Metro-North station and close to town, schools, shopping, and dining. The versatile floor plan offers generous living spaces, including a formal Living Room (or Home Office), Dining Room, and a welcoming Family Room with a fireplace. The spacious Primary Suite features its own fireplace, private balcony, and en-suite bath, creating a comfortable retreat at the end of the day. Additional highlights include a private deck for outdoor enjoyment, an attached garage, and exceptional storage space with a walk-up attic. Tenant is responsible for utilities. Lawn care, snow removal, and trash service are shared with the neighboring unit (#41). No smoking. Good credit and strong references required.

Experience luxury living at its finest with this exquisite brand-new masterpiece built by award winning builder. Convenience & sophisticated style is what you get with this ultra-chic 4 bedroom 4.5 bathroom one of a kind property that will take your breath away from the moment you walk through the front door. Built with the best finishes in mind, you'll enjoy 9ft+ ceilings, Elevator, flexible open floor plan, office, gorgeous family with gas fireplace and walls of large-pane oversized glass that open up to your private terrace overlooking the beautifully manicured back yard creating the perfect indoor/outdoor living experience. Exquisite mill work, white oak floors, custom staircases, and built-ins truly show meticulous attention to detail. Absolutely spectacular primary bedroom with large walk-in closet and spa inspired bathroom featuring a 7tt x 4ft walk in shower, soaking tub, floating vanity, and heated floors. (All bedrooms have en-sutie bathrooms). Gorgeous mudroom with elevator that travels from bedroom level to the finished walkout basement. Additional features include Spray foam and sound proofing insulation, irrigation system, Hydro HVAC system, and more. Too many features to list. Walking distance to New Canaan's favorite restaurants, shops and train station.

Sunlight pours into the inviting living room, anchored by a classic fireplace and flowing seamlessly into a gracious dining area ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. An additional bedroom plus a versatile third bedroom or home office provide flexibility for guests, remote work, or today's evolving lifestyle needs. Offered UNFURNISHED or FURNISHED (additional charge) for ultimate convenience and flexibility, this exceptional rental presents a rare opportunity to enjoy turnkey living in one of New Canaan's most desirable in-town locations. (NOTE: There are about eight steps down to get to the unit door.)

A Masterpiece of Colonial Elegance and Resort-Style Living on Dunning Road - Perfectly positioned on a coveted cul-de-sac just moments from town on 2 perfectly flat acres, this stately 5-bedroom, 6.5-bath center hall colonial offers an unparalleled blend of sophisticated design and private resort living. Inside, the formal living room sets a dramatic tone with its stately fireplace and a breathtaking wall of windows framing views of the lushly landscaped backyard oasis, while a separate, sun-drenched solarium provides a tranquil and private retreat for quiet relaxation. The heart of the home is a designer kitchen equipped with professional-grade appliances, a massive center island, a walk-in pantry, and an adjacent breakfast room and separate command center-all seamlessly connecting to a formal dining room and opening through floor-to-ceiling glass French doors to the pool and cabana. For everyday gathering, a separate family room features custom built-ins and its own fireplace, complemented by an expansive finished lower level that boasts a third fireplace and endless recreation space. Outside, the property transforms into a premier entertainment venue, complete with a sparkling pool, a rare 2-room/2-bath cabana, and a private tennis court, making this exceptional estate a true sanctuary for modern living.

Sophisticated Center Hall Colonial totally renovated and expanded in 2008. Arched detailed interior doorways, enormous gourmet kitchen with several chef stations, sinks, 2 dishwashers, calacatta gold marble counters and high end appliances provides the hub where friends & family enjoy gathering. The welcoming great room with coffered ceiling, French doors & fireplace leads to flagstone terrace with outdoor fireplace for indoor/outdoor entertaining. A 2-story solarium offers picturesque seasonal views and overlooks spectacular private property with heated pool, cabana & stream beyond. Luxurious master suite with dressing room & marble bath, rear staircase, finished walk-out lower level, generator, garages for 4 cars and so much more. Located close to restaurants, shopping and commuting. Additional 1,800 sq ft in finished lower level with full bath. Tenant to use landlord's service providers.

Set on a desirable 1-acre lot in a quiet neighborhood setting on the west side of town, this property offers exceptional potential to renovate, expand or reimagine the existing home to fit your lifestyle. Ideally located with easy access to town, the Merritt Parkway, shopping, dining, and top-rated schools, the property combines convenience, privacy, and enduring neighborhood appeal. A rare opportunity to create your dream home in one of New Canaan's most desirable locations. Please do not walk property without confirmed appointment.

A rare opportunity to own a beautiful 1-acre property on the sought-after west side of town in one of New Canaan's most desirable neighborhoods. The existing residence offers renovation potential, while the exceptional lot provides the ideal setting to build a custom home. Enjoy the perfect balance of privacy and convenience with easy access to downtown New Canaan, the Merritt Parkway, shopping, dining, parks, and top-rated schools. Please do not walk the property without a confirmed appointment.

Move right into this totally renovated townhouse in desirable Orchard Hills with three bedrooms and three and a half baths. End unit with lovely private patio and gardens not far from the attractive heated pool. The kitchen with granite counters and upscale appliances is a chef's delight with eating island and is open to the dining area and living room with fireplace and custom built-ins. French doors open to the picturesque private flagstone patio and garden area. Two oversized bedroom suites are located on the second floor and the lower level has a family room, bedroom suite with large walk-in closet and large laundry room. Many recent improvements including new furnace and front walkway. Close to scenic Mead Park, with concession stand, tennis /pickle ball courts, and play ground. The commuter train, grocery stores and farmers market are close by. Enjoy living in the heart of New Canaan with fashionable shops, award winning restaurants, schools and library.

listings.remarks: Just off South Avenue, with much quieter surroundings, sits a modern farmhouse Colonial almost new construction with innovative design, high-style and unparalleled building quality. The exterior blends classic colonial style with contemporary flair. The interior space is thoughtfully created to provide open concept living with transitional finishing elements that will satisfy the needs of today's sophisticated families. The home offers over 7,800SF of finished space including 5 en-suite designer inspired bedrooms and 5.5 baths. The third floor offers additional recreational space and the lower level is finished with gym, office and rec room.

Bright one-bedroom apartment in town, just steps away from the train, library, restaurants, and Mead Park. Features include all new kitchen appliances, hardwood floors, in-unit washer/dryer, a private balcony, reserved parking, and basement storage. Heat and hot water included! This apartment has it all.

Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac just minutes from town this 5br/5.2ba Colonial offers exceptional space, comfort, and flexibility. Designed for both everyday living and entertaining, the home features a spacious kitchen that was renovated in 2005 with a large breakfast room that flows seamlessly into an oversized family room with custom built-ins and a fireplace. Along with the formal living and dining rooms, the home also has a private office, large finished lower level ideal for a playroom, rec room, or fitness space, large mudroom, and a 2 car garage. The upper level features five bedrooms, including two primary suites. Two additional bedrooms each have their own baths, while a separate bedroom suite with an adjoining sitting room provides exceptional flexibility for an in-law, au pair suite, or 2nd office. Outside, enjoy a heated pool, slate terrace, and flat backyard, creating the perfect setting for outdoor gatherings and summer enjoyment. With its thoughtful layout and flexible living spaces, this home offers comfort and convenience at every turn.

Exceptionally crafted new construction by a highly regarded local builder, this home offers 5 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms, and 4 finished levels directly across from Bristow Bird Sanctuary with access to Mead Park, shops, train, and restaurants. Distinctive craftsmanship is found throughout, with custom millwork and cabinetry, detailed mouldings, white oak floors, quartz counters, and designer fixtures. The main level features an open floor plan centered around a beautifully appointed kitchen with dining area, separate office, and living room with access to a private fenced patio and landscaped grounds. Upstairs, the primary suite includes a walk-in closet and spa-like bath with double-sink vanity, soaking tub, water closet, and walk-in shower with ceramic walls and Carrera marble flooring. Completing the 2nd level are 2 additional bedrooms, full bath, and spacious laundry room. The finished 3rd level features vaulted ceilings, 4th bedroom, full bath, and flexible playroom. The finished lower level includes a 5th bedroom, full bath, and rec room, offering versatility for guests, work, fitness, or media use. Additional amenities: heated garage on main level with an electric vehicle charging station, irrigation system, and custom pull-down blinds throughout. Combining quality construction, 4 finished levels, and a premier walk-to-town location, this new home delivers details and functionality that set it apart.

Privately set on 3.2 picturesque acres, this distinguished 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath residence blends classic architecture with sophisticated living in a peaceful, private setting. A double-height foyer welcomes you into sun-filled interiors with elegant architectural details and generously proportioned rooms. At the center of the home is a beautifully designed gourmet kitchen that opens to a bright breakfast room and an impressive family room with cathedral ceilings, skylights, and a fireplace. French doors lead to an expansive deck, extending the living space outdoors. Gracious formal living and dining rooms, each with a fireplace, provide refined settings for both intimate gatherings and larger-scale entertaining. The finished walk-out lower level offers exceptional flexibility with a family/bonus room, playroom, guest bedroom or fitness room, and wine cellar. Modern upgrades include a new generator, updated heating and cooling systems, and smart home automation. A three-car garage with loft space above provides additional storage or flexible use. The property features open lawn areas, a heated pool and spa, and an inviting deck for outdoor entertaining-creating a peaceful retreat for everyday living and gathering with family and friends.

27 Raymond St blends move-in ready, in-town convenience with scale usually found farther from town. Set on a generous private feeling .36 acres, 27 Raymond offers a flat, fenced backyard and large patio at the end of a cul-de-sac neighborhood, all mere steps from town. With five en-suite bedrooms on the second floor, including a luxurious primary suite with two walk-in closets and the sanctuary of a large spa-like bathroom, an open chef's kitchen and family room, dining room, intimate living room, private office, finished third floor, and a fully finished lower level with a sixth en-suite bedroom and separate gym, this New Canaan gem checks all the boxes for convenience and low-maintenance modern living. Complete with an oversized two-car garage, spacious mudroom, and beautifully scaled living spaces, this exceptional, like-new home is just minutes from New Canaan downtown's shops, restaurants, New Canaan's brand new library and Metro North.

An extensively updated home on a quiet cul-de-sac offers a serene setting, while still conveniently close to the YMCA, public schools and Town center.  Step inside this three-level residence and be greeted by an abundance of natural light streaming in through plentiful windows and French doors. The home's open and airy ambiance has a thoughtful design and layout. Four spacious bedrooms and 3.5 modern bathrooms offer ample living space for all.  The heart of the home, the award-winning gourmet kitchen combined with the adjoining family room, is an entertainer's dream come true. Fully equipped and designed with functionality in mind the perfect place to create meals with family and friends. Then retreat to the cozy living room with vaulted ceilings to enjoy a book alongside a roaring fire.  Flooded with natural light, a finished lower level provides additional space for relaxation, entertainment or exercise. This home truly has it all, including an in-ground heated pool for summer enjoyment plus a 24kW full house generator.  The impressive outdoor living space features a great stone terrace and an abundance of French doors for easy indoor-outdoor flow. The expansive backyard is level and adorned with beautiful perennial gardens, charming stone walls and mature trees that provide a sense of privacy and tranquility.  Experience the charm of New Canaan living at 34 Horton Lane, a home that combines comfort, style, and convenience.

This stunning shingle and stone Colonial perfectly blends traditional architecture with modern luxury amenities, offering a resort-at-home lifestyle while maintaining close-to-town convenience.  The heart of the home is a brand-new Deane kitchen, featuring an oversized center island, high-end side-by-side refrigerator/freezer, two sinks, two dishwashers, and a premium range. This space is complemented by a dedicated bar area equipped with a large wine fridge and additional refrigerator drawers. The main level also boasts a magnificent great room with vaulted ceilings, along with a formal dining room, living room, and a separate family room, providing the open floor plan that today's buyers prioritize.  Situated on two peaceful acres near the New Canaan village center and Metro-North, the property also offers exceptional outdoor living. You will find a bluestone terrace with a full outdoor kitchen and a heated saltwater pool with a cascading waterfall spa.  With three finished, move-in-ready levels, this property is a rare find.

listings.remarks: Designed by acclaimed architect Dinyar Wadia, this exceptional 5-bedroom estate is set on park-like grounds just minutes from downtown New Canaan. Tranquil gardens, a scenic pond, meandering stream, and curated perennial plantings create a rare sense of serenity and privacy - an ideal setting for both entertaining and everyday living. In the main residence, a gracious foyer introduces elegant, well-proportioned interiors, with dining and living rooms anchored by a double-sided stone fireplace. The gourmet kitchen opens to the family room, sunroom, and front and rear covered porches. The home also features multiple private offices and sun-filled bedrooms, including a serene primary-suite with vaulted ceiling, fireplace, private porch, and own sauna. A third-floor suite provides a private guest retreat, while the fully finished lower level includes a dedicated gym with separate entrance. Exceptional outdoor living unfolds with a heated pool, outdoor kitchen, fieldstone fireplace, spa tub, stone terraces, and covered dining areas. A six-person sauna with full bath enhances the spa-like atmosphere, while an authentic tea house provides the ideal setting for yoga or meditation. A refined separate barn/garage includes a beautifully appointed 1-bedroom apartment-perfect for guests, extended family, or a private retreat. The expansive garage accommodates up to six cars, with space for lifts and multiple charging stations, offering a rare opportunity for the discerning car collector.

listings.remarks: Discover the perfect balance of comfort, connection & a prime location in this inviting 4-bedroom home, ideally sited in a highly desirable neighborhood on a corner lot with sidewalk-lined streets. Designed w/both everyday living & memorable entertaining in mind, this home offers great space & flow. The sun-filled home welcomes you with a large living room w/picture window creating a warm & inviting atmosphere for relaxing or hosting guests. At the heart of the home, the beautifully updated Mohawk designed kitchen, featuring stylish cabinetry, skylights, generous counter space, & a casual dining welcome all to gather and linger. Multiple communal spaces provide flexibility for easy living. Enjoy dedicated, additional areas that serve perfectly as a media room, playroom, fitness area, or home office. The primary suite offers a peaceful retreat, while 3 additional bedrooms, conveniently located on the same level, provide comfortable accommodations for family, guests, or remote work. Step outside & experience your own private escape - a flat, picturesque yard paired w/a covered patio, easily accessible from kitchen and dining area, that's ideal for summer barbecues, outdoor dining, or simply unwinding. Two car attached garage & generator. Live at the center of it all-just moments from a vibrant downtown, train, top-rated schools, the popular YMCA, & everything that makes daily life effortless. 6 Field Crest isn't just a home-it's the lifestyle you've been yearning to find!

2024 complete renovation of this 3-bedroom townhouse that is walking distance to town, train, shops and restaurants! New kitchen and baths, newly finished floors and freshly painted walls. New Central Air and high-efficiency heating system! Lower level completely finished with family room, large laundry/utility room and additional bonus room/home office. Look no further than this beautiful home in a quiet residential neighborhood. Listen to the babbling Five Mile River from your large deck overlooking a private back yard. Additional storage area in detached barn for motorcycle, bicycles, sports gear, etc.

Pristine move in ready five-bedroom Colonial residence situated on 2.9 acres of parklike grounds. Spanning over 6,000 square feet, this home features an open floor plan with formal rooms, elegant moldings, graceful archways and French doors. The interior includes a gourmet kitchen with high-end appliances, a marble center seating island, breakfast room with coffee bar, all which open into a family room with vaulted ceilings and a fireplace. Additional highlights include a library/office with built-ins, and a primary suite featuring a private balcony overlooking the pond, a sitting area, and a marble bathroom.  The property also includes a separate-entry apt. equipped with a kitchenette, a large living and dining area, a bedroom, and a full bath. The home is finished with hardwood flooring, custom millwork, and three fireplaces. Exterior amenities include a spacious deck and room for 5 cars, a heated main level 3 car garage, large mudroom, and an additional two-car garage on the lower level.   The residence is conveniently located near local schools, the village center, Metro-North New Canaan station, The Field Club, and the Merritt Parkway.

Welcome to the Original Norman Dairy Farmhouse, where 1900s craftsmanship meets 21st-century convenience. Originally the heart of a local dairy operation, this stately 5-bedroom residence sits on nearly an acre of level, sun-drenched land. Enter through the home's iconic wrap-around porch and beautiful entry door to soaring 9 foot ceilings throughout the primary living spaces. The main level is designed for gathering, a stately parlor with custom built-ins, a formal living room & dining room, and an expansive family room. The updated kitchen serves as the hub of the home, featuring granite countertops and a sunny breakfast nook overlooking the grounds. With 5 generous bedrooms and three finished levels-including a private third-floor retreat and a dedicated media room - floor plan offers endless flexibility. Located just a stone's throw from the Talmadge Hill train and top-rated schools, this landmark home offers a lifestyle of quiet elegance and historical depth.

Welcome to refined townhouse living in Old Forge Green, one of New Canaan's most sought-after communities. This beautifully maintained 4-bedroom, 3-bath residence offers the perfect blend of comfort and style. The thoughtfully designed floor plan features a generous eat-in kitchen, formal dining room, and an inviting living room anchored by a fireplace and custom built-ins. French doors open to a private terrace with a chic awning-ideal for al fresco dining surrounded by professionally landscaped gardens. Enjoy walkability to New Canaan's vibrant village center, where award-winning restaurants, boutique shopping, and Metro-North access await. A rare opportunity to experience low-maintenance living without sacrificing space or location. --

Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac on a private lane, 46 Wakeman Road is a quintessential Country Colonial set on 4 beautifully landscaped acres. Meticulously maintained, the home blends timeless elegance with modern comfort, offering bright, expansive living spaces in a serene setting.  The main level features soaring ceilings, refined details, and a gracious flow. The large, elegant living room and formal dining room open to an expansive screened porch creating a seamless indoor-outdoor flow. A stunning kitchen with spacious breakfast area, transitions effortlessly to the inviting family room with walls of windows and glass doors creating a dramatic, sun-drenched space that accesses the wraparound deck framing the picturesque grounds.  The 1st-floor primary suite is a serene haven with glass doors to its own deck, dual walk-in closets and sitting area. A handsome library/office with fireplace and built-ins offers a warm workspace. Upstairs are 3 bedrooms, including a spacious secondary suite. A large bonus room with vaulted ceiling and built-in workspaces is ideal for play, media or studio use. The walkout lower level recreation room/gym has potential for a 5th bedroom or guest suite.  Outdoors, rolling lawns and mature trees create a peaceful backdrop. Additional highlights include 4 fireplaces, 3-car garage, generator, 2 laundry rooms, and a windowed butler's pantry. A rare blend of privacy, space & convenience just minutes from town, top-rated schools and commuter access.

listings.remarks: Welcome to 1541 Oenoke Ridge, a spectacular country retreat with unparalleled privacy and natural beauty. Beyond the stately stone pillars, you are greeted by 4.5 beautifully landscaped acres including manicured gardens, a lighted tennis/sports court, a swimming pool, a 1-bedroom guest/pool house and a cozy stone fire pit. The main house blends elegance with everyday comfort. Highlights: spacious custom chef's kitchen with dining area, magnificent great room with cathedral ceiling and a paneled wood-burning fireplace, dining room with bay window and a family room with its own fireplace and French doors opening to the wrap around deck overlooking a serene and bucolic backdrop. A perfect setting for entertaining. Ideal for everyday living. Upstairs, the sun-filled primary suite offers a vaulted ceiling, dressing room and luxurious marble bath. Three more bedrooms, one en-suite, and a hall bath complete the second floor. The walk-out lower level is equipped with a kitchenette and full bath, providing flexible space for recreation, work or extended living. Overlooking the heated pool, the charming guest house is perfect for weekend guests, in-laws, a private office or a fitness studio. Whether hosting gatherings or enjoying quiet moments at home, this remarkable property offers endless possibilities. A rare opportunity not to be missed.
