listings.remarks: Welcome home to this beautifully maintained condominium in coveted Graystone! Offering the perfect blend of space, comfort, and an unbeatable prized in-town location, this is the one. This bright and spacious residence features hardwood floors throughout, three generously sized bedrooms, all thoughtfully situated on one level, along with three full bathrooms. The home is ideal for both everyday living and effortless entertaining.The renovated and expansive kitchen is warm and inviting, complete with a large bow window dining area- ideal for morning coffee or casual meals. A sun-filled family room highlighted by four skylights, complemented by the living and formal dining areas, offers versatile spaces for both relaxation and entertaining. The large unfinished lower level offers additional possibilities, perfect for a home office, gym, or recreation area. Step outside to your own private, fully fenced stone patio, a peaceful retreat for outdoor enjoyment. An attached one-car garage offers convenient year-round access, while second-level laundry adds everyday ease. Set within a beautifully maintained condominium community, this home places you just steps from the best of New Canaan's downtown living-dining, shopping, parks and more. Move right-in to this delightful unit, and enjoy this easy lifestyle.

This is home is exactly where the New Canaan market is right now. Tucked down a private lane, this is the kind of home buyers are looking for-clean, updated, and completely move-in ready.  254 White Oak Shade has just been refreshed with new paint, refinished floors, and thoughtful staging that makes the entire home feel light, bright, and easy. The living spaces are filled with natural light, and the layout works for both everyday living and entertaining without trying too hard.  It's a classic New Canaan home with the right updates already done-so you're not walking into a project. The setting is what makes this one stand out. Quiet, private, and surrounded by greenery, yet just minutes to town, the train, and an easy commute. You have quick access to Norwalk for everyday convenience-Costco and Target runs-while still living in New Canaan with top-tier schools and the charm of a true village.  Homes like this-updated, well-located, and ready to go-make this a choice you will not want to miss. Deadline for offers is Monday 5/4 @ 5pm

Tucked into one of New Canaan's most desirable in-town neighborhoods, 33 Village Drive offers the perfect blend of thoughtful renovation, comfortable living, and unbeatable convenience. Recently updated, the home features bright, open living spaces designed for today's lifestyle, with a seamless flow ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Generous room sizes, updated finishes, and great natural light create a warm and inviting feel throughout. Whether gathering in the main living areas or enjoying quieter moments at home, the layout offers flexibility and ease. The location is hard to beat. Just moments to schools, Waveny Park, the YMCA, and downtown New Canaan, everything you need is right at your fingertips. A turnkey opportunity in a truly special neighborhood.

Beautifully updated and full of charm, this surprisingly spacious townhome offers the ease of in-town living in one of New Canaan's most convenient locations. The kitchen has been thoughtfully updated, while beautiful hardwood floors shine throughout, abundant natural light fills the home, and 7 inch crown moldings bring warmth and character. The grand primary suite is a true retreat with an oversized bathroom, a massive walk-in closet, and two additional closets for effortless organization. The finished lower level is a standout feature, offering wonderful flex space for a family room plus a home office and workout space. Outside, enjoy a private fenced in backyard with a charming slate patio where the peaceful sounds of the nearby river create a relaxing backdrop. There is excellent storage throughout in addition to a vaulted attic with full flooring for even more room, and a one car attached garage. All of this in a low-maintenance setting just moments from town, shops, restaurants, and the train, with the rare benefit of no HOA dues. A special opportunity to enjoy comfort, convenience, and easy living in the heart of New Canaan.

The seller is requesting highest and best offers by Tuesday at 3:00 PM.  Perched gracefully atop a scenic hill, this quintessential Connecticut home offers a rare blend of privacy, charm, and opportunity. Set among grand estates and located just two miles from the New Canaan train station, the setting alone is enough to capture your heart. This is an exceptional opportunity to reimagine and elevate a truly special property into your own masterpiece. The home features generously scaled rooms, beautiful hardwood floors, and a screened-in porch you may never wish to leave. A welcoming family room with a striking brick fireplace overlooks the serene, private backyard, creating the perfect space to unwind or entertain. The residence includes a spacious living room and dining room, a private office ideal for working from home, and a lovely primary suite with en-suite bath. Three additional bedrooms and a two-car garage complete the offering. Please refer to the floor plan for full layout details. Beyond the home, enjoy all that New Canaan has to offer, from award-winning restaurants and unique boutique shopping to top-rated schools, beautiful parks, and an Olympic-sized town pool. With Metro-North access, commuting to New York City is seamless. Adding to the charm, Lee Memorial Garden is just a short stroll away, offering breathtaking displays of azaleas and rhododendrons each spring. A rare setting, a special home, and an opportunity not to be missed... welcome home.

Hurry to see this New Canaan charmer! Custom designed and meticulously maintained by the same family for 30 years this 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom ranch is handsomely sited on a beautiful, level 1-acre lot with lovely landscaping. With an impressive floor plan, this spacious home offers wonderful rooms for every lifestyle-whether relaxing, working, playing, studying, or gathering with family. Take your choice: Great Room, Library/Office, Sitting Room, or Recreation Room. Three generously proportioned bedrooms and three full bathrooms provide ample space for gracious living, remote work, and relaxation. As a bonus, there is an in-law suite on the lower level. A beautiful home with classic New England character and the essential modern amenities needed for today's living. Located in New Canaan, known for its top-rated schools, exceptional library, community amenities, fine shopping and restaurants, plus easy access to the Merritt Parkway and Metro-North.

176 Carter Street is a rare retreat tucked down a quiet lane on nearly two park-like acres surrounded by mature specimen trees, perennial gardens, and sweeping open lawns. Peaceful and picturesque, this bucolic setting offers exceptional privacy without ever feeling remote.  Thoughtfully improved throughout, the light-filled Gambrel Colonial flows across three finished levels. Light pours through oversized windows across gracious main rooms - a spacious living room with fireplace, lacquered office with custom built-ins, generous dining room, and updated chef's kitchen with bay window overlooking the breathtaking grounds. A first-floor bedroom and full bath are perfect for guests or a private suite.  Upstairs, five serene bedrooms include a beautifully updated primary suite, three additional full baths, and a flexible bonus room currently used as a playroom.The walk-out lower level, complete with fireplace and wet bar, opens through a sweeping wall of French doors to a private ivy-covered stone patio, where evenings unfold around the fire pit under open skies. Outside, a spectacular heated pool and sprawling lawn create the perfect backdrop for entertaining.   A charming barn sparks endless possibility, while a full-house generator and detached two-car garage add everyday practicality. The property also offers exceptional potential for future expansion or reimagination. Ideally located just minutes to downtown New Canaan, train, top-rated schools, and the Merritt Parkway

listings.remarks: In-town living at its best. This beautifully updated corner-unit townhouse offers the perfect blend of convenience, ease of living, and refined style in a prime, convenient location in New Canaan. The classic brick exterior sets a timeless tone, while its desirable end-unit positioning provides added privacy and abundant natural light. Inside, thoughtful updates elevate every space. The kitchen features refreshed countertops and a stylish backsplash, seamlessly flowing into a welcoming living area enhanced by custom built-ins. The sunlit primary bedroom is completed with a beautifully renovated en-suite bath. Step outside to your own private garden patio-an ideal retreat for morning coffee or relaxed entertaining. The finished lower level offers a versatile living space: perfect for a family room, playroom, or home office. Whether you're downsizing or searching for a turnkey first home, this exceptional property delivers easy living conveniently near the shops, dining, and everything downtown New Canaan has to offer.

Rich in warmth and history, this enchanting antique gable-front home has been thoroughly updated to offer the rare combination of timeless character and modern ease. A townhouse in a small condo association, the home lives like a single-family home, blending privacy, space, curb appeal, and charm with the convenience of shared exterior maintenance. The home welcomes guests with an inviting foyer leading to open living spaces. The thoughtfully renovated chef's kitchen features elegant marble countertops and a stunning Lacanche range, handcrafted in Burgundy, France. Upstairs are three bedrooms, including a spacious primary suite with an updated en suite bath. The third floor, with its sun-filled skylights, built-in shelving, and new flooring, offers exceptional flexibility. It is ideal as a home office, playroom, private guest space, or as the coolest kids' bedroom ever, with its hangout area featuring a rattan swing chair. The recently fully-finished basement provides bonus space and is perfect for recreation, fitness, or a media room. Other significant recent upgrades include a new heat pump system, tankless water heater, and built-in cabinets. A private, south-facing deck invites morning coffee, outdoor dining, and summer entertaining. Dedicated outdoor parking spaces and a private garage add daily convenience. Located in a quiet, walkable neighborhood with a great sense of community. Near to New Canaan's village, schools, Bristow Bird Sanctuary, and Mead Park.

IN TOWN LIVING! Gracefully set on a charming in-town street, this lovely 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers the perfect blend of character, comfort, and convenience. Filled with natural light, this inviting home showcases timeless appeal, warm and welcoming living spaces, and the flexibility to suit today's lifestyle. The open kitchen with a comfortable sitting area with bay window serves as the heart of the home, seamlessly connecting to the formal dining room and creating an ideal setting for both everyday living and entertaining. The living room, centered around a wood-burning fireplace, creates a cozy and comfortable gathering space. Just beyond, a screened-in porch provides the perfect place to relax or entertain while enjoying seamless indoor-outdoor living. The lovely brick patio and spacious yard further enhance the outdoor experience, offering a beautiful backdrop for al fresco dining, play, or quiet enjoyment. The sun-filled finished third floor adds exceptional versatility, ideal for recreation, a playroom, home office, gym, or guest overflow space. Perfectly positioned in a coveted in-town location, this special home is just moments from New Canaan's vibrant village center, with easy access to shops, restaurants, parks, schools, and the train. A rare opportunity to enjoy the very best of in-town living in one of New Canaan's most desirable settings.

Have you ever imagined living at the end of a cul-de-sac, where neighbors gather and a true sense of community naturally unfolds? Welcome to 36 Down River Road, a special offering that combines privacy, convenience, and everyday beauty.  Set against the backdrop of a peaceful river, the property offers a serene escape. From the deck, the gentle sound of the water creates a calming, spa-like atmosphere, making it the perfect place to relax and unwind.  Inside, the spacious living room features a fireplace and opens directly to the deck, creating a seamless connection between indoor comfort and outdoor living. The inviting family room boasts impressive ceiling height, a space so warm and welcoming you may never want to leave.  The home offers flexibility with two options for a primary bedroom, one on the first floor and another on the second. The upstairs bedrooms feature built-ins and shelving, share a bathroom, and include a second bedroom with a generously sized walk-in closet.  Ideally located, you can enjoy a true walk-to-town lifestyle with easy access to schools, restaurants, specialty shops, parks, the new library, the farmers market, and the Metro-North train station.

In-town Oasis! Expanded 4 bedroom, 3.5 bath cape on private, professionally landscaped property. Renovated for today's lifestyle with generous room sizes and an open floor plan. Vaulted ceiling family room features a brick fireplace and French doors opening to an extensive terrace w/spa tub and outdoor shower. Brand new designer kitchen with quartz counters, Wolf range, Subzero refrigerators, Bosch dishwasher. Formal living room with fireplace and French doors opening to terrace. Master suite features a spa bath with radiant heat floors, steam shower, whirlpool tub & walk-in closet. 4th bedroom or in-home office with built-ins. 2 car garage and state of the art recessed lighting & sound system inside & out! Enjoy being in the heart of town on this sought-after street. Walking distance to schools, park, restaurants and more. Move-in ready in the heart of New Canaan!

listings.remarks: Historic Canaan Parish Gem! Originally built in 1775, this remarkable property began it's life as a working barn on a local farm in the heart of Canaan Parish. Originally the "hopeful" site of downtown, New Canaan was instead incorporated in 1801 less than a mile down the road.  Over the centuries, the house has evolved with grace and character - from private squash court to a warm and inviting family home. Later additions of a horse barn and charming cottage continued to add depth to the story.  Set amid beautifully landscaped gardens, the grounds offer a tranquil retreat just a short stroll from downtown New Canaan. A root (and wine) cellar nods to the home's agrarian past, while the thoughtful blend of period architecture and modern updates creates a residence that is both steeped in history and full of life. This is more than a home, it's a living piece of New Canaan's heritage, offering a rare opportunity to own a property of enduring character and timeless appeal.

Offered "as-is," this exceptional property presents a unique opportunity to personalize and elevate to your own tastes while enjoying one of New Canaan's most desirable addresses.

listings.remarks: This 4 bedroom,3.5 bath tastefully renovated vintage home has an open floor plan,walls and windows with divided light and high ceilings, creating an instant sense of peace and well being. A stone hearth at the entry is surrounded by walls of bookshelves and a reading corner. The beamed living room and adjacent sun room overlook a romantic tiered garden and flat lawn. The fireplace's stone wall frames the dining space, and French doors open onto the garden patio and pergola. The warm polished wood island featuring a copper bar sink is the centerpiece of a perfect chef's kitchen. Down a private hall is the walk out first floor bedroom with full bath, walk in closet and adjacent laundry room. Upstairs an exercise/ gym space is conveniently located outside the primary suite with it's private office, high ceilings, walk in closet, and elegantly kitted bath (soaking tub, double sinks, walk in shower) Two additional generously proportioned bedrooms share a large hall bath. Convenient to charming Scott's Corners and just a few minutes to New Canaan town center, this is a special spot. Swing on the front porch, have morning coffee on the patio, wander the charming garden features, plant the enclosed garden with vegetables, flowers and herbs. Breathe. Zen living behind a stone wall on a rural street.This one is just right.

Welcome home to this bright, well-maintained, and move-in ready 2-bedroom, 1-bath apartment with attached garage and in-unit washer/dryer offering the perfect combination of comfort and convenience. The thoughtfully designed floor plan features spacious living areas, generously sized bedrooms, and plenty of natural light throughout. Prime in-town New Canaan location close to shopping, dining, parks and Metro-North train station. Enjoy the added convenience of an attached one-car garage with additional storage space-ideal for keeping seasonal items, bikes, and outdoor gear organized. There is also a second assigned parking space in the driveway. Whether you're relaxing at home or looking for easy everyday living, this apartment has everything you need!

Darien Beach rights and New Canaan Schools make this a very special offering! Storybook charm greets you at this one-of-a-kind, vintage Tudor home, set back from the road on landscaped property with lovely private terrace and lawns. Natural gas and town water and sewer are a definite plus for easy maintenance. A parcel of acreage is in Darien, offering the unique option of full access to beaches and boat launch. Timbered beam construction is authentic to the original structure and creates a fairytale ambiance throughout. Thoughtful updates provide the comforts of today's living without sacrificing the essence of a Tudor style including wide plank hardwood floors and original hardware. The great room with vaulted ceiling, stone hearth and wraparound balcony is the captivating focal point w/open access to family and dining rooms and the delightful porch off the terrace. An office and four en-suite bedrooms, including one on the main floor and one with walk out access to a large deck over the garage allows for versatile options. Manicured lawns and gardens surround the bluestone terrace for gracious entertaining and cul de sac access from the side lawn is perfect for bike riding or pet walking. Minutes to New Canaan schools and village, Talmadge Hill train and Pkwy, as well as a short drive to the beaches in Darien.  A truly wonderful location!

listings.remarks: A storybook entrance framed by classic stone walls opens to four flat, park-like acres leads you to this thoughtfully updated five-bedroom Colonial layered with warmth, character, and the kind of detail that make a house feel instantly welcoming. The light filled chef's kitchen flowing seamlessly into a family room with fireplace and French doors open to the terrace, heated pool, spa, and paddle court - effortless indoor outdoor living. Upstairs offers a light filled, vaulted primary bedroom suite plus 3/4 additional bedrooms and rear staircase to the spacious mudroom and side entrance. A gracious first-floor guest suite is perfect for family and friends. The finished lower level adds flexible space for exercise or play. The stunning post-and-beam barn - with room for 4+ cars and an oversized loft - completes the picture.Warm, inviting, and undeniably special. A true New England gem. Prepare to fall in love.

Discover New Canaan as it was meant to be. This stunner on coveted St. John's Place was built in 1910 and occupied by the same family for 44 years. Every year, the home was improved, and stands today as a testament to the labor of love built and cared for over four decades. Fully modernized to today's high standards with hints of its storied history as one of the loveliest homes in New Canaan. This quintessential home boasts classic cedar shingle siding and roof, high ceilings, 4 wood-burning fireplaces, bay windows, custom plantation shutters and beautiful wainscoting and molding throughout. Prime location on St. John's Place, steps from Elm and Park Street and bordering God's Acre. The picturesque property abuts ACRES of wooded conservation land with a charming, tucked-away pool surrounded by lush plantings and trees. Militantly maintained interiors lovingly updated with four en-suite bedrooms PLUS versatile library/office space with enchanting private spaces throughout this gracious home.

Experience the pinnacle of sophisticated living in this extraordinary estate by renowned builder Kaali-Nagy, perfectly situated within walking distance to the village, train, and nature center. The residence showcases impeccable craftsmanship throughout, defined by extensive custom moldings, intricate wainscoting, and an effortless flow designed for both grand entertaining and intimate daily life. At the heart of the home, a gourmet chef's kitchen features a sun-drenched breakfast room and a butler's pantry, with French doors opening to one of three private terraces for seamless indoor-outdoor transitions. Designed to elevate everyday living, the home also boasts a fully equipped private home gym, an inviting billiards room and media area, perfect for relaxed gatherings.The private property is equally impressive, boasting a spectacular 20 x 40 heated gunite pool surrounded by professionally designed, mature landscaping that creates a serene and secluded outdoor retreat-ideal for summer entertaining or peaceful relaxation. This thoughtfully designed floor plan includes five spacious ensuite bedrooms, each boasting its own walk-in closet, ensuring unparalleled comfort for family and guests alike. Complete with the modern convenience of a private elevator serving the home's multiple levels, this property offers a rare blend of timeless architectural detail, exceptional amenities, and a premier "walk-to-everything" location.

Your Private Five-Star Resort in New Canaan: Experience the pinnacle of luxury at this 2-acre custom estate, where "vacationing at home" is your daily reality. Tucked behind commanding stone columns near the vibrant town center, this park-like sanctuary is framed by gorgeous stone walls and lush, professional landscaping and sited on a quiet cul-de-sac. The sun filled open-concept interior boasts 9'+ and vaulted ceilings, extensive millwork and gleaming hardwood floors, anchored by four fireplaces that radiate warmth and sophistication. At the heart of the home lies a breathtaking chef's kitchen featuring a legendary island with enough room for a large gathering and a dreamy walk-in pantry. The formal living room with gas fireplace and formal dining room with butler's pantry offer an easy flow for entertaining. With 5 bedrooms, 6.5 baths, a stately library and two additional offices, there is unparalleled space for both high-stakes productivity and total relaxation. The lifestyle continues outdoors with a sparkling pool and a private sports/tennis/pickleball court designed for endless summer afternoons. Whether hosting a grand gala or retreating to your private oasis, this property offers a seamless blend of modern elegance with New England charm.

Grounds: Set high on the ridge, 4 pastoral acres with an identified pool site, multiple gardens, and rolling lawns. Own a piece of New Canaan history on Oenoke Ridge.

The home has been fully updated with modern amenities while preserving its classic charm. Move right into this gem, complete with first floor primary suite and 4 additional bedrooms on the 2nd level. An expansive family room, framed by walls of windows, captures sweeping views of the landscape. Completing the first floor plan is a new bright and sunny laundry room, two beautifully appointed half baths and a thoughtfully designed mudroom leading to a brand-new second-floor home gym.The third floor boats a private home office and another bedroom suite with full bath. A truly rare and incomparable offering, combining vintage charm, modern luxury, and an exceptional West Road location; ready for the most discerning buyer.

Newly renovated in-town charmer in sought-after New Canaan, CT. Thoughtfully updated to blend vintage character with modern amenities, this home offers timeless appeal with today's comforts. The finished lower level boasts a media room, fitness center, and wine cellar. Outdoors, curated grounds offer a dining pavilion, outdoor kitchen, and a newly constructed pool and spa, with space for a tennis/pickle-ball court. Engineered for efficiency, the estate features commercial-grade systems, radiant heat, and a rare Welsh slate roof. A four-car garage and an elevator service complete this exceptional offering.

Beautiful patio in fenced back yard. Move right into this bright and fresh home. Walk to town, train, schools and parks. Enjoy all that New Canaan has to offer. PLEASE NOTE: Tax records show the property address as 44 Hillside. This is a duplex townhouse and this rental is for right side of the building that has a mailing address of 46 Hillside.

Private yet moments from town, this exceptional five-bedroom Contemporary Craftsman is a masterclass in workmanship, scale, and thoughtful design. A first-floor primary suite and four additional bedrooms offer flexibility for modern living, while exquisite millwork, refined architectural detail, and open floor plan create spaces equally suited to everyday comfort, working from home, recreation, and entertaining. A gourmet kitchen with high-end appliances and large pantry will please discerning cooks, while a breakfast bar and large dining room allows for easy socializing. A spectacular deck serves as a true extension of the home, complete with an outdoor kitchen, gracious dining and lounge areas, and a charming bridge crossing a peaceful stretch of the Five Mile River, leading to a golf chipping area and small, lovely yard. Additional features include soaring ceilings in the main living area, a two-story foyer, bonus room with deck overlooking the putting green, with bar, wine storage and a half bathroom. The third level offers a private office, a kitchenette, ample storage and fifth bedroom and an en-suite full bath lending the space to flexible use - sunlit gym, guest room, whatever suits. One mile from restaurants, shops and Metro-North, 107 Parade Hill offers the convenience of living close to town and the ease of low-maintenance living.

Elegant, sun-drenched and sophisticated, this timeless country estate, built by Alex Kaali-Nagy and decorated by Lynn Morgan, offers the ultimate in superior quality construction, luxurious amenities, exceptional millwork, refined architectural details, built-ins galore and a fabulous versatile floor plan for easy living and gracious entertaining. With four fully finished floors, highlights include 7 large ensuite bedrooms with walk-in closets,10 foot ceilings,7 fireplaces, front to back grand entrance hall, elevator, full house generator, slate roof, expansive covered rear porch, bluestone terraces, fabulous chef's eat-in kitchen opening into the family room, handsome library and adjacent home office, wet bar, spectacular second floor playroom, exercise room and so much more. The serene private 4 acre property on coveted West Rd. is equally impressive. The deep play yard is surrounded by majestic trees, beautiful professional landscaping and glorious gardens. There is a fabulous new Gunite heated pool by Shoreline with retractable cover, a charming custom fitted gazebo and an amazing newly restored circa 1790 barn with loft and several garage spaces. In addition, there is courtyard parking for guests and a separate service entrance for convenience. Make this your forever home to love and cherish and build special memories with family and friends. Welcome to 584 West Rd.!

listings.remarks: Enchanting Private Country Estate offering classic design and exceptional lifestyle flexibility. Privately set at the end of a country lane among prestigious estates on one of New Canaan's premier streets, this property delivers rare seclusion just minutes from town and train and acclaimed award-winning schools. Recently refreshed throughout, the home features a spacious primary suite with vaulted ceilings and a Juliette balcony overlooking beautifully landscaped grounds with multiple patios, a pool with waterfall spa, and mature perennial plantings. The suite is complemented by a spa-like bath and an expansive walk-in dressing room. Four additional bedrooms include a first-floor guest suite or flexible office. The gourmet kitchen is appointed with high-end appliances and opens to a bright, airy layout with seamless access to the patio-ideal for entertaining. An oversized family room with a fieldstone fireplace and French doors enhances the indoor-outdoor flow, while a large library/playroom with built-ins adds versatility to the main level. The lower level provides a relaxed recreation space, perfect for a game of pool. The expansive grounds also feature a large yard with a playground and ample open space for recreation and outdoor enjoyment. Surrounded by serene, private landscaping, this home offers a true sense of tranquility. A rare offering combining an ideal layout with every modern amenity-completely move-in ready.

Located in the desirable Lake Wind / Ponus Ridge corridor, this custom Colonial estate offers over 9,000 square feet of living space, thoughtfully rebuilt in 2010 and designed for both scale and comfort. The home features 5 bedrooms, 7 full and 3 half baths, six fireplaces (including one outdoor), and multiple porches, with select rooms showcasing cathedral ceilings. Set on 2.74 acres, the property includes a saltwater pool and spa, pool house, expansive flagstone patio, and tennis court-creating a true estate setting with exceptional potential for outdoor living and entertaining. The interior presents with a clean, functional layout, including a recently installed boiler, while exterior amenities and select finishes offer a compelling opportunity for renovation and customization, allowing the next owner to fully realize the property's potential. A rare offering combining size, privacy, and long-term upside in one of New Canaan's premier estate areas.

listings.remarks: A thoughtfully updated townhouse-style condo offering exceptional value, efficiency improvements, and modern living in one of New Canaan's most convenient and desirable communities. Ideally located just moments from downtown New Canaan, this 3-bedroom residence combines comfortable living spaces filled with natural light. The home features an inviting open-concept main level, spacious bedrooms, private outdoor space, and a heated lower-level area is ideal for a home office, media room, fitness gym, or other flex living space. Recent improvements include a newly insulated attic designed to support enhanced year-round comfort and energy efficiency as well as landscape improvements for outdoor enjoyment. The home is wired for high-speed internet, making it exceptionally well-suited for modern remote work-at-home and streaming needs. Additional highlights include relatively low property taxes and low HOA when compared to many surrounding Fairfield County communities, and a low-maintenance lifestyle. Residents enjoy access to New Canaan's highly regarded public schools, along with the town's vibrant downtown, parks, dining, library, shopping, and commuter convenience to downtown Stamford and New York City. This is a rare opportunity to own a proactively maintained home offering efficiency upgrades, flexibility, and long-term value.

Conveniently located just steps from downtown, shopping, restaurants, and the train station, move-in-ready unit offers comfort and convenience. The spacious eat-in kitchen features granite countertops, a dishwasher, refrigerator, with direct access to a generously sized private deck. Elegant molding details add character throughout the home, and the in-unit washer and dryer provide everyday convenience. Additional storage is available in the lower-level basement. Private rear parking and a designated garden area are included for tenants who enjoy gardening. Area rugs are required to protect the flooring.

Experience the perfect blend of luxury and convenience with this stunning Leefair Ranch condo. This exceptional property features a great sunny southern exposure with three french doors leading to a magnificent large garden. Included in this home is a full dining room, eat in kitchen, large living room with fireplace, separate study or den, half bath, two spacious bedrooms and two full baths on main level. An open staircase leads to the lower level featuring an attractive family room with book cases, a full bath and laundry and vast potential for future finishing. Complete with a two car garage, this is a must-see for anyone seeking the best of New Canaan condo living

listings.remarks: This is a stunning 3 bedroom stand-alone home designed by Judith Larson, and built by The Gardiner Group. The architectural detail is extensive and beautiful featuring generous trim, coffered ceiling, built-ins, paneling, custom closets, plantation shutters, marble baths, and generator! The state of the art kitchen has granite countertops, sub-zero refrigerator/freezer, Miele dishwasher, Wolf gas range and large island. It is complemented by a generous, eating area adjacent to an outdoor deck, wonderful for grilling and dining. The Davenport home is beautifully sited within Jelliff Mill Falls, which borders the Noroton River providing wonderful views, open green space, a carefree lifestyle, and convenience. This freestanding turn-key home is truly a MUST SEE! Per previous owner, design includes potential for an elevator. Please ask for association, bylaws and restrictions. All measurements are approximate.

Versatile Gem: Walkable and with Income Potential - This light-filled Cape Cod offers a rare blend of flexible living and a prime location on one of New Canaan's most coveted streets. Whether you envision a grand 4-bedroom, 3-bath single-family home or a savvy investment using the upstairs 2-bedroom apartment, this home currently features a main-floor primary suite, an additional bedroom and bath, open concept dining and living rooms, a dedicated office, and a striking family room with beams and cathedral ceilings (currently serving as a 3rd bedroom for the sellers). The kitchen flows seamlessly onto a private backyard terrace, while the separate second-floor 2-bedroom, 1-bath apartment serves as a legal, $2,000+/month income-producing suite or an ideal in-law residence. Outside, the large and grassy lot acts as a peaceful retreat and a detached two-car garage featuring a workshop and a large loft recreation room. Just steps from the train station, fine dining, and boutique shopping, this property represents an exceptional opportunity to create your dream lifestyle with many living options in a perfect neighborhood setting.

A gated entry introduces this stunning Federal-style Colonial, privately set on just over 2-acres. Bathed in natural light, the home is defined by floor-to-ceiling windows, French doors, and skylights that illuminate every space. The flow is exceptional, designed for elegant entertaining and comfortable daily living. A gracious 23-ft foyer leads to a dramatic living room featuring a fireplace, cathedral ceiling, and a striking wall of windows overlooking the gardens. The formal dining room easily accommodates 12 guests. The kitchen and family room combination offers a vaulted ceiling, oversized windows, French doors, and custom cabinetry. A large central island provides ample seating, a built-in banquette and additional gathering space. The primary suite is a private retreat featuring a beautiful marble bath with double vanities, a soaking tub, and a spacious shower. Upstairs, 3 additional bedrooms include one en-suite, along with a hall bath. The 3rd level presents a large unfinished attic, offering excellent potential for a bonus space. The property is truly bucolic, with mature plantings, curated garden areas, and expansive lawns. Outdoor living is enhanced by 2 stone terraces, a pickleball court, and a new heated Gunite pool with a sun shelf, surrounded by an expansive slate patio. Additional features include a generator and storage sheds. Located just 3 miles from downtown New Canaan & Award-Winning Schools, privacy and convenience.

Storybook charm meets modern living in the heart of New Canaan! Ideally located just steps from the YMCA, Waveny Park, top-rated schools, and a short stroll to the vibrant downtown, this exceptionally charming Cape Cod / Colonial-style home offers the lifestyle you've been waiting for.  Thoughtfully designed and beautifully maintained, this expansive residence features 5 spacious bedrooms and 4.5 baths, including a rare and highly sought-after dual primary setup with luxurious suites on both the first and second floors -- offering ultimate flexibility, comfort, and privacy.  At the heart of the home, a stunningly remodeled kitchen flows seamlessly into the inviting family room, where sweeping green views of the backyard can be enjoyed from the brand new deck -- perfect for everyday living and effortless entertaining. A second oversized family / great room just off the kitchen provides even more space to gather, relax, and host.  Designed for today's lifestyle, the home also offers multiple dedicated office spaces, ideal for remote work or creative pursuits. The lower level is a true standout, featuring three expansive finished areas -- perfect for a media room, recreation space, fitness area, or additional office setup.  This home checks every box with the coveted trifecta of town water, town sewer, and natural gas.

Minutes to the the heart of New Canaan and walk to Waveny Park from this beautifully updated Colonial in a prime location. Light filled, open floor plan, chef's kitchen, 2 office spaces, 2nd floor family room, finished lower level, three car garage, lovely east facing terrace, gated driveway and fenced in flat backyard. Enjoy all New Canaan has to offer!  *Potential membership to the Waveny Public Pool.

The Seely House is a rare opportunity to become the next steward of one of New Canaan's enduring historic treasures. This remarkable residence traces its origins to the years surrounding the American Revolution and stands as a tangible link to the town's earliest beginnings. Rich in character and architectural authenticity, the home showcases the craftmanship and charm that can only be achieved through centuries of careful preservation. Historic details blend seamlessly with modern comforts, creating a warm and inviting living experience that honors the home's heritage while accommodating today's lifestyle. Set along picturesque Old Stamford Rd., the property enjoys an enviable location just moments from downtown New Canaan's acclaimed restaurants, boutiques, parks, train station and schools. Here, homeowners can enjoy the rare combination of historic significance and walk-to-town/schools convenience. More than a residence, The Seely House is a legacy property offering timeless character, irreplaceable authenticity, and the chance to write the next chapter in a story that has endured for generations.

UTILITIES INCLUDED! Enjoy in-town New Canaan living in this sunny and charming 1-bedroom, 1-bath townhouse-style apartment featuring a private entrance, private yard, and off-street parking. Tucked away on a quiet street, yet just moments from everything New Canaan has to offer, this special East Maple Street location provides the perfect blend of privacy and convenience. Imagine strolling into town for ice cream on a beautiful evening or enjoying easy access to New Canaan's award-winning restaurants, the new world-class library, boutique shopping, parks, and Metro-North train service to NYC. Additional features include central air conditioning, oil heat (included), and a bright, sunny interior. Available immediately. Available for ONE resident only. Building is OWNER OCCUPIED. No smoking and no pets. References and full credit report required. Unit includes Washer and Dryer

**Receive up to one month free when you lease in May** Gorgeous one-bedroom apartment on Main Street in a landmark, boutique building (one of only ten units). Located in the heart of New Canaan Village, it is ideal for a highly walkable lifestyle with easy access to shops, restaurants, and the train for a Grand Central commute. The residence blends old-world charm (1881) with luxury new construction (2023 renovation). Features include high ceilings, hardwood floors, and a modern, open-concept kitchen with new appliances (range, dishwasher, refrigerator). Enjoy new windows, a separate heating/cooling system with your own thermostat, and a spectacular common roof deck with seating and chaise lounges.

Fabulous corner-unit townhome in the heart of New Canaan. This bright and beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence offers the perfect blend of style, space, and convenience. Flooded with natural light, the home features an open flow ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Step outside to your own large private terrace-a rare find, perfect for alfresco dining, morning coffee, or quiet evenings. Additional highlights include a detached garage for added storage and convenience. Enjoy resort-style living with access to two community pools, plus New Canaan's award-winning schools, vibrant downtown, and easy commuter access-all from this exceptional corner location.

listings.remarks: An exceptional opportunity to own in the desirable South of the YMCA neighborhood featuring four bedrooms & 4 1/2 baths, this home is a perfect mix of elegance and practicality. Taken down to the studs and rebuilt in 2006 - this home has it all. From the moment you step inside, you'll be captivated by the sophisticated details, including elegant moldings and wainscoting, rich hardwood floors and sunlit living spaces. The Living room boasts a wood burning fireplace and both LR and DR feature large bay windows. The library accessed off the LR has a trey coffered ceiling and a door to the terrace. Step through to the incredible oversized family room with gas fireplace which is wide open to an updated kitchen complete with top of the line stainless steel appliances, a walk-in pantry and a huge quartzite island. The breakfast nook opens to a charming terrace with a built-in gas grill and a large pergola with retractable shades. Upstairs an incredible primary suite is accented by another gas fireplace, a gorgeously updated bath and huge walk-in closet. There is a large bonus room with vaulted ceiling and three additional bedrooms, two with walk in closets and their own bath and one with access to a hall bath.  The unfinished basement is 1784 square feet and is completely dry awaiting your finishing touches! But the piece de la resistance is the over 1 acre of beautifully landscaped level yard perfect for family gatherings, or peaceful relaxation!

Step into timeless sophistication at this breathtaking Neoclassical estate, ideally located on over 4 pristine acres in one of New Canaan's most sought-after locations. Offering 6,557 square feet of beautifully refined living space, this extraordinary home effortlessly balances classic architectural elegance with the comforts of modern luxury. Thoughtfully redesigned and expanded between 2010 and 2017, the main residence features 5 spacious bedrooms and 4.1 bathrooms, alongside formal living and dining rooms, a chef-inspired kitchen, a sunlit mudroom, and multiple inviting family and gathering spaces. Every room showcases meticulous craftsmanship, bespoke millwork, and exceptional finishes-designed for both everyday living and elegant entertaining. A charming detached carriage house adds even more flexibility, perfect as a guest retreat, home office, fitness studio, or private residence for in-laws or an au pair. It includes its own bedroom, full bath, kitchen, and living area.  Outside, the estate unfolds into sweeping lawns, curated gardens, specimen trees, and beautifully designed hardscapes, including a sparkling pool and spa. With top-to-bottom improvements-new windows and doors, updated utilities, a re-sealed roof, and more-this home is as turnkey as it is timeless.  This is a rare opportunity to own an iconic and serene legacy property in the heart of New Canaan-an estate that truly must be seen to be appreciated.

listings.remarks: Classic Colonial in sought-after Silvermine, set on four acres of protected natural surroundings that offer a rare combination of privacy, beauty, and enduring character. Mature trees, preserved wetlands, and seasonal views create a landscape that feels both expansive and intimately connected to nature, while a conservation easement helps ensure these surroundings remain protected for generations to come. Inside, elegant living spaces and thoughtful design create a home equally suited to quiet enjoyment and effortless entertaining. A two-story entry opens to an oversized formal living room, while the kitchen flows seamlessly into the family room. Two main-level offices offer flexibility for today's lifestyle. The primary bedroom features a spa-like bath with heated floors and dual walk-in closets. Three additional bedrooms include two en-suite baths. A private fifth bedroom with sitting room and full bath is ideal for in-law or au pair. Finished basement and full-house generator complete this exceptional offering.

Welcome to 372 Brushy Ridge Road in the picturesque town of New Canaan, CT. A stone-pillared entrance leads you to this magnificent estate, meticulously transformed between 2022 and 2024. This 8,000+ sq ft home strikes a balance that is genuinely difficult to achieve: light-flooded and effortlessly modern, yet layered with warmth and character that only time can give. The four rooms at the heart of this home - the primary bedroom, kitchen, sunroom, and family room - each received transformations of the highest order. In both the primary suite and sunroom, rooflines were lifted to create spaces of extraordinary volume and light. The primary bedroom is a true sanctuary: soaring ceilings, new Marvin windows framing the treetops, an antique Delft-tiled fireplace, and a spa bath of the finest standard. The rebuilt sunroom, with vaulted beamed ceiling and Paris Ceramics heated reclaimed marble tile floor, is simply breathtaking, and the showpiece kitchen looks directly into it, featuring custom cabinetry, honed black granite, a butler's pantry, and Miele coffee station. Antique chandeliers, Ball & Ball hardware, Gracie wallpaper, and hand-scraped oak floors whisper of the home's soul - every finish custom, nothing left to do. Set across 3.5 enchanting acres designed by renowned landscape architect Kathryn Herman, the grounds evoke the quiet romance of the English countryside. A guest cottage and garaging for five complete this singular estate - minutes from town, worlds away.

Privately set at the end of a long drive and elevated to capture tranquil reservoir views, this more than 5,500 square foot Colonial offers a rare sense of serenity and scale. Designed to embrace its natural surroundings, the home features beautifully proportioned interiors and oversized windows that bathe each space in light. The grand living room with fireplace opens seamlessly to a screened porch, creating an effortless indoor-outdoor experience ideal for quiet mornings or relaxed entertaining. A spacious eat-in kitchen with SubZero, Wolf and Miele appliances, huge center island, and skylight connects to the inviting family room with fireplace. The second level offers a refined primary suite along with five additional bedrooms, including ensuite and Jack-and-Jill configurations. Surrounded by professionally landscaped grounds, with a tennis court and charming gazebo, the property offers a peaceful retreat just minutes from town.

Modern Luxury Meets Classic Charm on Elm Place - Experience sophisticated living in this spectacular masterpiece situated on one of the area's most coveted streets, where a dramatic, light-drenched three-story foyer flows effortlessly into a formal dining room and a sprawling front-to-back living room anchored by a classic fireplace. The heart of the home features an open-concept gourmet kitchen and an inviting family room complete with a rugged stone fireplace, custom wet bar, and sunny breakfast nook. Through elegant French doors, the living space extends to an unparalleled outdoor oasis; this private sanctuary is anchored by an expansive stone terrace and a pristine, heated Gunite pool and spa, all framed by lush, professional landscaping and a fully fenced perimeter for ultimate seclusion. The second level is home to a luxurious primary retreat with a gas fireplace, expansive walk-in closets, and a spa-like marble bath, alongside three additional en-suite bedrooms and a convenient laundry room. Versatility abounds on the finished third floor, which offers a dedicated office, family room, and a fifth bedroom, while the lower level provides a spacious gym or media room with integrated cabinetry. Ideally located just moments from award-winning schools, fine dining, and boutique shopping, with easy access to NYC and Boston, this home offers a masterclass in style, privacy, and convenience.

Modern Architectural Masterpiece - Nestled on 1.77 acres of lush, verdant grounds, this custom 2014-built estate is a triumph of contemporary design and sophisticated luxury. Spanning 5,630 square feet, the residence strikes a perfect chord between avant-garde architecture and residential warmth, characterized by soaring ceilings, premium finishes, an abundance of natural light and a Geo-thermal efficient energy system with radiant heat floors throughout. The meticulously curated interior features an open concept floorplan with generously proportioned rooms, four ensuite bedrooms, providing an unrivaled level of privacy and comfort for family and guests alike. While the indoor living spaces transition gracefully from formal galleries to casual retreats, the exterior is a true resort-style sanctuary. The expansive acreage boasts a heated pool, a discreet in-ground trampoline, Large terraces with fireplace and built-in BBQ's and a stylish pool house with kitchen, bath, stone fireplace and sleeping loft, all overlooking the serene, shimmering waters of a spring-fed pond. Complete with a detached 3-car garage and state-of-the-art systems, this modern gem offers a rare lifestyle opportunity within a community world-renowned for its prestigious schools and refined suburban charm.

listings.remarks: HIGHEST and BEST offers due Monday April 27th at noon. Nestled on a beautiful one acre lot, this charming home blends comfort and convenience. This home has been cherished by the same family for over 44 years. The bright main level flows easily through the living spaces, while the expansive lower level becomes the heart of the home with its spacious family room with fireplace and beautiful built-ins, private office, and fun bar area. Three bedrooms offer peaceful retreats, and the property's wide, open yard invites outdoor play, gardening, or quiet evenings under the trees. A wonderful opportunity to enjoy space inside and out.  Amazing location just steps to Waveny Park; leisurely walk to town; convenient to both the Merritt Parkway and train stations; and the most charming New England Village of New Canaan with top ranking schools, restaurants, and shopping.

Timeless character and thoughtful, recent updates come together beautifully at this classic 1930s Colonial set on over three private acres in one of New Canaan's most serene settings. Lovingly maintained and enhanced over time, you'll find a rare combination of architectural charm, graceful living spaces, and a sense of quiet retreat surrounded by protected land. The gracious foyer introduces interiors filled with warmth and personality, where rich finishes and curated details create a home that feels both refined and deeply comfortable. The living room, anchored by a fireplace, opens seamlessly to a terrace, inviting an easy connection between indoor and outdoor living. A very generous dining room and a cozy, wood-paneled family room offer intimate spaces for gathering or unwinding, while the recently renovated kitchen is both functional and beautifully designed, with custom cabinetry, high-end appliances, and beautiful western sunlight with views across the property. Upstairs, four well-proportioned bedrooms include a serene primary suite with a newly designed bath and custom closet. Each additional bedroom offers its own sense of privacy and comfort. A separate studio complete with its own full bath and walk-in closet, provides exceptional flexibility for guests, extended family, or a private work-from-home suite. The grounds are as special as the home itself.

Welcome to 40 Church Street. Where comfort meets chic. This thoughtfully updated home will lure you in with its warmth and charming details. The front porch and patio are the perfect setting for a summer barbecue. Enjoy the open floor plan, gourmet kitchen, three en-suite bedrooms and cozy family room. Ideally located in the heart of New Canaan. Just a short stroll to town center, parks, train and restaurants. THIS HOME IS AVAILABLE AS A SUMMER RENTAL or SHORT TERM - May 1st through October 31st. Renter responsible for monthly cleaning service. $10,000/month.

Welcome to 40 Church Street. Where comfort meets chic. This thoughtfully updated home will lure you in with its warmth and charming details. The front porch and patio are the perfect setting for a summer barbecue. Enjoy the open floor plan, gourmet kitchen, three en-suite bedrooms and cozy family room. Ideally located in the heart of New Canaan. Just a short stroll to town center, parks, train and restaurants. THIS HOME IS AVAILABLE AS A SUMMER RENTAL or SHORT TERM - May 1st through October 31st. Renter responsible for monthly cleaning service. $10,000/month.

Summer furnished rental. An incredibly rare opportunity to reside in a mid-century modern home designed by world renowned Harvard Five Architect, Eliot Noyes. In The Lee Ault House, originally built in 1951 and recently renovated with the utmost care and consideration for maintaining the brilliant mid-century modern design, the indoors and outdoors blend seamlessly to create a stunning, light filled home. You will delight in expansive views of nature, mature trees and level property with patios & courtyards and floor to ceiling glass walls throughout. This truly spectacular home is both minimalist yet inviting with new white oak floors throughout. The newly installed, state-of-the-art spacious kitchen/breakfast room which features Miele appliances, John Pawson stainless steel fixtures, a large island with Carrera marble countertops, and custom cabinetry. Bathrooms feature Carrera marble sinks and custom white oak cabinetry along with John Pawson fixtures and sink in the primary bath. The private and tranquil 4+ acre property was originally designed by Landscape Designer Thomas Church, and the home's original pool has been opened and heated. Available Furnished with flexible lease term. The furnished option includes Fritz Hansen furniture (interior), Carl Hansen patio furniture, and Francis Mallman grill. How wonderful to have the good fortune to live in a work of art. Offered as a flexible term furnished summer rental starting June through August.

ALL OFFERS TO BE RECEIVED BY NOON (12:00) ON FRIDAY THE 15TH. Ideally located close to schools and Waveny Park, this updated Colonial is set on 1.34 private acres at the end of a secluded lane. An open floor plan with abundant windows and doors fills the home with natural light and creates seamless access to a terrace and expansive, level backyard. Featuring a spacious primary suite, generous secondary bedrooms, an updated kitchen, new 5-zone heating system, and a detached three-car garage-perfect for both everyday living and effortless entertaining.

Welcome to this stunning custom shingle-style residence set amid sweeping lawns, mature flowering trees, and beautiful natural surroundings in one of New Canaan's most picturesque settings.This exceptional 4/5-bedroom residence blends timeless New England architecture with modern living and refined architectural detail throughout. The cathedral-ceiling living room with fireplace, walls of windows, and sliders to the deck serves as an inviting and dramatic centerpiece. The open-concept kitchen, breakfast area, and family room are thoughtfully designed for everyday living and entertaining, opening seamlessly to the side porch and terrace overlooking the majestic property. A formal dining room lends warmth and sophistication, complemented by a first-floor guest bedroom and office. Upstairs features 3 additional bedrooms, including one with a balcony overlooking the breathtaking property, plus a lounge and skylit study area. The expansive walk-out lower level offers 1,600+ square feet with recreation room, full bath, and wine cellar. Outside, enjoy peaceful entertaining spaces, a beautiful Wagner gunite pool with gazebo, and a classic red barn with stalls, all surrounded by vibrant seasonal landscaping that enhances the property's natural beauty year round. A rare offering that combines beautiful grounds, timeless charm, and an exceptional lifestyle, all just minutes from town, schools, and the train.

Nestled in a quiet neighborhood this spacious single family home offers flexibility, comfort, and a highly convenient location. Set on a generous lot, the property features a large backyard ideal for outdoor gatherings, complete with ample parking. Inside, the home provides an expansive layout the main floor features five comfortable, carpeted bedrooms, a full bath, a dedicated laundry room, a bright eat-in kitchen, and a welcoming living room with hardwood flooring, perfect for everyday living and entertaining. The lower level adds even more versatility, offering three additional bedrooms with wall-to-wall carpeting, a full bath, and a spacious living area with dining space and a second kitchen setup. Whether used for extended living, guest accommodations, or recreation, this level enhances the home's overall functionality. The home has been thoughtfully updated, updated cabinets and flooring on both the upper and lower levels, and fully renovated bathrooms upstairs and downstairs. Additional improvements include a new fire-rated window in the lower level and brand new carpeting throughout both levels, enhancing comfort and peace of mind. Enjoy easy access to the Merritt Parkway, while also being within walking distance to the train station and the charming town center, known for its quaint shops and local amenities!

Complete renovation in 2024 of this 3-bedroom townhouse that is walking distance to town, train, shops and restaurants! New kitchen and baths, newly finished floors and freshly painted walls. New Central Air and high-efficiency heating system! Lower level completely finished with family room, large laundry/utility room and additional bonus room/home office. Look no further than this beautiful home in a quiet residential neighborhood. Listen to the babbling Five Mile River from your large deck overlooking a private back yard. Additional storage area in detached barn for motorcycle, bicycles, sports gear, etc.

Set on 5 private acres in one of New Canaan's most desirable settings, this beautifully maintained home is on the market for the first time in nearly three decades. The property has been meticulously maintained and offers a true country club lifestyle with a tennis court, pool, and expansive grounds designed for recreation and relaxation. The main level features an open concept layout with abundant natural light, a dedicated office, and a wraparound deck overlooking the sweeping landscape and pool area. The upper level offers four bedrooms, including a serene primary suite with an updated ensuite bath and large walk-in closet. The fully finished walkout lower level adds exceptional versatility with a gym, additional flexible space and lots of storage. The house comes with an irrigation system, invisible fence and a driveway manometer. A rare opportunity to enjoy resort style living just minutes from town, schools, and train.

Discover the epitome of modern living with this stunning brand new construction, perfectly nestled in the vibrant heart of New Canaan.   Enjoy unparalleled convenience as you stroll to the charming downtown, catch a train for an effortless commute, or explore the scenic beauty of Waveny Park. With shopping, the newly constructed library, exquisite dining options, and a plethora of amenities just steps away, this property offers an exceptional blend of urban charm and suburban tranquility. Welcome to your dream home, where lifestyle, ease and location come together seamlessly. Featuring an approved pool site and a full-house generator, this property offers both comfort and peace of mind.

Experience timeless elegance and resort-style living in this extraordinary stone estate on 2+ spectacular acres overlooking a serene spring-fed pond with direct water access. Designed by architect Malcolm Robertson with interiors inspired by Rick Livingston Period Design, this home offers 9,369 SF of masterfully crafted living space blending architectural sophistication with modern luxury. Built in 2004, the home showcases Venetian plaster walls, cerused oak details, radiant heated stone floors, soaring ceilings, extensive custom millwork, and dramatic walls of glass framing breathtaking views of the pool, grounds, and pond. At the center of the home is a showstopping 3 story gourmet kitchen-a true culinary masterpiece-seamlessly blending architectural drama with top-tier functionality with limestone counters, oversized gathering island, and premium Miele, Wolf, Viking, and SubZero appliances. Designed for both grand entertaining and comfortable everyday living, the residence features 6 en-suite bedrooms, 8 full and 2 half baths, with spectacular first-floor primary suite with dressing rm and spa bath. Amenities incl media rm, billiard rm, sun rm, gym, professional office suite, Control4 smart home technology, surround sound, heated pool w/automatic cover, separate spa, Har-Tru tennis court, extensive landscape lighting, and beautifully manicured grounds. Rarely does a property of this caliber, privacy, and design become available just moments from town in a coveted location

Avail July 1. Renovated and spacious two bedroom unit w/Din Rm used as possible separate 3rd room for office, gym, playroom etc! The updated kitchen has Quartz counters, tile floor, high end S/S appliances, custom lighting, sunny window and plenty of cabinets. Relax in a luxurious renovated bathroom with amazing modern details, extra hidden storages and natural sunlight. You will be welcomed into the unit with high ceilings through a cozy wide foyer featuring hardwood floors and arched doorways seen throughout the condo. Two convenient closets are in the entrance foyer. Extra large living room with views of the treed courtyard. The living room is large enough to combine a LR/DR leaving the separate DR to be used as an office, gym or playroom if desired. Enjoy the comfort of having two large bedrooms with extra modern wardrobe closets located in each room. 2 unassigned parking spots included in the rent. Unit has a newer HVAC system, windows and ELFA shelving. Painted and prof cleaned in 2025. The complex is situated on a beautiful and scenic tree lined campus with walkways, grills, gazebo, dog area and a secure bike room. This is a pet friendly complex. Condo located in desirable Woodside Green across from Scalzi Park and from Summer Street shopping/dining. Minutes to bus, train, UCONN, library, fitness and major highways. Available immediately. Please note: No weekend move-ins allowed per Association. Landlord requires Credit Score 650+.

This distinguished Colonial, originally built in 1911, seamlessly blends timeless character with modern sophistication. Thoughtfully renovated and reimagined by renowned Country Club Homes, this HOBI Award-winning residence showcases exceptional craftsmanship, refined millwork, and today's most desirable amenities. Ideally situated in the heart of New Canaan, just moments from the train, downtown, and local conveniences, the home offers both elegance and accessibility. Architectural highlights include a striking curved wall of windows that fills the interiors with natural light, while the open floor plan provides effortless flow for everyday living and entertaining, with seamless access to inviting outdoor spaces. The second floor features a gracious primary suite along with three additional bedrooms, while the third level offers a private ensuite bedroom with sitting room and full bath-ideal for guests or extended family. Set amid beautifully landscaped grounds, the property is enhanced by terraces and outdoor fireplace, creating an exceptional setting for relaxation and gatherings. A rare offering, this home captures the perfect balance of old-world charm and modern living in a premier in-town location.

Recently renovated 3-bedroom townhouse, walking distance to town, train, shops and restaurants! New kitchen and baths, newly finished floors and freshly painted walls. New Central Air! Lower level completely finished with family room, large laundry/utility room and separate storage area. Look no further than this beautiful home in a quiet residential neighborhood. Listen to the babbling Five Mile River from your large deck overlooking a private back yard. Additional storage area in detached barn for motorcycle, bicycles, sports gear, etc. Photos taken prior to current tenants moving in.

Discover the perfect blend of elegance and modern comfort in this newly renovated home nestled on two serene acres in New Canaan. Boasting five spacious bedrooms and three and a half baths, this home offers ample space for relaxation and entertaining.  The heart of the home is an open floorplan kitchen and dining area, featuring a large kitchen island perfect for culinary creations and gatherings. The formal living room and the family room each have a working fireplace, creating warm and inviting spaces.  Upstairs, a fully finished third floor provides a dedicated office space, ideal for those who work from home. The property also includes a large bonus room above the two-car garage, which can serve as an entertainment area or exercise space.  With an additional room on the main floor available for home office use, this property accommodates today's need for versatile work and living spaces. Every corner of this home has been thoughtfully updated with modern finishes, ensuring a luxurious and comfortable lifestyle.  Experience the best of New Canaan living in this exceptional rental property, where every detail has been designed for your comfort and convenience.

Turn-key, move in ready modern townhouse located in the heart of downtown New Canaan, this home offers three floors of elegant living with the feel of a single-family residence and the convenience of low-maintenance living. The renovated open floor plan features a state of the art newer chef's kitchen, a breakfast nook, island, and a light-filled living room/dining room with a fireplace. The main floor offers a study or additional bedroom with its own fireplace and large windows. On the second floor, you will find the owner suite featuring- a renovated luxury bathroom with soaking tub, shower, 2 vanities, two walk-in fitted closets-along with two additional bedrooms, a full bath, and a laundry area. The lower level provides nearly 1,000 square feet of additional walk out living space with fireplace large recreation room and a patio. Outside, the walk-out lower level leads to a private patio and yard, offering a quiet oasis which backs up to a Bristow Park Bird Sanctuary and Mead Park. A short stroll on sidewalks to Metro North train station, shops, restaurants and the beautiful village of New Canaan.

Experience the best of New Canaan living in this impeccable first-floor corner-unit condominium in one of Fairfield's County's most sought-after communities. This beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 2 bath home offers the perfect blend of comfort, style and convenience just walking distant to restaurants, cafes, shopping parks, and the Metro-North Railroad for and easy NYC commute. Filled with both morning and afternoon sunlight, the home features custom floor-to- ceiling built-ins surrounding a marble electric fireplace, crown molding throughout, refreshed hardwood floors (2024) newer windows, and stylish new lighting. The refreshed kitchen (20024) includes a new refrigerator, microwave all stainless-steel appliances, while both full baths were beautifully renovated in 2024. Rare conveniences include a detached one-car garage and a deeded parking space just outside the rear entrance. Additional private basement storage. Enjoy beautifully landscaped grounds, two community pools and low-maintenance living with heat, A/C, hot water, snow and garbage removal, professionally managed included in the HOA. Located near top-rated public schools, new library and beloved town parks, this is the turnkey living in the heart of New Canaan. 125 Heritage Hill Road Unit A is a special place to call home.

listings.remarks: A rare opportunity to enjoy all that New Canaan has to offer while living in an historic mid-century modern masterpiece: The Elinor and Sherman Ford House. Located on 5.2 private, lush acres in desirable New Canaan, CT. This iconic residence, listed on the National Register of Historic Places (2010), is a pristine local example of Mid-Century Modern architecture designed in 1952-54 by the firm Gates and Ford.  The sprawling property includes a period guesthouse and a pool house, all set within grounds meticulously designed by notable landscape architect Fride Stege in 1963.  The main house is a striking low, single-story structure defined by its wood frame construction and a compelling combination of floor-to-ceiling glass, dark brown vertical board siding, and authentic fieldstone. The three-section layout masterfully balances light and privacy: the west wing features extensive glass to engage the outside living spaces and beautifully curated landscaping, while the east wing provides a more private retreat.   Just minutes from the Metro North train station and the village of New Canaan with notable restaurants, shopping and entertainment.

Renovated, move-in-ready condo located in the heart of New Canaan village. This spacious end unit features large picture windows providing excellent natural light. The interior includes an eat-in kitchen with a built-in sitting banquette and new stainless steel appliances, alongside a large living room with a fireplace and a tandem dining room. The home offers three large ensuite bedrooms and a finished lower level suitable for a playroom or home gym. Additional amenities include a half bath, a laundry room, an attached garage, and a private fenced patio. Residents also enjoy access to the Cobbler's Green community pool. The property is ideally situated in town within walking distance of the village center, library, restaurants, shops, schools, and parks. It also offers convenient access to the express train to New York City.

listings.remarks: Experience refined living in this beautifully renovated townhouse-style condominium, ideally situated in the heart of New Canaan. Offering four bedrooms, two full bathrooms, and a finished third floor, this exceptional residence combines timeless elegance with modern comfort and effortless functionality. The thoughtfully updated interior features a designer-inspired kitchen with elegant quartz countertops conviniently opens to an expansive deck. Beautifully renovated bathrooms, pristine hardwood floors, and an abundance of natural light throughout. The spacious and versatile layout provides plenty of room for both everyday living and entertaining. The first floor offers a private bedroom and full bathroom, perfect for guests, a home office, or flexible living arrangements. The finished third floor provides additional space that can be tailored to your lifestyle.  Ideally located just moments from New Canaan's brand-new library, charming downtown, acclaimed restaurants and shops, and the train station, this home offers the rare combination of sophisticated living and unparalleled convenience. Plenty of parking space. A truly exceptional opportunity to enjoy the best of New Canaan living.  Qualified tenants only. Good credit, verifiable income, and strong references required. Two months' security deposit and one month's rent in advance required.

Imagine an exquisite Federal-style townhouse born from an extraordinary collaboration between its owner and an award-winning builder. Imagine sitting on the home's expansive terrace, surrounded by gorgeous gardens and enjoying breathtaking, private views of New Canaan's most picturesque park and pond. Welcome to Richmond Mews.    This beautiful three-bedroom, three-bath residence features 9+ foot ceilings and oversized windows that flood the interiors with natural light. Relax in today's highly desirable open-concept family room and gourmet kitchen, while gracious living and dining rooms create an elegant setting for entertaining.    Whether working from home, enjoying 4th of July fireworks with friends right from your patio, hosting loved ones after the town's celebrated Memorial Day parade, or devouring your favorite novel, you'll appreciate the home's multiple flexible spaces, including charming library, office, and sitting rooms. The primary suite offers oversized walk-in closets, a luxurious bath, and a private office, while two additional spacious bedrooms provide lovely accommodations for family and guests.    And from virtually every room, delight in incomparable park views.   Just moments from top restaurants, fine shopping, and the train, this exceptional residence offers the very best of village living in one of New England's prettiest towns.

Discover boutique-style living at Husted Commons, where timeless elegance meets contemporary design in a prime downtown New Canaan location, just 50 miles from NYC. Enjoy easy access to the Metro-North train station, Main and Elm streets, and a wide array of retail and dining options. This distinctive new complex built in 2024 features 12 residences, offering one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and two-bedroom loft options. The loft residences feature private rooftop decks. Each unique residence boasts open layouts that flood with natural light, soaring 9+ foot ceilings, and beautiful white oak flooring. Experience chef-inspired kitchens equipped with custom cabinetry, premium appliances, and quartz countertops. Master bedroom suites are designed for comfort, complemented by bathrooms with heated floors. Enjoy the benefits of smart home technology, in-residence washers and dryers, private security system, and custom solar shades for added convenience. Husted Commons also features elevator service, private balconies or terraces in select residences, reserved underground and courtyard parking for two cars with car charging stations, and inviting outdoor green spaces, making it the ideal choice for in-town living!

Move-in-ready, renovated New Canaan charmer. This three-bedroom home is a true gem, featuring 1930s vintage architectural details alongside extensive recent updates. Key highlights of the property include: Main Level: An updated kitchen with top-of-the-line stainless appliances and a sitting island, opens to the dining room, and a living room. Easy access to outdoor patio. Second Floor: An owner suite with hardwood floors and a large walk-in closet, plus two additional bedrooms, a full bath, and a large linen closet. Lower Level: A finished recreational playroom, laundry area, workroom, and storage closet. Additional Storage: Plentiful space in the walk-up attic.  Exterior: A level backyard with a two-car garage and a private courtyard patio, perfect for relaxation and entertaining. Ideally located for commuters, this home offers easy access to West Elementary School, the town center, Metro-North, and the Parkway.

Nestled in the heart of downtown New Canaan, this charming and beautifully updated home offers the perfect blend of classic character and modern convenience. Just moments from town, the property features four finished levels of living space, including a newly finished lower level and a spacious livable third floor complete with a cedar closet. French doors off the kitchen open seamlessly to a stunning patio overlooking a large, rare in-town backyard - fully fenced for privacy and ideal for entertaining, play or relaxation. The eat in kitchen boasts top of the line appliances with a butchers block and breakfast nook. This home offers three bedrooms, a sunroom and two and a half baths, including a primary suite with en-suite bath and walk-in closet. Less than .3 miles to fine dining, shopping, Metro-North, the library and award winning schools, 42 Hoyt Street is truly a commuters dream in one of Fairfield County's most sought after communities. Its a must see!

Gut renovated in 2019 and now going through a major refresh, this 3 bedroom townhouse has refinished floors, updated kitchen, new bathrooms and freshly painted interiors. All interior doors are being replaced, new recessed lighting, new carpeting on stairwells, plus new Central AC. New floors in Lower level family room. Many new appliances. New stone patio overlooking fenced yard. Move right into this bright and fresh home. Walk to town, train, schools and parks. Enjoy all that New Canaan has to offer.

Enjoy the ease of in-town living at its finest. Ideally located just moments from restaurants, shops, library, farmer's market, movie theater, the Metro-North train and local churches. This home offers exceptional convenience with no car required. Set on a quiet cul-de-sac, the property combines peaceful surroundings with close proximity to all the amenities of town.   A rare opportunity, this legal two-family residence offers outstanding flexibility, live in one unit while generating rental income from the other, or rent both units. Perfect for commuters or those seeking a weekend retreat, the home also features a sunny backyard, ideal for gardening, relaxing, or entertaining.   Thoughtfully updated, the main house includes a new washer and dryer (2026), new dishwasher and hood (2025), a perimeter fence (2023), a mini-split heating and cooling system (2023), a roof installed in 2021, and a whole house water filtration system in place. The apartment has also been well maintained with a new stove (2026), new dishwasher (2025), and washer and dryer (2023). The property is serviced by public sewer and town water. Properties with this combination of location, versatility, and charm rarely come to market. Come experience all the possibilities this exceptional home has to offer.
