Charming brick condo in a desirable complex just moments from downtown New Canaan and the train station. This inviting 2-bedroom, 1 full bath home offers comfortable, easy living with a spacious living room filled with natural light and an eat-in kitchen with plenty of room for casual dining. Enjoy the convenience of being within walking distance to shops, restaurants, parks, and commuter rail service while living in a quiet, well-maintained community. *Heat & hot water included in rent, just pay electric!*

The ONE you've been waiting for! Picture-perfect classic Colonial in the heart of one of New Canaan's CUTEST neighborhoods, steps from South School, Saxe Middle School, New Canaan High School, and the vibrant town center. Move right in and enjoy a spacious kitchen, generous living spaces, and a large, flat backyard perfect for entertaining, play, or relaxing outdoors. 4+ bedrooms, huge second-floor family room, light-filled unfinished third floor with charming dormer windows ready for expansion, and a lower level with high ceilings offering endless possibilities for future finished space. A rare opportunity to embrace the unmatched lifestyle, sense of community, and convenience that make New Canaan so special. Top-Rated Schools * Steps to Town * Expansion Potential * Flat Backyard * Coveted Location * Move-In Ready. Come see why so many families are loving New Canaan!

Situated just moments from town, the train, schools, restaurants and shops, 349 Ponus Ridge offers one level living at its finest. The open floor plan consists of a formal living and dining room with stone fireplace, updated eat in kitchen with vaulted ceiling and exposed beams. The large primary suite has views of the backyard with full bathroom, walk in closet and laundry room. Two double bedrooms share a hall bath. A blue stone patio leads to the private backyard that has plenty of space for play, outdoor dining, and entertaining. Attached one car garage. Auxiliary generator adds peace of mind.

listings.remarks: Discover the perfect blend of a private retreat and everyday convenience in this beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom townhouse. Ideally situated at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, this home offers a serene setting with picturesque views of the Five Mile River, while being just minutes from East Elementary School, downtown shopping and dining, and Metro-North. Property sold as-is.

Set atop a native stone lined property in one of New Canaan's most convenient locations, this spacious 5 bedroom, 5 full bath home offers timeless appeal, generous scale, and incredible flexibility for today's lifestyle. Just minutes from Waveny Park, top-rated schools, and only 0.6 miles to Talmadge Hill Train Station, the location is ideal for both everyday living and commuting. An appealing 57 foot front porch creates a warm welcome into the impressive foyer, setting the tone for beautifully proportioned interiors beyond. Elegant formal living room with fireplace and dining room, provide inviting spaces for entertaining, while the expansive renovated kitchen with oversized center island, gas range, pantry, and sunlit breakfast room opens to the patio for effortless indoor/outdoor living. The adjoining family room with fireplace is the heart of the home, offering a warm and comfortable gathering space, and a private first floor office provides an ideal work from home retreat. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite is a true sanctuary, featuring an expansive bedroom, walk in closet, and a stunning spa inspired bath with vaulted ceilings, dual vanities, a sculptural soaking tub, and a separate shower, creating a serene retreat filled with natural light. Three additional generously sized bedrooms, well appointed baths and a convenient laundry room complete this level. The third floor offers exceptional versatility as a 5th bedroom suite, gym, recreation or media room.

Located on 1.34 picturesque acres in New Canaan's historic Silvermine neighborhood, this well-maintained 5-bedroom Colonial combines timeless appeal, a peaceful setting, and plenty of room both inside and out. The expansive 4,194-square-foot floor plan offers great flow and flexible living spaces to accommodate today's lifestyle. The main level features an eat-in kitchen, formal living and dining rooms, a family room, home office, and mudroom with laundry. The second floor includes four bedrooms and a walk-up attic, along with a bonus fifth bedroom located above the garage with its own en-suite bath, providing the perfect setup for an au pair, in-laws, or guests. The lower level provides additional versatile space, including a second family room, office, and gym. The beautiful property offers room for outdoor entertaining, gardening, play, or simply enjoying the peaceful surroundings from the charming gazebo. Ideally situated with easy access to downtown New Canaan, neighboring towns, and commuting routes, this home enjoys the charm and ambiance of the Silvermine community, with close proximity to GrayBarns, the Silvermine Market, and the Silvermine Arts Center, as well as the convenience of nearby amenities in one of New Canaan's most desirable settings.

Welcome to 112 East Avenue! A wonderful and spacious 4 Bedroom Townhouse with lovely, private stone front terrace/patio. Set back from the street with 2 designated parking spaces and featuring an oversized eat in kitchen with ample space for meal prep and entertaining with convenient access leading to private patio. Large Living Room, with hardwood floors, featuring oversized window and wood-burning fireplace, leads to an oversized Formal Dining Room with hardwood floors. The family room has direct access to 1/2 bath and sliders leading to the backyard. The upper level offers a huge primary bedroom and private full bath. There are 3 additional bedrooms plus a large full bath with dressing table and oversized shower. Pull down attic AND full basement offer additional storage.

Set just four minutes from town on nearly three acres adjacent to protected Land Trust property, this exceptional residence offers the privacy, scale, and tranquility of a country estate without sacrificing convenience. Sprawling lawns, stone walls, and a fully finished pool house with pool accessed through a dramatic hornbeam archway, underscore the property's exceptional outdoor living experience. The entry foyer establishes the home's architectural character, unfolding into a generous front to back gallery anchored by mahogany doors that open directly to the 33 foot covered porch and outdoor terrace. Detailed millwork, oak floors, and beautifully proportioned rooms create a sense of continuity throughout, while French doors across the principal living spaces provide a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living. The kitchen, family room, and informal dining area are thoughtfully arranged in an open, flowing layout oriented toward the grounds, balancing everyday comfort with effortless entertaining. A well appointed mudroom serves the practical demands of daily life with equal attention to detail. The primary suite is distinguished by soaring 12 foot ceilings and dual walk in closets. Four additional en suite bedrooms, a substantial bonus room, and a third floor guest suite/lounge complete the upper levels. The lower level is finished with a generous recreation space, half bath, media room, and a gaming room that walks out to a private terrace.

Located in one of the community's most desirable settings, this elevated end-unit one-bedroom condo enjoys sweeping views and exceptional natural light from three exposures. Freshly painted and thoughtfully updated, the home features an upgraded kitchen, spacious and well-defined living areas, and abundant storage, including a large walk-in closet.  The flexible floor plan allows for the addition of a separate sleeping area or Murphy bed within the main living space, offering versatility to fit your lifestyle. Additional conveniences include basement storage and on-site laundry.  Recent improvements include new windows and a new air conditioning unit. Heat and hot water are included in the common charges for added value and ease of ownership.  Ideally situated near the assigned parking space and separately deeded garage available for purchase with the unit (not included in listing price), residents also enjoy access to two community pools. A perfect combination of comfort, convenience, and low-maintenance living just moments from town.

Filled with warmth and charm, the home features inviting living spaces, thoughtful updates and wonderful natural light throughout. The private backyard is a true gem beautifully landscaped, space for relaxing and entertaining. A detached garage provides valuable additional space and flexibility; home office, party barn. Combining charm, convenience and outdoor beauty, this home is a wonderful opportunity in a sought-after neighborhood.

listings.remarks: JUST REDUCED-AMAZING PRICE. Exceptional investment opportunity in the heart of New Canaan. This fully leased, income-producing 3-family property offers immediate cash flow and long-term value in one of Fairfield County's most desirable communities. Generating $8,450 per month in rental income, the property is meticulously maintained and features 3 well appointed residences, each with in-unit laundry, garage and functional layouts that attract quality tenants. A rare offering, the property incls 6 garage spaces-4 attached to the main residence plus a detached 2-car garage with loft storage-providing additional rental potential, storage, or future flexibility. The charming grounds feature a delightful garden setting, creating an appealing environment for residents. Ideally located within walking distance to New Canaan's vibrant downtown, residents enjoy easy access to fine dining, boutique shopping, parks, cultural attractions, and the Metro-North train with direct service to Grand Central Terminal. Consistently recognized for its top-rated schools, picturesque New England character, and exceptional quality of life, New Canaan remains one of Connecticut's most sought-after residential destinations. Whether expanding an investment portfolio or seeking a multi-generational living opportunity with strong income potential, this turnkey property presents a rare chance to own a premier multi-family asset in an exceptional location. This is a rare opportunity for a savvy purchaser.

Exquisite 6-Bedroom Colonial on Over 3 Private Acres - This is the one you've been waiting for-a timeless estate designed for gracious living, exceptional entertaining, and the creation of lifelong memories. Set at the end of a private lane on over 3 spectacular acres, this exceptional Colonial blends timeless elegance with modern luxury. A grand foyer with a sweeping curved staircase welcomes you into beautifully scaled rooms featuring soaring ceilings, exquisite millwork, and abundant natural light. Formal living and dining rooms, each with a fireplace, flow seamlessly into an impressive library w/custom built-ins and a sun-filled family room w/French doors opening to an expansive terrace. The gourmet kitchen overlooks the pool and adjoins a charming paneled breakfast room with a fireplace, creating the perfect setting for everyday living and entertaining. Upstairs, a gracious landing overlooks the dramatic foyer and leads to a luxurious primary suite with fireplace, custom cabinetry, and a spa-inspired bath. Three additional en-suite bedrooms, a spacious bonus room, and a private guest suite provide exceptional flexibility. The fully finished walk-out lower level offers a large playroom, guest suite with full bath, and a dedicated fitness room. Outside, enjoy the private, park-like grounds complete with stone walls, a new pool, fenced yard, and playset. Just minutes from town, train, and award-winning schools, this rare offering combines privacy, scale, and convenience.

Welcome to 134 Woodside Green #1 in Stamford. This spacious condo offers comfortable living with a large bedroom featuring its own private bathroom, plus a private patio and separate entrance for added convenience. Ideally located within walking distance to shopping, dining, and everyday amenities, making it the perfect blend of comfort and accessibility.

listings.remarks: Classic Connecticut Colonial beautifully renovated for today's lifestyle! This pristine 4-bedroom, 3.1-bath home offers an inviting open floor plan centered around a fabulous gourmet kitchen flowing seamlessly into a sun-filled family room with custom built-ins. Elegant entertaining spaces include an oversized dining room and gracious living room with fireplace, while a thoughtfully designed mudroom with custom millwork keeps things organized.                  Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite features a marble bath and his-and-hers walk-in closets, creating a private retreat, while two additional beautifully updated bathrooms complete the second floor. The finished lower level, filled with natural light from abundant windows, provides flexible space ideal for a playroom, home office, gym, or recreation room.                  Designed for both everyday living and entertaining, the screened porch and deck offer seamless indoor-outdoor enjoyment overlooking the sweeping flat backyard. Stone walls, perennial gardens, and beautifully landscaped grounds complete this picture-perfect family home, ideally located close to town, schools, Waveny Park, and commuting. ***HIGHEST AND BEST OFFERS BY 5PM 6/15/26***

Spacious 2 bedroom apartment in town. Close to train, shopping and restaurants. Well maintained complex with easy parking, laundry and storage on premises. Open floor plan with hardwood floors throughout. Two pools on premises and a fun common room that can be reserved for functions. Heat and hot water included.

Have you ever imagined living on prestigious South Avenue and strolling into town for dinner, a movie, or ice cream on a beautiful New England evening? Here is your opportunity. Welcome to highly sought-after Hathaway Common, a charming condominium community known for its beautifully maintained grounds, inviting pool, clubhouse, and warm neighborhood atmosphere with social gatherings and community events throughout the year. This desirable home offers the ease of one-floor living, with an enormous lower level providing exceptional storage or the opportunity to create additional finished living space. A nice surprise is there are hardwood floors under the carpet. A one-car garage and additional parking add to the convenience. The unit also enjoys an unusually generous outdoor space, including an area for your own private garden. The location simply cannot be beat. Enjoy an easy walk to New Canaan's vibrant village center, featuring award-winning restaurants, boutique shopping, the world-class library, and Metro-North train access to New York City. Just moments away is beautiful Mead Park, offering tennis, pickleball, baseball, and skating. This special South Avenue offering provides the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and community, truly an opportunity not to be missed.

listings.remarks: Idyllic Silvermine cottage living along one of New Canaan's most enchanting river roads.  Set on a narrow, storybook stretch of Mill Road where yellow lines disappear, stone walls trace the landscape, and older homes sit close to the Silvermine River, this charming 1933 cottage offers a rare chance to live in one of New Canaan's most atmospheric settings.  With direct frontage along the Silvermine River, the property feels less like a typical rental and more like a transport back to an earlier New England rhythm - river views, mature greenery, winding roads, and the quiet character of a historic enclave. Just moments from GrayBarns, the setting offers a unique blend of privacy, beauty, and walkable lifestyle, where dinner, drinks, or lunch by the river can feel like part of everyday life.  Inside, the home offers approximately 945 square feet with 2 bedrooms, 1 full bath, 1 half bath, a fireplace, off-street parking, and a cottage-style layout that lives simply and comfortably. The property sits on just over one acre and has been previously remodeled while maintaining the charm and scale that make Silvermine so distinct.  For those seeking something polished but not generic, private but not isolated, and connected to one of New Canaan's most beautiful natural and architectural pockets, this Silvermine cottage is a rare offering.

Delightfully renovated cape located centrally in New Canaan. Features a new kitchen equipped with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances, well-lit living room complete with built-ins and a fireplace. The ground floor hosts a master bedroom with an en suite bathroom, along with an additional room that can serve as a den, study, or second bedroom. Upstairs, there are two spacious, versatile rooms. The lower level includes extra storage and another full bathroom. The expansive front and side yard ensures a private, serene setting. Walk, bike, stroll or jog this quiet, yet minutes to town neighborhood. Located conveniently to Merrit Parkway (1-2 min). Downtown New Canaan (5 min). Walk to Talmadge train station and be in NYC in 1 hour and 15 minutes. School bus pickup/drop off in front of the house. Cats ok, dog on a case-by-case consideration, 2 year lease preferred. listings.remarks: An icon of American modernism, the celebrated Celanese House presents a rare opportunity to own one of New Canaan's most architecturally significant residences. Designed in 1959 by acclaimed architect Edward Durell Stone, this internationally recognized masterpiece has been admired for decades for its timeless design. Meticulously restored to honor Stone's original vision while embracing contemporary living, the home showcases his signature architectural vocabulary-from the striking lattice facade and sculptural glass roof pyramids to soaring walls of glass that dissolve the boundary between indoors and out. Light becomes an architectural element, filling every space and transforming the home throughout the day. Nearly 5,000 square feet of thoughtfully curated living space blend historic integrity with refined modern luxury. Satin-bleached oak floors, floating walls, museum-quality lighting and a dramatic illuminated glass entry create interiors that feel simultaneously iconic and effortlessly livable. Four bedrooms, four-and-a-half baths and beautifully proportioned entertaining spaces provide exceptional comfort without compromising the purity of the original design. Set on 2.06 private acres along a distinguished road, the landscape complements the architecture with tranquil views and remarkable privacy. More than a residence, the Celanese House is an enduring work of architecture-offering the privilege of becoming the next steward of a true design landmark.

listings.remarks: Presenting the historic Landis Gores House, an architectural masterpiece epitomizing post-WWII Modernism. Designed in 1946 by Harvard Five architect Landis Gores for his own family, it stands proudly as one of New Canaan's first Modern homes. Gores was at that time working in association with Philip Johnson. He set his own home on a narrow granite ridge astride a majestic 4-acre wooded lot; the residence brilliantly leavens the glass-walled austerity of the International Style with the natural warmth of Wrightian organic architecture.The 130-foot long, single-story form is defined by sweeping horizontal planes, full-height plate glass walls, grey-stained cypress siding, and by natural stone fireplaces, walls and terracing. Its informal, open plan is divided into three distinct pavilions, anchored by the dramatic central living and dining area featuring a raised roof and tall ceilings. Original exterior lighting design by Richard Kelly enhances the seamless integration between the avant-garde interior and its environment. An expansive rear terrace, added by Gores himself in the 1980s, features circular seating areas and an elegant oval swimming pool.Listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 2002 and held by the Gores family since its inception.  The Gores family granted a perpetual preservation easement to the National Trust for Historic Preservation. This iconic property offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to own a foundational piece of architectural history

This extraordinary property is a rare offering that blends timeless architecture with iconic waterfront living. With sweeping views of Long Island Sound, the home's stately presence is matched only by its stunning 3.55 acres of parklike grounds and over 200 feet of waterfront, including a waterfront pool, well-equipped pool house, and 3-bedroom guest cottage. Approach through the gated stone walls and travel the tree-lined drive, enjoying the unfolding Sound views. Rich with original character, the main residence evokes the grace of a bygone era with leaded glass windows, impressive millwork, and grand gathering spaces featuring soaring ceilings designed to showcase the breathtaking views. Included in the home's magic is this wonder: a sailing ship imported from England, reconstructed on site to create a one-of-a-kind study. Generations have hosted parties on these magnificent grounds, enjoyed quiet mornings by the seawall or spent a day boating from the mooring off its private beach. This former longtime home of Lucie Bedford and her husband, Briggs Cunningham - race car driver and America's Cup winner - is a landmark opportunity to own a storied piece of Westport's history along prestigious Beachside Avenue. A one-of-one opportunity to carry on this legacy of luxury and history at this iconic waterfront estate.

The enclosed heated porch adds approximately 120 square feet of year-round living space. Enjoy access to Compo Beach, Longshore Club Park, award-winning Westport schools, Metro-North, I-95, shopping, dining, and everything that makes Westport one of Connecticut's premier coastal communities.

Ideally situated directly across from the picturesque Saugatuck River and just minutes from vibrant Westport Center, shopping, dining, train stations, and major commuting routes, this home combines exceptional convenience with a desirable neighborhood setting. Unit 1 features easy one-level living with a bright and inviting living room, two spacious bedrooms, a beautifully renovated full bath, and the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer. Enjoy relaxing on the screened porch overlooking the level backyard-perfect for outdoor enjoyment. Ample off-street parking completes this exceptional rental. Experience the best of Westport living in a fully renovated, move-in-ready home that feels brand new.

Spacious sophistication in the heart of Downtown Westport. Perfectly positioned just moments from shopping, dining & recreation, this lovely in-town home offers a rare blend of comfort, flexibility, and location. The inviting living room with wood-burning fireplace sets the tone for relaxed gatherings and quiet evenings alike. The open-concept kitchen features granite countertops and flows seamlessly into the dining area, with French doors leading to a private stone patio - ideal for morning coffee or alfresco entertaining. The main level includes a spacious primary suite with en-suite bath, along with two additional BRs. Downstairs, the finished lower level offers additional space with two more bedrooms and a full bath, offering flexible space for guests, rec/playroom, or multi-generational living. For those seeking a professional setup, the town-approved home occupation designation allows for a separate entrance, two offices, and a waiting room - a turnkey solution for small business owners or remote professionals. With quick access to the Westport Library, Levitt Pavilion, and the town's vibrant dining & shopping scene, this property delivers both lifestyle and convenience. Nearby commuting options include the Metro North Railroad to NYC, Merritt Parkway, I-95. A rare opportunity to live and work in one of Fairfield County's most sought-after communities, or to find a home that offers private space for visitors or extended family. AVAILABLE FOR RENT AT $6,700/mo.

Welcome to 108 Harbor Road, a beautifully updated 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home on desirable Saugatuck Island in Westport. Enjoy an open floor plan, recently renovated, and stylish finishes in every room. Just a short stroll to the water, this inviting home offers the best of coastal living and easy access to all that Westport has to offer. Available for up to 10 months starting September 8.

Great opportunity if you want to get to know Westport before purchasing your new home. This rental is available for 8 months, mid-September through May 5, 2027. Perhaps you are planning a construction project this fall and need to get out of the house during renovation. This updated, professionally decorated, fully furnished townhouse could be your solution. It's a bright end unit with lots of light and an open living/dining room area. A lovely patio is accessible through both the living room and dining room areas. The eat-in Beverly Ellsley custom kitchen has exquisite built-ins, rich wood counters, new double ovens and new dishwasher. Upstairs both the primary and secondary bedroom are en-suite. The lower level offers a movie viewing room with a full bath and wet bar. Regents Park is a well-known gated townhome community in the Greens Farms area of Westport giving you easy access to downtown shopping, the train to NYC, and the beaches. It offers a security guard, Har tru tennis court with lights for evening play, and pickleball. Give Westport a try, you won't regret it!

Beautifully remodeled 2 bedroom, 2 bath modular home in a prime Westport location available for a one or two year lease. Nestled within a well-maintained community just minutes to shopping, dining, beaches, and train access, this home offers convenience and easy living. Bright open floor plan featuring luxury vinyl plank flooring, updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances, and in-unit washer/dryer. Ample yard space for outdoor fun. HOA responsible for exterior grounds maintenance, trash removal and snow removal of roads. Tenant responsible for utilities, credit check, limited snow removal and maintenance of sidewalks, entrances, and parking spaces. No smoking. Ask about pet policy. Application, credit check, references are required.

Stunning Waterfront Retreat with Four Decks, Private Yard & Breathtaking Views! Escape to this beautifully appointed 2-bedroom, 2-bath furnished rental set directly on picturesque Old Mill Pond in the highly sought-after Compo Beach neighborhood. Designed for relaxation and coastal living, this light-filled home offers spectacular water views from every room and the perfect blend of comfort, charm, and convenience. Enjoy morning coffee at sunrise and evening cocktails at sunset from any of the four spacious decks overlooking Long Island Sound. Launch your kayak or canoe right from the backyard or stroll across to the beach for a swim and a day in the sun. Inside, the home is bright, airy, and equipped with central air for effortless summer comfort. Just minutes from the train, golf, tennis, shopping, and fine dining, this is the ideal seasonal getaway for those looking to enjoy the best of waterfront living. A rare opportunity to experience a true coastal escape. Credit check and references required.

NEWLY RENOVATED!!! Welcome to your dream summer rental. Gorgeous spacious home situated at the end of a long private driveway in a fully fenced professionally exquisite landscaped property on 2.14 level acres with pool and spa. This beautiful colonial with a dramatic two story foyer, new light natural hardwood floors, high ceilings, custom millwork & beautiful details is finished on 4 levels. 2 Home Offices with extensive built-ins is perfect to work remotely. Formal Living Room with fireplace flows into the banquet style formal Dining Room. Entertain with ease in the fully equipped modern Eat-in Kitchen complete with high end appliances including a wolf range, subzero refrigerator, 2 dishwashers and a huge marble island. Family Room with fireplace and french doors leading out to the patio. The Game Room is the perfect place to host with its stunning bar and pool table. Bluestone patio provides relaxed living and easy entertaining. Elegant Primary Bedroom with dual walk in closets and 2 luxe spa Bathrooms and a steam shower. Second floor has 3 more ensuite Bedrooms. The 3rd floor has a media room , work out area including free weights and an elliptical as well as a full bath. The massive patio features a built in grill, seating and eating areas, great for outdoor entertaining. Heated Pool House with Kitchenette, full bath and an extra Bedroom.  Full house generator. Your own putting green. Fabulous opportunity to enjoy summer in Westport at its best!!!

An antique jewel set on 3.5 extraordinary acres in the heart of Greens Farms, ready to be transformed into your forever home. Brimming with timeless charm and endless potential, this rare offering showcases beautiful period details, including arched doorways, custom built-ins, and charming deep-set windows that reflect the home's historic character. The gracious main house is complemented by a separate art studio, detached two-car garage, tennis court, and pool-creating a true country compound in one of Westport's most coveted locations. The property is enhanced by stunning specimen plantings, expansive open grounds, and complete deer fencing surrounding the entire lot. A remarkable opportunity to restore, renovate, or reimagine a treasured estate in an unparalleled setting.

An exceptional home in coveted Greens Farms, 124 Hillandale Road captures the essence of classic Connecticut living. Timeless, elegant, and impeccably maintained, this beautiful estate is surrounded by mature landscaping and a peaceful, private setting, while remaining just minutes from everything Westport has to offer. Spanning four finished levels connected by an elevator, the home seamlessly blends classic architecture with modern comfort. Sun-filled living spaces, beautiful millwork, and thoughtfully designed interiors create an atmosphere that is both sophisticated and welcoming. Whether hosting family and friends or enjoying a quiet evening at home, the layout is designed to accommodate every stage of life with ease. Every detail has been carefully considered, from the state-of-the-art movie theater and golf simulator to the fitness and recreation spaces that make everyday living feel a little more special. Outside, beautifully landscaped grounds and picture perfect pool with auto-cover provide the perfect backdrop for relaxing, entertaining, and making lasting memories, with an outdoor fireplace and multiple gathering spaces to enjoy throughout the seasons. Effortlessly elegant, 124 Hillandale Road embodies the very best of Greens Farms living-a home where timeless design and modern amenities come together to create something truly special.

Tucked behind a tall fence flanked by stone pillars. Less than 5 minutes to town, schools, beach and train. Easy one floor living.   Sun-filled main level open floor plan featuring a Living Room with fireplace, a large well-equipped Kitchen with a spacious Dining Area and Breakfast Bar, and a Family Room with walls of windows inviting nature in. There is also a private office next to the first floor Primary Bedroom with a full Bath. Several French doors are strategically placed to access the oversized deck that spans the length of the rear of the house, and there is a staircase leading to the picturesque backyard. Upstairs you will find the 2nd Bedroom with vaulted ceiling, skylights and a full Bath which can easily be used as a Studio or Office. The finished walk-out lower level offers the 3rd Bedroom and full Bath plus a large flex space for a Playroom, Recreation.  Lower level would make for a fabulous au-pair or in-law suite.  The Mudroom connects the house to the 2 car Garage, and above the Garage is a large unfinished space that is approximately 22X24. House has a generator. So much to love about this wonderful property.

HUGE OPPORTUNITY. PROPERTY TO BE SOLD AS-IS, WHERE IS WITH NO REPRESENTATIONS AS TO CONDITION. PERFECT FOR BUILDER/DEVELOPER TO BUILD ON .41 PARKLIKE ACRES AT IN-TOWN LOCATION. SALE SUBJECT TO PROBATE.

Welcome to this beautifully crafted new construction home in the heart of Westport, where timeless design and thoughtful details come together to create a luxurious space. From the moment you step inside, you're welcomed by a bright and open floor plan with high ceilings and wide-plank flooring that runs throughout the main living space. Natural light fills every room, highlighting the custom finishes and high-end craftsmanship that define this exceptional home. The kitchen is a true showpiece, designed for both everyday living and entertaining. Full custom inset cabinetry and professional appliances, sleek quartz countertops and double oversized center islands provide plenty of prep space and seating. On the exterior, the home is clad in classic hardy board, an expansive outdoor kitchen, and elaborate stone detail with plenty of room for a pool, spa, or however you wish to complete your outdoor oasis. At the end of a quiet cup-de-sac, yet situated in a prime Westport location close to schools, beaches, shopping, and commuting options, this new construction offers everything you need in a forever home-modern comfort, classic style, and room to grow. Pool/spa included for $4,399,000

Main Level: Foyer, Formal Liv/Din Rms, Family Rm w/vaulted ceiling, Kitchen, Breakfast Room, Office and access to Screened-in Porch and large, outdoor Deck. The Lower Level has another Family Rm, Office/Storage Rm, Full Bath, Sauna, Mudroom and tons of storage. Outdoors, you will find a beautifully set tennis/pickleball court with basketball hoop. The peacefulness of this property makes the perfect setting for parties and everyday enjoyment. All of this only 1.3 miles to Coleytown Elem/Middle Schools, less than 3 miles to downtown, and less than 5 miles to the Westport Train station!

listings.remarks: Located in Westport's coveted Greens Farms neighborhood, this light-filled home is perfectly sited high and dry on a private park-like acre with room for a pool and pool house. A renovated kitchen with top-of-the-line appliances and sunny breakfast nook opens to a spacious great room with stone fireplace and expansive deck overlooking the property, ideal for indoor-outdoor living.  The flexible floor plan includes a rare first-floor bedroom with full bath, ideal for guests, au pair, or multi-generational living, along with a finished walk-out lower level offering additional space for recreation, media, or work-from-home needs. The primary suite features two walk-in closets and a new spa-like bath.  With 5 bedrooms and 5 baths, the home offers ample space for living, working, and entertaining. Modern conveniences include city water, city sewer, natural gas, and an EV charger.  Exceptional location just minutes to Greens Farms Elementary, the Greens Farms train station, Burying Hill Beach, and downtown Westport shopping and dining.

Set on over 3 private acres with sweeping water views, 2 Judy Point Lane is a remarkable Westport waterfront estate offering approximately 14,000 square feet of living space and a rare compound-style layout.   The property consists of two substantial residences connected by a breezeway, creating exceptional flexibility for multi-generational living, extended guests, or a private guest house.   Dramatic interiors feature soaring ceilings, expansive windows, and multiple stone fireplaces that frame the natural beauty of the surrounding landscape. Generous living and entertaining spaces flow effortlessly to outdoor terraces and landscaped grounds designed for both relaxation and gathering.    The property includes a waterside pool overlooking the water, a private dock for boating, and a gated driveway set among mature plantings that enhance the estate's sense of privacy.   Additional amenities include the potential for an indoor pool and spa, offering an opportunity to further elevate the home's resort-like experience.    A rare offering combining scale, versatility, and waterfront living in one of Westport's most sought-after coastal settings.

This expansive 5-bedroom residence features 5 full baths and four full floors of beautifully finished living space, providing unparalleled flexibility for both grand entertaining and seamless work-from-home living. The home's impressive proportions are evident throughout, with generously sized rooms, soaring 10ft ceilings, and an effortless flow. Front and back staircases enhance both functionality and flow, ideal for everyday living. A finished walkout basement includes an additional room with a full bath, perfect for guests, an au pair, a gym, or a private office suite. Step outside to your backyard retreat, where a stunning pool with an automatic cover and built-in spa takes center stage. This resort-style setting is ideal for relaxing, entertaining, and extending your living space outdoors year-round.

listings.remarks: In Westport's coveted Long Lots neighborhood, this residence makes a striking first impression, set back in quiet privacy behind mature trees and landscaped grounds. Reimagined and expanded in 2010, the home offers sunlit rooms of impressive scale ideal for both memorable entertaining and everyday luxury, with high-end updates and amenities at every turn. An inviting first-floor lounge with pool table provides room to gather, while the gourmet chef's kitchen showcases premium appliances, an oversized island and countertops of statuary marble, and generous prep and entertaining areas. A private suite above a 3-car garage includes gathering room with fireplace, bedroom and full bath with room for guests and home office. The park-like property unfolds as a resort-style retreat featuring a sparkling pool, patio with pizza oven, expansive sunny lawn, outdoor fireplace and beautifully terraced gardens. A no-maintenance koi pond and a greenhouse add to the rare, estate setting, and a hot tub offers year-round enjoyment. 5 bedrooms include a sumptuous primary suite with fireplace, spa bath with heated floors, steam shower, and luxe statuary marble and nickel vanity, offering a private sanctuary. Enjoy property views from the 2nd floor deck. Walk to the ALL NEW Long Lots Elementary School that's underway and 2 min to middle and high schools. It's privacy, elevated living spaces and curated outdoor living at this exceptional residence 5 minutes to train and Westport's lively downtown

This impeccable, newly renovated colonial is now available for rent. Enjoy the ease of this fabulous, walkable location in the heart of Westport-convenient to shopping trains & schools. This wonderful home is sited on a private 1+ acres with mature landscaping, a fabulous sunroom, & multiple patio areas (including a fire pit). This extra large 6 bedrm home offers ultimate versatility with 3 levels, as well as the coveted open floor plan. The Kitchen has been beautifully renovated & boasts white cabinets, expansive quartz countertops, multiple seating areas, top of the line appliances & opens into a spacious Great Room with vaulted ceilings, a floor to ceiling stone fireplace & access to a light filled Sun Room. In fact this entire home has wonderful, oversized windows & is bursting with sunlight. The first floor has 3 bedrooms; one ensuite and the other two with a Jack & Jill Bathroom. The Foyer is dramatic with a charming curved staircase, oversized windows & an inviting window seat. The 2nd floor boasts an oversized Primary Bedroom Suite with a generous walk in closet/dressing room area & a luxurious Primary Bathroom with jacuzzi, large shower & double sink. An additional bedroom on this level also makes an ideal nursery, office or guest room. The walk out lower level is fully finished with a playroom/family room with a fireplace, exercise room, full bathroom, an additional bedroom & an ample storage space and accesses another patio. Huge front yard & ample parking!

Easy, one level living in this wonderful refreshed Ranch located on a beautifully landscaped dry, level acre on a great cul-de-sac. Located in the Coleytown section of Westport, this lovingly cared for home has many recent improvements including a fabulous sunlit Christopher Peacock chef's kitchen with Breakfast Bar and a dedicated Office with built-ins and Laundry. The flexible floor plan offers a Living Room with fireplace that connects to a spacious FamilyRoom/Sunroom, which in turn opens to the Private Back Yard with Patio, Deck and Garden Area. The Primary Bedroom has a walk-in closet and private Bath. The 2 other well-proportioned Bedrooms share another Bath. The separate 4th Bedroom has a murphy bed and an adjacent full Bath, offering a private space for guests/inlaw. Enjoy 3 remodeled Baths, newer Mud Room, engineered walnut flooring, newer windows,, newer septic (2012) exterior/interior paint and the fireplace convertion to gas. The 2nd bay of the 2 Car Detached Garage is being used for storage and can be converted back to 2 bays.

GET READY FOR THE UNEXPECTED when you pass through the front door of this charming 1940s cape and experience its clever DESIGN AND OPEN FLOOR PLAN making it relevant to today's lifestyle -- practical and functional! EASY LIVING is magnified by its CONVENIENCE TO SCHOOLS, FOOD, SHOPPING AND MORE. Long Lots Elementary and its playground are a quick 1/10th of a mile down Bauer Place through the "back door" neighborhood access that neighbors enjoy; Stop & Shop and other necessities are less than a mile away. More ambitious walkers can be at Burying Hill Beach in 25 minutes or you can hop in your car for a 10 minute drive and quick lunch break or escape. The light-filled and friendly 4 bedroom, 4-bath home was architecturally re-imagined with many thoughtfully-conceived living spaces. The oversized entry foyer carries you right through the 1st floor --- past the living room and kitchen into the family room where windows cross the entire rear wall and bring the private backyard into clear view. Glass double doors invite you to outdoor play -- and when you get dirty, USE THE OUTDOOR SHOWER! The FLEXIBLE USE "EXTRA SUITE" often used as an office that could EASILY BE A 5th Bedroom , or a SUITE FOR YOUR IN-LAW OR NANNY.The whole house makeover over 10 years ago entailed a gut-to-the-studs revamping of insulation and thermopane windows; optional-use heated tile floors;HVAC FOR CENTRAL AIR HEATING AND COOLING including the Lower Level rec room/optional office/laundry with its extra sf

Located at the end of a cul-de-sac and perfectly sited on a level .56 property this home is very convenient to downtown Westport, Compo Beach, Longshore and transportation. Features include spacious rooms, renovated baths, family room with access to rear deck, LR w/ FP, DR with sliders to large deck, and kitchen on the main level. The upper level includes the MBR w/ bath and three additional bedrooms with hall bath. The lower level family room has a half bath and a laundry area. Two large decks provide ample space for outdoor entertaining and relaxation, while the flat, spacious backyard adds even more versatility for outdoor activities.

Beautifully sited in prestigious Greens Farms this timeless 5 BR, 6BA clapboard-and-stone Colonial offers stunning architecture & resort like privacy just moments from train, town & beaches. A gracious front porch & exquisite landscaping create an immediate sense of presence; classic, composed & quietly impressive. Inside, a soaring entry filled w/natural light introduces interiors defined by beautiful scale, 9-ft ceilings & gracious flow. Formal living room w/gas fireplace & dining room w/wet bar lend elegance to entertaining while a handsome office/den w/custom built-ins offers warmth & intimacy. The kitchen is refined & inviting w/quartz countertops, Sub-Zero appliances, walk-in pantry & breakfast/dining area opening to bluestone terrace. The expansive family room anchored by a substantial stone fireplace creates a natural gathering place & French doors open seamlessly to the outdoor living space. The main level also includes a secondary entry w/back staircase, laundry room, additional office & 2nd powder room. Upstairs the primary suite is a true retreat w/oversized walk-in closets, dressing area & spa-like marble bath. 4 additional generously proportioned bedrooms including two en-suite offer flexibility for family & guests. Finished 3rd fl ideal for playroom, gym, media room, 6th BR. Outside sprawling grounds, expansive bluestone terraces, exceptional masonry & stunning saltwater gunite pool & spa create a private oasis w/serene resort-like feel. Impeccably presented.

A rare convergence of water, light and privacy, this extraordinary waterfront home offers a lifestyle few ever experience.Perfectly positioned between the open expanse of the Long Island Sound and the quiet rhythm of a private canal, the home is set on a private island just one hour from New York City, yet feels worlds away. Sweeping, unobstructed views stretch endlessly in every direction, with sunsets that transform the sky into a daily work of art. Defined by its clean, modern lines and expansive walls of glass,  the home is designed to fully embrace its surroundings.Three spacious decks extend the living experience outdoors, each offering a distinct vantage point from morning light over the water to the stillness of evening reflections along the canal. Inside, newly installed wide-board white oak floors bring warmth and understated sophistication to a home that is entirely move-in ready. Every space is oriented toward water, creating a seamless connection between interior living and the natural beauty beyond. With direct water frontage, a private beach and an ever-changing coastal backdrop, this is more than a home, it is a singular waterfront retreat defined by light, scale and the quiet luxury of complete privacy.

listings.remarks: Classic Old Hill Charm Where Character Meets Convenience Incredible location in the heart of Old Hill, with the ability to walk to downtown Westport shopping & dining, Kings Highway Elementary School, & Earthplace. This warm & inviting 3 BD, 2 BTH historic home is filled with classic details & thoughtful updates throughout. The expansive living room features a beautiful fieldstone fireplace and a cozy bay-window reading nook, while the spacious dining room sits adjacent to a bright kitchen with updated appliances, including a Viking range. A flexible first-floor bedroom, perfect as a guest room, office, or den, along with a renovated full bath, completes the main level. Upstairs, the large primary bedroom offers wonderful natural light, an updated hall bath, and generous closet space (with potential for a laundry area). Two additional bedrooms provide versatility for guests, family, or workspace needs. The dry, level lot includes a deck off the kitchen & a rear patio, ideal for outdoor dining &relaxation. With potential to add a garage or expand the living space, this home combines timeless charm, opportunity, & one of Westport's most desirable locations. The property boasts the convenience of gas, city water, & sewer. Situated in a fantastic location, it's just a few minutes from the train station, making commuting a breeze. Exciting plans for remodeling, crafted by a local architect known for their work on historical homes, are included to inspire your vision.

Tucked at the end of a coveted Hunt Club lane, 10 Sprucewood Lane offers exceptional privacy, architectural refinement, & an enviable setting within one of Westport's most sought-after neighborhoods. Thoughtfully renovated in 2017, this sophisticated Colonial showcases a gracious & versatile floor plan that seamlessly balances classic elegance with modern living. Sun-filled interiors & a curated neutral palette create a refined atmosphere throughout more than 5,000 square feet of beautifully appointed living space. At the center of the home is a stunning chef's kitchen, featuring Carrera marble, stainless steel appliances, & a walk-in pantry - expertly designed for both effortless daily living and elevated entertaining. Formal living spaces & the expansive great room connect seamlessly to an entertainer's backyard, highlighted by a spacious mahogany deck, sweeping lawn, & charming stone walls. A screened-in porch off the living room offers an inviting space for relaxation, casual dining, or gathering with guests. Distinctive highlights include two primary ensuite bedrooms - one featuring a luxurious steam shower, four fireplaces, two mudrooms, an oversized garage, & a dramatic great room anchored by a striking see-through fireplace. The fully finished lower level provides exceptional flexibility with an ensuite bedroom, home office, recreation room with fireplace, and an additional mudroom with abundant storage and direct exterior access. Room for a pool. Welcome Home!

Set high above the road, the home enjoys beautiful natural light and a peaceful setting, creating a bright and airy atmosphere throughout the living spaces. The heart of the home is the beautifully updated kitchen, which opens seamlessly into the sun-filled family room with a fireplace, creating a warm and inviting space for everyday living and entertaining. Step outside to a lovely private patio, perfect for outdoor dining, relaxing with friends, or enjoying quiet mornings surrounded by nature. Set discreetly at the end of a long drive and screened by mature landscaping, this exceptional Hillspoint residence offers a surprising sense of privacy in one of Westport's most convenient coastal settings. Just moments from Longshore Club Park, Compo Beach, town and train, it perfectly blends luxury, lifestyle and accessibility. Inside, soaring ceilings and sun-filled spaces create a light, airy flow enhanced by high-end finishes throughout. The three story Nantucket style home is meticulously designed by architect Peter Cadoux to soak up the sparkling Long Island Sound views from all angles. The main floor holds the horizon directly at eye level from the open concept living areas - a light and bright gourmet kitchen with island seating, a breakfast nook and butler's pantry leads into the spacious family room with stone fireplace and deck access, but the show stopping sun room wins for best seat in the house where the floor to ceiling windows feel like the bow of a ship. The formal dining room also opens to the deck set for both lounging and grilling. In the primary wing, a breathtaking bedroom looks over the gorgeous grounds and water beyond, while the beautiful his and hers combined bath takes in the south facing Sound view. There are dual walk-in wardrobe closets as well as a second laundry closet. An stunning office rounds out the main floor, while the third floor holds a guest suite/media room with balcony and one of the most spectacular "roof" level decks in all of Westport! On the ground level, there are two bedrooms of generous size, each with their own ensuite bath and custom closets as well as a true library style office. Across the foyer, the cabana kitchenette and bath are conveniently located close to the pool and beach! Peaceful and private, the "backyard" consists of the covered grotto spilling right on

Step into this beautifully updated Colonial in the heart of Coleytown, where timeless charm meets modern living. Set on over two landscaped acres in a desirable cul-de-sac, the property offers a spacious deck and expansive yard-perfect for entertaining or everyday enjoyment. Inside, a welcoming entry foyer opens to a warm center hall with hardwood floors and seamless flow throughout. The main level features a bright living room, a versatile dining room or home office, and an oversized family room ideal for relaxing or gathering. The eat-in kitchen is the heart of the home, showcasing stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, a peninsula with seating, and a cozy open-hearth fireplace. A breezeway leads to a flexible bonus space with a private entrance-perfect for a playroom, office, or guest suite. A stylish powder room with Waterworks fixtures and a dedicated laundry room complete the main level. Upstairs, you'll find four bedrooms, including a serene primary suite with a spa-like bath and steam shower. A circular driveway and two-car garage provide ample parking and storage. All just minutes from downtown shopping, dining, and top-rated schools, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort, space, and convenience.

Set on a quiet, private cul-de-sac very close to town and Winslow Park, this custom five-bedroom Colonial offers an exceptional opportunity for a new owner to leave their mark and add significant value. Designed with best-in-class materials and a thoughtfully planned layout, the home retains its gracious scale, natural flow, and exceptional character. Deferred maintenance has created the chance to elevate a well-loved property and return it to the signature splendor that defined it. The main level features a gourmet kitchen with Sub Zero & Viking appliances, stone counters, custom cabinetry and an adjacent breakfast room leading to a large family room, living room with fireplace, formal dining room, and two private offices with built-ins. French doors from most main floor rooms open to a balcony overlooking a heated Gunite pool and a large, level play area. listings.remarks: First time on the market in over 50 years, this meticulously maintained 1910 Colonial is a rare and timeless offering in one of Westport's most cherished settings. Set on 2.66 private acres and abutting an additional 7 acres of protected Land Trust, the property offers exceptional privacy, pastoral views, and enduring tranquility.  Rich in character and architectural detail, the home features four bedrooms, three full and one half baths, and graciously proportioned living spaces that balance historic charm with everyday comfort. A screened porch invites quiet mornings and long summer evenings overlooking the expansive grounds, while two classic barns offer endless possibilities for hobbyists, artists, or those seeking flexible auxiliary space.  Lovingly cared for over generations, this estate presents a rare opportunity to enjoy as-is or thoughtfully reimagine, all while preserving its authentic New England soul. A truly special property-where history, land, and lifestyle come together just minutes from Westport's town center, beaches, and schools.

listings.remarks: Charming, Light-Filled, Beach Cottage In Saugatuck Shores; A few steps From The Water, Kitchen w/ Dining Nook, New Appliances, Wood Floors throughout, Open Concept 1st Floor, LR/DR/Sunroom With Beamed Cathedral Ceilings; 2 Bed Rooms, Private Fenced In Yard, 1 car Detached Garage, Ample parking on-site; Minutes From I95, Westport Train Station, Downtown Westport And Westport's Longshore Municipal Facilities (Beach, Tennis, Golf, Marina, Pool); Wonderful Opportunity To Enjoy This Unique Beach Community; Perfect for Year-Round Carefree Living on Saugatuck Shores; EVEN BETTER THAN IT SOUNDS - A MUST SEE

There is a quality of light that artists seek-the kind that pours through the soaring atelier window of the great room in this updated vintage home. Once the studio of Norman Mason, each aspect of its design was in service to his art. Set on 1.26 acres overlooking Winslow Park, this charming home carries its history lightly and beautifully. The dramatic great room is anchored by an oversized fireplace, newly refinished hardwood floors and a special light that imbues the space with a certain atmosphere whether holding a dinner party for 20 or relaxing alone with a good book. The kitchen has been thoughtfully updated for how we live now-new appliances, clean lines, proper workspace, a walk-in pantry. The library offers a quiet place to work from home. The first floor primary suite is its own private world, serene and removed, with a generous walk-in closet and full bath that feels both practical and indulgent. Guests have a separate wing with room to settle in, while additional space throughout the property invites expansion, reinvention or room to grow. Step outside and the story continues. The grounds are lush and unhurried. The perennial gardens and flat sweep of lawn provide a living landscape that changes with the seasons. Moments from the center of town, theater, shops and restaurants, the particular rhythm of a place that is sophisticated and yet part of a neighborhood.

Timeless elegance meets modern comfort in this stunning 1936 brick Colonial, beautifully updated while preserving the warmth, character, and craftsmanship of its vintage roots. Set in one of Westport's most desirable coastal locations, this 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath antique home is filled with architectural detail and storybook charm at every turn.  Graceful arched doorways, a curved staircase, detailed moldings, leaded decorative windows, cozy window seats, original crystal and brass hardware, and three fireplaces create an atmosphere that feels both refined and deeply welcoming. Each room has been thoughtfully refreshed with an eye toward comfort, function, and timeless style, while honoring the home's original soul.  Outdoor living is equally inviting, with lovely gardens, a spacious patio, a built-in grill, and a firepit perfect for relaxed evenings under the stars. Enjoy an exceptional Westport lifestyle just moments from Compo Beach, Longshore Club, the train, and Saugatuck's beloved restaurants and shops.  The result is a rare blend of old-world beauty and updated livability - a home that feels elegant yet warm, sophisticated yet inviting. 5 Farnham Court is a truly special Westport residence for those who appreciate character, quality, location, and enduring design.

Coastal Living at Its Finest - Compo Beach, Westport, CT Some homes are simply houses - others are a lifestyle, and this exceptional Compo Beach Colonial is unmistakably the latter. Built in 2012 and maintained in pristine condition, this 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath residence offers the rare combination of newer construction quality and effortless coastal elegance, nestled just minutes from the sparkling shores of one of Westport's most coveted neighborhoods. Step inside to an open, airy floor plan bathed in natural light, where a spectacular great room and chef's kitchen flow seamlessly together - crisp whites, soothing blues, and natural textures creating a relaxed yet decidedly high-end atmosphere that simply lives beautifully. When the weather calls, the oversized porch becomes the true soul of the home - the perfect setting for morning coffee, evening gatherings, and the unhurried moments that define summer on the Connecticut shore. Upstairs, the primary suite redefines comfort with a private sitting room, home office, and a spa-inspired bath featuring heated floors, a heated towel rack, and a deep soaking tub - thoughtful luxuries that make every day feel like a getaway. With generous secondary bedrooms, meticulous finishes throughout, and a location that puts Compo Beach, Westport's beloved amenities, and Metro-North all within easy reach, this is coastal Connecticut living at its absolute finest.

So much house..So well located..At such a good price! If you think you can't have it all in ready move in condition then think again. Welcome to 44 Sniffen Road nestled on a tranquil street in a coveted walk to town neighborhood. Step inside & discover natural light pouring into the open concept floor plan encompassing the living & dining rms & kitchen all with hardwood floors creating the perfect atmosphere for your comfort & the ease of entertaining. With quality & style the updated kitchen offers stainless steel appliances, granite counters & breakfast bar open to the dining room with french doors leading to the deck, the perfect location for your barbecues & relaxation. The family room features media cabinet, full bath & access to the outdoor patio overlooking the amazing level fully fenced backyard perfect for play, chilling & entertaining. On the upper level are three well sized bdrms with hardwood floors & a full bath. An additional lower level with laundry provides flexible space for your needs be it office, playroom, gym or storage. And there is more..For the garden enthusiast, a deer proofed completely enclosed garden w/ raised beds. At the rear of the backyard there is a storage shed for garden or sports equipment. Professionally landscaped with mature specimen trees & perennials the property also features a stone wall, Belgian block lined driveway and paths and a stone patio. This is an opportunity not to be missed - minutes from Westport's exceptional amenities.

Experience the perfect harmony of sophisticated architecture and bucolic charm in this Colonial on a quiet cul-de-sac, centrally located in the Staples neighborhood. The residence situated on 1.07 acres offers a "farm-to-table" lifestyle without sacrificing modern-day luxuries of Westport living. The barn and orchard pay homage to the property's farming past, while maintaining a meticulous landscaped oasis. This home is for those who value both grand-scale entertaining and quiet everyday comforts. It's conveniently located to all town amenities, trendy downtown dining, and transportation hubs, while still maintaining the privacy of country living.

listings.remarks: Nestled in the coveted Old Hill section of Westport, this exceptional residence offers a rare blend of space, serenity, & timeless appeal. With over 3,200 square feet, the home unfolds beautifully-beginning with a gracious entry foyer, leading into the living room with hardwood floors and anchored by a classic fireplace. The large eat-in kitchen offers double ovens, an abundance of cabinets and marble countertops and opens to both the formal dining room and a more casual dining space with adjoining great room, all unified by gleaming wood floors and bathed in abundant natural light. Designed for both everyday ease and effortless entertaining, the main level also features a thoughtfully appointed mudroom with laundry, located just off the kitchen, offering generous storage for everyone's belongings. Every detail supports comfort and functionality without sacrificing style. Upstairs, four spacious bedrooms provide peaceful retreats. The primary suite is a true sanctuary, complete with a full bath, ample closet space, and a sun-filled porch that easily doubles as a home office, studio, or quiet escape. The finished lower level adds even more flexibility, featuring an office/guest room and a full bath-ideal for today's versatile living needs. Outdoors, the property truly shines. The fabulous backyard is a private oasis, highlighted by a gunite pool with spa and surrounded by lush landscaping-perfect for relaxation and summer gatherings.

listings.remarks: Set at the end of a private cul-de-sac in Westport's coveted Coleytown neighborhood, 5 Michele Lane is a statement of craftsmanship, scale, and resort-style living. Surrounded by mature plantings for exceptional privacy and just steps from the Saugatuck River, this custom Colonial blends timeless architecture with elevated design throughout. A classic wood shingle exterior and wood roof set the tone, while the interior showcases 9'+ ceilings, marble tile, extensive millwork, and refined trim details. A dramatic Venetian plaster foyer introduces the home's elegant yet inviting aesthetic. Spanning three expansive levels plus a walk-up attic, the residence offers 6 bedrooms, 7 full baths, and 2 powder rooms-designed to accommodate both grand entertaining and comfortable everyday living. Seven fireplaces add warmth and architectural character across the home's generous living spaces. The outdoor setting is truly exceptional, featuring a resort-caliber gunite pool with integrated spa, expansive bluestone patio, outdoor kitchen, and a beautifully designed pergola-creating a private retreat ideal for entertaining or relaxation. Inside, the home continues to impress with well-proportioned rooms, a luxurious primary suite, and en-suite bedrooms throughout. The finished lower level offers additional space for recreation, wellness, or guests, complemented by a private sauna, wine cellar, additional laundry, guest suite, rec room, gym and lounge.

Panoramic water views of Long Island Sound defines this Modern-Mid-Century Architectural gem set on an acre of beautiful grounds with a heated gunite pool. The home design features vaulted ceilings and large windows that fill the living space with natural light. Positioned on a hill and just steps from Compo Beach, the marina and Longshore Club Park. A rare opportunity for those seeking one of the area's finest properties.

Looking for a sensational home just a short walk to the beach, Longshore, train, and restaurants in trendy Saugatuck? This exceptional home by Walter Mattera is a masterclass in blending traditional design with contemporary style. Expansive interiors feature grand gathering spaces that flow naturally into intimate retreats, creating a home equally suited for entertaining and everyday living. Thoughtfully designed across 4 floors, the home offers 5 bedrooms, 6 full/3 half baths. A gracious foyer opens to large scale living spaces, including an oversized kitchen with breakfast nook that connects seamlessly to the family room with a striking stone fireplace. Formal dining with butlers pantry, private office, and multiple indoor outdoor connections create a dynamic and inviting environment. The second level is highlighted by the luxurious primary suite featuring a fireplace, spa inspired bath, and boutique caliber closet designed as a calming retreat. Four additional en suite bedrooms, laundry, and bonus room complete the level. Third floor and walk out lower level recreation spaces reflect a modern approach to luxury where work, wellness, and entertainment coexist effortlessly. Outside, the chic and ethereal setting continues with a pool, spa, covered patio, fireplace, and expansive bluestone terrace that seamlessly integrate indoor and outdoor living. Every detail has been carefully considered to deliver comfort, sophistication, privacy, and connection to the best of Westport.

Tucked away at the end of a long private drive, this exceptional property offers rare privacy just mins from everything Westport has to offer. Set on 2.1 acres, 3 Cedar Pond Rd is a true hidden oasis in the heart of town. Custom-built by noted architect George White as a 'replica' Colonial, the home reflects the timeless character of early CT architecture & was recognized by the Westport Historic District Commission for its authenticity. The 4-BR residence is beautifully maintained & turnkey, with a host of improvements already in place. The kitchen, featuring marble countertops & updated appliances, flows into the living rm, creating an easy layout for everyday living & entertaining. Both spaces open through doors to an expansive screened-in porch with views of Cedar Pond, while an all-season sunroom wrapped in walls of glass enhances the connection between indoor & outdoor living. The main level also includes a formal dining rm & study, while 4 fireplaces add warmth & character throughout. The lower level offers a fully legal walk-out office suite w/ fireplace & private entrance-ideal for a home business, recreation or guest accommodation. A detached 2-car garage & expansive property provide endless possibilities. Enjoy Cedar Pond year round-skating in winter, fishing & canoeing in the warmer months. With its rare blend of privacy, architectural significance & close proximity to town, schools & Merritt Pky, this is a unique opportunity to own a timeless Westport retreat!

Tucked behind a tall fence flanked by stone pillars, this customized contemporary home feels like a private hideaway, but less than 5 minutes to town, schools, beach and train. Looking for one level living? That can be easily accommodated here with a sun-filled main level open floor plan featuring a Living Room with fireplace, a large well-equipped Kitchen with a spacious Dining Area and Breakfast Bar, and a Family Room with walls of windows inviting nature in. There is also a private office next to the first floor Primary Bedroom with a full Bath. Several french doors are strategically placed to access the oversized deck that spans the length of the rear of the house, and there is a staircase leading to the picturesque backyard. Upstairs you will find the 2nd Bedroom with vaulted ceiling, skylights and a full Bath which can easily be used as a Studio or Office. The finished walk-out lower level offers the 3rd Bedroom and full Bath plus a large flex space for a Playroom, Recreation Room or whatever suits you. There is a Mudroom that connects the house to the 2 car Garage, and above the Garage is a large unfinished space that is approximately 22X24.  So much to love about this wonderful property.

listings.remarks: The Legacy of Elegance: 1.12 Acres in the Heart of Westport. Some homes are built for a market. This one was built for a lifetime.    Set on 1.12 tree-lined manicured acres framed by iconic New England stone walls, this pristine Westport Colonial is the definitive intersection of Classic Taste and Modern Life: Located in one of the town's most coveted walkable enclaves-just an hour from Manhattan-the home delivers both privacy and connection. The exceptional craftsmanship and layout are designed for the modern rhythm: Five bedrooms, seven baths and two dedicated offices allow effortless movement from productivity to play. Custom millwork and flooded natural light ground the home in tradition, while the versatile bonus spaces ensure there is a place for everything-and everyone.   The backyard isn't just a lot; it's a resort. A newly renovated pool and spa are anchored by a covered pavilion, creating a private stage for the quintessential Connecticut summer. This is where long summer days, spontaneous dinners, and poolside mornings happen - all within the safety of a neighborhood where you can ride bikes to friends' houses and neighbors still say, "Hello."   Minutes from Westport's gold-standard schools and its vibrant downtown, this home offers something incredibly rare: a true lifestyle rooted in connection and ease.  While trends come and go, this home will endure.

listings.remarks: Built in 1892, this designer-owned Victorian has been thoughtfully reimagined for modern living while preserving its original character and architectural integrity. Rooted in Westport's early history, the home reflects a seamless balance between timeless craftsmanship and refined contemporary design.  Influenced by Scandinavian simplicity with subtle Japanese sensibility, the interiors are light-filled, calm, and intentionally curated. A south-facing orientation and skylights fill the home with natural light throughout the day.  The main level offers effortless flow between living, dining, and kitchen spaces, along with a dedicated first-floor office. Three bedrooms and 2.5 baths include a serene primary suite with walk-in closet and ensuite bath featuring understated luxury details.  A walk-up attic offers future expansion potential for a studio, guest suite, or additional bedroom, while the full basement provides generous storage and utility space.  Covered front and rear porches, a private patio, and landscaped grounds extend the living experience outdoors. Extensive updates include a new roof, updated windows, central air, upgraded mechanicals, and enhanced insulation.  Ideally located within walking distance to town, train, and river, this home offers a rare blend of convenience, history, and quiet modern luxury.

Enjoy a convenient lifestyle at this centrally located well maintained Custom Colonial with a gorgeous pool and an expansive covered patio, fabulous yard, in the heart of Westport. Featuring an open spacious floor plan, gourmet kitchen with large center island leading to the dining room, family room and a dramatic two-sided floor to ceiling stone fireplace. Walls of glass open to the stone patio overlooking a private, fenced acre, in-ground pool, green house/barn. An office (or bedroom), full bath, powder room and game room complete the 1st floor. The 2nd floor includes a large primary suite plus 3 generously sized bedrooms (one currently an office) all en-suite. Minutes to all town amenities, train, shopping, beaches, schools.

A beautifully refined Colonial offering 2,695 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, plus an additional 485 square feet in the finished lower level. Privately sited on a .21-acre property bordering Birchwood Country Club, this home is located on a quiet street just moments from Saugatuck and downtown Westport. A charming front porch welcomes you into a home that was thoughtfully renovated and expanded in 2013, blending timeless design with modern comfort. Sun-filled interiors, quality craftsmanship, & an effortless floor plan create an ideal setting for both everyday living & entertaining. The heart of the home is the bright chef's kitchen, which opens seamlessly to the family room & overlooks the patio & fully fenced backyard, perfect for indoor-outdoor living. The residence features four bedrooms, four full baths, & one half bath, including a spacious primary suite with walk-in closets & a spa-inspired bath. Three additional bedrooms & two full baths complete the second floor. A generous mudroom adds convenience, while the finished lower level offers exceptional flexibility with a recreation room, full bath, & dedicated home office.Surrounded by mature landscaping & set in a peaceful, private setting, this property is just minutes from Saugatuck Center, Metro-North, & the shopping & dining of downtown Westport. A polished & sophisticated offering, it seamlessly combines classic architecture, modern livability, & an exceptional location. Welcome home!

This home has hardwood floors throughout. There is a 2 car garage & lots of storage. Landlord will include the lawn maintenance & Spring & Fall Cleanup. Private Setting. Convenient to Train & Beach. Good credit & adequate income a must. Move right in! Available July 1st.
