Welcome to 7 Mortar Rock, a thoughtfully designed living space. This stunning 6 bedroom transitional modern farmhouse showcases the exceptional craftsmanship and attention to detail that have made the Thomas Brothers Builders highly sought after. Perfectly blending beauty and functionality, this home is tailored to today's lifestyle while delivering timeless appeal. At the heart of the home is a spectacular chefs kitchen featuring quartz countertops and a large island with seating for four and an expansive dining area ideal for everyday living and entertaining. Sun filled spaces with nearly 10 foot ceilings on the main level creates and airy welcoming atmosphere throughout the home. Patio doors off the kitchen open seamlessly to a beautifully landscaped backyard with stone patio and built in gas fire pit. Ideally situated on a quiet cul-de-sac in one of Westport's most desirable locations this property offers the rare convenience of being just minutes from downtown shopping, dining, commuting options and Compo Beach.

Peacefully placed overlooking Signal Lake on a Greens Farms cul-de-sac is 4 Wake Robin Road, a classic Colonial with so much to offer! With over an acre of flat, private and blooming property, the home sits far back from the road with wooded and water views. Filled with historic charm, the main floor is bright and sunny - there are formal living and dining rooms with built-ins and cozy decorative fireplaces. The large family room has plenty of space for gathering and lounging, and connects to the beautiful screened in porch, perfect for 3 season enjoyment. The kitchen is anchored by a large island with cooktop, there are double wall ovens and a dining area. An office and powder room complete the main floor. Upstairs holds the primary suite, another ensuite bedroom, two bedrooms and a flexible bedroom/office space that share a hall bath as well as the laundry room. There is also a walk up attic space for plenty of storage. A pretty brick patio spans the front of the home with views of the rolling lawn, while there is a lush green backyard with access to the lake for a canoe rise or paddle board! There is a two car garage, and double driveway areas for sports and guest parking. Conveniently located to town, schools, the Greens Farms train station, and of course, Westport beaches!

A 2025 custom-built masterwork where uncompromising craftsmanship meets modern coastal sophistication. Newly completed and never lived in, this turnkey residence offers 4 bedrooms, 3 full and 2 half baths, and a fully finished lower level. Sun-filled interiors showcase site-finished hardwoods, soaring ceilings, and bespoke millwork by master craftsmen. The chef's kitchen features professional-grade Thermador appliances, custom inset cabinetry, a quartz island, and walk-in pantry - flowing into the great room for effortless entertaining. The primary suite is a true retreat, featuring a stunning oversized shower and a closet outfitted with custom built-ins. Beautiful tile work runs throughout the home, adding texture and craftsmanship to every space. Three additional bedrooms offer flexibility for family, guests, or a home office. The finished lower level is ideal as a media lounge, gym, or playroom. Minutes to Metro-North's express to Grand Central, with easy access to I-95 and the Merritt. Close to Westport's top schools, Compo Beach, downtown, and acclaimed dining. Move-in ready and built without compromise.

August First move-In Date - Just under a mile to Downtown Westport, on the Norwalk side of the Westport/Norwalk border you will find the: paddle tennis-filled, cozy walk-by-woods trailed, fun summertime-swimming pooled, refined living complex of "Strathmore Lane." And it is here that this fully renovated two bedroom, two bathroom townhouse apartment awaits you to enjoy the mirror shined hardwood floors and top of the line newest remodels as well as the best both Westport and Norwalk have to offer! Make an appointment while it's still here and come view this amazing rental with an detached included garage in this coveted remarkable complex!

~HIGH END LIVING~ This home is located in the "Golden Triangle" of downtown Westport. Bedford Square is a unique multi-purpose destination that includes premier residences, beautiful public areas, high-end retail and dining. Bedford Square is the culmination of the renovation and restoration of the stately 1923 Bedford Mansion and historic Firehouse. Bedford Square is ideally situated in the heart of this vibrant and prosperous community at the foot of Main Street and Church Lane. This luxury two-bedroom rental features upscale amenities and amazing views. Whether you are looking for an alternative to New York City living or want to downsize, Bedford Square brings a lifestyle of convenience to its residents. We can arrange rentals of one year, two years or more (unfurnished).

Like-new custom modern home with open-concept living designed for comfort and entertaining. The main level connects the family room, dining room, office, and chef's kitchen featuring Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, invisible speakers, quartzite countertops, custom cabinetry, two large islands and multiple sliding glass doors leading to an outdoor oasis. The spacious pantry includes custom shelving, an ice maker, and built-in water dispenser. The primary suite features cathedral ceilings, gas fireplace, a private balcony, expansive walk-in closet, and a spa-inspired bath with radiant heated floors, steam shower, soaking tub, and wet bar with refrigerator. The second level also includes four additional en-suite bedrooms and a spacious laundry room with double washer and dryer and custom cabinetry.  The third-floor lounge with wet bar and roof deck provides additional entertaining space along with another bedroom and full bath. The finished lower level offers a great room with wet bar, temperature-controlled wine room, gym, media/playroom, and en-suite guest bedroom. Outdoor spaces feature bluestone patios, a heated covered porch with fireplace, built-in grill, heated Gunite pool and spa and heated walkways. Additional highlights include Savant smart home system, Lutron lighting, whole-home audio, radiant heat, multi-zone HVAC, generator, and three-car garage with electric vehicle charger. Walk to Burying Hill Beach, Greens Farms Academy, and Greens Farms train station.

Luxurious living and entertaining spaces flow seamlessly to the outdoor oasis featuring a sparkling pool, spa, & private 1.6 property w/an irrigation system Belgium block trimmed driveway The magnificent primary suite is a private retreat, complete w/ a custom rift oak cathedral ceiling & a covered balcony w/ glass & wood railings overlooking the property.The 2nd level features 5 BRs w/ensuite baths. The 6th BR Suite is privately in the LL where there is a large FR & Gym.Additional amenities include natural gas, city water, Visual Comfort luxury lighting throughout, integrated recessed lighting, & countless custom features that elevate every room.This is a rare opportunity to own a newly built, architecturally stunning estate where exceptional design and refined living come together beautifully. Ready for move in Summer 2026

The beach lifestyle, water views, natural light, and endless possibilities await at 3 Madeline Avenue. Freshly painted and furnished, this charming 2-3 bedroom cottage offers an open and inviting floor plan featuring refinished hardwood floors, expansive windows, and a sun-filled living space one house from the waterfront. The kitchen is equipped with granite countertops and ample cabinetry, providing abundant storage and functionality. The lower level includes a mudroom, full bath, and a versatile bonus room with a skylight and window-ideal for a home office, guest space, gym, or creative studio. Upstairs, soaring vaulted ceilings, skylights, and oversized windows create a bright and airy retreat. Recent improvements include new flooring and a beautifully updated bath with a new vanity and tub. Step outside to a spacious patio, perfect for outdoor dining, entertaining, or simply enjoying the coastal setting. Whether you're looking for a turnkey weekend escape, year-round residence, investment opportunity, or the perfect site to renovate, expand, or build new, this property offers exceptional flexibility in a sought-after location. A rare opportunity to secure water views and exceptional potential in one of the area's most desirable coastal neighborhoods.

Designed by renowned architect and builder Frazier Forman Peters, this stone estate is set on nearly 3.5 private, meticulously landscaped acres in Westport. Crafted over more than two decades, the residence reflects exceptional artistry, scale, and craftsmanship. A gated entry and winding stone drive arrive at a stately porte-cochere and attached two-car garage, establishing a grand sense of arrival. Spanning over 10,500 square feet, the home offers four bedrooms, five full baths, one half bath, and living spaces defined by soaring ceilings, natural light, and timeless materials. The formal living room serves as a centerpiece with oak herringbone floors, Venetian plaster walls and ceilings, oversized windows, and a fireplace. Nearby, a double-height dining room with vaulted ceilings and imported Jerusalem stone creates a striking setting for entertaining. The chef's kitchen features professional-grade appliances, custom cabinetry, a large center island, and adjoining sitting area. A lofted library and study wrapped in handcrafted Honduran mahogany sits beneath skylights, while additional gathering spaces include a den, sunroom, wet bar, billiards lounge, and media room. A dedicated wellness wing offers an indoor lap pool, fitness center, sauna, and primary suite with dressing gallery, spa bath, studio, and private retreat. Grounds include an outdoor pool, tennis court, greenhouse, gazebo, pool house, and separate groundskeeper's residence.

Tucked within a peaceful garden setting, this beautifully renovated end-unit residence offers an effortless blend of comfort, style, and convenience. Enjoy the ease of garage parking within the building before stepping inside a thoughtfully designed condo featuring an open-concept layout, soaring 9-foot ceilings, abundant natural light, and serene views of the beautifully landscaped grounds. The beautifully appointed kitchen combines style and functionality with crisp white cabinetry, granite countertops, a classic subway tile backsplash, and stainless-steel appliances. A convenient in-unit washer and dryer enhance the ease of everyday living. Rich hardwood floors, custom built-ins, crown molding, and refined millwork add warmth and timeless character throughout. The spacious bedroom opens through French doors to a private bluestone patio-an inviting outdoor sanctuary for morning coffee, quiet afternoons, or an evening glass of wine. Ideally located just moments from downtown Westport's acclaimed restaurants, boutique shopping, library, Levitt Pavilion, Westport Country Playhouse, Longshore Club Park, Compo Beach, the marina, and Old Mill Beach. With convenient access to I-95, the Merritt Parkway, and Metro-North, this exceptional residence offers the perfect balance of coastal charm, vibrant community, and effortless convenience in one of Fairfield County's most desirable coastal communities.

Designed for comfortable everyday living, the home offers a spacious, light-filled layout with generous room sizes and exceptional flexibility. The eat-in kitchen flows into the dining room, while the expansive living room & sunroom feature sliders to a private patio overlooking tranquil, park-like grounds, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor setting. The den, located off the living room, features a fireplace & wet bar, offering a warm space to relax, read, or unwind. The sought-after first-floor primary suite offers a walk-in closet and an en-suite bath with a double vanity, separate shower, and jetted tub. A generously sized second bedroom with ample closet space, an additional full bath, laundry, and abundant storage complete the main level, providing the ease of one-level living. Upstairs offers a loft ideal for a home office or flex space, a private third bedroom with an en-suite bath, and a spacious walk-in storage room. A detached two-car garage is conveniently located directly in front of the residence. Residents enjoy beautifully maintained grounds, an in-ground pool, tennis and pickleball courts, and a prime Westport location just minutes to downtown, beaches, shopping, dining, and the train station. A rare opportunity in one of Westport's most desirable gated communities.

listings.remarks: Beautifully designed for effortless living, this light-filled and airy home at 20 Grassy Plains blends luxury, comfort, and convenience in one exceptional offering. Featuring a highly sought-after first-floor primary suite, this residence is ideal for both everyday living and long-term flexibility. An elevator connects multiple levels, providing ease and accessibility throughout the home, along with a finished basement offering approximately 1,500 square feet of additional living space. The open-concept floor plan is enhanced by abundant natural light, soaring ceilings, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The chef's kitchen is equipped with top-of-the-line appliances, custom cabinetry, and premium finishes, opening beautifully to the main living and entertaining spaces. Just a short stroll to Compo Beach, this striking modern coastal retreat is privately set on a coveted cul-de-sac, blending luxury, light, and effortless living. Spanning four levels, this six-bedroom home features an airy layout with refined finishes throughout. The open-concept kitchen flows seamlessly into the main living spaces, highlighted by a statement fireplace. A glass-enclosed office offers privacy, while additional living and dining areas, a stylish scullery, and an oversized mudroom add everyday functionality. A dramatic pivot door opens to a gallery-style entry. Upstairs, the primary suite is a serene retreat with its own fireplace, dual walk-in closets, a dressing area, and a spa-like bath. Four en-suite bedrooms and a laundry room complete the second floor, while the top level offers a private sixth suite, office, and flexible open spaces. The walk-out lower level expands the home with walls of glass, a terrace, gym, bar, wine cellar, media/playroom, and additional office. Outside, a 16'x32' pool, multiple terraces, and a grilling area create effortless summer living, complemented by a three-car garage with EV charging.

Located in the heart of Westport, The Gables of Westport presents a collection of eight townhomes and five flats, blending sophisticated design with the ease of in-town living. Enjoy close proximity to Metro-North, major highways, Longshore Club & Park, Compo Beach, Levitt Pavilion, Westport Country Playhouse, fine dining, shopping, and entertainment. Crafted by local renowned builder RPM Home Inc., these residences showcase open floor plans and premium finishes: Bertazzoni appliances, Grohe fixtures, custom cabinetry, quartz and marble countertops, 6" white oak flooring, and elegant trim selections. The main level offers a sun-filled living room, kitchen, dining area, and private terrace framed by expansive Marvin windows and sliding doors. Upstairs, retreat to a luxurious primary suite with spa-like bath and custom walk-in closet, plus an additional guest suite and laundry. Each townhome includes an oversized garage and attic with abundant storage. Set within a private enclave tucked away from Post Road, the community is surrounded by lush native landscaping and green spaces. Elevator option available.

listings.remarks: Now under construction with a summer move-in, this exceptional 6-BDRM SIGNATURE Home is set on a quiet cul-de-sac in Westport's sought-after Long Lots school district. Built by SIR Development-renowned for over 30 years and 300+ homes of exceptional craftsmanship-this residence seamlessly blends timeless design with modern luxury. A welcoming interior showcases 10-foot ceilings on the main level, highlighted by custom oak beam detailing and expansive windows that fill the home with natural light. The thoughtfully designed open floor plan is ideal for both everyday living and effortless entertaining. The chef's kitchen features custom SIR cabinetry, premium Thermador appliances, and a fully appointed larder with wet bar, wine cooler, and floor-to-ceiling storage-perfectly tailored for both function and style. The living room opens through sliding glass doors to a granite patio and spacious, level backyard, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor connection. Add'l main-level highlights include a private office with custom built-ins, formal LR, and a well-designed mudroom for everyday convenience. Upstairs, 5 generously sized BDRMs include a luxurious primary suite w/ a vaulted, beamed ceiling, fireplace, dual walk-in closets, and a spa-inspired bath designed for relaxation. The finished walk-out lower level offers exceptional versatility, complete w/ 6th BDRM, full bath, media room, gym, and custom built-ins w/ref drawers-ideal for guests,recreation, or extended living.

Introducing The Anchorage at Saugatuck Apartments - a rare collection of just eight luxury waterfront residences available for yearly or 2 year lease along the picturesque Saugatuck River in Westport. Offering an exceptional blend of modern design, tranquility, and the unrivaled coastal lifestyle, these spectacular two- and three-bedroom residences were thoughtfully crafted following a complete two-year redesign and renovation of the building. Each residence features stunning water views, floor-to-ceiling windows, sophisticated finishes, and private balconies overlooking the river - creating a seamless connection between indoor living and the beauty of the waterfront setting. A striking modern facade of concrete panels, beautifully landscaped riverside sitting areas, and carefully curated architectural details elevate the experience even further. Perfectly positioned just moments from vibrant downtown Westport, the Metro-North train, acclaimed dining, shopping, cafes, marinas, and Westport's beautiful beaches, The Anchorage at Saugatuck Apartments offers a rare opportunity to enjoy luxury waterfront living with both serenity and convenience.

listings.remarks: Welcome to Belden Place! Casual Luxury living personified in this boutique complex offering exquisite in-town living. This secure building with elevator access on the Saugatuck River is pet friendly. These luxury apartments are perfectly appointed and designed: plenty of closet space and storage, custom cabinetry, high-end appliances, in-unit washer and dryer, and private balconies. Enjoy the convenience of downtown living and inspiring river views in these beautifully renovated historic buildings in the robust downtown village. Leave your car at home and walk to everything the downtown community has to offer: restaurants, shopping, entertainment and more. Belden Place features fourteen one- and two-bedroom luxury apartments.   Enjoy luxury living on the Saugatuck River at Belden Place. Each apartment features a private deck, custom cabinetry and high-end appliances, elevator access and more!

Hidden along a private lane in Westport's Greens Farms neighborhood, this extraordinary 20-acre waterfront estate unfolds as one of the most remarkable shoreline settings ever offered. For more than 65 years, it has been held and enjoyed by the same family as a place to gather, unwind, and take in the ever-changing views across Sherwood Island Park and Long Island Sound. Surrounded by protected open space with no immediate neighbors, the property offers a rare sense of peace and privacy-reminiscent of the Lowcountry, the Hamptons, or Nantucket, a scale and atmosphere seldom found in Westport. Beautiful in every season, the setting also offers extraordinary birdlife and nature watching. Yet it remains moments to the Post Road, train, and town centers, and just one hour from Manhattan. A collection of residences and outbuildings is thoughtfully positioned across the land, including two circa 1940s three-bedroom guesthouses with sweeping water views, creating a true family compound where generations can come together while maintaining a sense of independence. Other structures offer flexibility for staff or future use. The grounds invite a lifestyle centered around the outdoors, with a tennis court, indoor pool, pool house, and formal gardens set within expansive lawns that stretch toward the water. Whether preserved, enhanced, or reimagined, this is a once-in-a-generation opportunity to shape a legacy estate-one that will be experienced and remembered for years to come.

listings.remarks: Built in 2022, 40 Richmondville Avenue offers generous scale, a thoughtful layout, and true move-in-ready ease.  Bright, open-concept main level connects kitchen, dining, and living spaces, with high ceilings and oversized windows throughout. The kitchen features a full Thermador appliance suite, large island with integrated outlets, extensive cabinetry, walk-in pantry, and mudroom with built-ins.  Upstairs includes a spacious primary suite with walk-in closet and spa-like bath with heated floors, soaking tub, and oversized shower. Two bedrooms are connected by a Jack and Jill bath, each with lofted spaces for added flexibility. Additional bedrooms offer options for guests, office, or evolving needs.  Third floor provides a private, multi-purpose level, while the finished lower level includes polished concrete floors and a bar/kitchenette area for casual entertaining.  Six bedrooms, five-and-a-half baths, and four finished levels offer exceptional flexibility.  Located just minutes from downtown Westport, with easy access to shopping, dining, and beaches, in an area experiencing continued growth.

Rare opportunity to build a custom residence on 1.2 acres in Westport. The previous home has been demolished, and the property is offered with approved architectural plans. Bring your preferred builder and collaborate with the project architect to tailor the design to your vision. Also listed as a to-be-built single-family residence.

An exceptional opportunity to create a custom luxury residence on 1.2 acres in Westport. With approved plans and permits already in place, buyers may bring their preferred builder and collaborate with the project architect to tailor the home to their vision. The property offers a streamlined path toward creating a distinctive residence while retaining flexibility in design, specifications, and finishes. Plans and renderings are representative and subject to change.

At the top of Clapboard Hill, through the gate and over the brick drive, an iconic Westport Colonial welcomes with an immediate feeling of privacy and classic beauty. The main entrance reveals a double height foyer, sweeping staircase and historic charm. The formal living room spans front to back with multiple seating areas flanking the original fireplace. A smart, chic library lands just off the center hall, followed by the gorgeous dining room ready for family dinners and holiday entertaining. The white and bright kitchen is anchored by an island and includes a full butler's pantry, a prohibition era wine closet, and the sunniest breakfast room overlooking the patio. The family room is so spacious with room for lounging by the fire and piling in for movie nights. Upstairs holds a total of six bedrooms. The primary suite includes a beautiful bath, multiple walk-in closets and sweeping views. A sweet set of bedrooms share a Jack and Jill bath. There are three additional bedrooms, a full bath, and a laundry room. The third level is fully finished as a recration room. The two acre property is fully irrigated, professionally landscaped, and sectioned for pool, play, patio spaces and privacy. The stunning pool includes a lap lane and the pool house is cabana perfection with a main room, poolside necessities (including a secondary bbq!) and full bath. There is a three car garage and automatic gate to split driveway. So close to beaches, GF train stations, schools and town!

Enjoy the best of downtown Westport from this bright, spacious studio overlooking the Saugatuck River. The open layout offers flexibility for distinct living, dining, and sleeping areas, complemented by warm wood-style flooring and large windows that bring in abundant natural light and peaceful river views. A generous granite-topped breakfast bar anchors the kitchen, which features ample cabinetry, a tiled backsplash, and full-size appliances. A substantial double-door closet provides excellent storage, while the full bath includes a wide vanity and tub-and-shower combination. Step outside and enjoy immediate access to downtown coffee shops, restaurants, boutiques, and everyday conveniences, with Bedford Square just a short walk away. An inviting in-town home combining water views, flexible living space, and a truly walkable Westport lifestyle.

Rarely available four bed circa 1900 home in Westport's coveted Saugatuck neighborhood, thoughtfully updated to blend historic character with modern comfort and energy efficiency. Original architectural details and mill work remain throughout, preserving the charm of its era while offering the upgrades today's renters seek. Welcoming entry features an enclosed front patio and entrance leading to a well-proportioned living room that flows into the dining area. Upgraded rear mudroom adds functionality. The thoughtfully designed kitchen features a custom wood block island serving as both workspace and a natural gathering place, proportioned with an efficient layout, it maximizes storage and workflow. A new electric range, plus an in-home washer and dryer, add convenience. A finished attic provides flex space for an office, playroom, fitness area, or guest retreat. A private backyard is designed for entertaining, with a beautifully renovated Ipe wood patio for outdoor dining and gatherings, plus a circular stone seating area for relaxing throughout the seasons. A backyard playset is also available for tenants. Owner upgrades include heat pumps, solar panels to help reduce utility costs, upgraded electrical service, central air, dual Bosch compressors, an oil-fired furnace for year-round comfort. Detached one-car garage provides parking and storage. Mins from Metro-North, restaurants, shops, waterfront, and downtown, this home offers exceptional convenience and coastal CT living!

RECENTLY UPDATED!!! Well maintained charming 3-4 Bedroom, 2 Full Bath rental available for October 1, 2026.  The location is ideal for both convenience and access to Westport amenities some of which includes: downtown Westport shopping, Compo Beach, Longshore Club Park, Metro North Train Station, top rated schools and I-95. Highly desirable neighborhood.  The open floor plan and abundance of natural light are definite highlights, creating a welcoming atmosphere throughout the home. White Kitchen has newish stainless steel appliances, new countertops and hardware that opens up into the Dining area and the Living Room. There are 3 Bedrooms on the second floor. On the third floor there is an additional room that can serve as a Bedroom or a private Office based on the tenants needs. The lower level Family Room is large and sunny with a full bath, newish vanity and shower.  Hardwood floors in all rooms except for the lower level. The screened-in porch has a new tiled floor.  The  porch and deck offer great spaces for relaxation and entertainment, while the flat spacious backyard adds even more versatility for outdoor activities.  Central Air. Lease term is one year or longer.

Sweet Cottage with In-Ground Pool on a lovely 1-acre property in Westport. Fabulous location, close to everything! This peaceful 3 Bedroom, 2 1/2 Bath home feels worlds away from the hustle and bustle, while being just minutes to Downtown Westport, Compo Beach, Longshore, and major commuter routes. Enjoy a dip in the pool, then relax on the expansive backyard deck and listen to the birds. You'll love the indoor-outdoor lifestyle and entertain with ease, with access to the deck from every room on the main level. A charming arched entrance leads to a gracious Living Room with cozy wood stove, vaulted ceiling and hardwood floors. The Dining Room connects the two sides of the house, with a wall of windows and French doors leading to the deck. The Kitchen allows room for a kitchen table for casual meals, and leads directly to the spacious, light-filled Family Room with vaulted ceilings, skylights and windows on three sides. There's a Half Bath and Laundry on the main level. Upstairs, the Primary Bedroom Suite is a restful retreat with Full Bath with tub and shower, a fireplace, and tree-house views to the backyard. Two additional Bedrooms and a Full Bath complete the second floor. Fantastic opportunity to enjoy the home as an end-user or build your dream house! Please do not enter property without an appointment.

This beautiful coastal residence, set on a half-acre, offers stunning views of the Saugatuck Yacht Club and the harbor, stretching to the Long Island Sound. Relax and unwind on the expansive front deck, perfect for soaking in the serene water views. This home features four bedrooms, three and a half baths, two fireplaces, and two decks for waterfront living, with endless expansion possibilities-add a rooftop deck, a second story, or a pool and pool house. The renovated chef's kitchen, with an induction range and top-line appliances, is brightened by skylights and opens via sliders to the back deck, where a hot tub awaits. The private primary suite, secluded on the second floor, offers lush backyard views, partial lagoon views, and a beautifully appointed primary bathroom. Just a few steps down from the kitchen, a spacious den with a cozy fireplace, a bar, and sliders to the backyard awaits. The lower level offers a large family room, a cedar closet, abundant storage, and direct access to the oversized two-car garage, plus even more storage rooms. Minutes to the train station and I-95, this is a perfect home for water lovers and commuters alike."

listings.remarks: The Bedford House: Architecturally and historically significant estate in Greens Farms. This exceptional property offers a rare opportunity to own one of Westport's true gems with a remarkable provenance. Set on 2.33 acres with a gunite pool & spa, court and a 2400 SF barn w/ 3 car garage, loft and more, this estate blends timeless elegance with modern comfort. Originally built in 1904 and designed by noted architects Visscher and Burley, this Colonial Revival style home has undergone thoughtful renovations over the years to preserve and enhance its original character. High ceilings, oversized windows, detailed millwork and sun-filled rooms create a sense of warmth and sophistication. Recent renovations include a new cedar roof on both house and barn, a like-new pool, spa & mechanicals, refinished hardwood floors, updated HVAC and new appliances. A unique highlight of this estate is its location across from Nyala Farms, offering scenic views of 50 acres of open meadows and fields with a deed restriction preventing any further development. Enjoy the ultimate lifestyle, minutes to the train, beaches, schools, shops and fine dining.

listings.remarks: Offers due by 5PM Monday, 7/27. Tucked into one of Westport's most treasured beach neighborhoods, this sun-filled Colonial is where people ride bikes until dinner, neighbors become lifelong friends, and an evening walk to Compo Beach can become part of your daily routine. From the moment you step inside, soaring ceilings, natural light, and beautifully connected living spaces create a home that feels larger, brighter, and happier than its square footage suggests. Designed for the way families actually live, the open floor plan flows effortlessly from the kitchen to the family room, while the unfinished lower level with soaring ceiling height offers potential for a home gym, golf simulator, media room, or recreation space-adding tremendous future value.  Then there's something you won't find in most homes: an owned Tesla Solar Roof with integrated battery backup. Not panels mounted on top, but the roof itself generating power. Enjoy remarkably low electric costs, automatic backup power during outages, and annual income through Tesla's Virtual Power Plant-all without compromising the home's classic architecture. Outside, gather around the fire pit beneath the stars, tend the garden, and simply enjoy the feeling of belonging that makes this neighborhood so special. With beach rights, top-rated Westport schools, Longshore just around the corner, and one of the area's most welcoming communities, this is more than a beautiful home. It's the heart of Compo Beach living.

Stylish2 bedroom 2 full bath condo upper floor totally renovated, with an open floor plan. This is a hidden gem nestled in the charming enclave of Westport village. Beautiful, updated kitchen with marble countertops, open concept living area enhanced with vaulted ceilings, and a gas fireplace creating an inviting atmosphere for relaxing and entertaining. Convenient location to all Westport amenities.

Light-Filled Westport Rental on a Private One-Acre Cul-de-Sac. Experience the best of Westport living in this beautifully updated, warm and welcoming 3 to 5 bedroom rental home, ideally situated on a picturesque one-acre property at the end of a highly desirable cul-de-sac, just moments from Wakeman Town Farm and all that Westport has to offer. Filled with natural light, the open-concept floor plan is designed for both comfortable daily living and effortless entertaining. The gourmet fully updated kitchen features stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and smart home technology, all while opening to inviting living spaces that seamlessly connect to the expansive outdoor deck, perfect for al fresco dining and gatherings.  The main level offers three bedrooms plus a flexible office that can easily serve as a fourth bedroom. The finished lower level provides exceptional additional living space, including an oversized family room, updated full bath, and an additional guest room or office. Completing the home are a laundry room with ample storage and an attached two-car garage. A rare opportunity to enjoy space, comfort, and convenience in one of Westport's most sought-after locations.

Compo Beach for summer fun. The Westport Playhouse. And a walking riverfront downtown featuring gourmet restaurants and boutique shops. All this within one hour to NYC. listings.remarks: Step into the timeless charm of this 1920s Classic Colonial, perfectly situated on nearly an acre of lush, manicured grounds. With 2,570 square feet of refined living space, this home effortlessly blends vintage character with modern convenience. The interior features four spacious bedrooms and two-and-a-half baths, offering a thoughtful layout that feels both grand and inviting. The heart of the home opens up to a beautiful, spacious deck and yard, providing a serene backdrop for morning coffee or afternoon relaxation. For those who need extra space, the 1,269-square-foot unfinished basement offers incredible storage potential, complemented by the convenience of a two-car attached garage. The location is truly unbeatable, placing you just moments away from local favorites like The Little Barn, Big Y, and an array of popular shops and restaurants. This is a rare opportunity to enjoy a quintessential New England lifestyle in a premier setting.

Rent a little bit of paradise. A beautifully appointed and renovated vintage cottage perfectly located to enjoy Westport. The sound of a running brook, egrets joining you for morning coffee, a convenient and coveted neighborhood. A little cottage that lives large.

Who doesn't love Roosevelt Road? I mean... if you are going to live anywhere in Westport this is the place. Wake to the rising sun and sip coffee in your sun-drenched screened in porch...then head for a soothing beachside walk, invigorating bike ride, or jog along the water's edge before starting your day. The life style at Compo Beach is in a league of its own and envied by all. This traditional 2 Bedroom 1.5 Bath colonial is filled with character and is situated on a beautiful oversized private lot with spacious flat yard, mature landscaping, pet friendly fencing, and a modern personal electric car charger for your convenience. Perfect place to hang your hat while building your dream home, or just wanting to check out what it's like to live in this amazing award-winning town. Only steps to beach, water and marina, and only minutes to Longshore Park offering golf, tennis, pool, boating, paddle tennis, winter skating and more. Be entertained by Westport's nationally acclaimed library, amazing five-star music rocking Levitt Pavilion, as well as fine Arts and Cultural events found at the Westport Country Playhouse and Museum of Contemporary Art. Enjoy vibrant downtown areas with premier shopping, restaurants and a wonderful seasonal Farmers Market. Award winning schools and only minutes to Metro North train to City.

Set well back from the road at the end of a long, tree-lined drive, this private Contemporary residence offers a rare pairing of seclusion and central Westport convenience. A short stroll from the Metro-North station, Compo Beach, and Longshore Club Park, the home rests on a level, professionally landscaped 1.05-acre lot in the coveted Compo Beach neighborhood - and, notably, sits comfortably outside the flood zone.  Inside, natural light pours across 4,449 square feet of light-filled living space. The main level opens through a gracious foyer to a beamed-ceiling living room with fireplace, a warm family room anchored by a second fireplace, and a well-appointed kitchen with a dedicated home office just off it. A first-floor primary suite makes single-level living effortless, complete with skylight, walk-in closet, and en-suite full bath.  Upstairs, three additional bedrooms - including a second suite with its own full bath and walk-in closet - surround a versatile loft, with laundry conveniently placed on the same level. Rich hardwood floors run throughout. A rear sunroom invites easy indoor-outdoor living, opening to the deck, porch, and private grounds, while the finished lower level adds flexible space and a further full bath.  Move-in ready and ideally positioned for summer at the beach - an A+ location, out of the flood zone, and ready to welcome its next residents.

A RARE SECOND CHANCE. This estate drew multiple offers within days, then sellers pressed pause. With plans now finalized, it's back on the market. Charming. Unique. Soulful. These are the words the current owner uses to describe this exceptional estate-and from the moment you arrive, you'll understand why. Poised on 2.85 private acres, this exceptional estate seamlessly weaves timeless heritage with modern luxury. At its core: a preserved 1930 Frazier Peters stone cottage-now a 2-bed, 2-bath guest house. At its heart: a 2007 custom-built main residence by Coastal Construction, echoing Peters' signature stonework with scale and sophistication.  Step inside and you'll understand why guests so often say, "Every room tells a story." A just-completed interior redesign has curated every finish, light fixture, and wall covering to create warmth and quiet elegance. The flow between rooms is not just open-it's meaningful, revealing itself gradually like a favorite novel.  The barrel-ceilinged primary suite, sunlit kitchen, cozy living room, hidden reading nooks, and versatile third-floor retreat all invite you to live more slowly, more beautifully. A gym, media room, and music studio offer space to move, create, and unwind. Outside, a pool/spa, pool house, and terrace with fireplace and outdoor kitchen extend the experience. Offered fully furnished at an additional cost if desired. Where every detail invites you to live with intention, comfort and quiet luxury.

Update: Offers are due at 6pm on Monday June 15th.  Set along one of Westport's most coveted stretches of the Saugatuck River, 18 River Lane is a timeless 1939 English Manor offering a rare blend of architectural character, waterfront serenity, and exceptional potential. Privately sited on 1.38 picturesque acres with sweeping river views and mature landscaping, this six-bedroom residence embodies the elegance and craftsmanship of a bygone era. Rich in period details, the home features graciously scaled rooms, distinctive architectural elements, and an inviting floor plan designed for both comfortable living and entertaining. The versatile layout includes a full walk-out lower-level apartment/studio, ideal for guests, extended family, a home office, creative workspace, or au pair accommodations. The spectacular riverfront setting provides a sense of tranquility and privacy while remaining just minutes from downtown Westport, the train, beaches, and top-rated schools. An extraordinary opportunity exists to further expand the estate, as the adjacent 1.13-acre building lot is also available for purchase, creating the potential for a remarkable compound or future development opportunity. A truly rare offering where historic charm, waterfront living, and limitless possibilities converge.

The professionally-landscaped property w/specimen plantings & artisanal stonework is the perfect backdrop for this classic Colonial. listings.remarks: This Westport residence is a meticulously executed Passive House retrofit of a modernist concrete home originally built in 1938. Few properties achieve this level of energy efficiency while also prioritizing non-toxic, health-conscious building materials. As you pass through the home's front entry gate and hear the gentle rhythm of tires over gravel, a striking and handsome facade comes into view-an arrival that feels both intentional and memorable. The setting immediately conveys a sense of privacy, character, and architectural distinction.  Your attention is naturally drawn to one of the most distinctive features of property: the Frazier Peters outbuilding. Rich in charm and architectural interest, this versatile structure offers exceptional flexibility-equally suited as a private office, creative studio, retreat, or state-of-the-art gaming lounge. The space adapts effortlessly to your vision and lifestyle  Originally designed by Frank Lloyd Wright protege Francis Barry Byrne, the home is a masterwork of form, function, and sustainability. Proportioned according to the Golden Ratio and set high atop a hill, those who visit cannot help but to enjoy sweeping views of mature rhododendrons and stately oaks. Inside, limestone walls, clean architectural lines, and abundant natural light create an atmosphere that feels both striking and serene.

Located on a quiet cul de sac only one mile from Metro North Train Station/I95 and two miles from Compo Beach, Longshore Country Club and downtown Westport - could your new home be any more convenient? Multiple HOBI award winning builder, CCO Habitats, presents its latest new construction project - a 5 bedroom, 4.5 bath home finished on 4 levels with room for a smaller pool. As always, there are some new features to discover, making this home unique from anything previously built. There's a warm, welcoming vibe, with oversized European tilting windows allowing the natural light to blend seamlessly with the white oak and glass interiors. Cozy modern. Sophisticated and stylish. An open floor plan presents a variety of lifestyle options. You can have either one or two offices and still have four multipurpose rooms to enjoy in different ways. Perhaps a living room, a family room, a media room and a great room? And that's not even including the gym! Maybe you'd prefer a library or a studio - go for it! There's an EV outlet waiting for you and yes, it's generator ready as well. It's just so easy. Functionality meets beauty and combines to create a truly livable home. Come discover. Come enjoy. Come home.

Bring your vision to life in Westport. Set on .23 acres and ideally located less than 2 miles from the beach, just 1 mile to the train &  I-95 and minutes to downtown, this property presents an opportunity to build new or completely reimagine. The existing structure is being sold strictly "As Is". An ideal offering for builders, investors or end users looking to customize to their own specifications. Buyers are encouraged to do their own due diligence. Estate property. Seller does not warranty any systems, appliances or utilities.

Convenient location close to town, shops, restaurants, the library and Levitte pavilion. This 3-bedroom ranch style home is on a level lot, on a cul de sac and there is a communal dock on the Saugatuck River at the end of the rd.  Easy one level living and in town.

Enjoy Westport's water community life-style, in this 4-5 bedroom seaside retreat in the Saugatuck Shores area of town. This 3000 square foot home comes with a membership to the Covlee Association, with its private beach, play area and boat slip. Beautifully maintained, the main floor living room has a cathedral ceiling with beams, fireplace and french doors to the blue stone patio. The updated and spacious eat-in kitchen, with fireplace breakfast bar, also accesses the patio. There is a Bedroom and Office on this level. Upstairs the Primary Bedroom boasts a huge walk-in closet and a double-sided fireplace that also opens to the luxurious bath with fabulous soaking tub & steam shower. 2 other Bedrooms and Bath complete this level. The sunny yard, with a second patio, offers privacy and space. Moments to the Westport train and amenities, this home is available in July 2026 for yearly rental. Good credit a must. Pets at owners discretion. No cats. Photos from previous tenancy.

listings.remarks: A rare offering indeed! Welcome to 4 Charcoal Lane, an unrivaled multi-generational estate mere minutes from top-rated schools, shopping, restaurants and all that Westport has to offer. Sited on 2 private acres, this extraordinary property offers panoramic views of a 7-acre nature preserve, affording permanent tranquility. The meticulous renovations center around a gracious farmhouse-style Colonial with stunning features and superior craftsmanship, plus a spectacular post-and-beam Party Barn. A gourmet chef's Kitchen is the heart of the main residence, featuring a 14-foot Calacatta marble island and a suite of professional-grade appliances with dual Family Room fireplaces nearby. The Living Room's unique tray ceiling was specially designed for a superior piano experience. Upstairs, the Primary Suite is highlighted by a gorgeous spa bath. The property's exceptional appeal is anchored by the Country Carpenters barn, connected by a breezeway w/barn doors that create an inviting welcome to backyard entertaining. This luxury 1BR barn features 20-foot ceilings, heated floors, a full kitchen, and hinge-free retractable doors to seamlessly blend indoor/outdoor living. Resort-style amenities await outdoors with a Pebble Tec pool, waterfall hot tub & blue granite patio that remains cool underfoot on hot summer days. The entertainment porch features built-in heaters, see-thru fireplace and outdoor television. This is more than just a home, it's a legacy waiting to be claimed!

listings.remarks: Classic 3 Bedroom Colonial in the heart of Westport set on a picturesque level .21-acre. Full of potential, this home awaits your creative vision. Good flow and hardwood floors throughout. Flat, pretty property with city water and sewer available nearby. Detached one car garage. Ideally located just a short walk to the Saugatuck River, train, restaurants, shops, the Rowing Club, and coveted Saugatuck Center. Bike to Compo Beach, Longshore Park and golf course, Ned Dimes Marina, the Westport Farmers' Market, Salmon Park, The Levitt Pavilion, Westport Library, The Westport Country Playhouse, and downtown Westport. Home is being sold "as-is". Amazing opportunity for a buyer, designer, investor or builder who understands the great potential in this most sought-after neighborhood.

Charming bungalow offering 2 bedrooms and 1.5 baths freshly painted with hardwood floors throughout the main living areas. Bright and inviting layout with an open flow between living room, dining room, and kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances, updated cabinetry, and granite countertops.  Upstairs includes a spacious primary bedroom and an additional bedroom with good closet space and an updated full bath.

Stunning custom-built residence, newly completed in 2024, set within one of Westport's most coveted enclaves. Impeccably designed, this home offers soaring ceilings, refined finishes, and exceptional craftsmanship throughout. At the heart of the home, a chef's kitchen features an oversized center island, Thermador appliance package, seamlessly opening to the dining room adorned with Thibaut wallpaper. The family room showcases vaulted ceilings, a Carrara marble gas fireplace, and French doors leading to the backyard and patio for effortless indoor-outdoor living. The main level also includes a formal living room, office, powder room, mudroom, and access to a three-car garage. Upstairs, the primary suite features vaulted ceilings, two oversized walk-in closets, and a spa-like bath with double vanities, soaking tub, and glass-enclosed shower. Three additional bedrooms, two full baths, and a spacious laundry room complete the second level. A finished third floor provides a versatile bonus room with full bath. The lower level features a media room, fitness space, second office, and ensuite guest suite. Professionally landscaped and fenced, the grounds offer privacy and a beautiful setting for outdoor living. Just minutes to Westport's beaches, shopping, dining and metro north for seamless access to NYC.

Set on a one-acre lot in a fabulous location, the property offers the perfect opportunity to create your dream home. Ride you bike to the beach or enjoy being just a stone's throw from Longshore Country Club and Park . Bring your imagination -and your builder-and make it your own!

Exceptional summer rental in the heart of Westport, available July 20 to August 20. This beautifully designed 6-bedroom, 4 full bath, 2 half bath home offers a rare blend of elevated style and effortless family living. Set on a fully fenced, professionally landscaped property, the backyard is a private oasis featuring an in-ground saltwater pool with spa, hot tub, and designer outdoor furnishings. It is perfect for both relaxed days and elegant entertaining.  Inside, the home is thoughtfully curated with sophisticated yet comfortable interiors, designed to feel both refined and welcoming. Spacious living areas, a well-appointed kitchen, and multiple gathering spaces provide flexibility for families, guests, and summer hosting alike. Ideally located just a short walk to downtown Westport's shops, restaurants, and amenities, this home offers the best of convenience and tranquility. A truly turnkey summer retreat that balances luxury, warmth, and livability.

Pristine Classic Westport Colonial thoughtfully updated to accommodate today's lifestyle. Home offers a gracious Living Room/Fpl/dining area, Six spacious Bedrooms plus 22x 28 Bonus room. Two bedrooms plus full bath on main Level. 16 x 23 Primary Bedroom plus 3 generous bedrooms on upper level. This level serviced by luxurious updated Full Bath. Kitchen is appointed with upscale appliances including 2025 Refrigerator and red oak flooring. Flexible Room 22x28/half bath can fulfill whatever your needs- in law, office family room all possibilities. Situated on private cul de sac ($500 annual contribution-no formal assoc)on.37 acre in heart of Westport. Shopping, restuarants, beaches, town owned Longshore CC and train all just minutes away.

listings.remarks: Located in prestigious Greens Farms, this European-inspired Colonial offers a rare opportunity to enjoy immediate charm while planning for the future. Set behind private gates on expansive, picturesque grounds, the property is surrounded by multimillion-dollar estates-making it an exceptional canvas for new construction or a significant estate expansion. The existing home is beautifully renovated, offering flexibility with gracious living and dining rooms, a sun-filled sunroom, cozy family room, and a curated Chef's kitchen with Calacatta marble, bespoke cabinetry, and top-tier appliances. A serene Primary Suite and additional bedrooms upstairs, the home functions perfectly as-is-or as a future guest house or accessory residence with thoughtful modifications. The sweeping land provides ample room for a new main residence set further back on the property, while maintaining the current home for extended family, guests, staff, or as a pool house. Outdoor living is equally compelling, with an expansive covered stone terrace, fire pit, and open meadow-like grounds offering endless possibilities for a pool, tennis court, barn, or gardens. Whether you choose to embrace the home's timeless appeal or create a legacy estate tailored to your vision, this is a unique chance to live comfortably now while building for tomorrow-all in one of Westport's most coveted locations, just minutes to Westport's vibrant downtown with award winning restaurants, premium shopping, beaches, and train.

Tucked away towards the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in a prime central Westport location, this beautifully updated home offers the perfect blend of privacy, convenience, and lifestyle. Set on 1.05 acres and just moments from town, close to schools, shopping, and commuting options, this five-bedroom residence is designed for both everyday living and effortless entertaining.  The heart of the home is the open kitchen featuring a large sunny dining area, center island, breakfast bar and exceptional flow into the family room-ideal for gatherings and modern living. A charming living room with a warm and inviting fireplace seamlessly flows into the private formal dining room, creating elegant spaces for more intimate gatherings.  This residence includes 4.5 baths and a thoughtfully designed layout throughout. The luxurious primary suite is a true retreat, complete with an adjacent office/dressing/make-up area or baby's room-exceptional custom closets-including a spacious walk-in with built-ins-and a spa-inspired bath with jetted tub.  The finished lower level, with private room with large closet, open space and full bath, provides ideal flexible space for storage, playroom, or gym.  Outdoors, enjoy a private oasis with an in-ground pool framed by beautiful stone walls and mature plantings. Set back from the road, the property offers both tranquility and seclusion while remaining close to all that Westport has to offer.

Fall in love with this immaculate and updated Storybook Charmer, nestled on half an acre in a special enclave near town and beach and train. Step inside and be delighted by the front-to- back Living Room with vaulted beamed ceilings, gleaming hardwood floors, fireplace and french doors from the Dining Area that opens to a large private deck. Also on the main level you will find the well-appointed Kitchen ( also opening to the deck) the cozy, sunfilled Family Room and the Primary Bedroom with Full Bath and sliders to a private patio. Upstairs discover a perfect Den/Office tucked away for quiet time. The above grade lower level features 2 additional lovely Bedrooms that share a Bath. This enchanting home is available as a yearly rental in June 2026. Tenant must have excellent credit and good references.

Welcome to 4 Cardinal Lane ~ a beautifully expanded and thoughtfully updated home set on two private, level acres in one of Westport's most desirable cul-de-sac neighborhoods. Originally built in 1964 and enhanced with a significant 2015 addition, this 4-bedroom, 3.5 bath residence offers over 4,100 square feet of versatile living space designed for both everyday comfort and effortless entertaining. The layout blends classic charm with modern functionality, featuring sun-filled living spaces, a wood-burning fireplace, an office and seamless flow throughout. The standout "bungalow" addition creates a one-of-a-kind experience, complete with a bar and direct access to the patio, perfect for hosting gatherings year-round. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with a walk-in closet and well-appointed bath, while three additional bedrooms provide flexibility for family and guests. A partially finished basement adds more usable space, including a dedicated gym area. Outside, the expansive backyard is a rare find offering endless potential for outdoor living, play, or future enhancements. The patio extends the home's entertaining footprint, creating an ideal setting for dining and relaxing. Just minutes from Westport's top-rated schools, beaches, golf course, tennis and pickle courts, town center, and train this is a unique opportunity to own a spacious, move-in ready home with exceptional indoor-outdoor living and standout entertaining spaces in a coveted setting.

Welcome to 10 Grist Mill Lane, a move-in ready home set on a beautiful, level acre at the end of a quiet Long Lots cul-de-sac. Thoughtfully updated throughout, this 3-4 bedroom, 2.5 bath residence offers an open and versatile floor plan designed for today's lifestyle. The dramatic living room features a vaulted ceiling and fireplace, creating a warm and inviting gathering space filled with natural light. The renovated kitchen opens seamlessly to the main living and dining areas, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. A screened porch extends the living space and provides the perfect setting for relaxing or hosting guests while overlooking the private backyard. Flexible living options include a main level den or office that can easily serve as a fourth bedroom. Renovated baths, updated Marvin windows, Hardie Plank siding, and numerous improvements throughout add to the home's appeal. Ideally located on a long, quiet lot in a desirable neighborhood setting, this home combines privacy, comfort, and convenience in one exceptional offering.

Better than new, this pristine 2016 custom-built residence offers a rare standard of refinement and sophisticated excellence. With 4,000+sqft and an elevator accessing all four finished levels, the home blends modern architecture with beautifully executed transitional design. The open-concept main level features a magnificent chef's kitchen, spacious dining area, and expansive living room with gas fireplace, custom built-ins, beams, and tray ceiling. Four-inch white oak flooring runs throughout. A wall of glass doors opens to a breathtaking private setting with a remote-controlled awning, ideal for effortless indoor/outdoor living. Four bedrooms include the luxurious primary suite with tray ceiling, built-ins, and serene garden views, plus a spa-like bath with heated floors, soaking tub, double vanity, and walk-in closets. Two additional en-suite BRs and an exceptional home office with dual built-in desks, double-height bookcases, library ladder, and automated shade complete the level. The third floor offers a skylit fourth bedroom with full bath and cedar closet. The finished lower level includes a playroom/gym, office, and half bath. A 2car garage, elevator to all levels, full-house generator, security and sound systems elevate the offering. Ideally set on a desirable cul-de-sac minutes to the beach, train, town, library, and farmers market, making this an incredible location from which to enjoy all of Westport's most coveted amenities. Move-in ready and truly exceptional.

listings.remarks: Award-winning builder proudly presents a rare, beautifully restored high Victorian Gothic home chronicled for its grace and splendor. Original architectural details artfully remain, including the only known local example of clustered colonette posts adorning the veranda. The interior showcases curved archways, carved mahogany stair banister and newel post, and detailed window trim. White oak Smallbone kitchen with La CornuFe range and mosaic marble tile opens to a dining/great room. Light fixtures and appliances were individually selected with an artist's eye. Sun-filled, the home offers six-inch white oak flooring throughout, stunning renovated baths, and all-new mechanicals with an electric heat pump and Smart home technology. The flexible layout includes a first-floor guest suite with full bath, powder room, and living room with fireplace. The second level boasts three bedrooms, one en-suite, plus a hall bath. The finished third level works as a primary suite, guest suite, or office with full bath and laundry. The detached two-car barn and garage conceal a legal one-bedroom cottage with a private garden. New kitchen, appliances, flooring, heat pump, and renovated bath; ideal for extended family or income. Both structures feature Smart eco-systems controlling security, sound, light, and climate via voice or phone. While away the hours on one of the two porches overlooking the private garden and stone wall. This coveted walk-to-town gem is an investment in loving life here.

listings.remarks: Set in one of Westport's most prestigious estate enclaves, this exceptional shingle-style residence defines luxury living with a rare emphasis on multi-generational comfort, timeless architecture, and impeccable craftsmanship. Designed and built by a renowned architect and builder for a Fortune 500 CEO, the home reflects uncompromising quality, enduring design, and gracious curb appeal that impresses. Seamless indoor-outdoor living defines the home, with sun-filled interiors, soaring 10-foot ceilings, and an expansive walkout lower level with fireplace, all opening to a resort-style pool, stone patios, fire pit, and covered porch with fireplace, providing an effortless setting for entertaining. Extensive bespoke millwork, six fireplaces, and refined architectural finishes enrich every space. The expansive, level, and private grounds, framed by mature landscaping and abutting the 39-acre Newman Preserve, offer serenity with rare walkability to top-rated schools and 8 minutes to Westport's lively downtown. A spectacular chef's kitchen features Thermador and Wolf appliances, dual islands, 2 dishwashers, walk-in pantry, and a fully equipped butler's pantry with wet bar. The primary suite offers a turreted sitting room, fireplace, and 2 walk-in closets. 6 ensuite bedrooms and a private suite over the garage provide flexibility for guests. Space for elevator! New cedar roof, new boiler, new wine cellar, and other upgrades complete this rare offering in a premier Westport location.

Beautifully set on a side street rise, this stately center hall Colonial has a traditional 4 bedroom, 3.5 bathroom floor plan, plus a bonus wing to suit your flexible space ideas! The main floor includes a front to back stretching living room with the sweetest screened porch, a dining room, an eat-in kitchen with dining area and breakfast bar, and a spacious family room. Upstairs, the primary bedroom has a full bath, three closets and beautiful views of the private property and pool! There are three additional bedrooms, one with an adorable play nook, and a hall bath. The "wing" connects to the main floor and is made up of a living room, office, 2 bedrooms, a full bath and there is a rec room, half baths, storage and a separate entrance on the lower level. A great space for guests, flexible use, and zoned as a legal two family. The 1.35 acre property is bright and blooming already, and the pool is ready for summer fun! Located so close to schools, town and transit, 52 Meadow View Road is ready to be enjoyed!

Located in the Hunt Club area of Westport, this Modern Farmhouse Colonial rental offers flexible living space across four finished levels. The home features a covered Brazilian mahogany front porch, open floor plan, 10' ceilings on the first floor, 9' ceilings on the second floor, Metro trim detail, crown moldings, and wainscoting throughout.  The kitchen opens directly to the great room and receives strong natural light through oversized sliding doors. The main level also includes a formal dining room and private library/home office.  The primary suite includes a fireplace, tray ceiling, two closets, and updated marble bath with soaking tub and separate shower. One secondary bedroom includes an en-suite bath, while two additional bedrooms share a full bath. The third floor includes an additional bedroom, full bath, and flexible recreation/play space.  The finished lower level includes a media room, gym area, office space, and full bath, offering additional work and living flexibility.  Large front and rear lawns provide usable outdoor space with room for entertaining, recreation, or play. Convenient access to Westport amenities, train, shopping, beaches, schools, and commuting routes.  Available for annual or multi-year lease.

Beautifully updated with main level primary suite and abundant additional living space for family and guests in this move-in ready townhouse. You will love the soaring ceilings, the open and very flexible floor plan and natural light that fills this home throughout the day. Enjoy coffee or dinner al fresco on your dedicated private patio - so rarely found in a condominium community. Almost fully revamped with high quality materials and a simple but stunning palette that will appeal to every taste and decor. One of the largest 2 bedroom 2.5 bath models, this unit includes an upper level open loft or office plus a finished lower level for your home theater or gym and extensive storage in the unfinished area. Every detail has been considered for comfort and peace of mind, including a generator and hard-wired security system. Harvest Commons is a vibrant and well managed community with pool, pool house and tennis courts. Ideally located close to shopping, dining, Metro North and our beaches. No need to downsize - this is an opportunity to "right size" and enjoy all the advantages of a home, without the headaches.

listings.remarks: Classic Nantucket-style beach house just five homes from the sand at Compo Beach, offering the ultimate coastal lifestyle. Move right into this beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home filled with warmth, charm and natural light. The inviting family room features a wood-burning fireplace, while the renovated kitchen opens effortlessly for easy everyday living and entertaining. The sunlit primary suite includes a private balcony with views of Long Island Sound. Main floor laundry adds convenience. Outside, glass sliders lead to a beautifully landscaped patio and serene backyard oasis - the perfect place to relax, entertain and enjoy the salt air. Detached shed plus crawl-space storage complete this special beachside retreat.

*SELLERS ARE AKSING FOR HIGHEST AND BEST OFFERS BY 4PM MONDAY JUNE 1ST*Set on a beautifully landscaped, bucolic acre at the top of a quiet cul-de-sac in Westport's coveted Old Hill neighborhood, this charming cottage-style ranch home offers the perfect blend of modern convenience, and luxurious Westport lifestyle. Move-in ready and beautifully maintained it's thoughtful layout is ideal for both everyday living and gracious entertaining. Light pours in through picture windows, French doors, and skylights giving a bright airy feel throughout. At the heart of the home is a stunning chef's kitchen equipped with high-end stainless steel appliances. The open dining area is perfect for feasts with family. Sliders leading to multiple decks make indoor-outdoor living seamless. Relax in the inviting living room with a cozy fireplace, or entertain outdoors on the expansive deck overlooking lush lawns. Retreat to the primary suite that boasts a newly renovated spa-like bath. Two additional bedrooms & full bath complete this level. The lower level offers a family room, perfect for movie nights, as well as office built-ins to WFH. A playroom/rec space, plus a fourth bedroom and full bath, make an ideal setup for guests, in-laws, or au pair. Step outside to your resort-like oasis featuring a stunning, sun-drenched saltwater pool and cabana with bar & Sonos - summer entertaining perfection! Energy efficient with Tesla Solar Roof, newer mechanicals and a generator give peace of mind.

For the first time since it was built in 1956, 22 Fillow Street is ready for its next chapter. Set on a beautiful .40-acre property in Westport's cherished Flower Estates neighborhood, this solid, well-built home offers a rare opportunity to become part of one of the town's most established and beloved in-town communities. Flower Estates is one of those increasingly rare Westport neighborhoods where the setting still feels personal, connected, and timeless - a true neighborhood close to town, schools, the train, and the beach. From here, you are just minutes to downtown Westport, approximately 10 minutes to the Westport train station, about 10 minutes to Compo Beach, and only minutes to Coleytown Elementary School. The home has been lovingly owned by one family since new and features hardwood floors throughout, wonderful natural light, and quality construction that has stood the test of time. Mechanicals recently updated. The .40-acre property is spacious, pretty, and full of possibility. Whether you envision updating the existing home, designing a larger residence, or adding outdoor entertaining spaces, this property offers flexibility in a location that is hard to duplicate. 22 Fillow Street is more than a house - it is a chance to continue a Westport tradition and enjoy a lifestyle defined by neighborhood, convenience, beach, town, train, and community.

Tucked away in a prime Westport location, this boutique turnkey property offers effortless luxury, exceptional comfort, and refined coastal living. Newly constructed and beautifully furnished with pristine white furnishings, the home exudes a fresh, sophisticated aesthetic throughout. Vaulted, beamed ceilings create an open and airy atmosphere, while crisp interiors, warm area rugs, curated artwork, and designer details lend an inviting yet elevated feel.The sun-drenched Great Room flows seamlessly into a stylish eat-in kitchen featuring a generous dining table that doubles as an island, handsome accent lighting, abundant storage, and new appliances. Sliding doors open to a huge private, FULLY FENCED, DOG FRIENDLY backyard oasis-perfect for relaxing, al fresco dining, summer entertaining, or simply unwinding in complete privacy.The spacious bedroom suite serves as a serene retreat with a beautifully appointed bath and walk-in shower. Thoughtful amenities, including a stacked washer/dryer, wall-mounted televisions, outdoor grill, and private exterior storage for bicycles or kayaks make everyday living effortless. Separate parking for two cars, plus guest parking, adds to the home's convenience.Just minutes from downtown Westport's renowned shopping, dining, beaches, Longshore Club, YMCA, & major commuting routes, this sophisticated cottage offers the perfect blend of style, comfort, privacy, & convenience. Move right in and enjoy all this exceptional property has to offer

Set in Westport's sought-after Hunt Club neighborhood, this European-inspired Colonial offers over 6,300 square feet across three finished levels, including expansive recreation spaces and a dedicated home theater. A dramatic two-story entry introduces refined formal and informal rooms, including a fireplaced living room, formal dining room, private office, and an expansive eat-in kitchen with custom cabinetry, oversized island, and professional-grade appliances.  The primary suite is a private retreat featuring a spa-like marble bath with steam/sauna and an exceptionally large walk-in closet. Four additional bedrooms-many with ensuite or Jack-and-Jill baths-offer flexibility and comfort for family and guests. The finished lower level provides exceptional lifestyle space ideal for entertaining, fitness, or play.  Additional highlights include soaring ceilings, custom millwork, hardwood floors throughout, walk-up attic storage, and a three-car garage. Conveniently located near town, schools, shopping, and transportation.

This Greenfield hill Charming colonial, sits on a 1.6 acre lot, right at the border of Fairfield and Westport and only 6 away minutes from the Southport train station and multiple beautiful beaches. Cozy and stylish with a twist of French flair, this well maintained property offers, 5 bedrooms, including a nursery right by the primary suite, 3.5 bathrooms and 5 garages, 3 being attached to the house. On the first floor a large living room leads to an open concept dining room and a bright kitchen, perfect for gatherings. On the second floor, the 5 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms as well as a dedicated office space await you. A full house generator has been installed. Be the first to discover this hidden gem. Agent/co owner. Cameras are installed outside. UPDATE: Sellers are thanking all agents and potential buyers for their interest and are asking for Highest and best offers by Tuesday June 9th noon.

Brand new furnished luxury coastal retreat available for rent in the highly sought-after Saugatuck Shores neighborhood. Privately situated on a quiet cul-de-sac, this exceptional 3,540 SF home offers 4 bedrooms, 4 full baths, and 2 half baths with breathtaking direct views of the Long Island Sound and surrounding marshlands. The lower level features a spacious 2-car garage, mudroom with large storage closet with a premium dry-cleaning steam closet system, recreation room w/ glass doors to rear yard, & exterior storage rm. The main level showcases an expansive open-concept design with a dramatic living room centered around a gas fireplace and floor-to-ceiling windows capturing panoramic water views. The eat-in chef's kitchen is beautifully appointed with custom cabinetry, high-end stainless steel appliances, pantry closet, drawer microwave, beverage cooler in the island w/ seating. Step outside to the rear deck overlooking the peaceful marshlands. A powder room and first-floor bedroom suite, thoughfully furnished as a private home office, complete this level. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite features a French balcony, 2 walk-in closets, linen closet, and spa-inspired bath w/ heated floor, soak tub, walk-in shower, and private water closet w/ smart bidet toilet. Bedrooms 3 & 4 are both en-suite with walk-in closets. Laundry room w/ storage closet. 3rd floor den w/ half bath and a spectacular rooftop deck offering stunning sunsets over Long Island Sound. Min. 1 year rent
