listings.remarks: Tucked at the end of one of Westport's most coveted cul-de-sacs, this 5-bedroom contemporary offers 6,310 sq ft of finished living space on just over a private acre, with a backyard path leading directly to Bedford Middle and Staples High School. From the foyer, a dramatic vaulted living room with skylights, built-ins and a floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace sets the tone. The glass-wrapped sunroom windows (newly replaced) frames stunning views of the lush grounds and heated gunite pool, while the updated eat-in kitchen with granite counters, center island, breakfast bar and pantry flows into a generous family room anchored by a second fireplace. A formal dining room and four main-level bedrooms offer flexibility, including possible first-floor in-law. Upstairs, the primary suite is a true retreat: vaulted ceilings, dressing room, walk-in closet and a private treehouse-like balcony overlooking the backyard. The expansive finished lower level delivers a playroom, game area and built-in wet bar, plus a large laundry room, mudroom and abundant storage. Recent updates include new natural gas heating and tankless hot water systems and new pool filtration. With a 2-car attached garage, walk-up floored attic and Westport beach rights, this is the rare home combining resort-style privacy with a walk-to-schools location - minutes to downtown, the train and Compo Beach.

22 Sturges Commons offers the rare combination of timeless elegance, true neighborhood living, and unmatched convenience in one of Westport's most sought-after locations near the Hunt Club. Just one traffic light to the Greens Farms Station train station, this home makes commuting to New York City effortless while allowing you to return home to a peaceful walking neighborhood where charming streets converge, creating the classic community feel that is increasingly rare in Westport, CT real estate. Set on beautifully landscaped property, the home is designed for both relaxed everyday living and exceptional entertaining. The fully fenced backyard features a sparkling pool and spa, expansive outdoor spaces for dining and gatherings, and plenty of room for sports and play. Inside, warmth and sophistication define every space. The gourmet chef's kitchen opens seamlessly to a spacious step-down family room with soaring ceilings and abundant natural light, creating the perfect heart of the home. Formal living and dining rooms provide elegant entertaining spaces, while multiple options for home offices and flexible living make this property ideal for today's lifestyle. Offering 5 ensuite bedrooms, 8 baths, a third-floor office or yoga retreat, and a finished lower level complete with gym, media room, and playroom, this exceptional Westport home blends luxury, comfort, and functionality in one of the best commuter locations in Fairfield County.

AVAILABLE AUGUST 15th.  Located in the heart of Greens Farms, the home features three finished levels with 3-4 bedrooms and three baths. Inviting living spaces include a living room with fireplace, formal dining room, and a sun-filled den. The bright kitchen offers a breakfast room, pantry, and sliding glass doors that open to the backyard, deck, and one-car garage - creating an easy indoor-outdoor flow ideal for everyday living and entertaining. The lower level adds exceptional flexibility with a playroom, home office or 4th bedroom option, and laundry room. A private driveway provides ample parking, completing this centrally located and beautifully livable home. Minutes to Metro North Greens Farms Station.

Now more than ever, home is a haven - a place to live, work, relax, and entertain. Privately sited on 1 beautifully landscaped acre in highly sought-after Old Hill, this sophisticated 6,000+ SF home with a brand-new pool offers 6 bedrooms, exceptional living spaces, and breathtaking western sunsets overlooking Earthplace's 62-acre nature sanctuary. A rare blend of privacy, style, and convenience, all within walking distance to town. Designed for both elegant entertaining and comfortable everyday living, the main level features a stunning chef's kitchen with custom cabinetry, pantry, and sun-filled dining area flowing seamlessly into the spacious family room with fireplace - all overlooking the expansive lawns, sparkling pool, and serene natural setting. Formal living and dining rooms provide elegant gathering spaces, while a private office/playroom and guest bedroom with full bath complete the first floor. The luxurious primary serves as a private retreat with sitting area or office, walk-in closet, and spa-inspired bath. Four additional bedrooms, two full baths, and a conveniently located laundry room complete the second level. The top floor offers exceptional bonus space, including a vaulted-ceiling playroom, additional room, and half bath. The lower level provides versatile space featuring a gym, mudroom, and extensive storage. Chic yet welcoming interiors, contemporary amenities, and extraordinary natural surroundings combine to create the ultimate Westport retreat.

Welcome home to this charming 5-bedroom home located in the desirable Long Lots area, convenient to everything. Short walk to schools, shopping and minutes from train and highways. Every room in this home is so inviting, gather round in the kitchen or watch movies in the den, sit by the fireplace in the living room or enjoy the view of the brook from the balcony in the primary bedroom. The walk-out lower level leads to a brick patio perfect for private twilight nights and an expansive backyard to kick a ball around. The home abuts a dead end great for riding bikes and extra parking for large gatherings. This multi-level home lives large, truly a must-see.

listings.remarks: Tucked behind a gated entry in Old Hill, this stunning 5 bedroom, 6.2 bath home offers a rare blend of elegance, privacy and natural beauty. The property has multiple serene water features-a heated saltwater gunite pool with hot tub, a tranquil private pond with fountain and picturesque Stony Brook. The stately stone and wood exterior blends seamlessly with the lush surroundings, while inside, an expansive, light-filled layout is ideal both for grand entertaining and quiet retreat. A dramatic wall of windows captures sweeping views of the brook, creating a seamless connection between indoor comfort and the surrounding landscape. The ground floor consists of a gourmet kitchen, large family room with fireplace, dining room with wet bar, living room with fireplace + lounge area with water views, a large entry foyer with stone floors and two powder rooms. Upstairs, a primary bedroom suite with two balconies overlooking the pond and brook, two walk in closets & beautifully appointed bathroom, 4 additional bedrooms each with its own bathroom, a large home office/6th bedroom with fireplace and brook & pond views, a large playroom with full bathroom, windowed home gym, and another family room on the 3rd floor, offering multiple options for relaxation and entertainment. Fully fenced for privacy with automated driveway gates, it has a heated 3 car garage, Crestron lighting system, full house generator, mature landscaping, and a gas grill seamlessly built into the stonework by the pool.

Compo Beach...

Carefully crafted Connecticut modern farmhouse by award-winning Heine Development, this exceptional 6-bedroom residence blends timeless architecture with refined contemporary living amongst 4 finished levels on 2 private, level acres in one of Westport's most convenient luxury locations. Designed with perfection in symmetry, detail, and craftsmanship, the home pairs classic farmhouse inspiration with sophisticated modern finishes, including wide-plank white oak floors, curated lighting, and elegant interiors by renowned House of Clement. The stunning chef's kitchen features Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, seamlessly connecting to beautifully scaled living and entertaining spaces filled with natural light with Southern exposure and beautiful sunsets. Outdoors, enjoy a resort-style ozone maintained 20'x 50'pool with automatic safety cover, sun shelf, and expansive flat lawns enhanced by organic vegetable beds. The extraordinary lower level offers the ultimate lifestyle experience with a gym, sauna, full bath and a custom treehouse, playroom, and second laundry room, creating flexible spaces for wellness, recreation, and everyday convenience. Additional highlights include natural gas heat, a generator, and exceptional indoor-outdoor flow designed for effortless living and entertaining. A rare offering that combines privacy, luxury, and modern farmhouse elegance just moments from town, train, beaches, and all that Westport has to offer.

All utilities included! Thoughtfully updated and full of character, this inviting Westport home perfectly balances charm, comfort, and convenience. This beautifully updated 2-bedroom home with an additional loft-style bedroom is filled with natural light and architectural appeal. Soaring vaulted ceilings create an open, airy atmosphere, while the renovated kitchen and bathrooms blend style and comfort. Additional highlights include garage parking, a dedicated laundry room, and a location that puts downtown Westport, parks, shopping, dining, and transportation just moments away. Enjoy simplified living with utilities included and all the charm of one of Fairfield County's most desirable communities.

HIGHEST AND BEST DEADLINE: SUNDAY, 6/7 BY 5PM -- Beautifully renovated and perfectly positioned in one of Westport's most coveted and centrally located neighborhoods, this 4-bedroom home offers the turnkey lifestyle today's buyers are seeking, with modern updates, flexible living spaces, and easy access to everything that makes Westport so special. Just minutes from top-ranked schools, downtown shopping and dining, Compo Beach, and transportation -- the location is simply exceptional. The sun-filled main level features a welcoming living room with vaulted ceiling, fireplace, and seamless flow into the dining room. The renovated kitchen showcases crisp white cabinetry, quartz countertops, marble backsplash, chic lighting, and sweeping views of the private backyard. The primary suite has been thoughtfully transformed with a tray ceiling, large walk-in closet, and luxurious marble bath with double vanity, soaking tub, and shower. Two additional bedrooms and a renovated full bath complete the upper level. The lower level offers outstanding flexibility with a fourth bedroom, renovated full bath, convenient home office, and spacious family room featuring custom built-ins, a wood-burning fireplace, and sliders to the patio and backyard. An additional lower level provides a large recreation room, dedicated laundry room, cedar closet, and abundant storage. Move right in and enjoy a turnkey lifestyle in one of Westport's most desirable neighborhoods.

Experience the perfect blend of charm, sophistication, and convenience in this beautifully updated Colonial home, nestled in the vibrant Saugatuck Enclave. Just a short stroll away from the Metro North train station, popular restaurants, and the scenic river, this residence offers both tranquility and accessibility.  Boasting four spacious bedrooms, two full bathrooms, and a half bath, this home is designed for modern living. Enter through the inviting front door into a gracious foyer, flanked by a home office on the left and an expansive formal living room on the right, featuring a cozy wood-burning fireplace.  The heart of the home is the open-concept kitchen and family room, bathed in natural light from numerous windows. A formal dining room seamlessly connects to the living room, creating an ideal space for entertaining.  Upstairs, the primary suite occupies the entire rear side of the home, providing a private retreat away from the other three bedrooms. The lower level offers a versatile playroom or movie room, along with convenient laundry and ample storage space.  Outside, enjoy informal gatherings on the patio, surrounded by a generous, well-maintained yard. This home is a delightful haven with close proximity to all the amenities that make Saugatuck a sought-after community.

Located in one of Westport's most desirable and convenient neighborhoods, this beautifully updated home offers the perfect blend of style, comfort, and functionality. Designed for today's lifestyle, the open-concept floor plan features a recently renovated kitchen with an oversized island that seamlessly connects to the main living and entertaining spaces.  The upper level includes three spacious bedrooms and two full baths, while the main level offers an inviting family room and a half bath. Just beyond, a spectacular four-season sunroom is flooded with natural light year-round, providing the perfect place to enjoy your morning coffee, work from home, or take in the changing seasons. The finished lower level adds exceptional versatility, offering space for a playroom, home gym, media room, or office.  Ideally situated just minutes from all that downtown Westport as to offer, top-rated schools, and the Merritt Parkway, this home combines an unbeatable location with modern updates and everyday convenience.

"MEADOW WOOD" - Nearly two acres of Westport's most spectacular land is the setting for this storied estate, which has been completely remodeled, expanded and transformed for modern living. Totally fenced & screened w/privacy trees, this unique property offers rare sophistication with a stunning main residence, gunite pool, and a 2,447+/- sqft barn. Gated driveways lead to both the main house & the barn, and the stunning setting makes an enduring impression. The glamorous echoes of a Hollywood-style estate combine w/incredible updates throughout the transformed interiors. The front-to-back LR has a distinctive bay window & dual doors to a serene porch that gazes across the expansive grounds. The incredible great room is the focal point of this expertly-designed floorplan, combining a Chef's kitchen w/expansive island, endless storage, Thermador appliances, breakfast/casual dining area, all leading to the incredible DR & fam rm which has a wall of folding glass doors creating an effortless flow between the gorgeous interior & exterior spaces while preserving open views across the property. A BR suite w/private access, large laundry rm, mudrm, garage & powder rm complete this level. Upstairs, well-appointed BRs w/designer baths await. The primary suite is an exquisite space w/tray ceiling, fpl, plush bth, walk-in dressing rm & an amazing balcony that spans much of the rear of the home. An elegant patio lines the heated pool. The barn is a dream for auto enthusiasts.

This historic Greens Farms acreage was once part of the famed Winfromere Stables where Edward T. Bedford's world class trotters were kept in grand style. Offering over 220 feet of broad frontage on private Bedford Drive, this scenic 1.14 acre parcel features a gentle rise above the street level, providing an ideal setting for a light filled home. Mature, statuesque trees grace the open landscape, offering established character and picturesque summer shade. City water and electricity are already on the property. This is a prime canvas for you to bring your vision to life in one of Connecticut's most sought-after neighborhoods.

Saint John Place is the street people who know Westport quietly hope opens up. It almost never does. Reimagined in 2007 by Renato Gasparian Associates and refreshed in 2022, this house has all the right moves. Inside, the main level opens up the way you hope it will. The great room stretches nearly thirty-four feet and flows into the dining area and a kitchen built around a center island, with a custom walk-in pantry right behind it. A sun room pulls in the morning light. There's a separate family room, plus a real office with a door that closes. Upstairs, five bedrooms give everyone somewhere to land. The primary suite has a spa bath with a soaking tub, a separate shower, and two walk-in closets (because who likes to share?). The laundry is up here too, in its own room. The outdoor spaces close the deal. A bluestone patio wraps around a good portion of the house with a stone fireplace. The deep flat lot is screened by mature plantings and gives you the privacy people leave town to find. You're in the heart of Westport's in-town neighborhood, which means the car can stay in the driveway. Walk to a different cuisine every night, the shops, the Library, the Westport Country Playhouse, summer nights at the Levitt Pavilion. The Saugatuck River is right there, and a celebrated omakase counter is a few minutes on foot. When you do want the car, the beach is a short drive away. Beautiful house, easy life, almost everything a walk from the door. Tour online @ 30saintjohn.com

Enjoy easy living in this charming 2-bedroom, 1-bath apartment located in a sought-after Westport neighborhood. Filled with natural light, the home features a spacious living room that opens to a modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances, a gas cooktop, and a wine refrigerator. Both bedrooms offer comfortable space, and hardwood floors run throughout the apartment, adding timeless appeal. Practical amenities include in-unit laundry, generous storage, and a private garage with additional driveway parking. Surrounded by beautifully maintained grounds, the property offers a peaceful setting while remaining close to everything Westport has to offer. Residents appreciate access to Westport's town beaches, top-rated schools, and convenient commuting options. Available unfurnished for preferably 2-year lease term.

Enjoy one of Westport's most convenient locations from this 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath rental home with two parking spaces and a fenced backyard with patio. Both full bathrooms have just been renovated, many interior spaces have been freshly painted, and first-floor wood floors refinished. Comfortable living spaces extend across three levels, including a finished lower level that works well as a recreation room, home office, workout area, or flexible-use space. All three bedrooms are located together on the second floor. Convenient to Saugatuck Center, Metro-North, I-95, and the many amenities that make Westport such a sought-after place to live, including Main Street shopping and dining, the Westport Library, Levitt Pavilion, Compo Beach, Longshore Club Park, tennis, pickleball, recreational opportunities, and the Saugatuck River.

Set on over an acre of beautifully landscaped, level property, this freshly updated Westport home offers the perfect balance of everyday comfort and effortless outdoor living. A welcoming front porch leads inside to hardwood floors throughout and a thoughtfully designed layout where the open kitchen flows seamlessly into the family room, formal dining room, and living room with a wood-burning fireplace. Sliders off the family room open to an expansive deck overlooking the private backyard featuring an in-ground pool, spa, fire pit, and generous lawn with plenty of space for recreation and entertaining.  The bedroom wing of the home provides privacy and functionality, highlighted by a spacious primary suite with a full wall of closets and an en-suite bath, along with well-proportioned secondary bedrooms sharing a hall bath. The finished lower level expands the lifestyle with a media room and additional family room with direct pool access, a full bath, dedicated home office, flexible gym space, laundry room, and access to the attached two-car garage. A newly paved driveway provides plenty of parking.Perfectly positioned just moments from Westport's schools and centrally located for everyday convenience, you'll enjoy easy access to the train, downtown shopping and dining, Wakeman Town Farm, parks, beaches, and everything that makes Westport such a special place.

Commuters' delight! This hidden gem is a recently renovated and updated 1 bedroom in charming Westport close to train and downtown for enjoyable restaurant dining & lots of shopping. Just a short stroll to picturesque Old Mill Beach and moments from vibrant downtown Westport, this home offers the perfect blend of coastal living and everyday convenience. A welcoming sunroom greets you as you enter, filling the home with natural light and creating the perfect space to relax or entertain. Sun-drenched rooms, hardwood floors throughout, and a thoughtfully designed layout make this home warm and inviting. The main level also features a bedroom and a full bath, offering flexibility for guests, a home office, or convenient one-level living. The finished lower level provides additional living space ideal for a family room, recreation area, gym, or playroom. Step outside to a private backyard with a charming deck and pergola, perfect for outdoor dining or relaxing. Enjoy easy access to all of Westport's amenities, including the natural beauty of Long Island Sound, golf, tennis, swimming, and boating at Longshore Club Park. Set on just over an acre in a convenient Westport location, 2 Quarter Mile Road combines comfortable living, modern updates, and outdoor spaces designed to be enjoyed throughout every season. Professionally landscaped grounds showcase mature specimen and evergreen trees, perennial gardens, and expansive lawn areas that create both beauty and privacy. Inside, natural light fills the home, highlighting light oak hardwood floors and a floor plan that flows effortlessly from room to room. listings.remarks: In the owners' words...  We moved to this home looking for an escape from city life and a place to grow our family. It has offered us all of that and more.   Every inch of the home serves a purpose, creating a space that feels intentional and complete. The thoughtful size and open layout means we are never far from one another. We can prepare meals in the kitchen while watching our little ones play in the family room. It truly brings a family together.   With an abundance of windows, the living area draws the outdoors in and floods our home with natural light. We love enjoying a cup of coffee in the breakfast nook while looking out at the yard and appreciating the beauty of each season.   Outside, we all spend countless hours exploring the spacious yard - racing around the house, crossing the bridges, searching for frogs in the brook. This is a home that lets us embrace nature.  As much as this home feels like a private retreat, we love the convenience of its central location and being able to get anywhere within Westport, from town to beaches to schools, in a few minutes.   Over our years here, this house became a home, a truly special place to grow our family.

Prominently situated at the end of a private enclave surrounded by nature is where you will find 4 Nappa Lane. This beautifully renovated home offers a serene escape while being perfectly positioned just minutes from everything Westport has to offer. Step inside to discover a bright, open interior where modern updates meet effortless style. The heart of the home features a fully renovated kitchen that flows seamlessly into spacious living areas, all framed by large windows and sliders to the outdoor deck that bring the lush greenery of the outdoors in. Each room has been thoughtfully refreshed with refinished hard wood floors, beautifully tiled kitchen and baths and a neutral palette, creating a sophisticated backdrop for any lifestyle. The primary suite serves as a tranquil retreat, complemented by an additional en-suite, and 2 other well-appointed bedrooms that offer versatility and flexibility. A partially finished walkout lower level offers a flexible space for work or play. The back garden provides a private oasis for relaxing or entertaining. With its blend of modern luxury and a secluded, natural setting, this home is a rare rental opportunity in a prime location. The landlord requires an application form filled out along with copies of credit scores from one of the three major credit bureaus for each occupant over the age of 18. Please ensure the credit report is no more than 30 days old and excellent credit is a must.

A wonderful opportunity to make this home your own. The property offers the potential to be converted back into a single-family residence and is ideally located just moments from vibrant Main Street, Saugatuck Village, the train station, and local schools.

Beautifully kept and updated Antique Colonial with the Charm of Yesteryear-adapted to today's lifestyle. Fenced in back yard with additional party deck, sited in the heart of Westport. Convenient to town, schools, shopping, restaurants and train. Hardwood Floors, arched doorways, lovely living room with fireplace, formal dining room, Study/Office and library. Newer, updated white kitchen with marble countertops,soft close drawers, eat in kitchen area, Wolf range, Miele Dishwasher and Subzero Fridge/freezer. Ensuite Primary bedroom with walk in closet, plus two additional bedrooms. Full bath and laundry on second floor. Zoned A/C. City water, city sewer, natural gas. Meandering brook does not affect house in periods of heavy rain. Hardwood Floors, arched doorways, lovely living room with fireplace, formal dining room, Study/Office and library. Newer, updated white kitchen with marble countertops, eat in kitchen, ensuite Primary bedroom, plus two additional bedrooms. Full bath and laundry on second floor.   Second floor windows to be replaced before new tenant takes possession. Available for lease starting August 28, 2026

YEARLY OR FLEXIBLE TERM FURNISHED OR UNFURNISHED LEASE AVAILABLE MID AUGUST! Experience an exceptional coastal lifestyle in the private waterfront enclave of Bluewater Hill in Compo Beach. Set on one of the area's premier streets, residents enjoy access to private association tennis courts & are just steps from Compo Beach & the LI Sound. This sophisticated 6,200-square-foot contemporary residence with 5 bedrooms, 4 full & 2 half baths offers year-round water views along with a rare blend of refined design, relaxed elegance, & effortless indoor-outdoor living. Thoughtfully designed with a flexible floor plan suited to a variety of lifestyles, the home seamlessly balances grand entertaining spaces with comfortable everyday living. Sun-filled formal living & dining rooms flow into a stunning family room & gourmet kitchen, while three private bedrooms on the main level open directly to beautifully landscaped grounds featuring a heated in-ground pool & hot tub, creating the ultimate setting for gatherings & summer entertaining. The serene second-floor primary suite offers a spa-inspired bath, expansive walk-in closet, private office, & private deck with stunning views. An additional bedroom & sitting area provide peaceful spaces to unwind. Finished lower level ideal for recreation, fitness, or media. Moments from Longshore, downtown Westport, train & I-95.

listings.remarks: Experience the best of Westport living in this beautifully FULLY FURNISHED contemporary retreat, ideally located near Green's Farms Train Station and Burying Hill Beach, and everything the area has to offer. Bathed in natural light, the open, airy floor plan features soaring ceilings, a gourmet eat-in kitchen with professional appliances, and inviting living spaces that flow effortlessly to the outdoors through sliding glass doors and a multitude of windows. Set on a picturesque one-acre property with a lap pool, the home is designed for relaxed everyday living as well as effortless entertaining. A main-level office and small second bedroom with a full bath offer flexibility, while the spacious upstairs primary suite features a private deck overlooking the beautiful grounds, generous closets, an en-suite bath, and laundry. There is a detached one-car garage with a pool room with sliders opening to the pool. Available immediately and fully furnished-simply unpack, settle in, and enjoy the very best of Westport!

Welcome to Belden Place! Casual Luxury living personified in this boutique complex offering exquisite in-town living. This secure building with elevator access on the Saugatuck River is pet friendly. These luxury apartments are perfectly appointed and designed: plenty of closet space and storage, custom cabinetry, high-end appliances, in-unit washer and dryer, and private balconies. Enjoy the convenience of downtown living and inspiring river views in these beautifully renovated historic buildings in the robust downtown village. Leave your car at home and walk to everything the downtown community has to offer: restaurants, shopping, entertainment and more. Belden Place features fourteen one- and two-bedroom luxury apartments. Enjoy luxury living on the Saugatuck River at Belden Place. Each apartment features a private deck, custom cabinetry and high-end appliances, elevator access and more!

Privately nestled in Westport's coveted Old Hill neighborhood, this extraordinary five-bedroom New England residence offers a rare opportunity to own a home where timeless character & modern comfort come together beautifully. Thoughtfully updated while preserving its remarkable architectural details, the residence features sun-filled interiors, beautifully scaled rooms, & an inviting warmth throughout. Original elements reflect the home's storied past, while carefully integrated updates provide exceptional comfort for today's lifestyle. A standout feature is the distinctive pub room with its original wood bar - an unforgettable setting for intimate gatherings, celebrations, or quiet evenings at home. The versatile third level offers endless possibilities as a private guest retreat, second primary suite, or home office. Outside, mature specimen trees, flowering gardens, rolling lawns, and elegant stone terraces create a private retreat that evolves beautifully with the seasons. Completing the property is a charming barn with electricity, water, cable, & convenient parking, offering exceptional flexibility as a studio, workshop, recreation space, or a future vision uniquely tailored to the next owner. Just minutes from downtown Westport, award-winning schools, shopping, restaurants, beaches, & the train, this exceptional property presents a rare opportunity to become the next steward of one of Westport's most treasured homes. A truly special place to call home!

listings.remarks: Imagine a residence where every element has been considered for gracious living in stylish surroundings. This newly completed home by awardwinning Able Construction is set on a peaceful Coleytown estatearea street, framed by scenic land that enhances its sense of calm. A dramatic foyer with a woodaccented ceiling and millwork feature wall introduces interiors defined by creative decor, walls of glass, and exquisite lighting. The great room, anchored by a marble fireplace and French doors to the pool and patio, flows into the designer kitchen with a striking island, stone counters, custom cabinetry, Thermador appliances, and a beautiful and functional pantry. The dining room is a jewel, offering an elegant setting with illuminated shelving and views of the grounds. A quiet office and superb mudroom add daily convenience. A glasslined stair tower leads to sunfilled bedroom suites, beginning with the sublime primary suite set beyond double doors. An arched entry reveals a kingsized bedroom with balcony, two custom walkin closets, and a spalike bath with glass shower and distinctive vanity. The upper level also offers a laundry room with double washer and dryers and access to the finished thirdfloor bonus space. The lower level includes a fifth bedroom suite, recreation room, gym and media areas, and generous storage. Outside, the pool becomes the centerpiece for entertaining and relaxing at this designcentric showplace of style.

Get ready to make 19 Vineyard Lane home! This wonderful family home is ideally situated in the heart of Westport, offering 5 bedrooms and 2.5 baths designed for comfortable, everyday living and effortless entertaining alike. Lovingly cared for by its current owner for 50 years, this home features a first-floor office, while the partially finished basement offers space for a gym or playroom. Set on 1.24 flat acres, beautifully maintained with mature trees, an irrigation system, and room for a pool. Additional highlights include a whole-house generator, security system, irrigation and central air conditioning.  Location is everything, and this home delivers. It's walkable to Wakeman Town Farm, to the playing fields at Wakeman and to Staples High School, making morning drop-offs a breeze. Right around the corner is recently opened local favorite Gruel Britannia, perfect for a quick coffee, bite, or catch-up with neighbors.  This is more than a house - it's a place to put down roots in one of Westport's most desirable neighborhoods. Convenient to schools, beaches, shopping, and minutes to the train for seamless access on Metro North to NYC. Homes like this don't come along often.

Experience the future of coastal living in this brand-new smart home located just steps from the sands of Compo Beach. This is the only just-completed residence on the Compo Beach side of Westport delivered as a fully integrated, self-monitoring home: rooftop solar power w/battery storage, intelligent load management, leak detection w/automatic water shutoff, energy-recovery ventilation, radiant heated floors, singular app-controlled lighting, shades, locks + HVAC. The house can be monitored + adjusted from anywhere in the world and stays powered on stored solar when the grid goes down. Designed by The O'Dell Group across three vertical levels + a panoramic rooftop deck w/gas fireplace, the home opens to Long Island Sound through full-height glazing & connects ground-floor living to a private loggia, heated gunite spa, + landscaped courtyard. Inside, the open kitchen pairs Subzero refrigeration + an integrated appliance package w/a generous island + pantry; the primary suite includes a private balcony + spa-style bath; a fully accessible shower is finished in stone, and a flexible main-level room w/full bath lives as an additional bedroom, home office, or guest suite. Iconic Compo Beach is just a short drive to the Metro-North station and about an hour to Grand Central/Midtown Manhattan. The Westport Project is in a category of its' own; a home engineered to take care of itself, and you, whether you're upstairs, in the city, or on the other side of the world.

listings.remarks: Just 383 steps from the sands of Compo Beach, this storied 1920s residence claims one of Westport's most sought-after addresses. Approximately 3,255 square feet hold five bedrooms and four baths. An open, updated kitchen with top-tier appliances flows into the living and gathering areas. The primary suite is a generous retreat with vaulted ceilings, a spa bath, and a walk-in closet. Four additional bedrooms are ample in scale - one en-suite, with a Jack-and-Jill bath connecting two others - while a full bath and a dedicated office complete the first level. Outdoors, an expansive terrace invites al fresco dining and entertaining above a manicured, secluded yard set on a coveted corner lot. Beyond the door: sunrise strolls to the water, sunsets over the boardwalk, Longshore Club, downtown shops, dining, and the library, plus a straightforward Manhattan commute via Saugatuck Metro-North. Homes in this enclave seldom surface.

Are you dreaming of an estate property? Something a bit more than the generic flat acre on a cul de sac? How do two acres on the Aspetuck River sound to you? With views from your bedroom? The sounds of a waterfall next door lulling you to sleep? Having sunnies tickle your toes in the summertime? Maybe a bit of fly fishing for trout? Or perhaps some paddleboarding? Yes, of course, there's a 20x40 salt water pool, but . . the river - wow! Welcome to the latest offering from CCO Habitats - a new construction home with over 8300 sf of finished space on 3 floors. A floorplan you will love, with not only 2 designated offices, but a private first floor bedroom as well. Organic modern, warm and inviting, with a calming palette sure to blend with and enhance your personal taste. An open starfish floorplan for togetherness as well as privacy. 10 foot ceilings on the first floor. Luxurious European oversized doors and windows provide amazing natural light. Custom cabinetry throughout. 6 bedrooms, 6/2 bathrooms. All of the bedrooms are ensuite with walk in closets. The wine room - where it belongs - in the dining room. An amazing gym that will tempt even the people least prone to exercise into movement. A walk out lower level that doubles as a pool house, complete with a second laundry, full bath, wet bar, and entertaining space. It's all here; only a mile from the award winning Coleytown schools. This is the one you've been waiting for. Unique. Special. Just like you. :)

listings.remarks: Tucked away on a quiet cul de sac in the desirable Hunt Club area of Long Lots in Westport is a new construction lux home from CCO Habitats. 3 levels of finished living space with 10 foot ceilings on the 1st floor give an amazing sense of openness, as well as better functionality than 4 level homes. Think about it. Who really wants to walk up to the third floor every day? That's right; no one. And you don't want your guests walking past your bedroom to get to a third floor guest room either. The family bedroom floor should be private. Wider homes are much more desirable & functional than taller homes. The home has a generous first floor guest bedroom & full bath. Much better. It's not just for grandma you know, although she will love it. Who knows when you're going to tear your meniscus or ACL?? Pickleball hurts! :) Or - it's a great, convenient play room for little ones. Or a gamers' paradise for the older set. #Choices. We also have two designated offices; one on the first floor & a second in a private wing with its own staircase on the second floor. Three wet bars and a dry bar. Custom cabinetry & built ins throughout. There's a 20x40 salt water pool. Oversized tilting European windows & sliders drench the home in natural light. Organic modern; warm & functional. A true walk out lower level that easily doubles as a pool house with a full bath, second laundry and entertaining spaces. A full house generator and even an EV outlet. It's all here. Come visit. Come home.

listings.remarks: Welcome to 3080 Sturges - Fully Renovated Home set on 2.44 private acres in Fairfield's Greenfield Hill enclave on the Westport border. Offering a Westport mailing address together with Fairfield's acclaimed schools and amenities, this 7,317-square-foot modern residence blends architectural scale with contemporary comfort and luxury.  A dramatic two-story foyer introduces interiors defined by soaring ceilings, skylights, and oak hardwood floors throughout the home. Just off the foyer, a screened porch offers a peaceful setting for indoor-outdoor living and entertaining.  Designed for both everyday living and entertaining, the main living spaces center around a gourmet eat-in kitchen appointed with Sub-Zero refrigeration, a Wolf range, Wolf double ovens, Wolf built-in microwave, Miele dishwasher, Marvel undercounter ice machine, quartz countertops, and a gas fireplace. Complementing the kitchen is a walk-in pantry featuring a second full refrigerator, wine refrigerator, and custom cabinetry for exceptional storage and organization. Adjacent to the kitchen, the formal dining room features custom built-in cabinetry and ample space for entertaining. Additional highlights include a grand living room with dramatic cathedral ceilings, expansive skylights, and exceptional scale, flowing into an adjacent music room with a custom tray ceiling. The home also features a private office with fireplace, billiards lounge, fitness studio, and a second laundry room.

listings.remarks: Location, location, location! Located at the center of Saugatuck. Walking distance to train, restaurants, rowing club, gym, close to Compo Beach, Longshore, Golf, and tennis! Historic Landmark Queen Anne Victorian House c. 1899 with beautiful architectural detail. Well maintained and updated. Grand windows surround the house with light, featuring 9-foot ceilings on the main floor and a wonderfully spaced layout. There are 3 bedrooms, 3 baths, and a den that could be a 4th bedroom. Additionally, there is a large attic and 2-story detached garage with lots of storage. Don't miss this opportunity to call Westport your home and take advantage of the top-rated schools and many fabulous amenities.

Your private oasis awaits! This beautifully renovated home offers an ideal location with easy access to town, shopping, and the beach. Designed with comfort and style in mind, the home features inviting living spaces including a two-story family room with an open staircase. The gourmet eat-in kitchen is open to a sitting area with a corner fireplace. Two family bedrooms with en-suite baths complete the main level. Upstairs, an additional living area is perfect for family movie nights. A large primary suite and additional bedroom suite surround the second level. Step outside to enjoy the ultimate outdoor lifestyle-lounge by the sparkling swimming pool, relax under the pergola, or retreat to the pool house before gathering for al fresco dinners on the terrace, complete with a built-in grill. The large, level backyard is perfect for outdoor fun and catching fireflies on warm summer evenings. A rare opportunity to own a slice of paradise.

Set on a picturesque 0.30-acre lot, this ranch-style home is full of potential and waiting for your creative vision. While the home is being sold as-is the possibilities are endless. Whether you're an investor, a builder, or a homeowner with a vision, this property offers the perfect canvas to bring your ideas to life. Situated in a sought-after neighborhood with close proximity to downtown, shopping, beaches and parks, this property pairs endless possibilities with an unbeatable location. In this private road residence has access to a dock on the on the picturesque Saugatuck River where neighbors can go kayaking tubing or simply soak in the serene views

In today's world, there is nothing more important than having a place to gather. This private retreat with a stunning residence and amazing recreational facilities can become your own private sanctuary with a tennis court, heated Gunite pool and separate pool house set among lush, meticulously curated grounds on almost 2.4 acres. This 6,700-square-foot shingle-style residence offers refined luxury across three expansive levels, combining architectural sophistication with a warm sense of livable comfort. The main level flows beautifully and showcases dramatic interiors with large gathering spaces, gourmet kitchen facilities and incredible entertaining capabilities. The main floor primary suite serves as a luxurious private retreat with his and her bathrooms and separate sitting room/office. Upstairs, three additional bedrooms continue the home's commitment to comfort and privacy. The finished lower level extends the home's appeal with numerous recreational spaces and a full bath. Beyond the impressive interiors, the grounds are truly breathtaking. A rhythm of blooming flowers and mature landscaping creates a sense of beauty throughout all four seasons, thoughtfully designed to offer year-round color and serenity. Located on a private cul-de-sac, this home is a true compound-balanced, gracious, and masterfully executed, offering unparalleled living inside and out. Once you have arrived, it will be hard to leave!

An impeccable home in an incredible location! Just a stone's throw to Compo Beach, Ned Dimes Marina and Longshore Club Park, this gorgeous 4 bedroom, 4.5 bath modern Colonial with a pool is beach neighborhood perfection. The main floor is beautifully arranged, the family, dining area and kitchen span the back of the house creating a great room - with French doors to the patio and pool just beyond. The gorgeous kitchen is down in white oak, with a massive island, top appliances and smart storage. Gorgeous custom details throughout include built ins, dramatic modern millwork, sleek fireplaces and high end stone surfaces plus an elevator. Upstairs, the primary suite is a dream - a bright and airy bedroom, two walk in closets, and an oversized bath with soaking tub, steam shower and radient flooring. There are two additional bedrooms on the second floor, plus an office and laundry room. The third floor holds a bedroom and full bath. Tucked on a quiet side street steps to the water and all the Compo/Longshore area amenities like beach, boating, golf and tennis, while also being just a quick ride into town or to the train!

A rare opportunity in the heart of Westport's coveted Saugatuck section. Set on 1.10 dry acres w/ beautiful views overlooking the Saugatuck River, this property known historically as Twin Hickory's offers a unique blend of history, charm, & future potential. Rich in character & dating back more than a century, the property traces its roots to the Franklin M. Raymond estate. Orig constructed as a barn in the late 1800s & thoughtfully converted into a residence in the 1930s, the home & accompanying barn remain a fascinating piece of Westport's architectural history. The existing residence offers approximately 3,345 sq ft of living space w/ 5 bdrms, 3.5 ba. Filled w/ warmth & character, the home presents endless possibilities for restoration, renovation, or reimagining. Set back from the road & accessed from both Riverside Ave & Cherry Ln, the property enjoys an exceptional setting just minutes from downtown Westport, the train station, award winning schools, parks, restaurants, shopping, & major highways. Builders & developers take notice. With half acre zoning, no wetlands, dual street frontage, beautiful river views, & a prime location, this property offers exceptional redevelopment potential & a rare opportunity to create something truly special. Whether your vision is to preserve a piece of Westport history, renovate an architecturally significant home, or build a custom dream residence, opportunities of this caliber & flexibility are increasingly rare.

Charming newly renovated house on a great quiet cul-de-sac. Convenient to schools, parks, shopping, and transportation. 4 bedrooms, 2 baths, wonderful screened porch, fenced yard updated kitchen and baths. Fantastic Long Island Sound community with outstanding school system and great recreational opportunities.

A new opportunity to own in The Mill, now completely sold out, this is the first resale opportunity within this highly sought-after community.  This thoughtfully designed residence features floor-to-ceiling windows, beautiful European Oak floors, and a sleek linear gas fireplace anchoring the living space. The open-concept kitchen includes an oversized island, custom Poliform cabinetry, and high-end appliances-ideal for everyday living and entertaining.  A smart split-bedroom layout offers privacy, with bedrooms on opposite sides of the home. The primary suite features two walk-in closets and a bath with dual vanities, heated floors and a rain shower.  Enhanced beyond its original offering, this home now includes custom electronic shades, designer wall coverings, and added frosted glass for privacy.  Upstairs, a nearly 600 sq ft private rooftop terrace extends your living space outdoors. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, parking, and storage.  Residents enjoy a landscaped courtyard with a 45' lap pool and hot tub, grilling area, fitness center, Great Room, cafe, rooftop terrace, and concierge service six days a week.

listings.remarks: There is a moment just inside the front door, when the house introduces itself. The entrance hall-original, unhurried, exactly as gracious as 1919 intended-tells you everything. This is a home that was built when details mattered and time was taken. A century later, nothing essential has been lost. The living room and formal dining room carry that same quiet elegance, their proportions generous, their light beautiful through Anderson architectural-grade windows. Then comes the turn- into the 2013 addition, where a stunning chef's kitchen anchors a family room that opens through French doors onto a covered deck. Beyond it, a private landscaped backyard unfolds like a secret: lush, park-like, deeply planted and utterly your own. An outdoor shower with hot and cold water, a detached two-car garage, gravel driveway and an automated irrigation system make it as effortless as it is beautiful. Upstairs, the primary suite earns its name- spacious bedroom, sitting room, a spa bath, place to exhale. Three additional bedrooms, each with the soul of the original house, share a handsome hall bath.A finished third-floor now features two versatile offices and a full bath, offering flexible space ready for your next chapter. New roof, siding insulation, 4-zone A/C, sewer and water mains from 2013. 4300 SF set on .39 acres of one of Westport's most sought-after residential streets -walking distance to town.This home exudes charm and is completely, confidently, move -in ready.

listings.remarks: Imagine being able to view one of the town's loveliest Formal Gardens, from huge windows, throughout this stunning Mid-Century Modern home....Nestled tranquilly on a park-like private cul de sac, in Westport's highly-sought Coleytown neighborhood. 8 Bayberry Ridge is minutes from the Merritt and multiple Train stations. Become a resident of the Westport, CT community! Enjoy its pristine Beaches, superb public Golf course, upscale shopping, and thriving cultural life. This home offers 3,300 SF of Open, High-Ceilinged and Light-Filled space. The Kitchen/Living Room, with its charming timber beams, is one of several distinct and unique interior environments--all seamlessly connecting with the spectacular, Four Season Garden views, creating a colorful and ever-changing visual display from inside the home. Indulge in the Great Room with soaring Cathedral ceilings. Unwind in the Solarium, or take a refreshing dip in the Indoor Pool--ideal for year-round relaxation, fitness, and entertaining. The modernized Kitchen is equipped with high-end appliances. Lounge on the comfortable Screened Porch, surrounded by lush Nature. Retreat to one of the three Bedrooms, each with its Full Bath. The Finished Lower Level features a sauna, and a mirrored wall for dance or exercise. Garage has an EV charger. Multiple Patios + a Screened Porch beckon as perfect Outdoor Living and Entertaining venues. This rental provides a peaceful sanctuary, with its blend of indoor and outdoor spaces.

A rare opportunity to own new construction in Westport's coveted Old Hill neighborhood, offering refined design, a swimming pool, and a walkable lifestyle near Post Road and downtown. Tucked within one of Westport's most sought-after enclaves, this newly constructed 6-bedroom, 5.5-bath home blends architectural sophistication with modern livability. Natural light, clean lines, and well-proportioned spaces create an environment that feels both elevated and effortlessly comfortable. At the center of the home, a beautifully designed kitchen opens to expansive living and dining areas, creating a seamless flow for both everyday living and entertaining. The layout flows easily with ample room for work-from-home, multi-generational living, and evolving lifestyle needs. A main-level suite with a full bath provides privacy and versatility-ideal for guests, a dedicated office, or an extended family. Every detail accentuates comfort, function, and understated luxury. A back yard patio with pool abutting a nature preserve offers privacy with open space and the ease of in-town living. Positioned near Nash Pond and close to local nature trails and amenities, the home also offers exceptional convenience-walkable to the Post Road and just minutes to downtown Westport, shopping, dining, and Metro-North train service to New York City. Luxury new construction in Old Hill, Westport, CT-where location, design, and lifestyle align in one of the town's most desirable settings.

Unlock the potential of this exceptional corner lot property located in one of Westport's most desirable areas. Set on a prime piece of land, this property presents a rare opportunity for builders, investors, or end-users looking to create their dream home.  The existing structure requires renovation or may be best suited for a complete redevelopment, offering the perfect canvas for new construction. Surrounded by established homes and situated in a highly sought-after neighborhood, the value here is truly in the land and location.  Positioned on a corner lot, the property offers added flexibility for design, layout, and curb appeal-an attractive feature for those looking to maximize value.   Enjoy close proximity to town, schools, shopping, and commuter routes, making this an ideal setting for a custom home tailored to today's lifestyle.  Don't miss this chance to capitalize on a premier location and bring your vision to life.

Still hoping to move before school starts? This exceptional new construction home is ready for immediate occupancy! Built by SIR Development, Westport's premier luxury builder with 30+ years of experience and 300+ homes built, this hidden gem sits at the end of a cul-de-sac in a welcoming neighborhood within walking distance to Long Lots Elementary School. The open layout spans 4 beautifully finished levels and showcases SIR Signature Home craftsmanship and designer finishes throughout. The custom eat-in kitchen with butler's pantry features sleek white cabinetry with warm oak accents, quartz countertops, handmade ceramic tile backsplash and premium Thermador appliances, opening seamlessly to the inviting family room with fireplace. The main level also offers a private study with custom oak shelving, formal dining room, mudroom and powder room. The luxurious primary suite features vaulted ceilings, a spa-inspired bath and two walk-in closets. The finished 3rd floor includes a 5th bedroom and full bath. The walk-out lower level offers custom built-ins, recreation room, gym and half bath. Outside, enjoy a level backyard, spacious granite patio with room for a pool, professionally landscaped grounds and fencing for privacy. Connected to city water and sewer with propane gas, this move-in-ready home offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort and style.

Cute ranch located close to Compo Beach in Westport. Property features a beautiful private yard an acre and includes your own pond! Property has Belgian block walkway lined with lush landscaping leading you to the front door. Open floorplan with living area with fireplace and kitchen. Main level also features all 3 bedrooms. Good size deck off the kitchen looking out to the grounds and the pond. Basement features an additional finished room with sliders to rear yard, 2 car garage and laundry area. Owner/agent.

Set on 1.70 private acres in the heart of Greens Farms, this distinctive new construction by Dwell offers a rare combination of timeless design, exceptional privacy, and resort-caliber outdoor living. Offering 8,700+/- sq ft, this exceptional residence features 7 bedrooms, 8 bathrooms, and thoughtfully designed living spaces crafted with an emphasis on enduring design rather than passing trends. The chef's kitchen serves as the heart of the home with an 11-foot waterfall island, Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, custom cabinetry and millwork, and full scullery kitchen. Designed with both functionality and flexibility in mind, the home features a first-floor guest suite, expansive bonus room over the three-car garage, dual laundry stations, two wet bars, secondary staircase, 4 fireplaces, walkout basement, and ensuite bedroom accommodations on all four finished levels. Outdoor amenities include a heated 20' x 40' pool, covered outdoor living room with vaulted ceiling and wood-burning fireplace, sunken fire pit, expansive lawn areas, and professional landscaping with mature trees and multiple activity zones. Approximately one mile from Old Mill Beach and minutes to both train stations and town.

Boater's Paradise-Live the Ultimate Saugatuck Shores Waterfront Lifestyle. Experience unparalleled, direct waterfront access from this striking contemporary perched directly on the shores of Long Island Sound. Featuring its own rare private dock, this property is a true boater's/water lover's paradise. Enjoy all that Saugatuck Shores has to offer-boating, jet-skiing, paddle boarding, or kayaking from your own backyard. Dramatic walls of glass bathe the interior with natural light throughout effortlessly blending modern architectural lines with unparalleled, panoramic views of Bermuda Lagoon, Peck Ledge Lighthouse and boating channels which can be seen from almost every room. The open-concept main level transitions seamlessly to a massive sundeck, setting the ultimate stage for indoor-outdoor entertaining. Spend summers relaxing by your private waterfront gunite pool and spa, rinse off in your outdoor shower or unwind in the custom indoor sauna. Positioned within the coveted, private Covlee Beach Association, residents enjoy access to a private sandy beach with additional dock slips, kayak and paddleboard storage, a playground, picnic area, and fire pit just steps away, blending complete privacy with an active coastal community. From the Great Room with its dramatic fireplace and vaulted ceiling, to the custom Kitchen with fireplace, to the cozy Family Room and Study, there are so many spaces to delight. All bedrooms, including primary suite, have decks overlooking the Sound.

The front to back living room with marble fireplace offers peaceful views through expansive windows. The formal dining room with picture window is adjacent to a generous country kitchen featuring a bay window, granite countertops, a gas cooktop and double ovens. The oversized family room boasts a vaulted ceiling and access to main level laundry area. The rear of the house features a 58 ft long deck overlooking private acreage. The home contains 5 bedrooms and 4 full bathrooms. The primary suite includes a full bathroom, dressing area, linen closet and a walk in closet with built-in armoire. This home has fabulous closet space with each bedroom offering a minimum of 2 closets. The walk out lower level hosts a private den / office with wet bar and sliders to a stone patio. There is an additional laundry area and storage space that leads to an oversized 2 bay garage. Central air conditioning will keep you comfortable during summer months while five zone heating, Thermopane windows and extra insulation keep this home energy efficient all year long. Westport's luxury shops, fine restaurants, relaxing beaches and award winning school system combine to make this an irresistible value!

listings.remarks: Completely renovated Nantucket-inspired cottage with a cobblestone apron and crushed oyster shell driveway available for Yearly or Academic rental. 90 steps from Compo Beach! Easy flowing Living/dining room with exposed distressed beams and oversized windows maximizing water views from almost every room. Cook's kitchen w Thermador appliances, a coffee bar and all the accessories you could wish for. Large deck off the kitchen with a fire pit table & a Weber grill for BBQs whenever you like. Deep manicured lawn w sprinkler system, outdoor shower and bonus studio w Wifi possible office or gym. Second floor includes a Master bedroom with private deck with sectional & fire pit to enjoy spectacular sunsets and another bedroom with two twin beds. Lawn service and housekeeper maintained by owner. Outdoor shower. Westport also has a municipal country club called Longshore, which offers a newly renovated 18-hole golf course, tennis and paddleboard courts, two swimming pools, and a sailing school (with boat, kayak, and canoe rentals). Enjoy water community living at its best! 10 minutes to Metro North (commuter bus available) and I95. Available Sept 1 2026

Live the Westport lifestyle you've been dreaming of! Perfectly situated in one of Westport's most convenient neighborhoods, this charming renovated apartment places you just minutes from Compo Beach, the train, Saugatuck's renowned restaurants, Longshore Club Park, and downtown Westport. Filled with warmth and natural light, this inviting two-bedroom home features beautiful hardwood floors throughout, an open-concept living space with a skylight and decorative fireplace, and a well-appointed kitchen with granite countertops, a gas range featuring Air Fry mode, and a lighted ceiling fan. Efficient central air conditioning and heating, along with a newer roof, provide year-round comfort and peace of mind. Additional highlights include a private entrance, private attic storage with direct access from the unit, designated storage space in the shared basement, and a shared laundry area. Relax on your private front patio or enjoy the shared backyard, complete with additional storage beneath the deck. As an added benefit, the owner will retain the Compo Beach kayak rack membership; details are available upon request. Whether you're grabbing your morning coffee downtown, dining along the Saugatuck River, spending the day at Compo Beach, or catching the train into the city, you'll appreciate how effortlessly everything is within reach. Fixed utilities make life effortless. Welcome to 19 Hale Street...where convenience, charm, and the best of Westport come together.

This modern farmhouse was recently completed 2019 with highest level of craftsmanship, stunning interior and exceptional modern design. Covered front porch with seating area welcomes you and leads to grand front door entry with two-story foyer. Sun-filled open floor concept 9ft+ ceilings, white oak flooring and contemporary vibe. Fully furnished with essentials and many extras(bikes, scooters, and more). Custom kitchen/family room with marble counters, shiplap ceilings, a center island with breakfast bar, dining area, and a gas fireplace. Large barn doors from the family area lead to a formal living room that can be closed for quite time or opened for entertaining. The formal dining room, office, mudroom, and two half-baths are located on the first floor. A beautiful master suite with sitting area, x-large walk-in closet, and a luxurious marble bath is located on the second level. There are four additional bedrooms, one with en-suite bathroom and the other two sharing a Jack and Jill bathroom. Fifth bedroom are located on third level with full bath. Lower level is finished and offers over 1,800 square feet entertainment, pool, ping-pong, games, and fully equipped gym with bath. Backyard is fully fenced enjoy heated pool, covered porch with smart louvers that adjust with weather. Located right across "Earthplace," a nature preserve with lots of great walking trails, 62+ acres of open space, including a bird sanctuary, interpretive exhibits and nature inspired playground.

Beautiful first floor unit at 260 Riverside Ave new residential development. Private access to large 36ft covered porch. Launch kayaks/canoes, or enjoy afternoon fishing on Saugatuck river. Located in heart of Westport, walkable to Levitt Pavilion, KHS/SES sport fields, playgrounds and Westport Public library. Water views from every window. Across farmers market, Gilbertites, Birchwood country club and shopping. Short walk to MTA train station, Saugatuck Rowing club, Rive bistro, and so much more. Minutes drive from Compo Beach and Longshore, and SONO mall. Open floor plan, new kitchen and bath with Quartz counters, new stainless steel appliances, washer/dryer in unit, wired for internet, wired security system. Check out virtual tour.

listings.remarks: Charming Cape house situated on one acre of beautifully landscaped and maintained grounds. Prime location across from the Hunt Club with unencumbered views of serene horse stables. Enter the home through an inviting sun porch and convenient mudroom nook before stepping into the newly renovated kitchen. The spacious living room has an easy flow that is ideal for entertaining friends and spending quality time with family. The office/den area is ideal for those working from home or seeking a quiet space to focus. Off the kitchen, access a large back patio overlooking a heated gunite pool and sweeping backyard. Upstairs the home features 3 large bedrooms, ample closet space and 2 full bathrooms. You'll love the tranquility this private oasis provides.

Newly completed by Compo Luxury Homes, this exceptional modern estate offers approximately 9,200 square feet on 2.1 private acres just minutes from downtown Westport, Compo Beach, and Metro-North. Thoughtfully designed with European craftsmanship, premium finishes, and sophisticated smart-home technology, the home blends timeless design with exceptional functionality.  A dramatic floating staircase anchors four finished levels featuring soaring ceilings, custom millwork, and engineered white oak flooring. The chef's kitchen showcases dual quartzite waterfall islands, custom rift white oak cabinetry, a walk-in pantry, and a professional appliance suite. The primary suite offers cathedral ceilings, a fireplace, private balcony, dual dressing rooms, and a spa-inspired bath with heated floors and a soaking tub.  Designed for seamless indoor-outdoor living, the nearly 950-square-foot covered terrace features granite flooring, a wood-burning fireplace, outdoor kitchen, heated 20' 40' saltwater pool, year-round spa, and room for a future tennis or pickleball court. The walk-out lower level includes a family room, wet bar, fitness studio, guest suite, and flexible space for a theater, golf simulator, or media lounge.  Additional highlights include a DaVinci slate roof, premium European windows and lift-and-slide doors, Lutron lighting, whole-home networking, seven-zone HVAC, security system, and a 32kW Generac generator.

Available August 19. Welcome to this charming, sun-filled four-bedroom, three-bath home tucked away on a peaceful Westport cul-de-sac. The inviting main level features a spacious living room with recessed lighting and a wood-burning fireplace, an elegant formal dining room with wainscoting, and an updated eat-in kitchen. A separate family room offers a second wood-burning fireplace, tile flooring, and large windows overlooking the front yard. Three bedrooms with hardwood floors and two full baths complete the main level. Upstairs, a private fourth bedroom features an updated en-suite bath, a generous closet, and wall-to-wall carpeting. Enjoy outdoor living on the screened-in porch and rear patio-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Additional amenities include an attached two-car garage and ample storage space. Conveniently located just minutes from downtown Westport, shopping, dining, the Levitt Pavilion, Westport Country Playhouse, and Westport's award-winning schools. Please note that the home does not have central air conditioning; several window units are provided. Turtleback Road is private, with an informal association that shares snow-plowing costs of approximately $250 annually, depending on snowfall. Excellent credit and references are required.

Panoramic views of Long Island Sound extend from this gated, resort-like estate. Designed to maximize its spectacular waterfront setting, the east-facing main house takes in the coastal views from walls of windows, glass French doors, and private balconies. Effortless indoor-outdoor flow defines the main level, where a charming screened-in porch and awning-covered veranda overlook a Gunite pool with spa. First floor rooms facing the water include the living room and office, both with fireplaces, the formal dining room and the open kitchen/family room. This floor also has a billiard/media room, full bar, refrigerated wine room, two powder rooms and laundry. Idyllic second floor primary suite features waterfront balcony and sitting room, 3 walk-in closets and marble bathroom. Three additional en-suite bedrooms, each with balconies, complete this level. Perched on the third floor is a home gym with waterfront balcony, full bath and sauna. Newly added wing above attached two-car garage with one-bedroom guest suite. Perfect for summer entertaining, the backyard terrace offers a bar with built-in barbecue and a sitting area with firepit by the pool. Beyond the manicured lawns, the 168-ft seawall leads to an 80-ft pier and 20-ft private dock. Side yard with secluded outdoor shower, exterior-access powder room and kayak storage rack. Spacious two-bedroom guest cottage with 1.5 baths, kitchen, laundry and attached one-car garage. Commercial-sized generator powers main house & cottage.

listings.remarks: An exceptional offering on 1.38 private acres in the heart of Westport. Ideally situated just moments from vibrant Main Street, this centrally located property offers convenient access to shopping, dining, parks, tennis courts, beaches, the train, and Westport's award-winning schools. It provides an outstanding foundation for creating a one-of-a-kind estate. At the heart of this property stands the Studio-a remarkable 1,551-square-foot stone building designed and built in 1932 by Lewis Welch of Manhattan for renowned sculptor Berthold Nebel. Nebel's Westport estate originally encompassed nine acres, and this offering represents the last remaining parcel of his original estate. Berthold Nebel's daughter, photographer Lucia Nebel White, made the Studio her home and lived there until her death. The property has remained in the Nebel family for three generations. Today, the Studio includes one bedroom, one full bath, a full kitchen, and a dramatic open living space featuring soaring ceilings, a striking stone fireplace, oversized handcrafted timber doors, and exceptional natural light. Rich in character and architectural detail, the Studio offers a rare opportunity for restoration, thoughtful renovation, or integration into a distinctive new estate in one of Westport's most sought-after neighborhoods.

Experience modern coastal luxury in this custom-built, down-to-the-studs rental residence just minutes from Compo Beach and downtown Westport. Blending the scale and sophistication of a true custom home with effortless single-level living, this exceptional property showcases designer finishes and impeccable craftsmanship throughout. The sun-filled open floor plan features soaring cathedral ceilings, white oak floors, custom millwork, Marvin windows, and a striking porcelain fireplace. The chef's kitchen features custom cabinetry, premium Calacatta porcelain throughout the countertops, full-height backsplash, oversized island, and matching wet bar, complete with a dual-zone wine refrigerator, beverage cooler, and ice maker. Top-of-the-line Bosch appliances complete this exceptional space, designed for both everyday living and entertaining. Expansive tri-fold doors open to a spacious deck and private, fully fenced backyard with professional landscaping. The main-level primary suite offers heated bathroom floors, automated blinds, and spa-inspired finishes. The finished lower level includes a gym or recreation room, five-person infrared sauna, wine room, full bath, laundry room with GE appliances, and abundant storage. Additional highlights include smart home technology, integrated sound, a Tesla Universal EV charger, and an epoxy-finished garage. An exceptional rental offering in one of Westport's most desirable locations.

listings.remarks: Is this Westport or Provence? Sited high above Greens Farms is this charming and spacious renovated cottage on a prime, flat and open estate property. A water lover and swimmer's dream, with stunning, large heated pool (with kick pads) and spa (seats 8+). All-new gourmet kitchen, newly finished pickled wood floors, fresh paint throughout. Decorated for stylish and comfortable living, it's the perfect place to call home. Sunny living room, spacious family room with fireplace and wet bar. Private setting, away from main house. Walk to Greens Farms train station, quick bike ride to Burying Hill beach. Organic garden onsite with fresh herbs and occasionally vegetables available too! Full pool and spa privileges. See floor plans in attachments.

"Sherwood Farms"- a private enclave of upscale homes in Greens Farms designed by architect, Roger Ferris. Conveniently located near beaches, town owned golf club, tennis, sailing, train stations and all Westport has to offer in way of shopping & dining and the most desirable Greens Farm schools. Gracious interior features spacious, bright and open rooms with 9 ft. ceilings. Gourmet kitchen with granite countertops opens to a Gathering Room. Living room and gathering room feature fireplaces. Four oversized ensuite bedrooms. Fourth bedroom is a large private studio suitable as a home office or guest suite w/full bath. Outdoor amenities include open verandas and patio/terrace plus association pool and Clubhouse.

Rare Opportunity to own two private acres on the Aspetuck River in Westport. Tucked away at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, this gracious Colonial offers an extraordinary blend of privacy, natural beauty and relaxed country living. Set on two spectacular acres, the property extends to and beyond the banks of the river, creating a truly unique waterfront retreat. A natural riverside setting invites fishing, kayaking, and peaceful moments by the water's edge, where the soothing sounds of the flowing river provide a constant connection to nature. Mature trees frame the landscape, while a private tennis court enhances the exceptional recreational appeal and creates a remarkable park-like setting. Designed for both comfortable living and effortless entertaining, the home features a spacious living room, an elegant dining room with handsome built-ins, a den with dry bar, and a family room with FP. The thoughtfully appointed kitchen includes a farmhouse sink and Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances. An important recent improvement is a new roof installed approximately two years ago. Whether enjoying morning coffee on the screened porch overlooking the water, entertaining guests on the deck, playing tennis, launching a kayak, or unwinding beside the river at day's end, this home offers an exceptional lifestyle and rare opportunity to experience nature's beauty just minutes from all that Westport has to offer. The house is located in the X flood zone. There are multiple zones on property.

An exceptional opportunity to rent the main private residence of a spectacular waterfront home in Westport. Set along the Saugatuck River and including a pool, this tastefully renovated home in a prime location invites you to experience the very best of Westport living. Offering 4 bedrooms and 3.5 baths, the home provides generous space for comfortable everyday living. Thoughtfully designed work-from-home options allow for privacy and productivity, while a loft flex space and fully finished lower-level offer options for a playroom, gym, additional office and more. The home is beautifully appointed with a gourmet kitchen, luxurious baths, welcoming balconies, hardwood floors, and designer fixtures and finishes throughout. Available fully furnished, every space feels curated, comfortable, and effortlessly elegant. Outside, the waterfront living unfolds in every season allowing you to enjoy panoramic views of the river flowing through downtown and out to Long Island Sound. Quiet and private, yet moments to beaches, golf, exceptional restaurants, live entertainment, and more. Convenient access to NYC, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy refined waterfront living for the academic year. Please inquire with the listing broker regarding lease and conditions.

Enjoy a Country Club life-style in this fully renovated almost 2,000 square foot end-unit townhouse offering Primary & 2nd bedrooms, 2 baths both on the main level. The ante room welcomes you into the light-filled expansive living room w/gleaming floors, vaulted ceiling, custom built-ins & wood-burning fireplace. A separate large dining room, plus den/sun room provides ample space for comfortable living & entertaining. The den flows seamlessly off the living room & sliders invite you onto the private back patio. For ease of entertaining & located between the living & separate large dining room, utilize your built-in bar complete with wine cooler.

Custom built and well-maintained Ranch located in the "Old Hill" section of town, just minutes to Downtown Westport & Saugatuck dining and shopping, Route 1, Whole Foods, Stew Leonard's, I-95, the Merritt Parkway and Metro North. Large open living room/dining room combo with fireplace, flows directly into the bright and sunny kitchen/family room combo with second fireplace and sliders to the rear stone patio, making entertaining a breeze. Three additional bedrooms, full hall bath with double vanity, laundry area, half bath and two car garage complete this floor. In the lower level, you will find a large playroom, 5th bedroom (or office) and full bath with built-in sauna. Tons of additional storage space in the unfinished portion of the lower level with room to expand. With over 3,500 sqft of finished living space and many updates throughout the years... This home and neighborhood are bound to steal many hearts. Don't miss your opportunity. Set up an appointment to preview today! (Estate Sale - Subject to Probate)

Known as the historic "James Benedict" house, this central chimney (5 fireplaces : 3 gas and 2 wood burning) 3-story, post and beam construction residence is one of the more notable and better-preserved 18th century dwellings in town. All electrical fixtures have been updated with LED lighting. Three bathrooms updated. Plumbing fixtures, cabinet handles, door locks and most lighting fixtures are primarily Brushed Gold. New back splash. Wide plank floors were refinished. Dusk to down exterior lighting, Hot water baseboard gas heat and Mini split systems that provide high quality, low noise comfort AC Hot Water On Demand system will give you an endless supply of Hot Water. Home Automation items include WiFi Enabled Thermostats . House is also on the market for sale. Option to Purchase available.

3800 SF of total living space to enjoy! Expansive, four bedroom, four full bath home offers freshly painted rooms, polished hardwood floors and amazing storage, all ideally sited on popular Pipers Hill. The truly flexible floor plan encompasses 3.5 levels including a full, walk-out lower level and bonus den/family room above the two car garage. The formal living and dining rooms both boast bay windows, hardwood floors and wood burning fireplaces for gracious entertaining. The sun-filled, all white kitchen includes stainless appliances and a generous island for casual dining. Relax on the inviting screen porch or retreat to the oversized family room that could also easily be used for guests or as a home theatre. Upstairs the front-to-back primary suite includes a walk-in closet plus renovated bath with double vanities. There are 3 additional very generous family bedrooms on the upper level, all with hardwood floors, and a full hall bath. The walk-out lower level with laundry room, mudroom and an additional full bath is a sunny retreat for fun and games with sliders to the large back yard and has tremendous potential for added living space. Newer roof, added insulation and updated systems ensures peace of mind and no surprises. When you're ready to leave home, enjoy the nearly adjacent 140 acre Wilton Forest, or a hike at Weir Farm National Historic Park. This wonderful colonial is a happy home to call your own.
