listings.remarks: Beautifully constructed and thoughtfully designed, this exceptional 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom single-level home is privately set on a landscaped 0.70-acre cul-de-sac lot just minutes from downtown Wilton and the Norwalk River Valley Trails. Designed for today's lifestyle, the modern open-concept floor plan seamlessly blends indoor and outdoor living. The stunning chef's kitchen features a large quartzite center island, high-end stainless steel appliances, and abundant workspace - opening directly to an expansive outdoor deck ideal for entertaining and overlooking the flat, professionally landscaped backyard. The main living area offers an expansive entertaining space with fireplace and dining area, all positioned to enjoy beautiful backyard views. Adjacent to the kitchen is a cozy family room along with a flexible fourth bedroom or home office featuring stylish barn doors for privacy, a full bathroom, mudroom separate side entrance. The private bedroom wing includes three additional bedrooms, a separate laundry room, and a luxurious primary suite complete with tranquil backyard views, a spacious walk-in closet, and a custom-designed spa-like bathroom with double vanity and oversized shower. The lower level offers a large two-car garage with electric vehicle charger, extensive storage space, and a full unfinished basement ready to become a gym, recreation area, media room, or additional living space tailored to the next owner's needs.

Highest and best by 2:00 pm on Monday, 5/18. Set on a coveted lower Nod Hill cul-de-sac, 45 Ryders Lane is the kind of home that quietly wins people over the moment they arrive. Classic in style yet thoughtfully updated for modern living, this 4-bedroom Colonial blends timeless architecture with warm, inviting spaces designed for real life.  Inside, light pours through generously sized rooms, creating an easy elegance throughout the home. The renovated kitchen is both beautiful and functional, featuring a Wolf range, Sub-Zero refrigerator, and seamless flow into the home's casual gathering spaces. Nearby, the mudroom and updated laundry area make everyday living refreshingly effortless.   Upstairs, the primary suite feels like a private retreat, complete with a beautifully renovated bath featuring radiant heated floors and a heated towel bar. Three additional spacious bedrooms, an updated hall bath, and a walk-up attic provide flexibility for today's lifestyle.  Outside, summer practically writes its own plans. A charming screened porch overlooks the property, while the stone patio and expansive yard offer room for entertaining, gardening, or simply slowing down for the evening. Thoughtful improvements, including a new cedar roof, solar panels, upgraded electrical service, an invisible fence, and a new water heater, add comfort and peace of mind. A special home in one of Wilton's most sought-after neighborhoods.

Tucked away at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in desirable Lower Lower Wilton on the Westport border, this beautifully updated Colonial offers the perfect blend of privacy, convenience, and lifestyle. Set on 2.35 flat, dry acres with an in-ground pool, this 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home features approximately 3,500 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. A newly renovated eat-in kitchen showcases quartzite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and seamless flow for everyday living and entertaining. Spacious living and family rooms each feature wood-burning fireplaces, while a dedicated home office and sun-filled bonus room with polished concrete flooring provide flexible spaces for work, relaxation, or recreation. The second floor offers four generously sized bedrooms, including a spacious primary suite, along with the convenience of second-floor laundry. A walk-out lower level features an exceptional mudroom area with abundant storage and functionality. Additional highlights include city water, an ideal commuter location close to both Wilton and Westport amenities, and a rare combination of level land, neighborhood setting, and move-in-ready condition. Wired for generator. Underground electric.

Rarely does a home in Wilton offer true first-floor living with this level of renovation, layout, and neighborhood setting. Completely updated with a designer's eye, this Colonial is tucked into one of Wilton's most sought-after streets, just minutes to downtown, Metro North, the Wilton YMCA, schools, parks, and more. The main-level primary suite is a standout with a renovated spa bath featuring heated floors, soaking tub, oversized marble shower, and custom walk-in closet. The chef's kitchen anchors the home with a massive quartz island, 6-burner gas range, Walker Zanger backsplash, farmhouse sink, and seamless flow to both indoor and outdoor entertaining. The vaulted great room with shiplap, built-ins, and backyard access is where everyone naturally gathers. A separate office with built-ins plus an additional first-floor en suite bedroom with private entrance offers flexibility for guests, au pair, or in-laws. Upstairs are two spacious bedrooms, storage, craft room, and hangout/homework space. Finished lower level with wet bar adds even more usable space. Outside, enjoy the large bluestone patio and beautifully landscaped yard, perfect for summer dinners, morning coffee, or simply enjoying the neighborhood setting. This is the kind of Wilton home buyers wait for: updated, functional, full of character, and in a neighborhood people rarely want to leave.

listings.remarks: Best Value in Wilton! Featured in Fairfield County Home magazine, entitled "English Style," this little beauty was built by a retired Sea Captain in 1850 while the railroad was being built and was a popular Inn and Tavern.This multi-structure, 2.5 acre property is packed with Connecticut character! In addition to the pristine 3 bedroom Classic home, there is an oversized detached two car garage and a carriage house! Within the home there are lots of spacious rooms with gorgeous details and fun nooks and crannies making this a very special place to call home. The high-end kitchen is equipped w/custom white cabinetry, stone countertops, sub zero refrigerator/freezer/icemaker, GE Profile Gas Range and ergonomically-correct two-drawer Fisher Paykel dishwasher. There is a receiving room with radiant heat floors, (so welcoming on a winter's day), a music room/office, a true formal dining room, formal living room with fireplace, large sunny double home office/gym, a delightful "sea blue" walk-in pantry/bar. There are 3 bedrooms, 2 with with cathedral ceilings! Many major upgrades; Brand new On-Demand tankless hot water system, New electric panel 2019, New Central AC 2019, New engineered septic system in 2010 and huge air-jet tub. The yard has invisible dog fencing plus 2 fenced areas, safe for pooches or play and the property rambles beyond into your own private woods! This tasteful gem is in a convenient commuter location, only 50 miles to NYC! Many additional photos coming

Stunning, completely updated 4-bedroom home with flexible floor plan offering potential for a 5th bedroom, home office, or guest space! Set on a beautiful, level 2-acre lot at end of a cul-de-sac in Wilton's historic Cannondale neighborhood, this move-in ready home combines style, space, and location. The gorgeous updated kitchen features quartz countertops, custom tile backsplash, stainless steel appliances, and opens seamlessly to the sun-filled living room with vaulted ceilings, exposed wood beams, oversized windows, and slider to the massive deck overlooking the private backyard. The main level offers hardwood floors, spacious bedrooms and a primary suite with updated stall shower bathroom, while the lower level with luxury vinyl flooring provides incredible additional living space including a large bonus space/family room w/ wood burning fireplace, flex room/possible 5th bedroom, and full renovated bath. Central A/C, 2-car garage, and abundant natural light throughout. Enjoy the convenience of being walkable to Cannondale train station, while just minutes to downtown shopping, restaurants, schools, and major commute routes. Exceptional value and one of the best-prices opportunities in Wilton!

Turn-key, 3-bedroom, 2-full bath split-level home set on a level 2+ acre property in a sought-after neighborhood, perfect for walking and bike riding. Enjoy direct access to Sackett State Park, offering miles of scenic trails for hiking and walking your dogs. The updated kitchen features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a breakfast bar that opens seamlessly to the dining area and spacious living room, creating an ideal layout for everyday living and entertaining. Two bedrooms share a full bath, while the primary suite offers a walk-in closet, raised ceiling with skylight, and a private full bath. The finished lower level includes a welcoming family room with a fireplace, built-in shelving, office, full bath, and walkout access to the backyard and deck. Hardwood floors throughout, a gracious entry foyer, and fresh interior and exterior paint add to the home's appeal. Solar panels help keep electric costs low. Conveniently located close to town, schools, and New Canaan, this move-in ready home offers the perfect combination of comfort, convenience, and outdoor recreation. Don't miss this exceptional opportunity!

Nestled in the desirable Silvermine area just minutes from downtown Wilton, award-winning schools, and major highways, this charming home sits on a flat property near both New Canaan and Wilton town amenities. Surrounded by high-end homes, the property offers an open floor plan with endless opportunities to customize and make it your own. Inside, the bright and inviting interior, features hardwood floors on the main level, a sun-filled sunroom and a spacious living room with fireplace that opens seamlessly to the dining area - perfect for everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen is equipped with an island and stainless steel appliances, while the primary bedroom offers the convenience of a walk-in closet. The partially finished lower level adds valuable flexibility with a family room, laundry room, and mudroom, providing excellent additional living and storage space. Additional highlights of the home include a 1-car garage, 2-full baths and attic. Don't miss this opportunity!

A dream lifestyle, just minutes from town, 2 minutes walk to Schenk's Island and Bradley Park, 15 minute drive to SoNo train, and 3 minutes to NRVT hiking trails. Don't wait to see it!

listings.remarks: Welcome to 2 Pheasant Run, a meticulously maintained Cape-style residence set in a picturesque and peaceful setting that offers the perfect balance of privacy, comfort, and convenience. Designed for both relaxation and entertaining, the expansive wraparound deck overlooks a level backyard framed by mature trees, creating an inviting outdoor retreat. Inside, the thoughtfully designed main level features a bright white kitchen that opens seamlessly to a spacious family room with a fireplace, as well as a generously sized dining room ideal for gatherings. A separate music room and private office provide flexible spaces that can easily be customized to fit your lifestyle.The first-floor primary suite serves as a tranquil sanctuary, complete with sliding doors to the deck, dual closets, and a stunning recently renovated bath featuring double vanities and a dramatic glass-enclosed shower. Oversized windows throughout the home fill the interior with natural light. The upper level offers 3 additional bedrooms, a full bath, and 2 large walk-in attic spaces that provide exceptional storage. The finished lower level expands the living space with a large family room featuring a fireplace and bar area, a separate room ideal for a playroom or fitness space. There's also a laundry room & multiple unfinished storage areas. Offering a rare combination of space, privacy, and functionality, this exceptional home is conveniently located minutes from town, train, top-rated schools & highways.

listings.remarks: This captivating home offers a unique blend of architectural character, warmth, and modern functionality. From the moment you step inside, the soaring cathedral ceiling and open living spaces create an airy yet inviting atmosphere filled with light and charm. The great room serves as a dramatic focal point of the home, anchored by a contemporary freestanding wood-burning fireplace. The open-concept layout flows seamlessly into the dining area and Euro-style kitchen. A den, convenient powder room with laundry, and flexible living space complete the main level. An open staircase leads to two loft-style bedrooms with hardwood floors and a full bath with shower/tub combination, enhancing the home's distinctive design aesthetic. In addition, the seller has an approved 4-bedroom septic plan on file with the town, offering valuable future expansion potential. Outdoor living is equally appealing with a recently updated deck spanning the side of the home creating the perfect setting for entertaining or simply enjoying the peaceful surroundings. Set on nearly two acres, the property overlooks a distant pond and charming wishing well, offering a serene escape. Ideally located with convenient access to both Wilton and Ridgefield amenities including shopping, dining, entertainment, schools, and both the Branchville and Wilton train stations for commuting to NYC. Just over a mile from Weir Farm, this special property offers a rare opportunity for a full-time residence or weekend retreat.

Classic 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath Colonial offers the perfect combination of comfort, functionality, and convenience. Featuring an open floor plan with 9+ ft ceilings, hardwood floors, central air, city water, and sewer, this home is designed for today's lifestyle. The light-filled family room with gas fireplace opens to the gourmet kitchen featuring granite countertops, center island, stainless steel appliances including a gas range, and casual dining area with access to the private patio-ideal for entertaining. A formal living room, dining room, half bath, and remodeled laundry/mudroom complete the main level. Upstairs, the primary suite includes a walk-in closet and spacious bath with soaking tub, oversized shower, and double vanity. Three additional bedrooms and a full hall bath complete the second floor. The finished lower level provides flexible space for a playroom, office, gym, or media room. Notable improvements include new hardwood floors throughout, crown moldings, interior doors and hardware, upgraded lighting, kitchen backsplash, remodeled laundry room, custom closet systems, and finished basement. Major mechanical updates include new furnace and central air system (2023), new hot water heater (2024). Exterior improvements include house painting in 2024 and roof less than 6 years old. Located in well-maintained association w/ ground maintenance and snow plowing included, this home offers easy living just minutes from Wilton and Westport town centers, trains and hwys.

listings.remarks: Easy town and school access with a neighborhood feel.  This South Wilton 4/5 bedroom designer-owned home is set way back off the road and has an amazing convenient location. Owners and neighbors have created a wonderful community feeling with trails through the backyards leading to town! Built just nine years ago by Petrucci Builders, this beautifully appointed Colonial delivers the craftsmanship and character that buyers covet without the compromises of an older home. From the moment you step inside, the open, flowing layout draws you forward, where generous proportions, elevated ceilings, premium finishes and an abundance of natural light set the tone for a life well-lived. Whether you're hosting a dinner party that spills from the kitchen to the living room, or settling into a quiet evening at home, every space has been thoughtfully designed to meet the moment. Five generous bedrooms and 4.5 luxurious baths ensure everyone has room to breathe and privacy to retreat. The primary suite is in a category of its own: a true sanctuary, anchored by a fireplace that transforms even the coldest Connecticut night into something intimate and indulgent. And the location? Rarely does a home this polished sit this close to Wilton's beloved town center with its shops, restaurants, and the easy rhythms of a community that knows how to slow down without feeling left behind. BRAND NEW COOKTOP in kitchen and finished space on third floor and lower level makes this house live large.

HIGHEST & BEST OFFERS REQUESTED BY MONDAY, 6/22 AT 10:00 AM. Exquisite Dream Home in South Wilton: A Sanctuary of Elegance and Nature. Nestled at the end of a South Wilton cul-de-sac on an elevated site, this extraordinary home blends luxury with natural beauty. Surrounded by 83 acres of Bradley Park conservation land with hiking trails and a short walk to Wilton Town Center, it offers privacy and convenience. Spanning 5,560 sq ft, this light-filled residence features four spacious bedrooms, ideal for elegant living and entertaining. With 9+ ft ceilings, hardwood floors, two fireplaces, French doors, and deep moldings, the home exudes sophistication. The open layout includes a recreational room, an 800-bottle wine cellar, and a butler's pantry. A fifth or sixth bedroom can be added in the den/office or rec room. Over $400,000 in upgrades elevate this property, including a heated Signature  Gunite saltwater pool, a solar panel system with Tesla Powerwall, a Fiero Forni pizza oven, vegetable gardens, a chicken coop, and a slate patio with built-in seating for outdoor dining. Nature enthusiasts will enjoy proximity to Bradley Park, Norwalk River Valley Trail, and vast conservation land. Just minutes from NYC, this home offers luxurious living, privacy, and convenience-a true sanctuary and rare find.

Rare opportunity to experience refined living in this unique end-unit townhouse within Wilton Crest. Flooded with natural light, the home boasts airy, well-appointed interiors. A vaulted living room, complete with hardwood floors and a fireplace, seamlessly extends to a private deck offering serene pond views - ideal for relaxation or entertaining. The gourmet kitchen, featuring premium appliances and Corian counters, connects effortlessly to a bright dining space. Retreat to the primary suite with its private courtyard access and a luxurious, spa-inspired en-suite bath. A second spacious bedroom also includes a full private bathroom for guest comfort. The expansive, unfinished lower level provides unlimited potential for customization, from a home office to a media room. This low-maintenance residence combines comfort and convenience in a tranquil setting, a truly rare find.

Nestled on a picturesque property with protected open space directly across the street, 31 Vista Road offers privacy, charm, and flexibility in a convenient Wilton location just minutes to both Wilton Center and Ridgefield's vibrant shops and restaurants. Lovingly maintained, this inviting home blends timeless character with everyday comfort, featuring hardwood floors, exposed beams, a welcoming family room with fireplace, and an open dining area ideal for gathering. The eat-in kitchen overlooks the peaceful backyard and showcases its original vintage 1961 countertops alongside stainless steel appliances and abundant cabinetry. The **second-floor addition, completed in 2008,** added two spacious bedrooms, a full bath with a thoughtfully designed separate vanity and shower/WC layout, and a generous den connected by a spiral staircase to a finished 27' x 15' loft with standing headroom-ideal for recreation, hobbies, or storage. Surrounded by mature trees and level lawn, this special property offers the perfect balance of nature, convenience, and classic New England charm.

ALL OFFERS MUST BE SUBMITTED BY 11AM 6/9/2026. THANK YOU! A Rare Gem in a Serene Setting... This thoughtfully renovated South Wilton home is nestled in a quiet neighborhood on a private, sunlit lot. The beautifully landscaped yard creates a peaceful retreat while conveniently close to local amenities. This turn-key home boasts hardwood floors, high ceilings, large windows and natural light throughout. On the main level, the chef-inspired kitchen features an oversized stone island, perfect for gathering and entertaining. The impressive stone fireplace adds warmth and character to the living space. Down the hall is your ensuite primary bedroom and a second bedroom as well as a full bath. The large and light-filled den, currently used as an office, has a 1/2 bath adjacent. Step outside to enjoy the screened-in porch and oversized deck overlooking breathtaking scenery and a large, fenced-in wooded area. Or step onto the back yard patio to relax in nature. The lower level is a fabulous living space, including an expansive mudroom entry, large family room with wood burning fireplace, full bath and additional room with ample closet space. With generous storage, an oversized garage, and numerous updates, this exceptional home combines comfort, privacy, and convenience in a highly desirable location.  Minutes away are wonderful restaurants, shopping, theatre, entertainment, train station and schools.

Welcome to 172 Mather Street spacious updated home offering over 3,000 square feet of flexible living. Upstairs there are two to five large rooms that can be bedrooms, guest rooms, or offices. Newer kitchen with stainless steel appliances and granite counters that flow into a sunny breakfast room with walls of windows. Living room and dining room have hardwood floors and french doors leading to your screened in porch, the ideal place for morning coffee or evening glass of wine. Family room with sliding doors out to the backyard. This turnkey home is freshly painted with many updates. The house is set back from the road with city water, close to shopping, restaurants, and trains. With its versatile space and updates, this home offers endless possibilities.

Beautifully updated and tastefully appointed open-concept ranch in the highly desirable Silvermine neighborhood, conveniently located near the town centers of Wilton and New Canaan, Gray Barns, top-rated schools, train stations, and major highways. This exceptional home offers 3 bedrooms, 3 full and 2 half baths, with a thoughtfully designed layout ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The spacious primary suite features a walk-in closet and a luxurious spa-like bath, while two additional bedrooms include one with an en-suite bath. The heart of the home is the expansive kitchen with a large center island, seamlessly flowing into the dining area, family room, and inviting living room with fireplace. A mudroom, laundry area, playroom, and powder room complete the main level. Step outside to enjoy your private backyard retreat featuring a deck, patio, and in-ground pool, perfect for relaxing or hosting guests. A two-car garage provides added convenience and storage. Combining modern updates, timeless style, and an unbeatable location, this move-in-ready home offers the perfect balance of comfort, elegance, and accessibility.

Set on a beautifully landscaped, level property in South Wilton, 18 West Meadow offers exceptional indoor and outdoor living with convenient access to Westport, Norwalk, I-95, the Merritt Parkway, shopping, dining, and train service. This 4-5 bedroom home features a renovated kitchen with Absolute Black granite countertops, a large center island, breakfast area, Wolf cooktop and wall ovens, and a Sub-Zero refrigerator. The kitchen opens to the family room with custom built-ins, a wood-burning fireplace, and sliding doors to the stone patio. Sliders from both the family room and dining room create a seamless connection to outdoor living spaces. The main level also includes an office with a bay window, built-in bookshelves, gas fireplace, and backyard views. A formal living room features additional built-ins and a gas fireplace, while a large pantry provides ample storage. Upstairs, the primary suite includes a windowed walk-in closet, Juliet balcony overlooking the backyard, and a renovated, bath with soaking tub, walk-in shower, dual vanities, and private water closet, all with Porcelainosa fixtures. Three additional bedrooms are located on the upper level, including two with en-suite baths. A walk-up attic offers future expansion potential. Above the garage is a flexible living area with a bedroom, full bath, and separate access through the mudroom. The backyard features a stone patio, irrigation system, fenced vegetable garden, expansive lawn, and a whole house generator.

Tucked away on peaceful and highly sought-after Spectacle Lane, this property offers an exceptional blend of country-like privacy and convenient access to Wilton's top-rated schools, both Wilton and Ridgefield's charming town centers, and major commuter routes. It stands as a rare architectural masterpiece, having been lovingly restored to flawlessly showcase the soulful character and timeless craftsmanship of a 1925 home-an effortless allure that was recently featured in New York Magazine.   The estate provides an incredibly versatile living arrangement with a total of three bedrooms. The main house features two character-filled bedrooms and light-filled living spaces, while a separate, private one-bedroom guest quarters offers the perfect setup for weekend visitors, extended family, an au pair or home office. A standout feature of the property is the dramatic, dedicated art studio/home office in the main house, boasting impressive vaulted ceilings and an abundance of natural light. Throughout both residences, the thoughtfully designed spaces serve as a blank canvas, offering incredible aesthetic flexibility that effortlessly accommodates any decor style-from classic traditional to sleek modern minimalism.

With 2,736 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, this home is ideal for buyers seeking a peaceful setting without sacrificing access to town amenities, top-rated schools, commuting options, and vibrant communities. A covered Ipe front porch sets the tone, leading into a classic center hall layout featuring a front-to-back living room with a fireplace and bay window, a formal dining room, and a stunning, expanded chef's kitchen. Upstairs, three bedrooms each enjoy their own walk-in closet, while hardwood floors and central air conditioning enhance comfort throughout the home. The walk-out lower level offers exceptional flexibility, currently configured as a private in-law or guest suite with a family room, fourth bedroom, full bath, and large mudroom with exterior access. Existing plumbing allows for an easy kitchen installation should future needs require a fully independent living space. Additional highlights include a three-car garage and generous parking area. Located in the historic and highly desirable Silvermine section of Wilton, known for its artistic heritage, scenic roads, and timeless character, this special property offers a rare opportunity to enjoy the Fairfield County lifestyle at its best.

Tucked at the end of a private shared driveway far off the main road, this exceptional Wilton colonial has the feel of a quiet cul-de-sac - offering the perfect blend of privacy, space, and convenience. The heart of the home is an expansive great room that flows into a spectacular kitchen - ideal for everyday living and effortless entertaining - with sliders opening to a wraparound deck overlooking a beautiful, flat yard. The formal dining room is made for holidays and dinner parties alike. Upstairs, the generous primary suite is a retreat unto itself, complete with a walk-in closet, full bath, and a private office. Three full bathrooms serve the home, with a flexible fourth bedroom upstairs perfect for guests, a playroom, or a home office. A third garage bay provides excellent storage. Perfectly positioned in the heart of Wilton - just minutes to town center, Georgetown, Cannondale Station, and major highway access.

This charming home is set on over 2 flat acres in desirable South Wilton and offers the ease of single-level living just minutes from town, schools, and commuter routes. Thoughtfully maintained, the home features 3 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, along with a living room with wood-burning fireplace, separate dining room, and kitchen with marble counters. A second living area with a wood stove opens to a screened porch and spacious deck, overlooking the property with ample room for a pool. Recent improvements feature an AC and heating system, hot water heater, garage doors, and new roof. Additional features include a portable generator wired to the house and a 2-car garage.
